dialogue.text: The ruins will test you. Gather the rune stones scattered at the gate, and the arch will know its heir.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could have come with me.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I could have done many things for three hundred years. Go. I will follow when my shame lets me.

quests.title: Stones That Remember
quests.summary: Gather the lotus rune stones and read the old stele at the shrine. Someone has followed you from the sect.

objectives.text: Gather the lotus rune stones around the gate
Deal with Zhao Kang on the forest path

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look so surprised. You're not the only one who can walk through bamboo.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You followed me? From the sect?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Gu ordered me to keep an eye on you. He said you carry something the sect must protect.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Personally, I think it's a waste of my talents. But a Zhao obeys the Law Hall. So. Lead on, village brat.

objectives.text: Read the stele in the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Here the Verdant Lotus gave its heart. With the Azure Cloud we bound the Patriarch Xue Wuji beneath the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seal has two keys. The Lotus Key, which binds. The Azure Eye, which watches. Never let both fall to one hand.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Azure Eye... that's the formation array at home. And the Lotus Key is... your trinket?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Apparently my trinket is older than your clan.

quests.title: Stone Guardians
quests.summary: The ruins' stone sentinels wake at the sound of footsteps. Get past them and open the archway.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone sentinels at the gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stone men! Wonderful. My sword was freshly polished, too.

objectives.text: Set the rune stones into the archway

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rune stones slide into place one by one. The carved lotus on the keystone opens its petals.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: With a sound like a sigh, the vines fall away and the gate of the Verdant Lotus opens for the first time in three centuries.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It... opened. For you. Fine. FINE. I'm not impressed. I'm slightly impressed.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the arch lies a courtyard of green stone. At its centre kneels a giant statue, head bowed, hands resting on a sword.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Please tell me that one doesn't move.

quests.title: The Guardian of the Lotus
quests.summary: The inner courtyard is watched by the last guardian of the Verdant Lotus. It will not accept an heir without a trial.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the shrine

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I followed. My shame is slower than my feet, it turns out.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The guardian in the courtyard was carved by my master. It asks one question with its fists: are you worthy?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Do not fear it. It is not cruel, only very, very thorough.

objectives.text: Stop the sentinels reforming at the gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The sentinels are reforming. Break them again, quickly, before the guardian wakes!

objectives.text: Pass the trial of the ancient guardian

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The great statue lifts its head. Moss sloughs from its shoulders. A voice grinds like millstones: who bears the lotus?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I do. {player}, of the Azure Cloud. And of the Verdant Lotus.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then show me that the lotus has not wilted.

quests.title: Legacy of the Lotus
quests.summary: The guardian kneels. The Verdant Lotus left something for its heir.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside lies a jade slip carved with lotus roots: the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra, and a letter in an elegant hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: To whoever carries my key. I am sorry for the burden. It was always meant to be shared. Do not carry it alone.

objectives.text: Comprehend the Heart Sutra at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sutra unfolds in your mind like a flower opening underwater. Roots, stem, blossom. Patience, strength, compassion.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi begins to settle, layer upon layer, like silt forming bedrock.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You read it. I can see it in your breathing. The lotus grows in mud and is not stained.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred years I waited for someone to open that box. I thought I would feel relief. I feel... old.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Come back to the sect with me. Tell them what you know.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One day. Not yet. First I must forgive a coward, and he is very stubborn.

quests.title: Blood in the Shrine
quests.summary: Blood Moon scouts have followed your trail to the ruins and are defacing the stele.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon scouts from the shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're smashing the stele! Barbarians! That's at least a thousand years of calligraphy!

objectives.text: Check on Zhao Kang at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a scratch. Don't fuss. A Zhao doesn't bleed. We... tactically leak.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You stepped in front of that blade for me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't be sentimental. Nobody gets to defeat you except me. I've been planning it for months.

objectives.text: Gather herbs to treat Zhao Kang's wound

quests.title: The Law Hall's Interest
quests.summary: Back at the sect, everyone wants to see the Heart Sutra. Some want it more than others.

objectives.text: Return to the sect with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Home. I'm going to bathe for three days. Don't tell anyone I helped you. I have a reputation for being unbearable.

objectives.text: Show the Heart Sutra to Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra. I have waited my whole life to see this. I may cry. Don't look.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Keep it. It is bound to the Lotus Key and would only sulk in my shelves.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: And the missing pages... the fourth-floor log shows a Law Hall seal. The Law Hall borrows everything. It's how they keep us honest.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang tells me you found a Verdant Lotus relic. The Law Hall will take custody of it. For safekeeping.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: With respect, Elder, the Sect Master ordered me to keep it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Did she. Then keep it, disciple. Keep it very close. Things kept close are the easiest to lose.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu wanted the sutra? Don't take it to heart. He's been cold ever since his daughter died. Twenty years now.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu Lan. A bright girl. Meridian sickness. No pill could save her. He searched the whole world.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Grief is a heart demon that never stops whispering. Be patient with him, {junior}. For my sake.

quests.title: Preparing the Foundation
quests.summary: Establishing a foundation takes pills, spirit stones, and a clear conscience. You have one of three.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Hua for a Foundation Pill

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A Foundation Pill needs lotus root from the pond, gathered at dusk, and five spirit stones to fire the cauldron.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The stones come from the treasury. Good luck with that.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Five spirit stones? Five? Do you know what five spirit stones could buy? Five spirit stones!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's for a Foundation Pill. The Sect Master approved it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Approved it. Everyone approves things. Nobody counts things. Fine. Take them. Sign here. And here. And here.

objectives.text: Gather lotus root at the pond at dusk
Tell Xiao Man what you learned in Qingshi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You're back! Did you go through Qingshi? Did you see my brother? Did he say why he hasn't written?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Xiao Man... Xiao Shi was taken. By the same people who took the townsfolk. I think he's alive.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Taken? But he... he's so bad at fighting. He faints at the sight of needles.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Promise me you'll bring him back. No. Don't promise. Just... do it. Please.

quests.title: Foundation Establishment
quests.summary: With the Foundation Pill in hand and Han Xue standing guard, build the foundation of your dao.

objectives.text: Ask Han Xue to guard your breakthrough

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breakthroughs attract trouble. Heart demons, jealous juniors, very curious elders. I'll stand guard.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The plum garden is quiet at night, and Zhao Kang is too injured to sulk there. Go.

objectives.text: Establish your foundation in the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi pours downward like a waterfall into your dantian, and there it hardens, layer upon layer, into a foundation of jade.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the plum blossoms, a single green lotus flickers into being around you, and slowly sinks into your heart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I can feel every blossom on every branch. Is this what the elders feel all the time?

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Foundation Establishment

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Clouds pile up over the mountain, black at the heart. A foundation must be tested before anything is built on it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Foundation Establishment, and a Verdant Lotus sutra. You grow faster than my worries, {player}. Barely.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In one month the sect holds the Inner Sect Tournament. The winner earns a place at my side, and the Azure Eye's trust.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I want you to enter. And I want whoever cut those pages to watch you win.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Banners on the Mountain
quests.summary: The Inner Sect Tournament begins. Register with the Treasury Steward, then catch up on the gossip at the gate.

objectives.text: Watch the opening of the Inner Sect Tournament

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Banners of every peak ring the plaza. Disciples crowd the walls and railings. Someone is selling roasted chestnuts at twice the price.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Registration fee: two spirit stones. Non-refundable. Especially if you lose. Particularly if you die.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The Sect Master told me to enter. Personally.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Then the Sect Master can pay. Fine, fine. Waived. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

objectives.text: Hear the gossip from Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The betting pool is open! Yan Tie, three-time champion, two to one. Zhao Kang, five to one.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're at nine to one. I put three stones on you. Don't tell Steward Qian. Actually, win, then tell him.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Oh, and Elder Gu is supervising the pill supplies this year. First time ever. Very thorough man.

quests.title: Sharpening the Blade
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on one last training session before the preliminary round.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Right. Foundation Establishment. So the puppets need to be angrier. I've had them tuned up.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Four at once. If you get hit, you buy lunch. If you don't get hit, I buy lunch. Either way, lunch.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Not a scratch. I'm buying lunch. I'm always buying lunch. How did this happen to me?

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Listen. Yan Tie is strong, but he fights like a landslide, all at once. Make him chase you and he'll tire.

quests.title: The Preliminary Round
quests.summary: Three opponents on the formation plaza. Elder Mo is referee, and he does not believe in mercy.

objectives.text: Report to Elder Mo, the referee

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Rules: no killing, no crippling, no weeping on the formation. Last one standing advances.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: And {junior}? Don't embarrass me. I told the other elders you were adequate.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Begin!

objectives.text: Win the deciding bout of your bracket

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Two more from Cloud Peak who think they were robbed. Settle it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Hmph. Don't let it go to your head. Heads are heavy enough already.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Was that a compliment, Elder Mo?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: It was an observation. Go and eat something. You look like a boiled noodle.

quests.title: Whispers at Night
quests.summary: Zhao Kang slipped out through the moon gate after curfew. Follow him.

objectives.text: Follow Zhao Kang to the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A figure in gold-trimmed robes slips through the moon gate, carrying a bundle of incense sticks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sneaking out the night before the second round? What are you up to, Zhao Kang?

objectives.text: Confront Zhao Kang at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go ahead. Report me to the Law Hall. It's what they're for.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My elder brother Zhao Ming died a year ago tonight. A Law Hall mission. Bandits, they said, in the bamboo forest.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I burn incense here because he liked the view. That's all. That's all it is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm sorry, Zhao Kang. Who assigned his mission?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Gu. Same as yours. Why does that matter?

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Zhao Ming. I remember him. He was kind. He was also ambushed in exactly the place you were ambushed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Elder Gu assigned both missions. The Law Hall held the Blood Moon token. Law Hall seals are on the missing pages.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That isn't proof. It's a pattern. I'll watch the Law Hall. You win the tournament. Don't let him see you suspect.

quests.title: The Hundred-Disciple Melee
quests.summary: The second round is a melee on the plaza. Wei Tong was knocked out early and is taking it well. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Eliminated. By a girl half my size who hid behind a banner and poked me in the kidney. Twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Honestly, it was brilliant. I'm going to learn it. Go on. Avenge my kidney.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Second round! Everyone against everyone! Try not to hit the audience!

objectives.text: Help Lu Ping gather his scattered winnings

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: You're into the semifinal! I've won eleven stones! I'm rich! I'm going to buy a hat!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Also, a Law Hall disciple told me to stop betting on you. Rude, right? I bet more.

objectives.choice_prompt: Lu Ping's winnings came from betting on you. Gambling is forbidden in the sect.

choices.text: Tell him to give them to the Medicine Hall

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Report him to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Take a cut

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Poisoned Cup
quests.summary: Elder Hua has found something wrong with the tournament pills.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Frenzy Pills. Blood lotus and wolf's bane, hidden inside Vitality Pills. They burn a cultivator from the inside.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Three boxes were meant for the finalists' quarters. I need four moonbell herbs to brew an antidote. Hurry.

objectives.text: Gather moonbell herbs for the antidote
Ask Xiao Man what she saw

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The pill boxes? A disciple in Law Hall grey carried them in. He said Elder Gu approved them personally.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: One box went to Yan Tie's room. He's the champion. He's so strong already, why would he need pills?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe he doesn't know what's in them.

objectives.text: Deliver the herbs to Elder Hua

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Good. I'll brew the antidote tonight. If Yan Tie has taken a Frenzy Pill, he will not know friend from foe.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Tell no one about the Law Hall yet. An accusation without proof is just a very loud way to die.

quests.title: Partners in the Semifinal
quests.summary: The semifinal is a paired bout, and fate has a sense of humour: your partner is Zhao Kang.

objectives.text: Find your partner in the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Of all the disciples in all the peaks. Fine. Stay on my left. Don't slow me down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're still limping from the shrine.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Then stay on my right. Whatever. Just win.

objectives.text: Win the paired semifinal with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Five of them? Good. I was worried this would be boring.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On your left, Zhao Kang!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I SEE them!

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You fight like a farmer. Stubborn, unpolished, impossible to knock over.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was a compliment. Don't get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Win the final. If anyone is going to beat Yan Tie, it should be the person who's going to lose to me someday.

quests.title: Eve of the Final
quests.summary: The night before the final, Elder Gu summons you. It is not about the tournament.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Congratulations on reaching the final. An unlikely journey for a village orphan.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tournament rules forbid external artifacts. Bring your pendant to the Law Hall tonight for inspection.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's not an artifact, Elder. It's a family keepsake.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Then you have nothing to fear. The Law Hall. Tonight. Do not make me ask again.

objectives.text: Ask Elder Mo about the rule

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Inspection? There's no such rule. There never has been. I wrote half the tournament rules myself.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu... no. He is grieving, not wicked. Still. Don't go. If he asks, tell him I forbade it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go and clear your head. You've a champion to face at dawn.

objectives.text: Steady your dao heart on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pond is still. The moon lies in it, whole. You breathe until your heart lies as still as the water.

objectives.text: Speak with Han Xue in the pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu asked for the pendant? Then he's run out of patience. That makes him dangerous.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Win tomorrow. I'll be watching the pagoda. If the Law Hall moves while everyone watches the final, I'll know.

quests.title: The Final Bout
quests.summary: Face Yan Tie, three-time champion of the Inner Sect Tournament. Something is wrong with his eyes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The final! {player} of the Outer Court against Yan Tie of Thunder Peak, champion three years running!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bow to your opponent. Bow to the Sect Master. And for heaven's sake, bow to me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Yan Tie bows, and when he straightens, his eyes are the colour of blood. Veins crawl black up his neck.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Frenzy qi! Stop the bout... no, he won't stop now. {player}, bring him down without killing him!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll try. Stay back, everyone!

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Yan Tie will live. Elder Hua's antidote reached him in time. You fought to save him, not to win. I saw that.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The victory is yours, and with it, a place at my side. But someone fed him that pill.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wait. The pagoda bell... someone is ringing the pagoda bell. Where is Han Xue?

quests.title: The Law Hall's Shadow
quests.summary: While the whole sect watched the final, someone broke into the scripture pagoda.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}! Elder Bai's been hurt. It's Gu. Gu is in the pagoda. The seal diagram, he's taking the seal diagram!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Stay here. I'll stop him.

objectives.text: Defeat the traitor's Blood Moon accomplices

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Hold them. The pendant can wait. The diagram cannot.

objectives.text: Check on the wounded Elder Bai on the plaza

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I'm fine. I've been hit harder by falling bookshelves. Gu Hanshan... forty years we've shared tea.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He took the Azure Heaven Seal diagram. The master copy. The one we would need to repair the seal.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Without it, if the seal breaks, we cannot remake it. Go to the Sect Master. Quickly.

objectives.text: Report to the Sect Master at the teleport array

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He fled through the teleport array. Its last destination was the Blood Moon Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty years I trusted him with our law. I trusted him with our children.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest tonight, {player}. Tomorrow we go into the Abyss after him.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Slag Where the Array Stood
quests.summary: The Sect Master promised to follow Gu into the Abyss at dawn. At dawn, she finds out why that is impossible.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I said tomorrow we go after him. I was angry, and I was wrong. Look at the array.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He burned the Abyss route behind him. The jade is slag. It will take weeks to lay it again.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The array's outer ring is melted glass. Scorched into the stone, still faintly warm, is a single character: Lan.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: His daughter's name. He signed his escape with it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Whatever he was promised, he believes it. That makes him more dangerous, not less.

quests.title: The Empty Chairs of the Law Hall
quests.summary: The Law Hall's disciples are being questioned one by one. Han Xue wants you there, to watch their faces.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Eleven Law Hall disciples. One of them carried the Frenzy Pills. Maybe more. I want you to watch their faces while I ask.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the scholar rock, the Law Hall's chairs stand in a neat row. Only ten of the eleven are occupied.

objectives.text: Search the empty Law Hall desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The eleventh desk has been cleared in a hurry. Wedged behind a drawer: a Frenzy Pill box, and a crescent drawn in ink.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Pei Rong. The one who carried the boxes. He ran in the night, toward the outer pines.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The pines are thick and he doesn't know them. We do. Let's go and introduce ourselves.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Grey Robes in the Pines
quests.summary: The runaway Law Hall disciple has friends waiting beyond the wall. They wear grey by day and crimson by night.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey robes flutter between the pines. Too many for one runaway. They have been waiting for him.

objectives.text: Defeat the Law Hall turncoats at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Law Hall grey on the outside, Blood Moon red underneath. Take them alive if you can!

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Pei Rong's alive. Barely. He's crying and saying it was for his family. Everyone has a family, apparently, except the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They hold families. That's how they own people. Gou's list said the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Somewhere in Qingshi, Gou the Scarred is teaching carters to read their own names. You spared him for this.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You think of Gou's broken hand, and wonder whose family he couldn't fight for after.

quests.title: Bai Qiu Counts His Scrolls
quests.summary: Elder Bai is back among his shelves, bandaged and furious, counting everything Gu touched.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Forty years we shared tea. He took the master diagram of the seal, and my second-best inkstone. I miss the inkstone more today.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: That's a lie. I miss the tea. Help me count, disciple. Counting stops me thinking.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Bai won't rest. I've given him a sleeping draught three times. He reads the label and puts it on a shelf.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Keep him company. Grief is easier to mend when someone else holds the other end of the bandage.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Is it true? Elder Gu? The man who carried those pill boxes was his. And my brother... Is it all connected?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I think so, Xiao Man. And I think it all leads to the same place.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Then go there. Please. Before it's too late. I'll keep the herbs ready. I won't even drop them.

quests.title: Gu Hanshan's Study
quests.summary: The Sect Master orders the traitor's rooms opened. Nobody has been inside in twenty years but him.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Open his rooms. I want every letter, every note, every lie. Han Xue has the key. Bring me what you find, not what you feel.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Gu's study is spotless and bare. One brush, one inkstone, one portrait of a smiling girl with ink on her fingers.

objectives.text: Read the letters in Gu's desk

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hundreds of letters, all addressed to Gu Lan, all unsent. Today you learned the ninth precept. You would have liked it.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Twenty years of letters to a dead girl. I wanted to hate him. It's harder now. I'm still going to try.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among Gu's letters: names of disciples who took Blood Moon silver once, then refused it.

choices.text: Give every letter to the Sect Master

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Burn the names of the ones who refused

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Keep the letters. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Fire in the Pagoda
quests.summary: In the dead of night someone tries to burn what is left of the seal records. The pagoda bell wakes the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Fire! In the pagoda! I saw them go in, three shadows, and I rang the bell twice, which is once more than required!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Beat out the fire on the pagoda steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Oil burns on the lowest steps. You smother it with your robe and your qi. Above, glass breaks on the fourth floor.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Masked figures drop from the pagoda's eaves, blades out, oil flasks in their belts.

objectives.text: Clear the formation plaza of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The fourth floor survived. My turtle soup recipes did not. I will never forgive them. Truly, this is war.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: They came for what's left of the seal records. Gu must have told them what he couldn't carry.

quests.title: Why We Wait
quests.summary: The Sect Master explains why she will not march on the Abyss today, or tomorrow, and it costs her to say it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Every disciple wants to charge into the Abyss after him. So do I. But the Azure Eye is cracked, and I am its keeper.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: If I leave the mountain, the Eye goes dark. If the Eye goes dark, the seal has only one key left. Yours.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then how do we follow him?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Slowly. We rebuild the array. We find a way down on foot. We grow strong enough to survive the bottom.

objectives.text: Find Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: She's right, and she hates it. So do I. So: we get strong. You first. You're behind schedule.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Foundation Establishment, and still sloppy on the left side. Tomorrow, dawn.

quests.title: Jade for a New Road
quests.summary: Laying a teleport route to the Abyss again needs raw jade, and the treasury is suddenly careful with its stones.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The array masters need raw jade to lay the Abyss route again. The treasury has some. Steward Qian has opinions.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Join Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Raw jade! For a road to the worst place in the world! Do you know what that costs?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: ...Fine. Fine. But you dig the rest yourself. There's a seam in the herb terraces. Elder Hua will pretend not to see you.

objectives.text: Dig raw jade from the terrace seam

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You're digging up my terraces for a road to the Abyss. I'm pretending not to see. Dig faster; my pretending has limits.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: A Place at Her Side
quests.summary: The tournament's prize was a place at the Sect Master's side. She shows you what that means: the Azure Eye, from the inside.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You won a place at my side. Here is what it means. Sit on the Eye with me. Feel what I feel every day.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Sit within the Azure Eye beside the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The formation rises around you like water. Somewhere deep in its pattern a thin crack runs, and through it, very faint, something is breathing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It is patient. It is hungry. It knows your name.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You felt him. Three hundred years under the earth and he still breathes through a crack in my formation.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That is what I carry. Now you know why I don't sleep. Go and sleep for both of us.

quests.title: A Promise Without the Word
quests.summary: Xiao Man has packed a bag. She intends to go to the Abyss herself. Somebody has to talk her out of it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I packed a bag. Medicine, rope, a knife I don't know how to use. I'm going to the Abyss. Don't stop me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Xiao Man, you faint when Elder Hua lances a boil.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Then I'll faint in the Abyss! At least I'll be closer!

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Let her cry. Then give her something to do. I'll have her make medicine bundles for whoever goes. Hundreds.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Grief with work is survivable. Grief with nothing is a cliff edge.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Hundreds of bundles. For whoever goes. You're going, aren't you? Don't promise. I hate promises now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm going. I won't promise. I'll just bring him back.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Blue Robes, Heavy Sleeves
quests.summary: The Sect Master names you an inner disciple before the whole sect. The robes are blue, and the sleeves are very long.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: By the tournament's law and my own wish, you are an inner disciple of the Azure Cloud. Kneel. Now stand. Don't trip on the sleeves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A hundred disciples watch from the plaza. Some clap. Some don't. Lu Ping cheers loud enough for the ones who don't.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Blue suits you. Don't let it go to your head; the sleeves are there to hide how much your arms shake.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Inner disciples get a peak, a master and a thousand new ways to be embarrassed. Go and find out which peak wants you.

quests.title: Every Peak Wants You
quests.summary: Frost Sword, Thunder, Cloud and Cinder Peak all send letters. Every letter is very polite and slightly threatening.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Four letters! Four peaks want you! Frost Sword, Thunder, Cloud and Cinder. Cinder's letter is on fire. Literally, a bit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Frost Sword: discipline. Thunder: strength. Cloud: patience. Cinder: we have the best food. The last line is underlined twice.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Frost Sword Peak is my peak. I'm not going to tell you to choose it. I'm going to stand here and look disappointed until you do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Can I choose the Sect Master's side and visit all four?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the most diplomatic cowardice I've ever heard. She'll love it.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Debt
quests.summary: Yan Tie, the champion you saved from the Frenzy Pill, is on his feet again. He has come to repay a debt he cannot measure.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Yan Tie. You know me. You broke my ribs to save my life. I've come to say thank you, and to ask for a rematch.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Not now. When I've forgotten the taste of that pill. Some nights I still wake with red at the edges of my eyes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says it passes.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says a lot of kind things. I'd rather hear them from someone who's been through it. So, you, eventually.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The great Yan Tie, thanking a village brat. The world's gone upside down. I suppose I'll have to get used to it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell him I said he fought well in the final. Before the pill. He did.

quests.title: Thunder Peak Trials
quests.summary: Yan Tie invites you to Thunder Peak's morning trials, where the puppets are heavier and the disciples are louder.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak trains at dawn. We shout. It helps the qi. It also annoys Frost Sword Peak, which helps morale.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Louder! If the puppet can't hear you, it won't respect you!

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Good. Your foundation is solid. Heavy, like a river stone. Most new inner disciples float. You sink. That's a compliment.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Inner Sect Allowance
quests.summary: Inner disciples draw a real allowance. Steward Qian regards this as a personal tragedy.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Inner allowance: twelve spirit stones a month. Twelve! When I was an inner disciple it was six, and we were grateful.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Collect them from the donation boxes yourself. I refuse to hand over that many stones with my own hands. It's bad for my heart.

objectives.text: Collect your allowance from the donation boxes

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Twelve. Count them in front of me. Slowly. I want to say goodbye to each one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Envy Wears Blue Too
quests.summary: Not every inner disciple is pleased that a village orphan skipped the line. Three of them want to test the new robes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Three inner disciples from Cloud Peak are waiting at the training ground. They say you bought your victory with luck.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I said it was stubbornness, which is much worse to fight. They didn't listen. Go on. I'll hold your sleeves.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three Cloud Peak disciples bow with exaggerated courtesy, and then do not wait for you to bow back.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Three. Hm. I would have beaten four. But you didn't use your elbows once, which Elder Mo will be pleased about.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan has always said envy is a compliment with a knife in it. Congratulations. You're being complimented.

objectives.choice_prompt: The three inner disciples who ambushed you are nursing bruises, afraid you'll report them.

choices.text: Forgive them

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report them to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Humiliate them in front of the inner court

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Duties of a Champion
quests.summary: Your first task at the Sect Master's side: carry her orders around the mountain, and learn how a sect is actually run.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take these to every peak master. Read them first. If you understand why I wrote each one, you'll understand the sect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One order about rice, one about roof tiles, one about a disciple's mother who is ill. And one that says only: watch the Abyss road.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every order is signed the same way, in small plain characters: Yun Qingyao, who is tired, and grateful.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She signs them like that? Every one? ...I never read the signatures. I should have.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Stone Guardians Wake
quests.summary: The cracked Azure Eye leaks qi, and the old stone guardians of the peaks wake confused and angry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The peak guardians are awake! The big stone ones! One of them sat on Cinder Peak's kitchen! Nobody's getting lunch!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qi spills from the crack in the Azure Eye like steam from a kettle. You press your palm to it until the hiss softens.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stone guardians lumber across the training ground, eyes glowing a confused and furious blue.

objectives.text: Break the peak guardians at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Peak guardians ahead! Don't let them surround us!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They went back to sleep! Mostly. One of them is still sitting on the kitchen. Cinder Peak says they're used to it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Different Eyes
quests.summary: The mountain looks at you differently now. Some of the looks are warm. Some are measuring. One is Elder Mo's.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The outer disciples have started bowing to you. I bowed to you this morning. It felt weird. Let's never do that again.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Also, I've started a fan club. It has four members. Three of them are me under different names.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Some of the inner disciples think you're the Sect Master's pet. Some think you're a Blood Moon spy. Nobody thinks you're ordinary.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ordinary was nice while it lasted. Walk straight. They're watching.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I watched your spar with the Cloud Peak three. Adequate. The blue is heavy. It's supposed to be.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Don't let it bend you. Let it hold you up. That's the only trick to wearing it.

quests.title: Foundation Like River Stone
quests.summary: Yan Tie called your foundation a river stone. Elder Mo agrees, and sends you to the cliff to prove it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: River stone, Yan Tie says. River stones get smooth by sitting in the current for a very long time. Go and sit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Temper your foundation at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wind off the sea of clouds pours over you like a river. Your foundation does not move. Layer by layer, it grows.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: When you rise, you are heavier and lighter at once. Middle stage of Foundation Establishment.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You were sitting in my spot. I let you. That is the biggest thank you Thunder Peak knows how to give.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Red at the Edges
quests.summary: Disciples on three peaks have red at the edges of their eyes. Elder Hua knows exactly what that means.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Nine disciples, three peaks, the same red ring around the iris. Frenzy residue. Gu salted our rations, not just the tournament.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: It sleeps in the meridians until anger wakes it. We need a Clear-Heart Pill. We've never needed one before.

objectives.text: Make your way to the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the pavilion, a Cloud Peak disciple sits very still, fists clenched, humming to drown out something only he can hear.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I know that humming. I did it for a week after the final. It's what you do so you don't hit anyone.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Whatever Elder Hua needs, I'll help. Nobody should have to hum through that.

quests.title: Recipe From the Fourth Floor
quests.summary: Elder Bai finds a Clear-Heart recipe in a book about turtle soup. Of course he does. It calls for herbs the sect doesn't grow.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Bai found the recipe! In a turtle soup book! He says it's where he hides everything important. We need calm-root and red-veined sage.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: We have the sage. Calm-root only grows in the bamboo, near water. I'll draw you a map. It'll be a bad map.

objectives.text: Gather red-veined sage on the terraces

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: That's the sage. Now the calm-root. Take my map. The squiggle is a stream. The other squiggle is also a stream.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Calm-Root by the Stream
quests.summary: The calm-root grows along the forest stream, where the wolves have started drinking again.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Pale calm-root trails in the stream like hair. On the far bank, wolves lift their heads, water dripping from their jaws.

objectives.text: Stop the corrupted wolves at the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wolves have red at the edges of their eyes too. Whoever salted the sect's rations salted the forest's water.

objectives.text: Show Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came to help carry. I ate one calm-root. I feel incredibly calm. I may never move again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The wolves had the red too. Poor things. They didn't hum. They just bit.

quests.title: The Hermit's Correction
quests.summary: The hermit reads the recipe over your shoulder and tuts. The Verdant Lotus made Clear-Heart Pills three centuries ago.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Turtle soup. Of course. Bai Qiu's grandmother taught him that trick. Your recipe is wrong, by the way. One line.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Add a lotus petal, from the spring, picked by the heir. The Heart Sutra does the rest. That is how we made them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Picked by me? Why me?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Because the lotus listens to you. It never listened to me. I ran from it, and it remembers.

objectives.text: Pick a lotus petal from the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One petal is enough. Don't take more; the spring is generous, not stupid.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Holding the Fire
quests.summary: Refining a Clear-Heart Pill takes a fire held perfectly steady for an hour. Elder Hua has you practise on ordinary pills first.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The fire must not flicker for one hour. Not for a sneeze, not for a thought. Practise on these Vitality Pills first.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: If the cauldron starts to sing, step back. If it starts to scream, run.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi flows into the flame. It gutters, steadies, gutters. The cauldron begins to sing, very softly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then scream. You run. Behind you, a small green explosion, and a rain of slightly singed Vitality Pills.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Singed, not ruined. Better than my first attempt. I lost my eyebrows for a season.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Again. And this time, when it sings, sing back. The fire likes company.

quests.title: Frenzy on Cinder Peak
quests.summary: Before the pill is ready, three disciples on Cinder Peak lose the fight with their residue.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Cinder Peak! Three of them snapped at once. They're tearing up the training ground. Don't hurt them. Much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Defeat the frenzied disciples at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Red-eyed disciples swing practice swords like woodcutters, weeping as they do it.

objectives.text: Drive the frenzied disciples from the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Another two on the plaza! Pin them, don't break them!

objectives.text: Look for Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Five more in my infirmary. We need that pill. Tonight. Whatever it takes.

quests.title: One Hour Without Flicker
quests.summary: The real refinement: calm-root, red-veined sage, a lotus petal, and one hour in which your fire must not waver.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Everything's in the cauldron. The rest is you. One hour. I'll stand by with a bucket.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: And I'll stand by with a second bucket. For Elder Hua.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cauldron sings. You sing back, a nonsense song Wei Tong taught you. The fire steadies. An hour passes like a breath.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine pills roll out, white as milk, each with a faint green lotus in its heart.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Nine. Nine perfect pills. I'm not crying. The smoke is very strong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Nine Pills, Nine Disciples
quests.summary: Nine pills for nine disciples. Some of them are in the infirmary; some are hiding their red eyes around the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Five in my infirmary, four still out there pretending they're fine. Find them. They won't come to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Find the hiding disciples in the plum garden
Meet Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That's all nine. The humming's stopped. You don't know how quiet the world is when it stops.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak owes you another debt. We'll have to invent a bigger bow.

objectives.choice_prompt: One pill is left over. A tenth disciple, too proud to admit his red eyes, hides at the cliff.

choices.text: Give it to him, quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report him so the Medicine Hall can treat him

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Sell it to him

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Where the Residue Came From
quests.summary: The pills are working. But how did the residue get into the rations? Steward Qian keeps the grain ledgers.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The grain ledgers? Every sack in, every sack out. I keep them under my pillow. Don't ask why.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every grain delivery for two years came through Qingshi, and every one was approved by the Law Hall. Gu's seal, on every page.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: He approved the rice. I thought he was being thorough. I thought, how kind, the Law Hall checking our rice.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I count stones. I never counted what was in the sacks. I'm going to count everything now. Everything.

quests.title: Xiao Man's Medicine Bundles
quests.summary: Elder Hua was right: work helps. Xiao Man has made two hundred medicine bundles and is starting on the third hundred.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Two hundred bundles! For whoever goes to the Abyss. I've only dropped eleven. Well, eleven that I know of.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Each one has a note inside. Most say 'get well soon'. One says 'Xiao Shi, you idiot, write to me'. In case.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: She'll make a healer yet. Not because of her hands. Because of the notes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Take one bundle. For luck. And for when you find him.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Every Bird at Once
quests.summary: At dawn every bird in the bamboo forest takes flight at once. Elder Mo does not need a scout to know what that means.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Every bird in the bamboo took off at dawn. All at once. That's not weather. That's a tide.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Gu kept the forest wards. We thought. Take Han Xue, Wei Tong and Yan Tie. Get the hermit out, or dig in beside him.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest is loud with running things. Deer, foxes, a family of boars, all fleeing past you toward the sect.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everything's running this way. Which means whatever they're running from is that way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The hermit's hut is that way too. Of course it is.

quests.title: Leashes, Not Wards
quests.summary: The ward-stones Gu planted along the forest path are cracked from the inside. They were never keeping beasts out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A ward-stone stands by the path, split down the middle. The runes inside are not warding runes.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Summoning runes. Gu planted leashes and called them wards. Every beast within a day's walk has been waiting for them to break.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: He planted a trap and waited for his own flight to spring it. Twenty years of patience. That's frightening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we're the ones who have to be faster.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The First Wave
quests.summary: The first wave comes through the herb grove: wolves, dozens of them, red-eyed and running.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Wolves! A river of wolves! Dumpling, I'm sorry, you're going to get very dirty today.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Clear the herb grove of corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The corrupted wolves come on in silence.

objectives.text: Hold the old bridge against more spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hold the bridge! If they cross the stream, they're at the hut!

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The first wave breaks on the bridge and scatters. Across the water, the bamboo is still shaking.

quests.title: The Hermit Won't Leave
quests.summary: The hermit refuses to leave his hut. He says he ran once, three hundred years ago, and has only just stopped.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I will not leave. I ran from the Verdant Lotus's last stand. I have only recently stopped running. I will not start again for wolves.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: But you may stay and help, if you like. I'll make tea.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine's stele answers your pendant with a low green hum. For the first time in three centuries, a real ward rises over the forest.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves hit the edge of the ward and recoil, snarling. Some of them find the gaps.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A true ward. Verdant Lotus work, woken by Verdant Lotus blood. It won't hold forever. Nothing does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Stones That Walk
quests.summary: The tide has woken the ruins' stone sentinels, and they cannot tell friend from wolf.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the ruins gate, stone sentinels stagger out, swinging at wolves and trees and anything that moves.

objectives.text: Break the stone golems at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stone men again! I came to help! Nobody told me it was stone men again!

objectives.text: Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me after you. He said you'd need someone to complain at. I'm very good at it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Those stones were your family's, weren't they. The Verdant Lotus. I'm sorry I broke them. Slightly.

quests.title: The Eye of the Storm
quests.summary: The ward holds for now. In the lull, the hermit tells you to rest, because the next wave has a king.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The ward holds. For an hour, perhaps two. Sit. Breathe. The next wave will have a king at its head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Rest your qi by the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spring is still while the forest howls. Your foundation drinks from it, slow and deep, like roots in dry season.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: There's something huge in the deep forest. The wolves part for it. It's coming this way.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak has a saying. The bigger they are, the louder you shout. I intend to shout very loudly.

quests.title: The Wolves Before the King
quests.summary: The king's pack comes first, circling to find the gaps in the ward.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're circling. Looking for the weak side. Wei Tong, left. Yan Tie, right. You, wherever it's worst.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Stop the corrupted wolves at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Face the next wave of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the old den pour wolves with silver-tipped fur, larger than any you've seen. The king's own pack.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong after the fight

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I've stopped counting wolves. I'm counting teeth now. It's a bigger number but it feels more manageable.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Bloodmaw, Lord of the Tide
quests.summary: At the head of the tide comes Bloodmaw, a wolf king older than the one you buried, gorged on twenty years of Gu's blood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends aside. A wolf the size of a cart pads into the clearing, fur black with old blood, eyes like coals.

objectives.name: Bloodmaw, Lord of the Tide
objectives.text: Defeat Bloodmaw, Lord of the Tide

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's not a wolf. That's twenty years of someone's patience with teeth. Together!

objectives.text: Lay the wolf king to rest

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press a purifying talisman to the great brow. The red drains from its eyes. For a moment it is only an old wolf, very tired.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Rest easy, old king. I'm saying that to all of them now. It seems right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: After the Tide
quests.summary: The tide has broken. The forest is torn and quiet, and the hermit wants every one of the leash-stones dug up.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Dig up every leash-stone Gu planted. Every one. I want this forest to belong to itself again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Dig up the leash-stones in the grove
Defeat the spirit wolves at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A few stragglers still guard the old den, confused and frightened now that no one is calling them.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Thank you. It is a strange thing, to be protected. I had forgotten how it feels.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The dug-up leash-stones would fetch a fortune from any beast-tamer, and leash beasts again.

choices.text: Smash them

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give them to the sect to study

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Sell them to a beast-tamer

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Beasts Toward Qingshi
quests.summary: Not every beast ran into your ward. The hermit's birds say a second tide turned east, toward the river and the town.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My birds say half the tide turned east. Toward the river. Toward your town with the good noodles.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Qingshi. Of course. The town's always in the way of something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We go now. The magistrate will make a speech. We'll have to fight through it.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak goes where the thunder goes. Lead the way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Before Nightfall
quests.summary: You reach Qingshi at noon. The tide will reach it at dusk. Constable Du is already stacking carts across the road.

objectives.text: Make your way to the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Carts are stacked across the road. Farmers carry children and chickens through the gate in a steady, frightened stream.

objectives.text: Talk with Constable Du at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Beasts, the birds say. A whole forest's worth. I've got carts, spears and the magistrate. The magistrate's making a speech.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Tell me what to do and I'll do it. Tell the magistrate and he'll do it louder.

quests.title: Everyone Has a Job
quests.summary: A town can be saved by everyone doing one small thing. Madam Fang, Old Pan and Widow Liu already know theirs.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The inn's cellar holds forty. I've put the children in it with the wine. The children are guarding the wine. We'll see who wins.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Ferry's running both ways. Farmers across, fish back. If the beasts come by water, I'll ring the dock bell. Twice. With feeling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.text: Join Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Water. Fighters need water. I'll carry it to the wall. I carried it for a year looking for my son. I can carry it one more night.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Oil for the Braziers
quests.summary: Beasts fear fire. The town's braziers need oil, and the only oil is in the guild warehouse.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Oil? For the braziers? Take it! All of it! Well, most of it. Some of it is imported. Fine! All of it!

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I'd like it noted that I was helpful. By someone. In writing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The braziers catch one by one along the wall. A ring of fire rises around Qingshi as the sun touches the hills.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Fire's up. Beasts are coming. Merchant Jin asked me to write down that he was helpful. I wrote it down. In pencil.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the lantern oil you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Tide Arrives
quests.summary: At dusk the fields fill with eyes.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Citizens of Qingshi! Fear not! The Azure Cloud is here, and I have written a very short speech! It is one word! Hold!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Across the fields a hundred pairs of red eyes turn toward the sound, and begin to run.

objectives.text: Drive the corrupted wolves from the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Keep them off the fields! Every wolf on the rice is a winter without bread!

objectives.text: Clear the town gate of corrupted wolves

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: One word! Hold! And they held! I have never given a better speech. I may never speak again. It can't be topped.

quests.title: Wolves on the Water
quests.summary: Some of the wolves took the river. Old Pan rings the dock bell twice, with feeling.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Wolves in the water! Swimming! I didn't know wolves swam! Nobody tells a ferryman anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Finish the corrupted wolves at the market square

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're in the market! Keep them away from the inn cellar!

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. First time I've hit a wolf with an oar. Won't be the last, I'd wager. It felt wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Behind the spirit wolves you drove off, a den of whimpering pups.

choices.text: Carry them to the deep forest, far from people

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Report the den to the sect's beast keepers

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Sell the pups to a beast trader

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Stone in the Graveyard
quests.summary: Something heavy is walking among the hill graves. Deacon Hong's old circle has woken a stone guardian meant for the dead.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grave tablets topple one by one. Among them lumbers a stone guardian, blood-ink still smeared on its chest.

objectives.text: Break the stone golems at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It swings at the tombs as if the dead had wronged it personally.

objectives.text: Tell Widow Liu what you found

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You put the tablets back. All of them. People will cry when they see that in the morning. Good crying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Longest Hour
quests.summary: The tide throws everything left at the town gate in one last push.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Everything they've got, right at the gate. My spear's broken. I'm using the magistrate's proclamation board.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Reinforce the gate ward with your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation pours into the gate like water into cracks. The old timbers stop groaning.

objectives.text: Stop the corrupted wolves at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The corrupted wolves have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the spirit wolves that follow
Catch your breath with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I followed you down from the sect. Elder Mo said stay. I said Qingshi has noodles. He understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Look. Dawn. They're running back to the forest. We did it. The noodle shop is safe.

quests.title: Morning in the Market
quests.summary: The town wakes up alive. Madam Fang opens the cellar. The children have not drunk the wine. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The children guarded the wine. Heroically. One of them guarded it into his stomach. He's asleep in a barrel.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Free noodles for everyone who stood on that wall. Which is everyone. I'm going to be poor and happy.

objectives.text: Hear what Merchant Jin has to say

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I was helpful. Everyone saw. The constable wrote it in pencil, but it's written.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: It felt... strange. Good strange. I didn't charge anyone for anything all night. I may be ill.

objectives.text: Meet Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My arms hurt. I carried water all night. I kept thinking, Liu Er would have carried twice as much and complained the whole way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A water-seller at the well is charging ten times the price to the families who carried water all night.

choices.text: Make him sell at a fair price

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Report him to the magistrate

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take a cut of his profits

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: What Drove Them
quests.summary: Among the beasts you find a collar of blood-red jade, still humming. Someone didn't just release the tide. Someone steered it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among the fallen beasts lies a wolf wearing a collar of blood-red jade, carved with a crescent. It still hums faintly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The collar cracks. For a moment you hear a voice from very far and very deep, counting, as if it were keeping score.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Steered. Not released. Someone pointed this tide at Qingshi on purpose.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone who knows the town. Someone who's been here. Gu, or his friends. We need to know where they come and go.

quests.title: Standing on the Wall
quests.summary: You watch the sun rise over the fields from the town wall, and something in your foundation settles into a new shape.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the watchtower, the fields are trampled but green. Smoke rises from a hundred chimneys, all of them breakfast.

objectives.text: Cultivate on the town wall at sunrise

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe in a town that did not die. Your foundation settles, and deepens, and grows quiet. Late stage.

objectives.text: Talk with Yan Tie at the main street

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You look like someone who's just understood something. Thunder Peak usually just shouts at that point. Go ahead.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I think I'm fighting for the wrong reasons. Not the wrong people. The wrong reasons.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Hm. That's too deep for me before breakfast. Tell me after noodles.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Letter in Spidery Hand
quests.summary: A paper crane lands on your windowsill at the sect: the hermit wants you in the forest. He does not say why.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A paper crane landed on my head this morning. For you. From the hermit. He writes like a spider fell in ink.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go. Take Han Xue. The sect can spare its champion for a few days. The puppets will be relieved.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hermit is waiting outside his hut. There are no cups of tea. That has never happened before.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: No tea today. Today we do something difficult, and tea would only make me feel better than I deserve.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Roots, Stem, Blossom
quests.summary: The hermit explains the Heart Sutra's three verses, and why he never finished learning the second.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root: patience. You learned it at the ruins. Stem: forgiveness. Blossom: compassion. Nobody reaches the blossom without the stem.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I have been stuck on the stem for three hundred years. I cannot forgive a boy who ran while his masters died.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You were that boy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
