dialogue.text: Yes. That is what makes it hard.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I didn't know sutras could be that personal. The Frost Sword manuals are mostly about angles.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Reliquary Below
quests.summary: Beneath the reliquary where you found the first verse, a second chamber has opened, answering the ward you woke during the tide.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the reliquary stood, a stair now leads down into green-lit stone. The ward you woke opened more than one door.

objectives.text: Gather the stair's scattered lotus tiles

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stem, the stele says. To forgive is not to forget. It is to put the burden down long enough to pick up someone else's.

objectives.text: Defeat the stone golems at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chamber's guardians wake behind you, stone and patient, and bar the way out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Outside, the shrine is warm with late sun. The hermit is sitting on a broken pillar, not looking at you.

quests.title: What Zhao Kang Can't Forgive
quests.summary: Zhao Kang has followed you into the forest again. The stele's words have found a raw place in him too.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look surprised. I followed you again. I'm very good at following. It's a clan skill.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Put the burden down long enough to pick up someone else's. My brother died on a mission Gu gave him. How do I put that down?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know. Maybe you don't have to put it down all at once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...That's the least helpful helpful thing anyone's ever said to me. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He'll be all right. He's stubborn. Stubborn people forgive slowly, but they forgive all the way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Robbers at the Shrine
quests.summary: Word of the ruins' second chamber has spread. Rogue cultivators have come with sacks and crowbars.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Rogues again. They heard the ruins opened. They want everything that glows, including you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: One rogue, caught with a sack of the shrine's lotus tiles, is barely more than a boy.

choices.text: Let him go with a warning

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hand him to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry the tiles back, then beat him

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

objectives.text: Drive the rogue cultivators from the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Make your way to the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rogues scatter into the bamboo, dropping crowbars and one very expensive-looking lantern.

quests.title: The Stem
quests.summary: The hermit asks you to sit with him at the spirit spring and try to forgive something. Anything. He will try too.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Find one thing you have not forgiven. It needn't be big. Big ones are for later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Gu. For the pendant, for Qingshi, for everything.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That is a big one. Well. We'll both fail together, then. That's something.

objectives.text: Meditate on forgiveness at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit with your anger at Gu the way you'd sit with a fire, watching it without feeding it. It doesn't go out. It gets smaller.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside you the hermit weeps without a sound, and the lotus on the spring turns, very slowly, toward him.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It turned to me. After three hundred years. Not forgiveness. Not yet. But it turned.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Wolves at the Spring
quests.summary: The spring's new light has drawn wolves from the deep forest. Not red-eyed ones. Curious ones. And a few that are neither.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves ring the spring, drinking the light. Most are grey and calm. Three are thin and wild, and they are not here to drink.

objectives.text: Clear the herb grove of spirit wolves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wild ones break from the pack and come for the hermit.

objectives.text: Gather herbs for the hermit's bitten arm
Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: One bite. Old men are chewy; the wolf will have regretted it. Thank you for the herbs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the spirit wolves lies wounded, panting, its eyes clearing now that the fight is over.

choices.text: Bind its leg and let it limp away

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give it a clean, quick end

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Cut out its core while it still breathes

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Letter in the Reliquary
quests.summary: In the lower chamber lies a second letter in the elegant hand that wrote the first. This one is addressed to Lan Jue.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On a shelf in the lower chamber lies a letter, sealed with green wax, addressed: to Lan, when he stops running.

objectives.text: Bring the letter to the light

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You don't open it. It isn't yours. But the seal is warm, as if someone had just pressed it.

objectives.text: Talk it over with the hermit

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That's my master's hand. She knew. Three hundred years ago she knew I'd run, and she left me a letter for when I stopped.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I'm not ready to read it. Keep it for me. Give it to me when I am. You'll know. I won't.

quests.title: Carrying Someone Else's
quests.summary: Yan Tie arrives with news from the sect, and finds three people sitting in silence around a spring. He sits too.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me. The array masters say the Abyss route will be ready in a month. Also, why is everyone crying?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We're not crying. We're forgiving. It's different. It's wetter.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Forgiving. Hm. I've been angry at the pill for a year. Not at Gu. At the pill. As if the pill chose.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I'll sit with you. Thunder Peak doesn't usually sit. But I'll try.

quests.title: The Hermit's Parting Gift
quests.summary: Before you go, the hermit gives you seeds from the spring's lotus, and asks you to plant one at the sect.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Take these seeds. Plant one at your sect, by the water. When the Verdant Lotus grows beside the Azure Cloud again, I'll visit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Not before. I'm not ready to see your Sect Master. She'll ask me why I ran. I'll have to say.

objectives.text: Gather lotus seeds from the spring
Meet Han Xue at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He'll come. People who give seeds always come to see if they grew.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Carts That Leave at Night
quests.summary: Constable Du has been watching the guild's carts. Some of them leave at night, heading west, and come back empty.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I've been watching the guild's carts, like you asked. Three a week leave after dark, heading west. Come back empty. Wheels muddy red.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Nothing grows red to the west. Nothing but bad luck.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A cart stands loaded in the warehouse yard, tarpaulin tied tight. It smells of silk, and underneath, of blood lotus.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the silk: blood lotus, dried and bundled, and a map of a road that follows the river west, then turns down.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Down. Toward the Abyss. There's a road. There's been a road all along.

quests.title: Merchant Jin Sweats
quests.summary: Merchant Jin swears the carts aren't his. His hands say otherwise. So do his daughters' shoes, which are new.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Those carts aren't mine! They're the guild's! I'm only the master of the guild! That's completely different!

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: ...They pay in silver. A lot of silver. My daughters have new shoes. Do you know what shoes cost?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Who pays?

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A man with a crescent on his seal. I never see his face. I don't want to. Please. I have daughters.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave him. For now. A frightened merchant is more useful than a dead one. The road is what matters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin begs you to keep his guild's part in the night carts quiet.

choices.text: Promise silence if he testifies

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Tell him the magistrate will hear everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Charge him for your silence

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Old Pan's River
quests.summary: Old Pan knows every bend of the river. He knows where the carts cross, and where the lanterns wait on the far bank.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: West bank, past the third bend. There's a ford nobody uses, and lanterns on the far side on moonless nights. Bone lanterns.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I'll take you as far as the ford. Not a step past. I'm brave, not stupid.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Pan's ferry noses into the current. The town slides away behind you, and the river turns quiet and dark.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Bone lanterns. Wonderful. I love a road with decorations.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Guards at the Ford
quests.summary: At the ford the carts meet their escort: bandits in borrowed armour and two runners in crimson.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Cart guards at the ford. And two in crimson behind them. Blood Moon runners. Don't let the runners get away.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Hold the terraced fields against more Blood Moon runners

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crimson runners break for the fields, fast as hares, blood-talismans burning at their ankles.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One runner falls, and a satchel spills open. Letters, a lantern of carved bone, a pouch of red soil.

quests.title: Letters in the Satchel
quests.summary: The runner's satchel is full of letters. They are addressed to Qingshi's watchers, and they are not friendly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The satchel's letters are orders. Names of Qingshi's watchers. Old Pan. Madam Fang. Constable Du. Beside each: when.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last line says: the heir must not reach the road. Beneath it, in a different, older hand, someone has written: yet.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They know about the watchers. They know about you. Yet. What does yet mean?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It means someone wants me on this road. Just not yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I hate that. I hate that more than the rest of it put together.

quests.title: Protecting the Watchers
quests.summary: If the Blood Moon has names, it will come for them. You and Han Xue split up to guard Qingshi's watchers.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My name's on a list? Mine? I'm flattered. I'm terrified. I'm going to hide behind the wine and hit people with a ladle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Set a ward over the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You draw a ward on the inn's lintel in cinnabar. Madam Fang watches, then adds a small cat of her own for luck.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Moon runners at the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: They come at midnight, masked and quiet, toward the inn, the docks and the yamen at once.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon runners

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: All three watchers alive. My name was on the list and I'm still here. I'm going to frame the list.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Bone Lanterns
quests.summary: The last runner flees west along the Crimson Road. You follow the bone lanterns as far as you dare.

objectives.text: Make your way to the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Past the hill graves the road runs west, lit at every hundred paces by a lantern carved from a single bone.

objectives.text: Stop the rogue cultivators at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rogues guarding the road step out from the lanterns' shadows. Hired swords, cheap and many.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You turn back before the road turns down. Far to the west, the sky is a faint red smudge that never fades.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That red smudge. That's where the road goes. That's where Gu went. That's where Xiao Shi is.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We tell the Sect Master everything. And then, I think, we finally go.

quests.title: The Magistrate's Seal
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou insists on writing an official report of the Crimson Road for the Sect Master. It is sealed with his best seal.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: An official report! From the yamen of Qingshi to the Sect Master of the Azure Cloud! My best seal! My second-best brush!

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I have described you as 'valiant'. I have described myself as 'present'. I feel that's fair.

objectives.text: Join Old Pan at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Took the ferry to the third bend and back. Didn't see any bone lanterns. Saw a heron. Very judgemental heron.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Evidence for the Mountain
quests.summary: The Sect Master will want proof. You gather what the runners dropped along the road.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Sect Master will want proof, not stories. Pick up everything they dropped. Even the unpleasant things.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Take a rubbing of the road's first lantern

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bone lantern's carving is a crescent over a sword. The same mark as the token. The same mark as everything.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak will march with you when you go down. All of us. We shout very loudly in dark places.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The sealed letters came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Home With the Map
quests.summary: You leave Qingshi with a map, a satchel of letters and a magistrate's report. The town waves you up the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Go on. We're watched now, but we're watching back. Bring the missing home. All of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Hear what Madam Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Bring Liu Er home. Bring the Xiao boy home. Bring yourself home. That's three bowls I'm keeping hot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Report Read Twice
quests.summary: The Sect Master reads the Crimson Road report twice, then Magistrate Zhou's description of himself as 'present', and almost smiles.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A road. All this time, a road, and our own Law Hall approving the carts. Thank you for bringing this home.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: An army would be seen for a hundred miles. I'll decide by morning who goes. Go and rest. You won't.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The array masters kneel around the teleport array, laying the last jade of the new route. It glows faintly red at its edge.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The new route only reaches the rim. After that, it's feet. Whoever goes, goes carefully.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: It'll be you. Don't pretend you don't know. Go and say your goodbyes, and don't make them sound like goodbyes.

quests.title: Two Hundred Bundles
quests.summary: Xiao Man's medicine bundles are finished: three hundred of them. She wants you to carry as many as you can.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Three hundred bundles! I only dropped twenty. Take as many as you can carry. Take more than you can carry.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The one with the red string is for my brother. Don't give it to anyone else. Promise. No, don't. Just don't.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: You'll find him. I know it. I dreamed it. I also dreamed I was a carp, so. But I know it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: One Last Lesson
quests.summary: Elder Mo insists on one last lesson before the descent. It is about falling down, and getting up.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Last lesson. Not about winning. About falling. In the Abyss you will fall. The question is how fast you get up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Fall! Up! Fall! Up! Faster! The puppet doesn't care how you feel about it!

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. More than adequate. Hmph. I've said that twice now. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Lessons From the Shelves
quests.summary: Elder Bai has something for you: everything the pagoda knows about the Abyss, which is not much, copied very small.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Everything the pagoda knows about the Abyss. It fits on one slip. That's how little we know. Copied very small.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Abyss has a heart, the old books say. A black pool that shows you yourself. Do not look into it. Or do. The books disagree.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Pills for pain, pills for poison, pills for when you're sure you can't go on. The last ones are sugar. They work anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Hua quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Planting the Seed
quests.summary: Before you go, you plant one of the hermit's lotus seeds in the sect's pond. Just in case you don't come back to do it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus pond is still. The carp gather, curious, as you kneel at the edge with a seed in your palm.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seed sinks. For a moment a green light spreads under the water like a breath, and every carp in the pond turns to face it.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Planting things before a journey. My grandmother did that. She said it gives you a reason to come back.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've got plenty of reasons. You're one of them. Don't make it weird.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Farewell
quests.summary: Zhao Kang won't say goodbye. He challenges you to a spar instead, which is how the Zhao clan says goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: (guarded) {player}. People are saying things. I'm not asking. Yet.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm not saying goodbye. The Zhao clan doesn't say goodbye. We spar. Loudly. Pick up a sword.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Spar with Zhao Kang's attendants first

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My attendants insist on going first. They say it's tradition. It's not. They just want to hit you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If you find out what happened to my brother down there... anything... tell me. Even if it's bad.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll tell you everything, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Good. Now go away before I say something I'll regret. Like 'be careful'. Be careful.

quests.title: Shadows at the Array
quests.summary: On your last night, someone tries to sabotage the new array. Gu's friends are still on the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Someone's at the array! In the dark! I'm pretty sure it's not the array masters, they snore!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Moon cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The saboteurs flee toward the pines. One of them drops a crescent seal and doesn't stop to pick it up.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The array's safe. I stood on it all night after that. I'm very cold. I'm very proud.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Dumplings
quests.summary: Wei Tong has made dumplings for the journey. Forty of them. He says it's for luck. He says a lot of things when he's worried.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Forty dumplings. For the journey. They're wrapped in lotus leaves so they'll stay fresh in the Abyss. I asked Elder Hua.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: She said nothing stays fresh in the Abyss. So I made extra.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Senior Brother, you're crying.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It's the onions. I put a lot of onions in. For luck. Come back and eat the rest.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

quests.title: Steward Qian's Ledger
quests.summary: Steward Qian stops you at the gate with a ledger. He has opened an account in your name. It is empty. That's the point.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've opened an account in your name. Contribution points for the descent. It's empty. You'll fill it when you come back.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I don't open accounts for people who don't come back. It's a very bad investment. So come back.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak will be at the rim when you come out. Shouting. You'll hear us before you see us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qian's empty account in your name can draw on the treasury for the descent. Nobody would check.

choices.text: Take only what's allotted

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Draw extra for the town's wounded

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Draw extra for yourself

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Night Before
quests.summary: The night before the descent, you sit on the cliff edge and let your foundation settle one last time.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sea of clouds is silver under the moon. Somewhere to the west, below the edge of the world, the sky is faintly red.

objectives.text: Sit in the moon gate's quiet before dawn

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. Patience you have. Forgiveness you are trying. The blossom will have to wait for the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your foundation reaches its peak, solid as the mountain under you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You're awake. So am I. I've chosen: you and Han Xue. And someone is waiting at the gate who says he knows the way down.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sleep an hour. Then come and find me. We'll talk about guides, and traitors, and coming home.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: An Unlikely Guide
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you and Han Xue after the traitor. A masked stranger waits at the gate with an offer.

objectives.text: Receive your orders from the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Abyss is a wound in the world. A sect army would be seen for a hundred miles. Two disciples might not.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Find Gu. Find the captives. Do not face the Patriarch's servants alone if you can help it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And {player}... come back. That is not a request.

objectives.text: Meet the masked wanderer at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You'll need a guide. The Abyss eats people who don't know where to step.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why should we trust you?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You shouldn't. But I know the Abyss. I was born to it. I'll show you the way down, and you decide the rest.

objectives.text: Descend into the Blood Moon Abyss

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The air is warm and wet, and tastes of copper. Somewhere far below, a drum beats slowly, like a heart.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's not a drum.

quests.title: The Field of Bones
quests.summary: Cross the plain of bones, where the Blood Moon's sentries hunt.

objectives.text: Cross onto the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Bones crunch underfoot, bleached white under the red moon. Dead trees claw at the sky.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Walk softly. The sentries listen for the crack of bone.

objectives.text: Clear the sentries on the field of bones
Talk with Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You fight well. You hesitate before the killing blow. That will get you killed here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They were people once, weren't they?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Children stolen from villages. Raised on blood and fear. I was one. The Patriarch took my name when I was six.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming. It means nameless night. I chose it myself. It is the only thing here I ever chose.

quests.title: The Blood Pools
quests.summary: The miasma from the blood pools eats at your qi. Blood lotus growing there can neutralise it, if you can stand the smell.

objectives.text: Harvest blood lotus from the steaming pools
Drive off the blood-fed wolves drinking at the pools
Purify the lotus and steady your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus hisses in your palm. You draw on the Heart Sutra. Mud, root, blossom. The red fades to a clean, pale pink.

objectives.text: Share the purified lotus with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It tastes like rust and flowers. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't trust him. But he hasn't led us into a trap yet. That's either honesty or patience.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Or both. People can be both.

quests.title: Ambush at the Obelisks
quests.summary: A ring of obelisks pulses with stolen blood. Investigate it, carefully.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Runes crawl across the black stone like beetles. Thin threads of blood run from the obelisks down into the dark.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They pull the life out of the prisoners and pour it into the altar. Every drop weakens your seal.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Guard ambush

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: Little lambs from the Azure Cloud. And one lost puppy, come home at last. Hello, Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Xue Mei. Crimson Elder. Stay close to me.

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: I'll take the pretty ice sword for the cages. Kill the rest.

objectives.text: Regroup with Ye Wuming by the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They took Han Xue. Xue Mei wanted her alive. Her blood is pure. They'll put her in the cages.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we go to the cages. Now.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not now. The obelisks will sense you. Break them first, or the cages will drain her before we arrive.

quests.title: Shattering the Obelisks
quests.summary: Ye Wuming knows a counter-rune. Gather the rune fragments and break the obelisk ring.

objectives.text: Collect rune fragments around the obelisks
Shatter the heart obelisk with the counter-rune

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press the fragments to the obelisk in Ye Wuming's pattern. Your pendant blazes. The black stone cracks like ice.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one, the obelisks crumble. Far off, in the dark, many voices gasp at once, like people breathing for the first time in days.

objectives.text: Deal with the guards drawn by the noise

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The cages are past the war camp. They'll be expecting us now. Good. Expecting and ready are different things.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You could have left me at your sect gate. Why didn't you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because you've never lied to me. Not once. That's rare.

quests.title: The War Camp
quests.summary: The Blood Moon war camp stands between you and the cages. Its command tent may hold answers.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crimson banners, black tents, and drums. Hundreds of warriors drill in silent rows.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The command tent is at the centre. Where there are orders, there are answers.

objectives.text: Break through the Blood Moon war camp
Seize the sealed letters from the command tent
Read the letters with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This one is orders. A siege on Qingshi Town, with Iron-Fang's bandits, before the next blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This one is in Gu's hand. To the Patriarch. The diagram is delivered. Remember your promise. Remember Lan.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Lan? Gu Lan was his daughter. She died twenty years ago.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Patriarch makes many promises to grieving fathers. He keeps very few.

quests.title: The Iron Cages
quests.summary: The prison cages hold every missing soul from Qingshi, and Han Xue.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron cages hang over a pit, each one crowded with pale, silent people. Somewhere a man is singing a lullaby, badly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The guards change at the red hour. That's now. Go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: About time. I was starting to compose my death poem. It was very good. Nobody will ever hear it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Farmers, fishermen, disciples of three sects. A young man with Xiao Man's eyes. And a boy who says his name is Liu Er.

quests.title: What the Prisoners Saw
quests.summary: The prisoners are free, but weak. Some of them have seen the altar.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: You're from the sect? My sister... is Xiao Man all right? Is she eating? She forgets to eat.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I followed the lanterns from the river. They caught me at the graves. They've been bleeding us for weeks.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: An elder from our sect was here. Gu. He stood by the altar and talked to the blood like it was a person.

objectives.text: Recover stolen medicine for the prisoners
Send the prisoners home with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'll lead them out. Ye Wuming marked the path. You two go to the altar.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And {player}? If Gu is there... don't hesitate. He won't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Get them home safe, Senior Sister. We'll be right behind you.

quests.title: The Altar of Blood
quests.summary: At the great altar, the stolen blood flows into the seal. The traitor is there, and he is not alone.

objectives.text: Witness the ritual at the Altar of Blood

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: You broke my obelisks and stole my lambs. I'll wear your skin to the Patriarch's awakening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You'll have to catch me first.

dialogue.speaker: crimson_xuemei
dialogue.text: Oh, I love it when they run.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You drive the Lotus Key against the altar. Green light floods the channels of blood, and the ritual chokes and dies.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Far below, something vast roars in frustration. The whole abyss shudders.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Gu is gone. Fled deeper. But you've bought the seal time. Months, maybe.

quests.title: Core Formation
quests.summary: The battle has pushed your qi to its limit. In the deepest part of the abyss, forge your golden core, then bring the news home.

objectives.text: Decide the fate of the captured acolytes with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: These three surrendered. Children, really. Blood Moon trained. The sect would execute them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They were stolen, like you. Take them. Teach them their own names.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...You are a strange cultivator, {player}. Very well. I will try.

objectives.choice_prompt: The captured acolytes wait on your word.

choices.text: Send them home, and trust them

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring them to the sect's Law Hall

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave them to the Abyss

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

objectives.text: Form your golden core in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Killing intent presses from every side. Your foundation cracks, and from the crack rises light.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi spins, tightens, and condenses into a golden core, bright as a small sun in the dark of the abyss.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The darkness can't touch it. I can feel it burning.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Core Formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The clouds come down low and heavy. Somewhere inside them, heaven weighs the core you are forging.

objectives.text: Return Xiao Shi to his sister

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Brother! Brother, you idiot, you absolute idiot, you never wrote!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: There were no brushes in the cage, Man Man.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {player}, I... thank you. I'll pick herbs for you for a hundred years. I'll only drop some of them.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A golden core, the captives freed, and the ritual broken. You went down a disciple and came back a pillar.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: But Qingshi is next. If the letters are true, the Blood Moon marches before the next blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest one night. Then we defend the town. We will not let it bleed a second time.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Smoke on the Horizon
quests.summary: The Sect Master sends you to Qingshi with Zhao Kang and Wei Tong. The Blood Moon will arrive within days.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take Zhao Kang and Wei Tong. The sect must hold the mountain in case this is a feint, so you three are the vanguard.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hold Qingshi until the moon wanes. Whatever it costs, don't let them turn the town into another graveyard.

objectives.text: Watch the Blood Moon host approach Qingshi
Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The immortals! Good. I have forty guards, three hundred farmers and one very old ballista.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I was a coward once, and a monster fed on my town while I drank his tea. Not twice. Tell me where to stand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right here, Magistrate. People need to see you standing.

quests.title: Walls and Wards
quests.summary: The walls are old, the guards are few, and Merchant Jin's warehouse is full of lamp oil he refuses to share.

objectives.text: Plan the defence with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The gate will hold for an hour against cultivators. Maybe. Fire will buy us more. We need oil for the wall braziers.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Jin's warehouse has barrels of it. He says it's for export. I say it's for not dying.

objectives.text: Persuade Merchant Jin to open his warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: My oil? That's six months' profit! Who compensates me? The yamen? The yamen owes me for the ballista!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You sold blood lotus to the people who took eleven of your neighbours. You owe this town more than oil.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: ...That was business. I didn't know. I didn't want to know.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Take it. Take all of it. Maybe it will weigh a little less on the scales in the next life.

objectives.text: Carry the oil barrels to the wall
Paint warding talismans on the town gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You paint the gate posts with cinnabar wards. Constable Du watches, then quietly paints a few crooked ones of his own.

quests.title: The Watchtower
quests.summary: Climb the watchtower and sound the alarm when the host arrives.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Torches, thousands of them, flow over the far hills like a burning river. Blood Moon banners, and bandit flags beside them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's... a lot of torches. I'm going to need a bigger lunch.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Doors slam. Children are carried to the temple. Old men pick up hoes and stand in the street.

objectives.text: Take your positions with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'll hold the east wall. Wei Tong takes the south. You go wherever it's worst. That's what you're good at.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And if I die, tell my clan I died beautifully. Specify beautifully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nobody's dying today, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. From your lips to heaven's ears.

quests.title: Raiders in the Fields
quests.summary: The bandits strike the farmland first, to burn the harvest and scatter the farmers.

objectives.text: Ask Old Pan to ferry the farmers to safety

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Ferry the farmers across? At night, with bandits shooting at us? Double fare.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I'm joking. No fare. Forty years on this river, and the first time anyone needed me. Go, I'll bring them over.

objectives.text: Drive the raiders from the fields

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Burn the rice! Burn the barns! Nobody eats this winter unless Iron-Fang says so!

objectives.text: Report to Wei Tong at the market kitchens

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The farmers are across? Good. I've been guarding the kitchens. Strategically. Armies march on their stomachs.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Here, a dumpling. Eat it. Then go and hit something. Elder Mo would want you fed and angry.

quests.title: The Graveyard Flank
quests.summary: Demonic cultivators are trying to wake Deacon Hong's old blood formation beneath the graves.

objectives.text: Break the demonic cultivators at the graves
Slay the blood-fed wolves they brought
Seal the blood formation for good

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press your palm to the rune circle. The Heart Sutra flows from your golden core, and the blood-ink fades to grey dust.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The east wall held. Barely. I may have set my own sleeve on fire. It was a tactical fire.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They didn't push the graveyard to take the town. They wanted blood on those runes. Why?

quests.title: The Riverside Assault
quests.summary: Blood Guards come up the river on rafts. Old Pan's ferry is still out on the water.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Black rafts slide down the river under the red moon. Out on the water, Old Pan's ferry is still crossing, packed with farmers.

objectives.text: Repel the Blood Guards at the docks
Save the medicine crates washed up on the bank
Bring the medicine to Widow Liu at the well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My Liu Er came home three days ago. Thin as a reed, but home. He talks about a sect disciple who broke his cage.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You didn't promise. You just did it. Now I'll carry water to your wall until my arms fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Tell Liu Er to stay inside tonight. And give him an extra bowl of rice from me.

quests.title: Treachery at the Warehouse
quests.summary: Bandits are pouring out of a tunnel under the guild warehouse. Merchant Jin knows why.

objectives.text: Catch Merchant Jin in the back alley

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Don't kill me! I dug that tunnel years ago for smuggling tea! Iron-Fang found out. He threatened my daughters.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I opened it for him tonight. Then I saw you give away my oil to people who'd spat at me. I couldn't...

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Turn me in. I deserve it. But close the tunnel first. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Fear made you do it. What you do next is your choice. Go help Constable Du, Master Jin.

objectives.text: Stop the bandits in the warehouse yard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A talisman flares. The earth groans, and the tunnel folds in on itself with a satisfying thump.

quests.title: Iron-Fang Tie Hu
quests.summary: Iron-Fang himself leads his men into the market square. End this.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You again! The sect brat who took my token. I've dreamed about this, you know. Every night.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I've heard your men talk, Iron-Fang. The Blood Moon holds their families. Holds yours too.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shut up! Shut up and fight!

objectives.text: Decide Iron-Fang's fate at the temple

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Go on, then. Finish it. That's what you sect types do to trash like me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Where are your people's families, Tie Hu?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: In the Abyss. Behind the black gate. I burned villages so they'd keep breathing. Does that make it better? It doesn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Kneel at this temple and swear to fight for the town you tried to burn. Then help me bring your families home.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...You're a fool. Fine. Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang kneels at the temple. The town wants blood.

choices.text: Spare him, as you promised

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Spare him, and bind him to the magistrate's justice

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Spare him, and make him your servant

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Last Wave
quests.summary: The final wave hits the town gate, and a familiar figure watches from the graveyard hill.

objectives.text: Hold the town gate against the last wave

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They're at the gate! Everyone with a spear, with me! For Qingshi!

objectives.text: Confront Gu Hanshan on the graveyard hill

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Well fought, disciple. Truly. You were always the most stubborn of the new ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Why, Elder Gu? Why betray the sect? Why feed children to the Blood Moon?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Patriarch holds my daughter's soul. When the seal breaks, he will give her back. A new body. A new life.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: This siege was never about the town. Every drop spilled here soaks down to the seal. You've helped him, you know.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You would do the same for someone you loved. Don't pretend you wouldn't.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where Gu stood there is only a scorched talisman and the smell of blood. He is gone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. I wouldn't. Not like this.

quests.title: Dawn over Qingshi
quests.summary: The siege is broken. Mourn the fallen, share a meal with the living, and report to the sect.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Qingshi stands. Nineteen dead, which is nineteen too many and ten thousand too few for what they intended.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I'm having a stele carved at the gate. Your name will be on it. The yamen will not forget. I will not forget.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Free wine for the heroes! One cup each. Immortals drink like fish and I'm not a lake.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang is washing dishes in my kitchen, by the way. He's surprisingly good. Very thorough scrubber.

objectives.text: Mourn the fallen at the temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nineteen tablets. Farmers, a guard, a boy who carried arrows. You burn incense for each, and say each name aloud.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You held the town. But Gu was right about one thing: the blood reached the seal. It has cracked again.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We cannot patch it any longer. We must build a new one. The Great Azure Formation, a seal for ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: It needs star iron, thunder crystal and phoenix feathers. They exist in one place: the Celestial Sky Isles.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Green Banners on the Steps
quests.summary: Green banners are climbing the nine thousand steps: the Iron Scale Sect, unannounced and in full armour.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (steps back half a pace) {senior}... people say things about you. I don't believe them. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Green banners on the steps! Thirty of them! In armour! Do we have an appointment? I don't think we have an appointment!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale disciples line the processional way, green scale armour polished to a shine. None of them bow.

objectives.text: Hear what Sect Master Ruan has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Ruan Hai, master of the Iron Scale. I have climbed nine thousand steps to say one thing to your Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Your traitor armed the Blood Moon. The Blood Moon took eleven of my children. I want the Lotus Key under a council's guard.

quests.title: An Audience Without Tea
quests.summary: The Sect Master receives the Iron Scale in the main hall. Nobody is offered tea, which in the Azure Cloud is a declaration.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan. Your grief is real, and our shame is real. The Lotus Key is not ours to give. It belongs to its bearer.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Then the bearer will come with me, under guard, to a council of the orthodox sects.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The bearer will do no such thing. You may stay as our guests. Without tea.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: No tea. She's furious. I haven't seen her refuse tea since the Cinder Peak incident. Nobody talks about the Cinder Peak incident.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Keep away from the green armour. Especially the young one. He's been glaring at you since the gate.

quests.title: The Young Master's Glare
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao, the Iron Scale's heir, does not keep away from you. He brings friends.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: So you're the famous Lotus heir. You look like a farmer. My cousin died on the Crimson Road. What did you ever lose?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My mother. My village. Nearly my senior sister. I'm sorry for your cousin.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Sorry. Everyone on this mountain is sorry. My friends want to see if you're sorry with a sword.

objectives.text: Defend yourself against the Iron Scale disciples

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: More Iron Scale disciples? Heaven must think we're bored.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Fine. You can fight. That doesn't make you right.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My cousin could fight too. It didn't help him. Remember that, farmer.

quests.title: Theft in the Guest Hall
quests.summary: In the night the Iron Scale's gift chest is broken open, and an Azure Cloud robe is found beside it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Their gift chest was forced in the night. An Azure Cloud outer robe was left beside it. Neatly folded. Too neatly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The guest hall is a storm of green armour and shouting. The chest lies open, and beside it, a folded blue robe.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock was cut with a blade that leaves a curved mark. There are traces of blood lotus in the cut. No Azure Cloud blade smells like that.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone wants us fighting. Someone who carries blood lotus and knows where our laundry is kept.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu had friends here. Some of them are still here. I'm starting to hate folded robes.

objectives.choice_prompt: The envoys demand that someone be punished for the broken chest before they leave.

choices.text: Stand surety for the sect yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Insist on a proper Law Hall inquiry

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Point at an Iron Scale servant to end it quickly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Folder of Robes
quests.summary: Footprints in the dew lead from the guest hall to the outer pines, where someone has been folding robes for a living.

objectives.text: Make your way to the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In a hollow under the pines: a stack of stolen robes, blue and green, and a blade with a curved edge still wet.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two of the sect's own servants turn from the hollow with knives. Their eyes flash red at the edges.

objectives.text: Gather the stolen robes as proof
Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know them. They carried food to the Law Hall cells. I saw them once in the Abyss too, bringing sacks. I didn't say. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You didn't know what it meant, Xiao Shi.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know now. I'll say everything I remember. Everything. Even the parts I'd rather keep in the cage.

quests.title: Evidence Before the Envoys
quests.summary: The Sect Master lays the stolen robes and the curved blade before Ruan Hai. He looks at them for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your chest was opened by the Blood Moon. The robe was ours, and stolen. They want our sects at each other's throats.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...And they very nearly had it. My son had his sword half drawn at breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: I do not withdraw my demand. But I withdraw my accusation. There will be a duel of banners instead. By the old law.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Nine Banners. Nine duels, nine champions a side. Nobody's done that in eighty years. We'll need nine people who can fight.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You're one. Pick the other eight. Choose well; the loser's sect gives up the question.

quests.title: Nine Banner Poles
quests.summary: The old law requires nine banner poles cut from the sect's own pines. Nobody remembers how tall. Lu Ping guesses.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nine banner poles! From our own pines! The law says 'as tall as honour'. I've decided honour is about four men tall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Cut banner poles in the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Perfect. Very honourable poles. I've also started a betting book. The Iron Scale are betting too. Business is booming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Choosing Nine
quests.summary: Nine champions for the Azure Cloud. Everyone wants to be chosen. Not everyone should be.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak volunteers. All of Thunder Peak. We've been practising shouting in green. Pick me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm on your list. Don't argue. The Zhao clan has fought in every duel of banners since the sect was founded. All two of them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And Han Xue. And Wei Tong, because he'll sulk otherwise, and a sulking Wei Tong eats the whole kitchen.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'm not on the list. Good. I'll hold the banners. I'm good at holding things. I held on for weeks in that cage.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Night Before the Banners
quests.summary: The night before the duel, someone rings the gate bell and sets fire to the Iron Scale's camp.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Fire at the Iron Scale camp! And I didn't ring the bell this time, someone else did, which is very rude!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Ring the bell to wake both sects

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell booms. Blue robes and green armour pour out together, buckets in hand, as masked figures slip toward the pines.

objectives.text: Clear the sect gate of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You... carried water to my camp. You fought the arsonists beside my disciples. Why?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because it was on fire, Ruan Jingtao.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: ...That's a stupid reason. It's the best reason I've heard in a year. The duel's still on tomorrow.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Rules of Banners
quests.summary: Elder Bai reads the old rules of the Nine Banners aloud, with commentary nobody asked for.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Rule one: no killing. Rule two: no crippling. Rule three: no insulting the other sect's grandmother. Rule three was added later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The last duel of banners, eighty years ago, ended when both champions fell in love. Rule nine was added after that.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Win if you can. Lose if you must. But whatever happens, make them see we are not their enemy.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon is laughing at us. Let's give it less to laugh at.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Banners Around the Plaza
quests.summary: Nine banners ring the formation plaza. Both sects fill the walls. Lu Ping's betting book is thicker than the rules.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine banners, blue and green, ring the plaza. Both sects crowd the walls. Somebody is selling roasted chestnuts at three times the price.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Mo has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: First banner: Wei Tong. He insisted on going first. He said he wants to finish before lunch.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Stand with me and watch. A champion watches before he fights. Otherwise he's just a man with a sword.

quests.title: The First Three Banners
quests.summary: Wei Tong wins the first banner. Yan Tie shouts his way through the second. Han Xue loses the third, and is furious about it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: First banner! I won! He was very big and I was very hungry! Hunger wins!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Help the heralds clear the rowdy crowd

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale supporters vault the wall after the second banner. Azure Cloud disciples vault after them. The heralds look at you.

objectives.text: Look for Han Xue at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I lost the third. He was better. I'm going to go and be angry in the pavilion. Win yours.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Eye Is Listening
quests.summary: Between banners you feel the cracked Azure Eye stir under the plaza, drinking the qi of every duel.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every clash on the plaza sends a ripple through the stone. Beneath your feet, the Azure Eye's crack drinks the ripples in.

objectives.text: Press your palm to the formation between bouts

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Faint, beneath the stone: the breathing you felt beside the Sect Master. Slower now. Pleased.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You felt it too? The Eye is feeding on the duel. Fighting on the formation was always a strange tradition.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I'll note it. I note everything. I'm noting that you look pale. Go and eat something before your banner.

quests.title: Fourth to Sixth
quests.summary: Zhao Kang takes the fourth banner with style. The fifth is a draw. The sixth, Iron Scale. The plaza holds its breath.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fourth banner, mine. Did you see the second exchange? Tell me you saw the second exchange. It was beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fifth was a draw. Sixth went to them. Three all. Your banner's the ninth. Of course it is. Everything important falls on you.

objectives.text: Meet Ruan Jingtao at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Ninth banner. You and me. I asked for it. My father said I was being childish. I said yes.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My cousin used to say the Azure Cloud were soft. I want to know if he was wrong.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Salve Between Bouts
quests.summary: Both sects' fighters are battered. Elder Hua has sent salve, and someone has to carry it round both camps.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Salve for every fighter. Both sides. A bruise doesn't care what colour the robe is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather salve jars from the Medicine Hall
Talk with Sect Master Ruan at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: You brought salve to my disciples. Before your own bout. Hm.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: My son thinks the Azure Cloud is soft. I'm beginning to think he means kind, and doesn't know the word.

quests.title: Seventh and Eighth
quests.summary: The seventh banner goes to Yan Tie. The eighth to the Iron Scale. The ninth is yours. Elder Mo gives you one minute of advice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Four all. Ninth banner. One minute of advice. The boy fights with his grief. Don't fight his grief. Fight him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Steady your golden core before the ninth banner

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your core turns slowly, gold and steady. The plaza's noise falls away until there is only breath, and the next breath.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Adequate. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Ninth Banner
quests.summary: The ninth banner: you against Ruan Jingtao, heir of the Iron Scale, with both sects' fate on the plaza.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The plaza falls silent. Ruan Jingtao draws a blade of green steel and salutes, stiffly, correctly.

objectives.name: Ruan Jingtao
objectives.text: Face Ruan Jingtao at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: For my cousin! For the eleven!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: For them too, Ruan Jingtao. Come on.

objectives.text: Find Ruan Jingtao after the fight

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You could have ended it at the third exchange. You didn't. You let me fight until I'd said everything I needed to say with my sword.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My cousin was wrong. You're not soft. You're something worse. You're kind on purpose.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemy's belongings: a manual of a forbidden blood technique.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Seal it in the Scripture Pagoda

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep it. Study it. Quietly.

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Question Given Up
quests.summary: Five banners to four. By the old law the Iron Scale gives up the question of the Lotus Key. Ruan Hai does it with dignity.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale gives up the question, by the old law. The key stays with its bearer. We will not raise it again.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: And we will ask for something else. When you go after the Blood Moon, send word. The Iron Scale will stand with you.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Thank you, Sect Master Ruan. Now there will be tea. A great deal of tea.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Cinder Peak incident started with tea. Let us hope this ends with it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Jingtao, humiliated by the loss, stands alone among the banners.

choices.text: Go and offer him your hand

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Leave him to his own sect's customs

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Mock the Iron Scale where he can hear

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Tea for Two Sects
quests.summary: The Azure Cloud serves tea to the Iron Scale on the plaza. It is awkward. Then it is less awkward. Then Wei Tong sings.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows so deeply they nearly topple) {senior}! This junior greets... I mean, hello. Your qi makes my hair stand up.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Tea for everyone! I'm pouring! I've won nineteen stones and lost eighteen. I'm up one stone and I feel like an emperor.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Carry tea cups around the plaza
Raise a cup to the fallen of both sects

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two sects raise their cups together, to eleven Iron Scale dead and to everyone the Blood Moon has taken. Then Wei Tong sings, badly.

objectives.text: Join Ruan Jingtao at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your senior brother is a terrible singer. He's wonderful. We don't have anyone like that. We should get one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Five Banners to Four
quests.summary: When the plaza empties, you sit where the ninth banner stood and let the duel settle into your core.

objectives.text: Settle your core on the empty plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your core spins, and each turn remembers a blow you didn't strike. It grows denser, and quieter. Middle stage of Core Formation.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath you the Azure Eye breathes. Slower now, and patient, like something that can wait a long time for what it wants.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I lost the third banner. I'm going to train until I never lose another. You're going to help. Tomorrow. Dawn.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And... you did well. That's all. Don't look at me like that.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Groves on Fire
quests.summary: Smoke rises from the forest's eastern groves. The hermit sends a crane: green armour, burning herbs, and something wrong.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The eastern groves are burning. The best moonbell in the province. The hermit's crane says green armour.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale swore peace a week ago. Either they lied, or someone is wearing their armour. Find out which.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The herb grove is ash and smoke. Among the burned moonbell, a scrap of green scale armour, still hot.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They came at dawn, in green. They burned the grove and left the wolves alone. Bandits burn everything. These chose.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Raiders in Green
quests.summary: The raiders are still in the forest, burning their way toward the spirit spring.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're heading for the spring. If they burn the spring, the whole forest sickens.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Iron Scale disciples is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Hold the spirit spring against more green-armoured raiders

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Green-armoured raiders turn at the spring, torches raised. Their eyes are red at the edges.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The raiders fall back into the bamboo. One leaves his helmet in the mud. It's too big for him.

quests.title: Armour Too Big
quests.summary: The fallen raider's armour is genuine Iron Scale work, but made for a larger man. Stolen, or taken from the dead.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The helmet is real Iron Scale steel. The name scratched inside is not the raider's.

objectives.text: Read the name inside the helmet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ruan Mingyu. Crimson Road. The Iron Scale's dead cousin, whose armour went into the Abyss with him.

objectives.text: Tell Ruan Jingtao what you found

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: That's my cousin's helmet. They took it off his body. They're wearing our dead to start a war.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale will hunt them with you. Not for peace. For him.

quests.title: Following the Ash
quests.summary: The raiders leave a trail of ash and red-eyed wolves. Ruan Jingtao insists on walking in front.

objectives.text: Make your way to the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A trail of burned bamboo leads north. Ruan Jingtao walks ahead of you, jaw tight, sword drawn.

objectives.text: Break the corrupted wolves at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Wolves with red eyes! Is everything in your forest trying to eat us?

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Orders. In Blood Moon script. They're camped in the old bandit camp. Of course they are. Everyone camps there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Camp of Borrowed Armour
quests.summary: The old bandit camp is full of green armour on red-eyed men. And in a pen at the back, three real Iron Scale disciples.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the camp below: green armour on red-eyed men, and in a pen at the back, three young disciples in torn green robes.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators at the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Those are ours! In the pen! Taken on the Crimson Road! Alive! Get them out!

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pen's lock breaks. Three Iron Scale disciples stumble out, thin and dazed, and throw themselves on Ruan Jingtao.

objectives.text: Show Ruan Jingtao what you found

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Three of the eleven. Alive. My father thought... we all thought...

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I owe you, Azure Cloud. The Iron Scale doesn't like owing. We're going to have to become friends to pay it off.

quests.title: What the Captives Saw
quests.summary: The rescued Iron Scale disciples were held in the Abyss before they were brought here. They saw things.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They were in the Abyss. Near the cages. They say someone was talking about you. By name.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The eldest captive speaks haltingly. An old man in Law Hall grey, he says. He said the heir must grow strong first. Strong enough to be worth it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Worth what?

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He didn't say. He only said it the way you'd say a crop needs to ripen.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Gu. Waiting for you to grow. Like a farmer. I'm going to be sick.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
