dialogue.text: Then we grow faster than he can plan for. That's all we can do.

objectives.choice_prompt: A captured raider offers the camp's cache in exchange for his freedom.

choices.text: Agree, and keep your word

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Refuse any deal with raiders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Agree, then hand him in anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Healing the Burned Grove
quests.summary: The hermit asks you to help him heal the burned grove with the sutra. Fire is fast; roots are patient.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Fire is fast. Roots are patient. Sit in the ash with me and remind the roots they're still alive.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Heal the burned grove with the Heart Sutra

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe the sutra into the ash. Root. Stem. Beneath your palms, something green stirs in the black.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Seedlings by morning. The forest is better at forgiving than we are. We could learn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Red Eyes Come Back
quests.summary: The raiders who escaped come back at night for the rescued captives, and bring more wolves than men.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me. He said you'd need someone to complain at. Also, there are about thirty wolves behind you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Defeat the corrupted wolves at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale boy fought well. Don't tell him. I've just got used to one rival; I can't handle two.

quests.title: The Raiders' Cache
quests.summary: Under the bandit camp's firepit the raiders buried a cache: stolen armour, Frenzy Pills and a list.

objectives.text: Go to the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The firepit is cold. Beneath the ash, a hatch of rotten boards, and beneath that, a pit.

objectives.text: Dig out the raiders' buried cache

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Frenzy Pills, forty of them. Iron Scale armour from nine dead disciples. And a list of sects: Iron Scale, Azure Cloud, Moon-Well, Zhao.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Four names. Four sects to set against each other. We were just the first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then the other three need to know. Before the pills reach them.

quests.title: Letters to Four Sects
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao and you write to the sects on the list, together. It is the first letter the Iron Scale has co-signed in a century.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father will faint. An Iron Scale letter, co-signed by an Azure Cloud disciple. We'll need to invent a new seal.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Moon-Well, Zhao clan... they'll listen to two sects where they'd laugh at one.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Two sects writing together. That's how the Verdant Lotus and the Azure Cloud started, the hermit says.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It ended with a seal under the earth. Let's hope ours ends better.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: What Bai Wants to Know
quests.summary: Elder Bai needs to know how the Sky Isles open. The pagoda's books say sixty years; they don't say when the sixty began.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Sky Isles open once in sixty years. Every book says so. No book says which sixty. We could wait a week or a lifetime.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus went to the isles for the first seal's star iron. If anyone recorded the cycle, they did. Beneath their ruins.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus archway stands open, as it has since the day it opened for you. Below the courtyard, water shines in the dark.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The archive. Flooded when the sect fell. I never went down. Some of my masters are still down there. Their bones, at least.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Breath Stones
quests.summary: The hermit says the Verdant Lotus used breath stones to walk the flooded halls. There are still some in the shrine.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Breath stones. Hold one under your tongue and the water forgets you're not a fish. There should be some left at the shrine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Find breath stones in the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Five stones. Enough for three of you, twice. Don't swallow them. My master swallowed one once. She was a fish for a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Into the Flooded Halls
quests.summary: Under the courtyard the Verdant Lotus archive lies drowned: shelves of jade, halls of green water, and silence.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Green water, still and clear. Shelves of jade slips glimmer on the bottom like fish scales.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The first seal's star iron came from the isles, in the sixtieth year after the Patriarch's first ascent. The isles keep his count.

objectives.text: Drive the stone golems from the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The archive's stone keepers rise from the water, streaming, to see who reads their stele.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You surface, gasping. The breath stone tastes of mint and old tears.

quests.title: The Patriarch's Count
quests.summary: Elder Bai does the arithmetic by the ruins gate, on a flat stone, with a stick, muttering.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Sixty years after the Patriarch's first ascent. He climbed three hundred and... carry the nine... The isles open this winter.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: This winter! We have months, not years! I need to sit down. I am sitting down. I need to sit down more.

objectives.text: Check Elder Bai's arithmetic against the shrine stele

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine's stele confirms it, in a Verdant Lotus hand: they open when the Patriarch's stars are low. This winter, they will be.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Months. We need the materials, the design, the people. And the isles are guarded, the books say. By what?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Bones in the Archive
quests.summary: In the lower hall you find what the hermit feared: the Verdant Lotus elders who stayed to guard the archive.

objectives.text: Make your way to the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the lowest hall lie seven skeletons in green-stained robes, seated in a circle, hands still joined.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Seven. My teachers' teachers. They stayed. They held the water back so the archive would survive. I ran past this door.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I ran past this door. I heard them singing. I ran.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I heard singing in the cages, too. Other prisoners. It helped. I don't think they minded that I didn't sing back.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I think they just wanted someone to hear.

quests.title: Robbers in the Water
quests.summary: Rogue cultivators have followed the rumour of Verdant Lotus treasure, and they're diving without breath stones.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Rogues again. Diving for the archive. Half of them are drowning and the other half are drowning slower.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Clear the ruins gate of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

objectives.text: Finish the rogue cultivators at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I pulled three of them out of the water before I hit them. The Zhao clan has standards. Low ones, but standards.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Drowned Librarian
quests.summary: The archive's last guardian is a stone librarian that has been reshelving the same drowned slips for three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A stone figure moves through the water, slow and precise, lifting slips from the floor and placing them on shelves that are no longer there.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It turns. Its eyes glow green. It does not ask who carries the flower. It asks: have you returned your books?

objectives.text: Return the drowned slips to the librarian

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The librarian takes the slips, places them on a shelf that isn't there, and kneels. Its work is finished.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It asked if you'd returned your books. A librarian after my own heart. I want it carved over the pagoda door.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The stone librarian won't let one slip leave: a forbidden technique it has guarded for centuries.

choices.text: Leave it with its guardian

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Distract the librarian and take it for Elder Bai

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Take it for yourself

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Song for Seven
quests.summary: The hermit goes down to the seven skeletons at last, and asks you to sit with him while he sings the song he ran from.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They sang the Heart Sutra while the water rose. I ran. Now I'm going to sing it back to them. Sit with me. I may not finish.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Sit with the hermit while he sings

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: His voice cracks on the first line, steadies on the second. By the third verse the water in the lower hall is glowing faintly green.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: When he finishes, the seven skeletons are gone. Only seven lotus flowers float where they sat.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They heard. I don't know how I know. They heard. Three hundred years late, and they heard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Slips for the Sect
quests.summary: The archive's surviving slips are Verdant Lotus lore: sealing arts, star charts, recipes. Bai wants every one dried.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Every surviving slip. Dry them in the shade, never the sun. Jade sulks in the sun. So do I.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Carry the surviving slips up from the archive

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Star charts! Sealing diagrams! A recipe for turtle soup! The Verdant Lotus understood what matters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Hermit Stops Running
quests.summary: On the way out, the hermit says something he has not said in three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I think I have stopped running. I don't know what to do now. Running was a very time-consuming hobby.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could come to the sect. The seed you gave me is growing in the pond.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Is it? ...Not yet. But I'll come and look at it. From a distance. That's a beginning.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Months until the isles open. We'd better go home and tell the Sect Master to start packing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Neutral Ground
quests.summary: Madam Fang has agreed to host four sects at the Drunken Crane. She has also raised her prices, on principle.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four sects' banners hang outside the Drunken Crane. The whole town has found reasons to walk past very slowly.

objectives.text: Talk with Madam Fang at the main street

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Four sects in my inn! Four! I've hidden the good wine and brought out the diplomatic wine. It's the same wine. The cups are nicer.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My dishwasher is very excited. Well. He's very quiet. That's excited, for him.

quests.title: The Dishwasher
quests.summary: Iron-Fang is washing dishes behind the inn. He has been since the siege. He is surprisingly good at it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Sect brat. You're here for the big meeting. I'm here for the big pile of cups. We all have our battles.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men are working the farms. My family's still in the Abyss. Every plate I wash, I count. It's a very long count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We'll bring them out, Tie Hu. I haven't forgotten.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Neither have I. Now move, you're standing in my rinse water.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang lets me dry. He says I'm the best dryer in Qingshi. I'm the only dryer in Qingshi.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Four Chairs, Five Guests
quests.summary: The meeting table is set for four sect leaders. Someone has quietly added a fifth chair.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The upstairs room is set for four: Azure Cloud, Iron Scale, Zhao clan, Moon-Well. A fifth chair stands in the corner, facing the window.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the seat, a crescent scratched into the wood, and fresh. Someone is expected who wasn't invited.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A fifth chair. A crescent. Someone thinks they're coming to this meeting. I'm going to be very rude to them.

quests.title: The Zhao Ancestor
quests.summary: Zhao Kang's great-grandfather arrives for the Zhao clan, and is exactly as warm as a gold bar left out in winter.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: So you're the village child my great-grandson writes about. He writes about you more than he writes to me.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: He says you're insufferable. From him, that's a love letter. The Zhao clan will listen. Once.

objectives.text: Join Sect Master Ruan at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Ancestor Zhao. Still alive, I see. Still counting gold, I hear.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan. Still losing duels, I hear. To children.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...It was a very good child.

quests.title: The First Cup
quests.summary: Madam Fang pours the first cup. Han Xue knocks it out of Sect Master Ruan's hand. It hisses on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Don't drink! The tea smells of blood lotus! Somebody's in the kitchen!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The kitchen door bangs shut under your ward. Behind it, something heavy hits the wood and snarls.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Servers throw off their aprons. Crimson robes underneath. Knives come out of the noodle baskets.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Guards that follow
Catch your breath with Constable Du

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Six of them, dressed as servers. Madam Fang hired them yesterday. She's mortified. She's hitting one with a ladle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Where the Poisoner Went
quests.summary: The poisoner slipped out of the kitchen's back window. Iron-Fang saw which way. He's already running.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Pale man, no apron, out the back window. I threw a pot at him. I missed. I never miss. He's quick.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back alley is empty. Too empty. A pot lies dented on the stones. Above, a shutter swings shut.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: More crimson servers wait at the docks, blocking the ferry. The poisoner's escape route.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Pale fellow jumped in the river. Swam like an eel. Didn't come up. I've seen that before. The Blood Moon ones swim under.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: He'll come up at the graves. They always do. Always the graves.

quests.title: The Pale Assassin
quests.summary: The poisoner comes up at the graves, as Old Pan said. He is pale as fish-belly, and he has been waiting for you, not the sect masters.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among the tombs stands a man so pale he seems carved from candle wax. He smiles. His teeth are red.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The heir, he says. I was told to test you, not kill you. But I've always been bad at following orders.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You chased him alone? Into a graveyard? The Iron Scale would call that brave. The Azure Cloud would call it stupid.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: I call it the reason my father is still alive. Thank you. Again. I'm running out of ways to say it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The pale poisoner lies beaten among the graves, offering his employer's name for his life.

choices.text: Let him go for the name

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Hand him to the four sects' tribunal

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Kill him before he can lie to you

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Four Seals on One Page
quests.summary: Over a second pot of tea, one that everyone watches Madam Fang pour, four sects put their seals on one page.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Four sects. One page. Mutual warning, mutual aid, against the Blood Moon. My seal first. I nearly died for this one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao seal. Gold, naturally. My great-grandson will pretend not to be proud of me. He's very bad at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.text: Hear what Magistrate Zhou has to say

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: And the yamen of Qingshi as witness! My best seal! My only seal! I am a witness to history! I'm going to cry!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Noodles for Four Sects
quests.summary: Peace is signed. Madam Fang makes noodles for four sects, and everyone eats from the same pot, watching each other.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Noodles! From one pot! If anyone poisons this pot, they poison themselves, which is the most honest diplomacy I know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Carry bowls from the market stalls
Serve the first bowl at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four sect masters eat from the same pot, watching each other over the rims. Iron-Fang washes their bowls, and nobody notices him smile.

objectives.text: Meet Widow Liu at the main street

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My son dried every bowl. He's asleep in a barrel. He says it's the best day of his life. He says that every day now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Test, Not the Kill
quests.summary: The assassin said he was sent to test you, not kill you. You sit in the clean temple and wonder who wanted to know.

objectives.text: Sit with the assassin's words in the temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Test you, not kill you. Someone is measuring your core the way a farmer measures a crop. You let the thought pass, and your core grows anyway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Late stage of Core Formation. You're stronger. That's exactly what they want. It's also exactly what you need.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Test, not kill. Gu, waiting for you to ripen. The assassin just confirmed it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Fine. We ripen. We ripen so hard it breaks their teeth.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Qi Like a Blade
quests.summary: Elder Mo's first lesson in sword qi: cut a falling leaf in half without touching it. He demonstrates. Four times.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sword qi. The core throws what the hand cannot reach. Watch. Leaf falls. Qi cuts. Leaf is two leaves.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: ...That was a gust of wind. Watch again. Leaf falls. There. Two leaves. Your turn.

objectives.text: Cut falling plum petals with sword qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thousand petals fall. You cut none. Then one. Then, as the sun sets, every petal that falls near you drifts down in halves.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Halves. Adequate. Tomorrow, stone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Stone Tomorrow
quests.summary: Tomorrow is stone: sparring golems that only sword qi can scratch.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sparring golems. Palm strikes bounce. Qi cuts. Don't punch them, you'll break your hand and I'll have to fill in a form.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Stop the sparring golems at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The sparring golems come on in silence.

objectives.text: Look for Wei Tong at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You cut a golem in half! With your mind! I've been punching them for six years. I feel betrayed by technique.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Nights
quests.summary: Xiao Man comes to you at night. Her brother still wakes up counting bars. She doesn't know what to do.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He wakes up counting. Every night. One, two, three, up to forty. The cage had forty bars.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I sit with him. It doesn't help. You were in the Abyss. Maybe he'd talk to you.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Forty bars. I know it's silly. I know I'm home. My body doesn't know. My body is still counting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mine counted too, after the Abyss. I count breaths instead now. It's the same counting, pointed somewhere better.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: ...Breaths. Four in, four out. Like Han Xue says. I'll try. Stay till I fall asleep? Just tonight.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks you not to tell anyone her brother still counts bars at night.

choices.text: Keep it between the three of you

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Put his name on Elder Hua's list

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Tell him to toughen up

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Counting Breaths
quests.summary: You sit with Xiao Shi on the stone bridge and count breaths until he stops counting bars.

objectives.text: Count breaths with Xiao Shi on the bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four in, four out. Xiao Shi's shoulders drop by the twentieth breath. By the fortieth he is asleep against the railing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You keep counting. Your core counts with you, steady and gold, and settles a little deeper.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He slept! All night! Without counting! I'm going to make you a pill. It'll probably be a pill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Iron From the Pines
quests.summary: Elder Mo wants to forge you a practice blade, one that can hold core-qi without shattering. It needs iron from a lightning-struck pine.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Lightning-struck pine. The iron in the sap holds qi. Find me enough and I'll forge you a practice blade. An ugly one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Collect iron sap from the lightning-struck pines

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Enough. It'll be ugly. Ugly blades live longest. So do ugly elders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit stones than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_mo
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Wolves Want the Sap
quests.summary: Iron sap draws wolves. They like the taste. So does Wei Tong, apparently.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pines are full of grey wolves licking the sap. Wei Tong is among them, also licking the sap.

objectives.text: Defeat the spirit wolves at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It tastes like pine and lightning! Don't judge me! Wolves! Wolves are judging me!

objectives.text: Gather what's left of the sap

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I've learned something about myself today. I don't like it. I'm going to go and lie down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Ugly Blade
quests.summary: Elder Mo forges the practice blade himself, at the formation's edge, at midnight, with a hammer older than the sect.

objectives.text: Make your way to the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sparks fly at the plaza's edge. Elder Mo works bare-armed, hammering iron sap into a blade by the formation's light.

objectives.text: Quench the blade in the formation's light

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blade drinks the formation's light and cools grey and plain. When you lift it, your core answers it like an old friend.

objectives.text: Show Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Ugly. Perfect. My master forged mine the same way. It's in my room. I'm too old for it. Don't argue. Take care of yours.

quests.title: Mo Remembers His Master
quests.summary: Elder Mo is in a talking mood, which happens once a decade. He tells you about his master.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: My master was a terrible teacher. Shouted. Threw things. Made me climb the steps on my hands.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Then one day he put his hand on my head and said adequate, and I would have died for him. That's all a teacher is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Mo. Adequate.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: ...Don't. Don't you dare. Hmph. Go to bed. My eyes are tired. It's the smoke.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Sword Qi in Earnest
quests.summary: Blood Moon scouts are caught mapping the sect's walls. Your new blade gets its first real test.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Scouts on the wall, mapping it. Gu wants to know our defences. Let's teach them a few new ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Hold the sect gate against more Blood Moon cultivators

quests.title: Winter Coming
quests.summary: The first snow falls on the mountain. Elder Bai looks at the sky and says the isles will open soon.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: First snow. The Patriarch's stars are sinking. The isles will open within the month. I've written to the Sect Master in capitals.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak wants to go to the isles. All of Thunder Peak. I said you'd pick. You'll pick me. You'll pick me, right?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The Sect Master will choose soon. Whatever she chooses, you're ready. Adequately ready. More than adequately.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Message From the Rim
quests.summary: A child in patched black robes climbs the nine thousand steps with a message from Ye Wuming. She has chosen her own name, too.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A little girl in black robes at the gate! She says her name is Spring, she chose it herself, and Ye Wuming sent her.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: She's very serious. She's frightening. I gave her a bun. She saluted the bun.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming waits at the canyon mouth with three children in black. They watch you with old eyes in young faces.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You came. Good. The Blood Moon has begun to dig on the bone field. I don't know what for. I'd like to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Picks on the Bone Field
quests.summary: Blood Guards are digging on the bone field, very carefully, as if the bones might break something they want.

objectives.text: Hurry to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Guards dig in careful rows among the bones. Crates stand nearby, each stamped with seven small dots.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder-struck bone, and chips of crystal that hum. Seven dots on every lid, arranged like a ladder.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Seven dots. I've seen the mark before. On the Patriarch's own door, long ago. I never knew what it meant.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I was six. I thought it was stars. Maybe it was.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

quests.title: Breaking the Dig
quests.summary: Whatever they're digging for, they shouldn't have it. Ye Wuming's children watch from the rocks as you break the dig.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Break the dig. My children will watch. They need to see that the Blood Guards can fall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Clear the field of bones of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Blood Guards ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The children cheer when the last guard falls, then stop, embarrassed, and cheer again more quietly.

quests.title: Children With Names
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children have chosen their names. They want to tell you, one by one, very formally.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They want to tell you their names. They chose them. Please be... very serious about it. It matters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring. River. Small Mountain. Each child bows and says the name as if handing you something breakable.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Spring, River, Small Mountain. Thank you for telling me. I'll remember.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Nobody ever said their names back to them before. You did it without thinking. That's why I asked you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I still haven't found mine. I will. I'm told these things take time.

objectives.choice_prompt: The children of the rim have names now, but nowhere to live. The sect has no rule for them.

choices.text: Petition the Sect Master to take them in

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Take them down to Qingshi yourself, tonight

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Leave them. They're not your problem.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Crystals in the Pools
quests.summary: The miners hid their finds in the blood pools. The pools are guarded by wolves who drink the stolen blood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crates bob in the steaming pools, tied with red rope. Wolves circle them, fat and slow and red-eyed.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Corrupted wolves! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Recover the hidden crystals from the pools
Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals. Why would the Blood Moon want thunder crystals? They're only good for one thing: calling lightning.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why would anyone down here want to call lightning?

quests.title: The Obelisk Stumps
quests.summary: The obelisks you broke have stumps, and someone has been re-carving them. Not with blood runes. With stars.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The obelisk stumps have been re-carved. Not blood runes: seven stars, over and over, climbing each stump like a ladder.

objectives.text: Collect fragments of the new carvings

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stump cracks. A thin thread of red light rises from it, straight up, toward where the stars would be if the Abyss had a sky.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The light draws Blood Guards from the camp, running.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming after the fight

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: A ladder of stars. They're building something that climbs. Your sect should know. Your old librarian especially.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Last Cage on the Rim
quests.summary: One cage still hangs at the rim, forgotten by everyone except the girl inside it.

objectives.text: Make your way to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Near the rim hangs a single cage, rusted. Inside, a girl in Moon-Well white is singing to herself.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Guards at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock breaks. The girl stops singing. I'm from the Moon-Well Nunnery, she says. Nobody came. I kept singing so I'd know I was here.

objectives.text: Tell Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'll take her home. I know what it's like when the door opens. You need someone to walk with you for the first hour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Letters for the Sect
quests.summary: Ye Wuming asks you to carry everything you found back to the sect. He also asks for something he has never asked for before.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Take the crystals, the carvings, the crates. Your sect will know what they mean better than I.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: And... when the time comes to march on this place, send for me. My children will help. They know every path.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You've never asked for anything before.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've never had anything to protect before. It changes a person. Go. Winter's coming, and so is your sky.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Pursuit to the Array
quests.summary: The Blood Guards are not letting the crystals go. They chase you all the way to the cracked teleport array.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me to bring you home. He didn't mention the forty Blood Guards. He never mentions the important things.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Go. I'll hold the rim with Ye Wuming's children. I've been told they bite. I respect that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Seven Dots, Explained Badly
quests.summary: Back at the sect, Elder Bai stares at the seven dots for an hour and declares that he has no idea, very loudly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Seven dots! Arranged like a ladder! Thunder crystals! I have no idea! I have read ten thousand books and I have no idea!

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: But the star charts from the drowned archive. There is a seven-star pattern on the one for the Sky Isles. Red. Unlabelled.

objectives.text: Compare the carvings with the drowned star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The same seven points. On the Verdant Lotus chart, drawn in red, over the highest of the Sky Isles. Someone has written beside it: never again.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Never again. Whatever it was happened before. On the isles. We're going to the isles in a month. Wonderful. Wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Stair Made of Cloud
quests.summary: At dawn a stair of cloud unrolls from the sky above the cliff edge. The whole sect comes out in its nightclothes to stare.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: There's a staircase in the sky! Made of cloud! Everyone's out in their pyjamas! Elder Bai's are covered in turtles!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A stair of white cloud descends from the sky, step by step, stopping just above the sea of clouds. It is not solid yet.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The isles are opening! In a week the stair will hold weight. In a week! I haven't finished the design!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Archive Copy
quests.summary: Elder Bai must finish the Great Azure Formation's design from the only complete copy left: the Law Hall's archive.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The master diagram is gone with Gu. The Law Hall kept an archive copy, sealed and certified. It's all we have.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Law Hall archive is a locked room of sealed boxes, each stamped with Gu Hanshan's seal. The dust on them is thick.

objectives.text: Unseal the Law Hall's archive copy

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The diagram is complete, certified, beautiful. Ten thousand runes. You couldn't tell a single one was wrong. Nobody could.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Complete. Certified. I'll need a week to rebuild the formation from it, and a month of Elder Mo's life to build it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: What the Formation Needs
quests.summary: The design is done. The list of materials is short and impossible: star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feathers.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feathers. None of them grow on this mountain. All of them grow up there.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Meanwhile, the frame. Spirit stones. Lots of them. Steward Qian has already fainted once.

objectives.text: Gather spirit stones for the formation frame
Meet Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Two hundred spirit stones! For a frame! A frame! I'm going to faint again. Catch me this time.

quests.title: Who Goes Up
quests.summary: The Sect Master chooses three for the isles. Everyone pretends they don't want to be chosen. Everyone wants to be chosen.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The isles allow few. Three will go. You. Han Xue. And Zhao Kang, who has asked me eleven times, in writing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Eleven times. With a seal. I'm not ashamed. I'm going to the isles. Try not to fall off anything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.text: Find Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak was not chosen. Thunder Peak will shout from the bottom of the stair. Very loudly. You'll hear us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Yan Tie mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Cloud Silk for the Climb
quests.summary: Elder Hua insists everyone who climbs wears cloud silk sashes, so the wind knows you're guests.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Cloud silk sashes. The wind on the isles is rude to strangers. It's polite to guests. This makes you guests.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Collect cloud silk from the drying racks

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Three sashes, one extra. For whoever falls first. It'll be Zhao Kang. Don't tell him I said that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the cloud silk you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Visitors Before the Stair
quests.summary: The stair has attracted more than sightseers. Blood Moon scouts try to climb it first.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Moon on the stair! They want to reach the isles before us. Why does everyone always want the same things we want?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They wanted the isles. Crystals, dots, ladders. We'll find out why up there. I'm tired of finding out after.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: One Blood Moon scout survived the fall from the stair. He offers what he knows for his life.

choices.text: Heal him and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Bring him to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Push him off again

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Dumplings for the Sky
quests.summary: The whole sect sends you off with gifts. Most of them are edible. One of them is a hat.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumplings for the sky. Wrapped in cloud silk, which Elder Hua says is a waste of cloud silk. She's wrong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Medicine. Also a hat. For the wind. My brother says the hat's ridiculous. He's wearing one.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It's a very good hat. Bring it back. Bring yourself back under it.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I've made a betting book on how many days you'll be gone. The Iron Scale are betting too. So is the Zhao ancestor. By letter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Core at the Peak
quests.summary: The night before the climb, Elder Mo sits with you at the cliff edge beneath the stair of cloud.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Sit. Your core's full. Too full. It'll crack soon, into something new. Probably on the isles. They're good at cracking people.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Cultivate beneath the stair of cloud

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core burns at its peak, so bright it almost hums. Above you the stair of cloud solidifies, step by step, in the moonlight.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Great Perfection of Core Formation. Adequate. I've said that word more to you than to anyone. Don't let it go to your head.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bring me star iron. I'll build the formation while you're gone. I'll check every rune. Twice. Go.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Last Word
quests.summary: Before the climb, the Sect Master says the thing she always says, and one thing she never has.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Look at the sky while you're up there. It's good for the soul. I never have time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: And... you were an orphan who climbed nine thousand steps with a letter and a pendant. Now you climb into the sky. I'm proud of you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you've never said that.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Sect masters don't. Tell no one. Go.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Man has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

quests.title: The Stair Holds
quests.summary: At dawn the stair of cloud holds weight. Three disciples stand at its foot with dumplings, silk and a hat.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair of cloud is solid under your foot. Cold, and faintly springy, like fresh snow. It climbs out of sight.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. That's a staircase to the sky. Zhao Kang is already complaining about the lack of railing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let's go. Before the Sect Master says anything else nice and we all start crying at the bottom of a staircase.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Stairway of Clouds
quests.summary: The Sky Isles have opened. The Sect Master sends you, Han Xue and Zhao Kang to gather materials for the Great Azure Formation.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Bai has rebuilt the formation design from the Law Hall archive copy. Elder Mo will build it. You will supply it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Five star iron, five thunder crystals, three phoenix feathers. The isles close again at the next full moon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Take Han Xue and Zhao Kang. And {player}? Look at the sky while you're up there. It's good for the soul.

objectives.text: Ascend to the Celestial Sky Isles
Meet the star-gazer at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Visitors. Sixty years, and they still come puffing up the stairs like it's a surprise.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I am Qing Luan. I was a sage of these isles, once. Now I'm mostly a very persistent memory.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The isles test those who cross. Your heart must be clear, your sword sharp, and your shoes sturdy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Two out of three is usually fine. Go on, lotus child. I'll be in my pavilion, watching.

quests.title: The Jade Bridge
quests.summary: Cross the long jade bridge to the second isle. The winds are strong, and you are not alone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's very high. Isn't it very high? Why is there no railing? Who builds a bridge with no railing?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Immortals who can fly, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well, that's elitist.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon pursuers on the bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Moon! They followed us through the array. Gu must have told them where we were going.

objectives.text: Catch your breath with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Why follow us here? What do demons want with the materials for a sealing formation?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: To stop us building it?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then why did they only watch us, and not attack until we reached the bridge? Something is wrong. I don't know what yet.

quests.title: Isle of Winds
quests.summary: The wind-swept isle is thick with cloud silk, and thick with sword intent for those who can listen.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk from the wind-swept pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wind has no shape, and so nothing can break it. It bends around every obstacle and arrives anyway.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang among the pines

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've been thinking. It happens occasionally. I've been an insufferable brat to you for two years.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: My brother would have liked you. He always said pride is a wall you build to keep yourself small.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: So. I'm sorry. There. Never tell anyone. I'll deny it with my last breath.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Apology accepted, Zhao Kang. Friend.

quests.title: The Star-Gazer's Riddle
quests.summary: Qing Luan will point you to the star iron, if you can answer her riddle. And read her chart. And listen to her complain.

objectives.text: Visit Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A riddle! I've waited sixty years to ask someone. What climbs higher the more you take away?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: A hole? No... a debt? Wait. A cultivator. The more attachments we let go, the higher we rise.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Wrong, but I like your answer better than mine. It was a staircase with the bottom steps removed. Read my chart.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Constellations drift across the jade. The star iron fell with the palace. The thunder grows where the vein runs.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the chart's corner, a seven-star pattern glows red. It is labelled: the Patriarch's Ladder.

objectives.text: Ask Qing Luan about the red stars

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Three hundred years ago a man called Xue Wuji came here. Very charming. He wanted the Ascension Stair.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He meant to ride the heavenly tribulation into the heavens and take them. Your founders stopped him, barely.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The star iron lies in the fallen palace. Watch out for the guardians. They're rude.

quests.title: Star Iron of the Fallen Palace
quests.summary: The celestial palace fell ten thousand years ago. Its guardians did not get the message.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Broken columns tower into the clouds. Among them lie lumps of dark metal, still faintly warm from falling out of the sky.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Whoever climbs the stair must carry nothing that is not theirs. Not a stolen body. Not a stolen name. Not a stolen heaven.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stolen body? What kind of warning is that?

quests.title: The Spirit Vein
quests.summary: Thunder crystals grow where the spirit vein breaks the surface. Someone else is already mining them.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon miners from the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Guards, with picks and sacks. They're mining thunder crystals!

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Crates of thunder crystals, carefully packed, each stamped with the same seven-star mark as the red stars.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals are only good for one thing: channelling heavenly lightning into a formation.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Our formation needs them too. Why would the Blood Moon build the same thing we're building?

quests.title: Garden of Immortals
quests.summary: Phoenix feathers fall in the overgrown garden, where the Jiao serpent hunts.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blossom trees taller than pagodas. Petals fall like warm snow. High in the branches, something golden rustles its wings.

objectives.text: Gather phoenix feathers in the immortal garden
Heed Qing Luan in the garden

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You have the feathers. Good. Now you have a problem. The Jiao smelled them. It smells everything.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It was a noble beast, guardian of these isles for a thousand years. Then the Blood Moon fed it their blood.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It is suffering. It will kill you because it is suffering. Please free it.

quests.title: The Jiao's Lair
quests.summary: The corrupted flood dragon will not let you leave the isles alive. Face it in its lair.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isle shudders. Scales the colour of storm clouds slide past, and a head the size of a house rises over the edge.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Nobody told me the serpent was THAT big.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone told you, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Its heart is still in there, lotus child. Strike the blood from it, not the life!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you. Hold on, great one. I'll set you free.

objectives.text: Tend to your wounds with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It looked at you before it sank into the clouds. Not like a beast. Like someone saying thank you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're shaking. Sit. That's an order from your senior sister, and I rarely give them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You give them constantly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I rarely give them nicely.

quests.title: The Stars Disagree
quests.summary: The Jiao left something behind in its lair, and Qing Luan has something to show you before you go.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Among bones and coins lies a heart of star iron the size of a fist, humming with stored lightning.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Its weight settles into your hands like it has been waiting for you.

objectives.text: Prepare to leave with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Star iron, thunder crystal, phoenix feather, and a dragon heart. We're rich. We're heroes. We're rich heroes.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Come on. Wei Tong promised a banquet. I'm told he's been practising dumplings for a month.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Show me the design your sect intends to build. Hm. Hmm. The stars disagree with it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Here, where it should turn inward, it turns outward. As if it were meant to open rather than close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It was rebuilt from the sect's Law Hall archive.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Then ask who kept the archive. Go carefully, lotus child. Heaven is watching you now.

quests.title: Nascent Soul
quests.summary: The winds of the isles have tempered you. At the cloud gate, give birth to your nascent soul, then bring the materials home.

objectives.text: Form your nascent soul at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your golden core cracks, and from it unfolds a tiny figure of light, cross-legged, with your face and a lotus in its hands.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: It opens its eyes. For the first time, you see the world twice: with your eyes, and with your soul.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul. Even the clouds look different. They look like they're breathing.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Nascent Soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The clouds split into a slow spiral. The first beasts of lightning drop out of it, eyes crackling.

objectives.text: Deliver the materials to Elder Mo at the formation array

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Star iron. Thunder crystal. Phoenix feathers. And a dragon's heart, you show-off. The formation will be finished in a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder, the star-gazer said the design is wrong. That it opens instead of closing. It was taken from the Law Hall archive.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bai checked it against the archive copy, sealed and certified. The Law Hall... hm. Gu kept that archive for thirty years.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Leave it with me. I'll check every rune myself. Go, see the Sect Master. You've earned your cake.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A nascent soul at your age. The elders are furious with envy. It's wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Elder Mo told me about the design. He is checking it himself. If anyone can find a hidden flaw, it is him.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest, {player}. For the first time in months, I think the sect can breathe.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Crane From the Clouds
quests.summary: A paper crane made of cloud lands on your windowsill and dissolves into Qing Luan's voice.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: A crane made of cloud flew into my tea. It said your name and then it was rain. I'm choosing to be calm about this.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The star-gazer wants you. Nascent souls can walk the cloud road, apparently. Go. The pillars can wait a week.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road holds under a soul's weight, if not a body's. The isles are silent and closed, and utterly beautiful.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You came! Through a closed gate, on a road made of your own soul. Sixty years, and you're my first repeat visitor.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit down. You have a soul now. Nobody ever teaches people what to do with it. I'm going to.

quests.title: Seeing With the Soul
quests.summary: Qing Luan's first lesson: close your eyes and look anyway.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Close your eyes. Now look. Not with those. With the little one inside, with your face and the lotus.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: See the isle with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind your eyelids the isle glows: every pine a green flame, every crystal a blue one. And far off, beneath the clouds, a red smear.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The red smear is the Abyss. You'll always see it now. Sorry. Soul sight doesn't have a way to not look.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Stepping With the Soul
quests.summary: The second lesson: let the soul step where the body can't, and the body will follow.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Soul step. Your soul goes first, one pace, and your body follows before it notices. Try it on my sentinels. They're very forgiving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They're not forgiving at all. I lied. Step faster!

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You're a pace ahead of yourself now. Everyone will think you're very quick. You're just early.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Seven Red Stars
quests.summary: Qing Luan brings out her star chart again. The seven red stars have moved, and she doesn't like where.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the jade floor of the pavilion, the seven red stars have shifted since you last saw them. Lower. Closer to the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Each red star is tied to a point on the earth below by a thread only soul sight can see. Seven threads. Seven places.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Patriarch's Ladder. Last time, he had seven servants, each holding one star. Rungs, they called themselves.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The rungs are held again. Seven someones, somewhere. Each one a step toward the sky for a soul that shouldn't climb.

quests.title: Storm Wolves on the Vein
quests.summary: Storm wolves have found the spirit vein, drawn by the crystals the Blood Moon left behind.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves with lightning in their fur prowl the spirit vein, licking the crystals until sparks run down their jaws.

objectives.text: Clear the spirit vein of storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These storm wolves fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Gather the crystals the wolves were guarding
Show Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Storm wolves. They used to be ordinary. The Blood Moon's crystals changed them. Everything they touch changes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Soul Knows Its Friends
quests.summary: Han Xue and Zhao Kang have followed you up the cloud road. With nascent souls you can see them for the first time.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Mo said you'd gone up alone. So we came. Obviously. Stop staring at me like that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your soul is a sword, Senior Sister. A very small, very straight sword.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's the nicest thing anyone's ever said to me. Don't say it again.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What's mine? No. Don't tell me. It's a peacock, isn't it. It's a peacock.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It's a lantern, Zhao Kang. A gold one. With a crack in it that lets the light out.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...I need a moment. On the other side of this pine. Alone.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Pursuers on the Cloud Road
quests.summary: Blood Guards who couldn't take the cloud road took the jade bridge instead, the long way. They are very tired and very angry.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Guards on the bridge. They came the long way round. They look exhausted. Good.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: More Blood Guards? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Catch your breath with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They're following your soul now, not your footprints. You shine, lotus child. Everyone can see you coming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: A Blood Guard slips from the jade bridge and clings to the edge by his fingertips.

choices.text: Pull him up

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Pull him up in chains, for questioning

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Step on his fingers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Soul Crystal
quests.summary: Qing Luan has one more thing: a crystal in the ruins that holds a soul's first memory. She wants you to see hers.

objectives.text: Make your way to the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the ruins, a crystal the height of a man stands in a ring of broken columns, lit from within.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A girl on these isles, ten thousand years ago, watching a man in red climb the Ascension Stair. Watching seven stars go red behind him.

objectives.text: Break the celestial sentinels at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystal's guardians wake, offended that anyone saw.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That was me. That was him. That was the first time. He fell. Your founders pushed. He'll try again.

quests.title: Back Down the Cloud Road
quests.summary: Qing Luan walks you to the cloud gate. She says she'll watch the red stars. She says to watch the earth.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I'll watch the stars. You watch the earth. Find the seven. Each one you break, the ladder loses a rung.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And lotus child? Take care of that formation of yours. The stars still disagree with it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You're back! Your body's been sitting in the pavilion for three days. Wei Tong fed it soup. It ate the soup.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Rungs. Ladders. Stars. Fine. Help me with the pillars and tell me about it while we lift.

quests.title: Mo Checks a Rune
quests.summary: Elder Mo has started checking the formation's runes one by one, as he promised, before a single pillar goes up.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sits cross-legged on the plaza with the archive copy spread before him, running a finger down ten thousand runes.

objectives.text: Help Elder Mo check the first ring of runes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rune after rune after rune. All correct. All certified. Your eyes water long before his do.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Four hundred checked. All correct. Nine thousand six hundred to go. The star-gazer said the stars disagree. So I check.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go to bed. I'll do the next four hundred. My eyes are older, but they're more stubborn.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The First Pillar-Stone
quests.summary: Elder Mo needs nine pillar-stones cut from the mountain's heart. He wants the first one today.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nine pillars. Each one cut from the mountain's heart, below the herb terraces. Then each one inscribed by a nascent soul. That's you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The mountain's heart is guarded by old stone. It'll want to know why we're cutting it. Tell it the truth.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below the terraces the mountain opens into a cave of grey-blue stone that hums when you breathe near it.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I'm carrying the stones. Elder Mo said I'm the strongest back on the mountain. I've never been so proud of my back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Mountain's Old Stone
quests.summary: The mountain's heart has guardians older than the sect. They do not like the sound of chisels.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The heart's guardians. Older than the sect. Don't break them. Convince them. Firmly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Stop the stone golems at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The stone golems have found you first.

objectives.text: Hold the training ground against more stone golems

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Convinced. The mountain's letting us cut. It remembers the founder. It remembers the Verdant Lotus too. It liked them better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Stone by Stone
quests.summary: Nine pillar-stones, each the size of a cart. Wei Tong carries two at once to prove a point.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nine stones! I'll carry two at a time! Watch! No, don't watch! Watch later!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nine stones on the plaza! My back has never been happier. My back is going to hate me tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The Treasury Weeps
quests.summary: Steward Qian has seen the bill for nine pillars' worth of inscribing ink. He has locked himself in the treasury.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steward Qian has locked himself in the treasury. He says he's not coming out until the formation's cheaper. It won't get cheaper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Meet Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Star-iron ink! Ground phoenix feather! Do you know what that costs? It costs everything! Everything I've ever saved!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It keeps the mountain safe for ten thousand years, Steward.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
