dialogue.text: ...Ten thousand years. That's... that's actually very good value. Fine. I'm coming out. Nobody look at my eyes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Inscribing With the Soul
quests.summary: Each pillar must be inscribed by a nascent soul. Yours steps out of your body, a hand's breadth, and writes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Your soul holds the brush. Your body holds the soul. Don't let go of either. If the soul wanders, the rune wanders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Inscribe the first pillar with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul leans out of your chest like someone leaning out of a window, and writes in light on the stone. It takes all day.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: One pillar. Eight to go. You look like a boiled noodle again. It's a good look on you. It means you worked.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: A Merchant's Donation
quests.summary: A cart arrives at the gate from Qingshi: star-iron ink, bought at cost, from a merchant who wants no thanks.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A cart from Qingshi! Ink, lots of ink! There's a note. It says 'at cost'. There's a second note. It says 'no thanks needed'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Twelve jars of star-iron ink, packed in straw. At the bottom, a third note: For the town I nearly sold. Jin Baoshan.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I came with the cart, to make sure. Not for thanks. For... the feeling. I've started liking the feeling. It's dreadful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Jin asks, very quietly, whether the sect could forget his old part in the night carts.

choices.text: Forgive him. He's paid.

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: The Law Hall remembers everything

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Name a price for forgetting

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Night Raid on the Pillars
quests.summary: Someone tries to smash the first pillar in the night. Whoever it is knows exactly where it stands.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone went for the first pillar. With a hammer. They knew exactly which one was finished.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward flares blue over the pillar just as shapes drop from the plaza wall.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Moon cultivators at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Blood Moon again. On our mountain, again. How are they still getting in?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Someone's leaving a door open. I'm going to find out who, and close them.

quests.title: The Open Door
quests.summary: Xiao Shi remembers something: in the Abyss, the guards talked about a way into the sect that didn't need the gate.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: In the cages, the guards used to laugh about 'the back door of heaven'. A way into the sect. I thought it was a joke.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Below the cliff edge, they said. Where the clouds are thickest.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Below the cliff. There's an old path down there, from before the sect had walls. Nobody uses it. Nobody watches it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Well. Somebody uses it.

quests.title: The Back Door of Heaven
quests.summary: Below the cliff edge, an old path winds down into the clouds. It has been swept recently.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the cliff, hidden by cloud, a path of old steps winds down the mountain. The moss on them has been scraped away by feet.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the path's foot, where it meets the outer pines, masked figures are waiting for their next climb.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the bottom, the path ends at a rusted gate in the outer wall. The lock is new. Very new.

objectives.text: Tell Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak will guard the back door. All of Thunder Peak. Nobody gets past us. We're very loud and very awake.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Eight More Pillars
quests.summary: With the back door shut, the work goes faster. Elder Mo checks runes by night and builds by day, and doesn't sleep.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eight pillars to go. I check runes at night, I build by day. Sleep is a habit. I've broken worse habits.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Four thousand runes checked. All correct. All certified. I'm beginning to think the star-gazer is wrong. I'll keep checking.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Mo hasn't slept in four days. I left soup outside his door. He ate the soup and left a note. 'Adequate soup.'

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I'm framing the note.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Honest Merchant, Worried Merchant
quests.summary: Merchant Jin writes to the sect in his own hand: crates with seven stars, passing his docks, paid in silver he won't take.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The guild warehouse is neat and honest now, which makes the three seven-starred crates in the corner look very out of place.

objectives.text: Join Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Seven stars on the lids. A man paid me in silver to store them. I refused the silver. He left the crates anyway.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Honesty is terrifying. Nobody tells you. Please take them away.

quests.title: What the Crates Hold
quests.summary: The crates are heavier than crystals should be, and one of them is humming a tune.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals, packed in blood-lotus straw. And at the bottom, sewn into the lining, a letter signed with ash.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letter reads: first rung holds. Deliver to the rim at the new moon. Luo Hui, of the Ladder.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Luo Hui. First rung. Qing Luan's seven. One of them is in this town, or was.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The new moon is in three days. So we wait, and we watch the docks.

quests.title: Watchers Watching
quests.summary: Qingshi's watchers have been busy. Old Pan, Madam Fang and Constable Du all saw the pale man. None of them liked him.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Pale fellow. Came in on a raft, not my ferry. Didn't pay a fare. Didn't cast a reflection in the water. I noticed that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: He took a room. Paid in old coins. Never ate. Left ash in the bed. Ash! I had to burn the sheets!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.text: Hear what Constable Du has to say

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: I followed him to the old guild warehouse by the river. The one nobody owns. He went in. He didn't come out. I wrote it down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Warehouse Nobody Owns
quests.summary: The old guild warehouse by the river has no owner, no door, and fresh footprints in ash on its floor.

objectives.text: Make your way to the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old warehouse leans over the river on rotting stilts. Ash footprints lead in, and none lead out.

objectives.text: Clear the back alley of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The alley behind it is guarded by men in crimson who have been told to let no one near the river.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside: nothing. Empty. And yet the ash footprints stop in the middle of the floor, as if someone went straight down.

objectives.text: Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Elder Mo sent me. He said you'd need someone to complain at. I see you've found a haunted warehouse. Of course you have.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Under the Floorboards
quests.summary: Beneath the ash footprints, a trapdoor. Beneath the trapdoor, a tunnel toward the graves. The Blood Moon loves a tunnel.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The trapdoor opens on stairs. Down there it smells of river mud and burning, and of blood lotus.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The tunnel comes up among the hill graves, where Blood Guards are loading crates onto a cart.

objectives.text: Seize the crates from the cart

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Seven stars on those crates. I've seen them before. On the black gate, back when the Blood Moon had my family. Same stars.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Whatever this is, it's big. They were scared of it. People like that are never scared of anything.

quests.title: The New Moon
quests.summary: On the night of the new moon, the pale man comes back for his crates.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: New moon. Every watcher's out. The town's asleep, or pretending to be. Old Pan's on the river with a lantern.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Signal the watchers from the tower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You swing a lantern twice. Across the dark town, lanterns answer: river, inn, yamen, gate. Qingshi is awake.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rafts slide out of the dark. Blood Guards, and among them a pale figure who leaves ash on the water.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: He's gone to the warehouse. The one with the crates. Alone. He wants them badly enough to come himself.

quests.title: Luo Hui, the First Rung
quests.summary: In the guild warehouse, among his crates, stands the First Rung of the Patriarch's Ladder. He is made mostly of patience and ash.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pale man sits on a seven-starred crate, turning a handful of ash in his fingers. He looks up and smiles with grey teeth.

objectives.name: Luo Hui, the First Rung
objectives.text: Face Luo Hui, the First Rung at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: The heir. The Patriarch said you would come. He says a lot of things about you. He's very fond of you, in his way.

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: I am Luo Hui, the First Rung. One rung is nothing. Seven is a road to heaven. Shall we see if you can climb?

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui staggers, laughs, and comes apart into ash that blows out through the cracks in the warehouse wall. His crates stay behind.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He ran. Like smoke. But he left his crates, and his crates are the point. One rung, shaken. Six to go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Liu Er Wants to Help
quests.summary: Liu Er, now fourteen and very tall, followed the fight from a rooftop and would like to become a cultivator immediately.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I saw everything! From the roof! The pale man turned into ash! I want to learn that! Not the ash part. The fighting part.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Can I climb the nine thousand steps? Mother says I have to ask you. She says you'll say no.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When you're sixteen. Train with Constable Du until then. And ask your mother again.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Sixteen! That's forever! ...Fine. Constable Du. I'll be the best constable's apprentice there's ever been.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the market square

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're done at the back alley. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er begs you to teach him a sword form tonight, before his mother finds out.

choices.text: Teach him, then walk him home

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Tell him to ask his mother first

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Laugh at him

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Ash on the River
quests.summary: Luo Hui's ash drifts on the river. You sit on the dock and let the fight settle into your nascent soul.

objectives.text: Settle your soul in the town temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul turns the fight over like a stone in its hands, and learns from it, and grows. Middle stage of Nascent Soul.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the red thread from Qingshi to the sky has thinned. Not broken. Thinner.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the main street

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One rung shaken, six to go, and you're meditating in a temple like an old monk. You should celebrate. With noodles. My treat.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look at me like that. I've apologised for two years of being awful. Now I'm being nice. It's very tiring.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Crates Up the Mountain
quests.summary: The seized crates go up the mountain to Elder Bai. Old Pan ferries them across the river himself, at no fare.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: No fare. For crates that nearly helped a monster climb to heaven, no fare. Mind the third plank.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Tell the Sect Master Qingshi says hello. And that we burned the pale man's sheets. Twice. For good measure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Hermit Forgets
quests.summary: A crane arrives from the hermit. It is blank. The hermit has forgotten how to write.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A blank crane from the hermit. Blank. He's never sent a blank crane. He wouldn't know how.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Go. Take Xiao Shi, he knows how to be patient with confused people. And take this. Smelling salts. For whoever needs them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest is grey and silent. Birds sit on branches, staring at nothing. The stream is not moving.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hello. Do I know you? You look like someone who drinks my tea. I have tea. I think. What is tea?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Soul Sight in the Fog
quests.summary: With ordinary eyes the fog is only grey. With soul sight it has threads, and the threads are pulling.

objectives.text: Look at the fog with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight the fog is a web, and every strand runs to something living, sipping at it. Every strand also runs north, toward the ruins.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I can't see the threads. But the hermit keeps asking me my name. I keep telling him. It seems to help, a bit.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: In the cages, people forgot things too. We told each other our names every morning. It's a good habit.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Fog With Hands
quests.summary: The fog has thickened into shapes that walk, and the shapes have hands.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fog's standing up. It's got hands. I really didn't need the fog to have hands.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Stop the fog wraiths at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Cut down the fog wraiths that follow

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the wraiths fall, the fog thins, and a bird somewhere remembers one note of its song.

quests.title: Telling the Hermit Who He Is
quests.summary: The hermit has forgotten three hundred years. Somebody has to tell him who he is. It's harder than it sounds.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Your name is Lan Jue. You were the last disciple of the Verdant Lotus. You ran, and then you stopped running.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ran? I don't run. My knees are terrible. Did I really run? From what?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: From a flood. From a song. You went back and sang it. You were very brave.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: ...I think I remember a song. Tell me again. The part where I was brave. I like that part.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Every hour. We'll tell him every hour until the fog's gone. That's what we did in the cages. It works if you keep doing it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Wolves Who Forgot
quests.summary: The forest's wolves have forgotten they were ever tame, or wild, or anything. They only remember hunger.

objectives.text: Make your way to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves stand in the fog outside the den, swaying, eyes blank. When you step closer, they remember one thing: teeth.

objectives.text: Defeat the fog-lost wolves at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather the fog-shards the wolves shed
Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Fog shards. They taste of nothing. I licked one. Don't ask. I've been told I have a curious tongue.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A fog-struck wolf pup follows you, remembering nothing, not even to be afraid.

choices.text: Carry it to the hermit

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give it to the sect's beast pens

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Sell it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Anchor at the Ruins
quests.summary: The fog's threads all run to the ruins gate, where someone has planted a stone that drinks memories.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the ruins gate stands a black stone the fog pours out of like steam from a kettle. Seven dots are carved on it.

objectives.text: Chip the seven-dot runes from the stone

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stone cracks. The fog screams without a mouth, and pulls back into the crack, and then there is only the forest, and birds.

objectives.text: Drive the fog wraiths from the ruins courtyard

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last of the fog-wraiths boil out of the courtyard, desperate, grabbing at anything that still remembers.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine is green again. From somewhere behind you comes the sound of a kettle, and an old man cursing it.

quests.title: Tea, Remembered
quests.summary: The hermit remembers everything, all at once, including that he has run out of tea.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I remember. All of it. Three hundred years at once. It's very loud. Also I've run out of tea. That's unforgivable.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You told me I was brave. I heard it, through the fog. Nobody's ever told me that. I'm going to remember it on purpose.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: He remembered my name before he remembered his own. He said it first. Xiao Shi. I'm going to go and cry by the stream.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Seven Dots on the Stone
quests.summary: The anchor-stone's seven dots match the crates. The Ladder didn't just want the forest's memories. It wanted a map.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the broken anchor-stone's heart lies a slip of jade, full of stolen memory: every path, every stream, every door in the forest.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins. The archive. The spring. The path to the sect's back door. The Ladder is mapping everything the Verdant Lotus ever touched.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They wanted a map of the Verdant Lotus. Of everything that's yours. Why would a ladder need to know where you've been?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe to know where I'll go.

quests.title: Giving Back the Forest's Memories
quests.summary: The memory-slip holds the forest's stolen memories. The hermit says they should go back where they came from.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Give them back. Every birdsong, every stream's direction. Open the slip at the spring and let them go home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Release the forest's memories at the spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Memories pour out of the slip like fireflies: a stream remembering downhill, a bird remembering its song, an old man remembering his teacher's voice.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My teacher's voice. It was in there. I'd forgotten it long before the fog. Thank you for giving back more than was taken.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: What the Ladder Wants
quests.summary: On the way home, Han Xue says what you are both thinking: the Ladder is studying you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The first rung tested you. The fog mapped you. The assassin in Qingshi measured you. Someone is studying you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A ladder for one soul to climb. I don't like where my thoughts go when I put those together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Neither do I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we both keep thinking. Separately. Loudly. And we tell Elder Mo, because he's building a thing that touches the sky.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lotus archway of the ruins rises from the bamboo, its carved petals furred with moss.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Palanquin on the Steps
quests.summary: A gold palanquin is coming up the nine thousand steps, carried by eight very tired men.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A gold palanquin! On the steps! Eight bearers! They've been climbing since yesterday! One of them is crying!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The palanquin sets down at the gate. The curtain parts. The ancestor of the Zhao clan steps out, frowning at the height of the steps.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I have come for my great-grandson. The clan requires its heir. He has played at cultivation long enough.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Where is he? Hiding, no doubt. He hides from me the way his father did. It's a family tradition.

quests.title: Zhao Kang Hides
quests.summary: Zhao Kang is, in fact, hiding. In the pagoda. Behind the turtle soup books.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm not hiding. I'm researching. Turtle soup. It's fascinating. Go away.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He wants me to go home and marry a merchant's daughter and count gold. I'm good at counting gold. I hate it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then tell him.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Tell him? He's a hundred and twelve. He's never been told anything. It would kill him. Or me. Probably me.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He's been behind my turtle soup shelf for three hours. He's reorganised it. Alphabetically. I'm furious. It's very well done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Zhao Ming's Stone
quests.summary: In the Zhao clan hall, Zhao Kang's great-grandfather says, there is a stone for his dead brother. The ancestor carries a copy.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Zhao Ming's stone. I had it copied, small, to carry. First out of the grotto, ten years ago. Dead on a mission two years later.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I will not lose another heir to this mountain. Tell him that. He won't hear it from me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The small stone is carved: Zhao Ming, first out of the Moonlit Grotto. Beneath it, newer, in a clumsy hand: and his brother, first out after.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Someone carved that line last year. A servant, I assumed. It's his hand, isn't it. He's been visiting home. Secretly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Clan's Test
quests.summary: The Zhao ancestor proposes a test: if his guards can't take Zhao Kang home by force, the boy can stay. He means it kindly. Probably.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The old way. My guards will escort him home. If he can refuse them, he can refuse me. That is the Zhao clan's test.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Of course it is. Everything's a test. Will you stand with me? Not for me. Beside me. There's a difference.

objectives.text: Stand beside Zhao Kang against the clan guards

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't hurt them! They carried me on their shoulders when I was four! Hurt them a little!

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Refused. By force. With a friend. Hm. His brother did the same, once, with a different friend.

quests.title: What Zhao Kang Says
quests.summary: Zhao Kang finally says it: to his great-grandfather, in front of the whole sect, with his voice shaking.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm not coming home. Not because I don't love the clan. Because Ming would have stayed, and I'm finishing what he started.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: And because I have a friend here who's going to do something stupid and heroic, and somebody has to complain about it.

objectives.text: Meet Ancestor Zhao at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: ...Your brother said almost the same words. Minus the complaining. You're more honest than he was.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay, then. The clan will manage. The clan managed before gold. It'll manage without you. Write to me. Monthly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Gifts From the Clan
quests.summary: The Zhao ancestor does not leave empty-handed or leave anyone else empty-handed. The palanquin was full of gifts.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The palanquin was full of gifts in case he came home. Take them. Spirit stones for the formation. Gold for the kitchen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Talk with Steward Qian at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Two hundred spirit stones. From the Zhao clan. For free. I think I'm going to faint. Somebody catch me. Anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Two hundred spirit stones from the Zhao clan. Steward Qian asks how to spend them.

choices.text: Medicine for Qingshi

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Into the treasury ledger, by the rules

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: A little for yourself first

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Uninvited Escort
quests.summary: The palanquin is ambushed on its way down the steps. Somebody wants the Zhao clan to blame the Azure Cloud.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The palanquin's under attack! On the steps! Masked men! The bearers are throwing gold at them! It's not working!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Clear the sect gate of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Blood Moon. Trying to kill me on your steps, so the clan would blame you. They don't know the clan. We blame precisely.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan will stand with the Azure Cloud when you go after them. That's not gratitude. It's accounting.

quests.title: Monthly Letters
quests.summary: Zhao Kang writes his first monthly letter home before the palanquin has even reached the bottom of the steps.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Dear Great-Grandfather. It's been an hour. I'm fine. The food is terrible. Wei Tong made dumplings. They were fine. Love, Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Too much? It's too much. I've never written 'love' to him. He's going to die of shock.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Send it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...Fine. If he dies, it's your fault. I'll carve it on your stone.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; here isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

quests.title: Brothers' Stone
quests.summary: Zhao Kang asks you to sit with him at the cliff edge where he used to burn incense for his brother.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I burned incense here for Ming. Every year. You found me here, once, and asked who assigned his mission. Remember?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Burn incense with Zhao Kang at the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two sticks of incense, side by side, their smoke twisting together over the sea of clouds.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Gu assigned it. He's in the Abyss. When we go after him, I'm going to ask him why. Just ask. I think that's what Ming would do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Accounting
quests.summary: The Sect Master notes that in one year the Azure Cloud has gained the Iron Scale, the Zhao clan and a very honest merchant as allies.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. The Zhao clan. Qingshi's yamen and its merchants. A year ago we had none of them. You collect allies like Wei Tong collects buns.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon keeps trying to set us against each other, and keeps pushing us together instead. Someone there is very bad at accounting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Pillar six is up. Seven thousand runes checked. All correct. I'm starting to hate the word correct. It sounds smug.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Rust on the Vein
quests.summary: Qing Luan's cloud crane is spotted with rust. It dissolves into her voice, and her voice is worried.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Another crane. It's rusty. How does a cloud rust? Don't answer. Go and find out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the cloud gate, rust creeps along the stone in orange veins, like something slowly bleeding.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The vein is rusting. Crystals that were blue for ten thousand years are turning orange. Someone is praying over them.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Praying. With a rosary made of rusted nails. I watched from my pavilion. I don't usually feel sick. I felt sick.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Storm Wolves in Rust
quests.summary: The storm wolves on the spirit vein are rusting too. They are in pain, and pain makes them fast.

objectives.text: Make your way to the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves limp across the vein, rust in their fur where lightning used to be. They snap at anything that moves.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The storm wolves come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather the crystals that haven't rusted yet

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's spreading. Every crystal the rust touches dies. If it reaches the heart of the vein, the isles will fall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Prayer Beads of Nails
quests.summary: At the vein's heart a string of rusted nails lies coiled on a crystal like a sleeping snake.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A rosary of rusted nails lies on the largest crystal. Where it touches, the crystal is orange and crumbling.

objectives.text: Lift the nail rosary from the crystal

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rosary is warm. Somewhere on the isles, someone feels it lifted, and stops praying.

objectives.text: Show Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He felt that. The Rust Monk. Tie Shan. He was a monk once, in a temple that burned. Now he's the Second Rung.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He'll come for his beads. He'll be polite about it. That's the worst part.

quests.title: The Monk's Acolytes
quests.summary: The Rust Monk's acolytes come first, bowing before they strike.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They bowed. Then they tried to stab me. I don't know how to feel. I bowed back. Then I stabbed them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Blood Guards ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Hold the Isle of Winds against more Blood Guards
Look for Yan Tie at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came up the cloud road! My soul is very small, but it's very loud! Where's the monk?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Rust Monk's acolytes lie beaten: villagers he twisted. Slowly, they could still be healed.

choices.text: Take them to Elder Hua

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Imprison them until the war is over

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Cut them down. It's quicker.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Soul Against Rust
quests.summary: Qing Luan says rust eats iron, not souls. If you can hold your soul outside your body, the rust can't touch it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Rust eats iron. Iron is body. Soul is not iron. Step your soul out, a hand's breadth, and let the rust find nothing to bite.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Hold your soul outside your body

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul steps out a hand's breadth and stays there, shining. The wind of the isle blows through it like light through a window.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Good. Now fight like that. It's exhausting. That's why nobody does it. You're going to do it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: Tie Shan, the Rust Monk
quests.summary: The Second Rung comes for his beads. He is huge, polite, and rotting, and he bows before every blow.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A huge monk in rotting orange robes kneels at the vein's heart, hands pressed together. Rust flakes from his fingers like snow.

objectives.name: Tie Shan, the Rust Monk
objectives.text: Bring down Tie Shan, the Rust Monk

dialogue.speaker: rung_shan
dialogue.text: Tie Shan, Second Rung. Forgive me. All iron rusts. All vows rust. Yours will too. Let me show you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My soul isn't iron, monk.

dialogue.speaker: rung_shan
dialogue.text: Ah. Luo Hui said you were clever. Pray with me, then. It won't help.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The monk bows one last time and crumbles into a heap of rust that the wind carries off the edge of the isle. His laughter goes with it.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He's not dead. Rungs don't die easily; they're tied to their stars. But his star dimmed. I saw it from here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Healing the Vein
quests.summary: The vein can heal if the rusted crystals are cleared away. Qing Luan wants every one gone before it spreads.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Clear away the dead crystals. The vein will grow new ones. It's patient. It's ten thousand years patient.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Clear the rusted crystals from the vein

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Blue again. Look at that. Ten thousand years, and it still manages to surprise me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Soul Grows Tall
quests.summary: After holding your soul outside your body through a whole fight, it doesn't want to go back in. It wants to grow.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your soul is bigger than it was this morning. That happens when you make it do something stupid. Sit. Let it settle.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Let your nascent soul settle at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul settles back into your body like a cat into a basket, turning twice. It is taller. Late stage of Nascent Soul.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You glowed. The whole fight. Like a lantern with a person in it. Don't do that again without warning me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Two Rungs Shaken
quests.summary: Two Rungs shaken, neither broken. Qing Luan's chart shows five red stars bright, and two dim.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Two dim. Five bright. The Ladder can't climb with dim rungs. But dim isn't broken. They'll heal, like the vein.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You need to break them, not shake them. For that you'll need to be stronger than a nascent soul. Much stronger.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stronger than a nascent soul. We only just got here. Is there always a next stage? Doesn't it ever end?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Qing Luan says it ends at the top of a staircase.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Of course it does. Everything ends with stairs. I hate stairs.

quests.title: Back to the Pillars
quests.summary: Back at the sect, Elder Mo has raised eight pillars and checked nine thousand runes. He is thinner, and very pleased with himself.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Eight pillars. Nine thousand runes. All correct. One ring left. Then we light it, and the sect is safe for ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The star-gazer can disagree all she likes. I've checked. Twice.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He's so thin. I've been making him soup. He says 'adequate soup' and eats three bowls. He's going to be fine. Right?

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: One Last Visit
quests.summary: The isles are going to close to souls too, soon. Qing Luan wants to show you one more thing before they do.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road is thinner than last time, almost transparent. Below, the sea of clouds is very far away.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The isles are closing, even to souls, for another sixty years. I want you to see something first. Something I saw.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The palace doesn't like visitors to see it. The palace is going to have to live with that.

quests.title: The Palace Says No
quests.summary: The palace sentinels bar the way. Qing Luan tells them to move. They don't.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Move. I was a sage of this palace when your stone was still gravel. Move! ...Fine. Hit them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Stop the celestial sentinels at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Celestial sentinels spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They'll reform by morning. They always do. They're very loyal and very stupid. I used to find it charming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: The palace sentinels will reform by morning. You could shatter their cores so they never do.

choices.text: Leave them be

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Ask Qing Luan's leave first

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Shatter the cores

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: The Mural of the First Climb
quests.summary: Inside the palace, a mural shows a man in red climbing the stair, seven stars behind him, and two sects pulling at his robe.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A mural on a broken wall: a man in red on a stair of light, seven red stars behind him, two figures at his heels, one blue, one green.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The figure in green holds a lotus. The figure in blue holds a sword. Both are pulling. Both are falling with him.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your founders. They pulled him down, and fell with him, into the earth. The Abyss is the hole they made landing.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The blue one lived. The green one... there's a reason the Verdant Lotus gave its elders to the seal. They'd already lost their founder.

quests.title: Qing Luan Remembers
quests.summary: Qing Luan tells you what she was, before she was a memory.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I was the palace's youngest sage. I watched him climb. I didn't stop him. I didn't know I could.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: When he fell, the palace fell with him. I stayed. As a memory. Watching the stair. Waiting for someone to do what I didn't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're doing it now. You're teaching me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: ...Yes. I suppose I am. Ten thousand years late, but teaching. That's something.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop smiling. It's suspicious.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Star-Shadows
quests.summary: Where the red stars shine on the isles at night, their light casts shadows that walk.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the blossom trees, shadows move without anything to cast them. The red stars are directly overhead.

objectives.text: Defeat the star-shadows at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The star-shadows have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather phoenix feathers the shadows scattered
Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows with nothing to cast them. I've fought wolves, stone men, monks and fog. Now shadows. I want a holiday.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Memory Crystal
quests.summary: Qing Luan leads you to a crystal where the isles keep their oldest memory: the night of the fall.

objectives.text: Make your way to the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Deep in the ruins, a crystal hangs in the air, turning slowly. Inside it, very small, a man in red is falling forever.

objectives.text: Gather star iron from the crystal's base
Touch the memory of the fall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hear him as he falls. Not screaming. Laughing. Next time, he says, I'll bring a body heaven can't refuse.

objectives.text: Drive the celestial sentinels from the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystal's keepers stir in the serpent's old isle, disturbed by the memory, and come to see who woke it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the cloud gate, the wind is cold. A body heaven can't refuse. The words sit in your chest like a stone.

quests.title: A Body Heaven Can't Refuse
quests.summary: Han Xue heard it too. So did Zhao Kang. Nobody wants to say what everyone is thinking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A body heaven can't refuse. A clean one. With the Verdant Lotus in it. I'm going to say it, because nobody else will.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He wants you. Not to kill. To wear.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Then he'll have to get through me. And her. And the entire Zhao clan, who've recently become very emotional about you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Also I'll complain. Loudly. Forever. Nobody wants to wear a body that has me complaining at it.

quests.title: Watching the Stair
quests.summary: Before the isles close, Qing Luan asks you to sit with her and watch the Ascension Stair, the way she has for ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit with me. Watch the stair. I've done it alone for ten thousand years. Tonight I'd like company.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Watch the Ascension Stair with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair climbs into cloud, faint, made of light. It is not for you. Not yet. But for the first time, it looks back.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It looked at you. I saw it. Ten thousand years and it has never looked at anyone. Heaven is starting to notice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Gifts for the Formation
quests.summary: Qing Luan fills your arms with star iron and cloud silk for Elder Mo. The isles are generous when they're closing.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: For your formation. Star iron from the palace floor, cloud silk from the pines. The isles are generous when they close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Gather cloud silk for Elder Mo

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: And lotus child. When you light it... be careful. I still don't like its shape. But I'm a memory, and memories worry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The cloud silk came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: The Isles Close
quests.summary: The cloud road dissolves behind you as you step onto the mountain. Above, the isles fade until they are only clouds.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road dissolves behind your last step. Above, the isles fade into ordinary cloud, and then into sky.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Sixty years until they open again. We'll be old. Well. You won't be. You'll be something else by then.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let's go and give Elder Mo his silk. He'll say adequate. He'll mean wonderful.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Ninth Pillar
quests.summary: The ninth pillar is ready to raise. Elder Mo wants you to inscribe it, and Wei Tong wants to carry it alone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: The ninth pillar. Last one. You inscribe. Wei Tong carries. Nobody helps him carry. He's been looking forward to it for a month.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eight pillars ring the plaza, humming faintly blue. The ninth lies on the stones, waiting.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Alone! I'm carrying it alone! Stand back! Stand further back! That's too far, I want an audience!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Final Inscription
quests.summary: You inscribe the ninth pillar with your soul while the whole sect watches from the walls.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul writes the last rune in light. Nine pillars hum together, one long note that you feel in your teeth. The whole mountain sighs.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nine. It's done. The frame of the Great Azure Formation. Ten thousand years of safety, and I built it. I built it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: ...With help. Adequate help. More than adequate. Somebody hand me a chair.

quests.title: Lanterns for Nine Pillars
quests.summary: The Sect Master declares a festival. Nine pillars, nine lanterns, and every disciple on the mountain gets a night off.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A festival. Nine lanterns for nine pillars. Every disciple gets a night off. Even Steward Qian. Especially Steward Qian.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Hang the first lantern on the ninth pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine lanterns, one on each pillar. The formation glows gold and blue, and the whole mountain comes out to see it.

objectives.text: Hear what Steward Qian has to say

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: A night off. I don't know what to do with a night off. I counted my spirit stones. It was very relaxing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Voices at the Festival
quests.summary: The festival is loud and bright. Everyone you love is there, and most of them want to talk to you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mo ate. At the festival. Two bowls. I watched him. I've never been so relieved to watch a man eat noodles.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: My brother laughed. Out loud. At Wei Tong falling off a bench. First time since the cages. I'm going to remember it forever.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It was a very good fall. He fell with dignity. Then without.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The formation's glow makes the pagoda look beautiful. I'm going to read by it. All night. Nobody stop me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Tribute
quests.summary: Thunder Peak insists on a tribute: a shouting contest against the training puppets. Everyone must participate.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's tribute! Everyone fights a puppet! Everyone shouts! The loudest wins nothing! It's tradition! I invented it tonight!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Shout at puppets for Thunder Peak

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Training puppets! Back to back, and mind your footing!

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You shouted beautifully. Elder Mo shouted too. He said 'adequate' very loudly. The whole peak cheered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Uninvited to the Festival
quests.summary: In the middle of the festival, Thunder Peak's guard at the back door rings its bell. Someone is climbing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The back door bell! Thunder Peak's ringing it! Someone's climbing up from the clouds! During the festival! How rude!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Ring the alarm at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings over the sea of clouds. Below, on the hidden path, masked figures freeze, then climb faster.

objectives.text: Clear the outer pines of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the sect gate
Find Han Xue after the fight

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They came for the formation. On festival night, when everyone was drunk on noodles. They're learning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The climber you caught is a Blood Moon deserter who wanted food, not the formation.

choices.text: Feed him and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Hold him for the Law Hall

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Throw him back down the mountain

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: One Ring Left
quests.summary: Elder Mo leaves the festival early. He has one ring of runes left to check, and he wants to finish before the lighting.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: While the festival roars on, Elder Mo sits alone at the edge of the formation, lamp in hand, bent over the outer ring.

objectives.text: Sit with Elder Mo as he checks the outer ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rune by rune. He mutters each one. Correct. Correct. Correct. His finger pauses once, then moves on. Correct.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Mo what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Nearly done. The outer ring's fiddly. Some of these runes are written backwards to look forwards. Bai's copying is very precise.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go back to the festival. Eat something. I'll be done in a few nights.

quests.title: Peaches for Elder Hua
quests.summary: Elder Mo gives you a basket and asks you to pick peaches from the outer pines' old orchard. For Elder Hua. Don't tell her who sent them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Peaches. From the old orchard past the pines. For Hua. Every autumn I leave them on her doorstep. I'm busy this year. You do it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Don't tell her who they're from. She knows. We both pretend. It's been forty years. It works.

objectives.text: Pick peaches in the old orchard
Find Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Peaches on my doorstep. From an anonymous admirer. Who has been anonymous for forty years. Tell him thank you. No. Don't.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Night Off
quests.summary: The Sect Master finds you at the cliff edge after the festival. She is not wearing her crown. She looks much younger without it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I took my crown off. First time in eleven years. My neck doesn't know what to do.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In a few days Mo finishes checking. Then we light it. Ten thousand years, and I can sleep. Do you know how long it's been?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Since you became Sect Master?

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Since I was a child, I think. Sit. Watch the formation glow. We've earned one night of looking at something beautiful.

objectives.text: Join Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Here is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In my day we trained in the snow. Uphill. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

quests.title: The Morning After
quests.summary: The morning after the festival, the sect is quiet and hungover on noodles. Elder Mo is still at the formation's edge.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo didn't come to bed. He's still out there checking runes. I brought him soup. He said adequate. He didn't look up.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He looked... worried. Elder Mo doesn't look worried. He looks annoyed. This was different.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Leave him. He's doing what he promised. When he finds something, he'll tell us. That's Elder Mo.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Setting the Star Iron
quests.summary: The star iron you brought from the isles goes into the formation's heart. Elder Mo wants your soul to guide it in.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Star iron in the heart. Guide it with your soul. It remembers the sky. It'll want to go back. Don't let it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Guide the star iron into the formation's heart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The star iron sinks into the heart of the formation like a stone into a pond. The whole plaza shivers once, and settles.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: In. The heart's set. Now the crystals. Then the feathers. Then... then I finish the outer ring, and we're done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Charging the Crystals
quests.summary: The thunder crystals must be charged at the cliff edge, where lightning strikes the mountain in storms.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Thunder crystals charge where lightning strikes. The cliff edge, in the storm tonight. Don't stand too close. Stand exactly close enough.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Set the thunder crystals on the cliff
Meet Yan Tie at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I watched from Thunder Peak! The lightning hit every crystal! You didn't even flinch! Thunder Peak is very proud of you!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Storm Visitors
quests.summary: The storm brings more than lightning. Blood Moon cultivators use the thunder to cover their climb.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Under the thunder! They're climbing under the thunder so nobody hears them! Thunder Peak can't hear anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Moon cultivators come on in silence.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They want the formation damaged before it's lit. Or... no. They didn't touch it. They went around it. Why go around it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Feathers in the Outer Ring
quests.summary: The phoenix feathers go into the outer ring, the ring Elder Mo hasn't finished checking.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Phoenix feathers in the outer ring. Mo says wait. He's not done checking. I've told him the copy is certified. He says 'so was Gu'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Lay the phoenix feathers in the outer ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The feathers settle into the outer ring's grooves. Where they touch one particular rune, they curl, very slightly, as if from heat.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Curled? Feathers don't curl. Mo. MO! ...He's asleep. At last. I'll tell him in the morning. It's probably nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Mo Asleep
quests.summary: Elder Mo is asleep at the formation's edge for the first time in weeks. Nobody has the heart to wake him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He's asleep. Sitting up. With his lamp still lit. I put a blanket on him. He said 'adequate blanket' in his sleep.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Let him sleep. He's been awake for weeks. He'll find whatever he's looking for with fresh eyes. Or he won't, and it's nothing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I left peaches by his lamp. Anonymous. It's our tradition.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Mo's last order was to wake him if the runes flickered. They are flickering, a little.

choices.text: Wake him, as ordered

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Let him sleep and watch the runes yourself

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Fix the runes yourself and take the credit

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: Last Spar Before the Lighting
quests.summary: Zhao Kang wants a spar. He says it's to celebrate. He's nervous. Everyone is nervous and nobody knows why.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Spar. Now. I'm nervous and I don't know why. When I'm nervous, I hit things. Better you than the formation.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Spar with Zhao Kang's practice puppets

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Better. Still nervous. The whole mountain's nervous. The birds are nervous. Wei Tong only ate one breakfast.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Whole Mountain Waits
quests.summary: Lu Ping has a theory about why everyone is nervous. Xiao Shi has a better one.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: My theory: everyone's nervous because nobody's had a disaster in weeks and we're out of practice.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: In the cages, before something bad, the guards would go quiet. Everyone felt it. Nobody knew what it was.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: It feels like that. I'm sorry. I'm probably wrong. I hope I'm wrong.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: He's not wrong. The carp are all at the bottom of the pond. They never go to the bottom. Not even in winter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Soul at the Peak
quests.summary: You sit on the stone bridge and let your nascent soul reach its peak, as if something in you knows you'll need it soon.

objectives.text: Bring your nascent soul to its peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul sits cross-legged in your chest, lotus in its hands, and opens its eyes very wide. Great Perfection of Nascent Soul.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the formation behind you glows blue. In one place, in the outer ring, the blue has a thread of red in it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You look like you saw something. Did you see something?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: A red thread in the outer ring. Very thin. I'll tell Elder Mo when he wakes.

quests.title: Telling Mo
quests.summary: Elder Mo wakes at dawn. You tell him about the red thread and the curling feathers. He goes very still.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Red thread. Outer ring. Curling feathers. Hm.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Bai's copy is certified. Gu kept that archive for thirty years. ...Thirty years. Leave it with me. Three more nights.

objectives.text: Show Elder Mo where the red thread runs

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You point. He looks. For a long moment he says nothing at all, and his hand, holding the lamp, is not quite steady.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go and rest. Tell no one yet. Not the Sect Master, not Bai. Not until I'm sure. Three nights. I'll check every rune on that ring.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Go on, {junior}. Adequate work. More than adequate.

quests.title: Three Nights
quests.summary: Elder Mo begins his three nights. The mountain goes quiet around him, and waits.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo's asked for three nights before the lighting. He won't say why. Forty years I've known him. He's never asked for anything.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'll give him three nights. And you. Rest. Whatever Mo finds, we'll need you rested.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Three nights. I'll bring him soup every night. He'll say adequate. I'll say you're welcome. That's our tradition now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Great Azure Formation
quests.summary: The Great Azure Formation is nearly complete. Elder Mo has been checking its runes for three nights without sleep.

objectives.text: Watch Elder Mo inspect the Great Azure Formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ten thousand runes glow a calm blue. Only in the outer ring, one branch seems to twist, like a signature written backwards.

objectives.text: Speak with Elder Mo at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Three nights, ten thousand runes. My eyes feel like two boiled dumplings. Don't tell Wei Tong I said that.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: I found something. A turn in the outer ring that shouldn't be there. I need one more night to be certain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Here. My old sword tassel. My master gave it to me when I formed my core. It's yours now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder, why give it to me now?

dialogue.speaker: elder_mo
dialogue.text: Because I'm old, and I forget things. Better to give it too early than too late. Go on, {junior}.

objectives.text: Spend an evening with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're back! You're taller. Are you taller? Nascent Soul makes people taller, I read it somewhere. Maybe.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo's been in a strange mood. Keeps patting my shoulder. He gave me his tea set. His good tea set.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Old men do that before long journeys. He's not going anywhere, is he?

quests.title: A Letter from the Abyss
quests.summary: A crow has brought a letter to the sect gate, addressed to you, in the traitor's hand.

objectives.text: Collect the letter from Lu Ping

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A crow brought this. A crow! It bit me. Twice. It had opinions.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: It's addressed to you. The seal is the Law Hall's. I thought about burning it. Then I thought, you'd want to know.

objectives.text: Break the Law Hall seal on the letter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Come to the Heart Mirror, alone. I will tell you how to save your sect. Bring anyone, and I will tell you nothing. Gu Hanshan.

objectives.text: Show the letter to Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's a trap. Obviously. Everything Gu does is a trap wrapped in a lesson.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: But if he knows something about the formation... Elder Mo found a flaw. I can't ignore this.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
