dialogue.text: I know. That's what worries me. Go. If you're not back by dawn, I'm telling Elder Mo, and then I'm coming to drag you home.

quests.title: The Mirror Pool
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan waits in the depths of the Blood Moon Abyss, alone and unarmed.

objectives.text: Slip past the scavengers on the field of bones
Hear the traitor out in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You came alone. Good. Then listen, because there is no time. The formation your sect built is a key, not a lock.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Twenty years ago I altered the archive copy. Seven runes. When it is lit, it will pour the sect's qi into the Abyss and break the seal from above.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I did it for Lan. The Patriarch swore he held her soul. He did. He fed it to the Heart Mirror long ago. I heard her screaming there.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I cannot face the mirror. It shows me what I am. You can. Free her. Then run home before they light it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A pool of black water, perfectly still. Your reflection looks back at you. Then it smiles, a moment before you do.

quests.title: The Heart Demon
quests.summary: The mirror has let something out. It wears your face and knows all your fears.

objectives.text: Face the reflection in the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: You were never chosen, {player}. You were only unlucky enough to be born holding the key.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Everyone you love will die because of that pendant. Mo. Han Xue. That silly girl by the pond. Give it to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're not me. You're only the part of me that's afraid.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Then why are your hands shaking?

objectives.text: Still the mirror and free the trapped souls

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit at the water's edge. Your hands stop shaking. The mirror ripples, and light rises from it like fireflies.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Hundreds of souls, drifting upward. One stops in front of you: a girl with Gu's eyes, who bows once, and is gone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I saw her. She bowed to you. She always had better manners than her father.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Go. Now. The formation... I can feel it waking even from here. Run, {player}, run!

quests.title: Burning Sky over Azure Cloud
quests.summary: The sky above the sect has turned red. The Great Azure Formation has been lit.

objectives.text: Race back to the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {player}! The formation lit itself at midnight. Blood Moon disciples came out of nowhere, in our robes!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Elder Mo went into the array. He told everyone to stay back. The light's gone red. It's gone all red!

objectives.text: Cut through the infiltrators at the gate
Clear the demonic cultivators guarding the array

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're protecting the array! They want it to keep burning. {player}, get to Elder Mo!

quests.title: Elder Mo's Choice
quests.summary: At the heart of the burning formation, Elder Mo makes his last decision.

objectives.text: Stand with the Sect Master at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He poured his whole life into the array's eye and turned the flow back. Seventy years of cultivation, in one breath.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The seal holds. The sect lives. And Mo Changfeng is gone.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He asked me to tell you something. He said, adequate. More than adequate.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He gave me his tea set. I thought he was being nice. He was saying goodbye, and I didn't even notice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I was going to make him dumplings. Proper ones, for his birthday. I've been practising for a month.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Make them anyway, Senior Brother. We'll eat them for him.

quests.title: Ashes and Incense
quests.summary: The sect mourns Elder Mo Changfeng.

objectives.text: Toll the great bell nine times

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine strokes. Across the mountain, every disciple stops what they are doing and bows toward the hall.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I've mended a thousand broken bones for that stubborn old man. He never once said thank you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: He'd leave peaches on my doorstep instead. Every autumn, for forty years. I'll miss the peaches.

objectives.text: Speak with Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I brought plum blossoms. Elder Mo pretended he didn't like flowers, but he always smelled them when he thought no one was looking.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Are you all right? You don't have to be. My brother says being all right is overrated.

objectives.text: Remember Elder Mo at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sea of clouds, where you first condensed your qi. Elder Mo's tassel flutters in your hand.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Back straight. A crooked spine makes a crooked meridian. You straighten your back, and weep, and breathe.

quests.title: What the Patriarch Wants
quests.summary: With the altered formation in pieces, Elder Bai can finally read what it was meant to do.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I've read the seven altered runes. The formation would open the Abyss upward, like a stairwell, for one soul to climb.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Patriarch cannot survive the heavenly tribulation in his own body. Too much blood, too much sin. Heaven would erase him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: He needs a body with a clean dao and the Verdant Lotus in its veins. The mirror was meant to crack your heart so he could step in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He wants to wear me. To ascend in my skin.

objectives.text: Compare the altered runes with the Heart Sutra

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Laid beside the Heart Sutra, the seven altered runes are plain as day: a lotus drawn upside down, a door drawn inside out.

objectives.text: Face Gu Hanshan in chains at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I surrendered at your gate an hour after you left the mirror. The Sect Master says my fate is yours to decide.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Execute me. It's what the precepts demand. I wrote half of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. Come with us to the Abyss. Fight as an elder of the Azure Cloud. If you must die, die as one.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...Mo would have said the same. Very well. I will show you the way through the black gate.

objectives.choice_prompt: Gu Hanshan asks you for nothing. You could give him something anyway.

choices.text: A cup of tea

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Nothing. He's a traitor.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Spit at his feet

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: The Five Oaths
quests.summary: Before the final assault, gather your allies and hear their oaths.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan sent me a letter telling me to come home where it's safe. I used it to light incense for Elder Mo.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I swear on my brother's name, I'll be at your side at the black gate. Try not to steal all the glory.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I can't fight like you. But I know the Abyss. I was there for weeks. I'll draw every path I remember.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Man Man is making medicine bundles. Hundreds of them. She's only dropped a few.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is open. All of it. Take whatever you need. Spirit stones are useless to the dead.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I have counted every stone in this sect for thirty years. Tonight I will count nothing. Just come back.

objectives.text: Collect Xiao Man's medicine bundles for the army
Meet Ye Wuming at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The blood moon rises in three days. On that night the Patriarch will break free with or without your formation.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The children you let me take are with me. And Iron-Fang, with his men. We will open the way.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I owe you a name, {player}. I intend to pay.

quests.title: Soul Transformation
quests.summary: The Great Azure Formation has been repaired, its seven runes turned true. Use its power to transform your soul.

objectives.text: Set spirit stones into the repaired formation
Transform your soul at the heart of the formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where Elder Mo gave his life, you sit. The formation rises around you, blue and clean. It feels like being held.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your nascent soul grows, merges with your body, and the boundary between you and heaven and earth thins like mist.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, Elder Mo. I'll carry it from here.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Soul Transformation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Heaven's eye opens over you. Your soul is changing, and heaven wants to know into what.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Soul Transformation. Heaven itself will notice you now. So will the Patriarch.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: In three days we march on the Abyss, every disciple who can hold a sword. We end this, as our founders could not.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo believed in you before any of us. Let's prove him right, {player}.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Three Days Later
quests.summary: The blood moon rises in three days, Ye Wuming said. On the third day the vanguard of the Azure Cloud stands at the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The vanguard goes first. You, Han Xue, Zhao Kang, Wei Tong. Ye Wuming's people. Iron-Fang's men. Gu, in chains, to show the way.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'll hold the formation from the mountain. If the seal holds tonight, we finish this. If not, we finish it anyway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The canyon rim is crowded with blue robes and black ones. Above, the moon is rising, and it is the colour of a wound.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The moon's rising. He'll try to break the seal tonight. With or without your formation. We'll see which.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Traitor in Chains
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan walks in chains beside the vanguard. Some of the disciples spit as he passes. Zhao Kang doesn't.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: They spit. They're right to. I would have, once. I wrote the precept about treason myself.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The black gate is past the obelisk ring. I'll show you. After tonight you'll have no use for me.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I promised myself I'd ask you one thing. Why did you send my brother to the bamboo forest?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...Because he was asking about the Law Hall's grain. He was clever. I was afraid. I'm sorry. It's worth nothing. I'm sorry.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: No. It's worth something. Not much. Something.

objectives.choice_prompt: Gu Hanshan, in chains, asks for water. The guards' orders: nothing until the trial.

choices.text: Give him water

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Follow the order

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Pour it out in front of him

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Bone Field Holds
quests.summary: The Blood Moon's last army waits on the bone field. It does not expect the Iron Scale's banners behind yours.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty of my men, and the Iron Scale's banners on the left! Didn't know they were coming! Nobody tells a bandit anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: For Elder Mo! Hey, Elder, are you watching? I'm doing the stance right! Mostly!

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The line breaks. Across the steaming pools the black gate stands open, and beyond it, something vast is waking.

quests.title: The Moon Rises
quests.summary: At the obelisk ring, you feel the blood moon reach its height, and the whole Abyss pulls upward at the seal.

objectives.text: Make your way to the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blood moon stands overhead. The earth heaves. Every obelisk stump lights red at once, pulling upward, pulling at the seal.

objectives.text: Press your palm to the shuddering earth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Through your soul you feel it: the Azure Eye on the mountain, blue and whole, and beneath you the seal, holding. Holding. Holding.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's holding. The seal's holding. Elder Mo's formation is holding. He can't get out.

quests.title: The Fortress Folds
quests.summary: Then the Patriarch does something nobody expected. The black gate, the fortress and the altar fold into nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the pools the black fortress creases like paper. It folds, and folds again, smaller and smaller, into a seam of purple dark.

objectives.text: Reach into the fold with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing. Not darkness, not stone. Nothing. The void, between one place and another. The black gate is in there somewhere, very far away.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's gone where no army can follow. Folded his home into the void and taken it with him. Behind that fold are my... Iron-Fang's family.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He won't come out tonight. He'll come out when he's ready. He's always been very good at waiting.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: What the Fold Leaves Behind
quests.summary: The fold leaves a wound in the air, and things come out of it: shapes of purple dark with hands.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Things coming out of the nothing! With hands! Why does everything bad have hands?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Hold the field of bones against more void wraiths
Catch your breath with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Void wraiths. The fold is leaking. The Abyss is going to be dangerous in a completely new way. Wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Iron-Fang at the Fold
quests.summary: Iron-Fang stands at the edge of the fold with his hand pressed flat against nothing.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They were behind that gate. My sister. My men's children. I came to bring them home. Now there isn't a gate.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. I don't know how to pay this one. There's nothing to hit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: There will be, Tie Hu. He'll open it again. He has to. And we'll be there.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...You're a fool, sect brat. I keep saying that. I keep believing you.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

objectives.text: Join Elder Gu at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Choice
quests.summary: The Sect Master arrives at the rim through the array. She listens, looks at the fold, and makes the hardest choice of her life.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We came to finish it. He's folded himself into nothing. I can't march an army into nothing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: So we go home. We get strong enough to walk into nothing. We break whatever he's waiting for. And we come back.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He's waiting for you, Lotus heir. For your tribulation. That's the only door heaven will open for him. You're his key and his ladder both.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I'm sorry. That's all I seem to say now. I'm sorry.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Gu still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Collecting the Wounded
quests.summary: The retreat is orderly. Xiao Shi, who knows every path, leads the wounded to the array. You carry what he can't.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know every path down here. I'll lead the wounded. You carry the medicine. My sister made eight hundred bundles. Eight hundred.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Gather Xiao Man's medicine bundles for the wounded

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Everyone out. Nobody left behind. That's the rule I made in the cages. I'm keeping it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Long War
quests.summary: On the rim, as the blood moon sets, Ye Wuming tells you the war has just changed shape.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It was going to be one night. Now it's a long war. Against a patriarch who isn't here, and seven servants who are.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Ladder. The rungs. Break them and he has nothing to climb when he comes out. I'll hunt with you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Still no name, Ye Wuming?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not yet. It's close. I can feel it, like a word on the tip of the tongue. I'll tell you when I have it.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Coming Home to an Empty Step
quests.summary: The vanguard comes home. At the hall steps, where Elder Mo always stood, there is nobody to tell you you're late.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hall steps are swept and empty. Somebody has left a cup of tea where Elder Mo used to stand. It has gone cold.

objectives.text: Meet Lu Ping at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: I keep expecting him to come out and shout at me. I've started standing up straight in case. It doesn't help.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Wei Tong hasn't left the training ground since you got back. He's just sitting with the puppets. Not training. Sitting.

quests.title: Wei Tong With the Puppets
quests.summary: Wei Tong is sitting among the training puppets, the way Elder Mo sat among his runes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He used to bet me buns on how many puppets the new ones could break. I lost every bet. On purpose. He knew.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I made his birthday dumplings. We ate them. You said we'd eat them for him. We did. It didn't help.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: It wasn't supposed to help, Senior Brother. It was supposed to hurt a little less.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...It hurts exactly the same. But I'm eating again. That's something, right? Tell me that's something.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I only dropped three herbs today! Well. Three that I know of.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: We're done at here. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Can you do that? Are we allowed to do that?

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Red at the Edges Again
quests.summary: Elder Hua has three disciples in the infirmary with red at the edges of their eyes. No pill caused it this time.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Red at the edges. No Frenzy Pill this time. They're grieving, and something is feeding on the grief.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the pavilion a disciple sits hugging his knees, whispering to someone who isn't there, and the someone whispers back.

objectives.text: Look at the grieving disciple with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Soul sight shows a shadow on his shoulder, small and grey, feeding. Heart demons. Dozens of them, all over the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Heart demons. The void fold at the Abyss loosened something. Grief is an open door, and things are walking through it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Shades on the Mountain
quests.summary: At dusk the grief-shades gather, more than anyone can count, drawn to the sect like moths to a lamp.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're coming out at dusk. Everywhere there's someone grieving. Which is everywhere.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Defeat the grief-shades at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These grief-shades fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of grief-shades

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They scatter when you strike them. They come back when people remember. We can't strike grief.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: What You Did at the Mirror
quests.summary: You faced your own heart demon at the Heart Mirror. Elder Hua asks you to teach the grieving how.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You faced yours at the mirror. What did you do? Not the fighting. Before.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I said it out loud. What I was afraid of. It's smaller when it's said.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Then teach them to say it. I'll bring them to the stone bridge. You sit with them.

objectives.text: Sit with the grieving on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one they say it. I miss him. I'm afraid I'll die too. I should have said thank you. The shades on their shoulders shrink.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: It's working. The shades are getting smaller. My brother said his, too. He said he misses the cages. He hates that he does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Biggest Shade
quests.summary: One shade isn't shrinking. It has grown so large it walks on its own, and it is walking toward Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: There's a shade at the training ground as big as a man. It looks like... it looks like you. But it's following Wei Tong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the weapon rack, a shadow shaped like you stands behind Wei Tong, bent close, whispering in his ear.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It says it was your fault. That you went to the mirror and left Elder Mo alone. It sounds like you. It uses your voice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I know it's not true. I know. But it's so loud. Make it stop. Please make it stop.

quests.title: Wei Tong's Despair
quests.summary: The heart demon feeding on Wei Tong has taken the shape of the person he'd least like to blame. You.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shade steps away from Wei Tong and turns. It has your face, your stance, your sword. Its eyes are Wei Tong's grief.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Don't hold back because it looks like you! It's not you! You're... you're my friend! Hit it!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It's gone. It's quiet. For the first time since the formation lit, it's quiet in my head.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It wasn't your fault. I knew that. I just needed someone to hit the part of me that didn't. Thank you. I'm hungry.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks you never to tell anyone what his heart demon looked like.

choices.text: Promise

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Tell Elder Hua, so she can help him

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Laugh about it

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Tea for the Empty Step
quests.summary: Wei Tong wants to do something for Elder Mo. Something he'd grumble at. He decides on tea, at the hall steps, every morning.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Every morning. A cup of tea on the hall steps, where he stood. He'd hate it. He'd say tea is for people who've finished training.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: So we'll train first. Then tea. Help me carry the pot.

objectives.text: Pick tea leaves from the terraces
Pour the first cup at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steam rises from the cup on the empty step. Nobody drinks it. Everybody who passes bows to it. Then goes to train.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd hate it so much. It's perfect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Grief
quests.summary: The Sect Master has not wept for Elder Mo. Elder Bai asks you to go and see her. He says she won't see him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: She won't see me. She won't see Hua. She's in the main hall with the doors shut, and she's not in seclusion. She's hiding.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty years. He argued with every decision I made. I'd give the sect to hear him argue with one more.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I can't weep. If I weep, I'll stop, and I can't stop. There's too much to do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He'd say you're being stubborn, Sect Master.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: ...He would. He'd say it exactly like that. Close the door on your way out. I'm going to be stubborn in private for an hour.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: The Shades Thin
quests.summary: Night by night, the grief-shades thin. Not gone. Grief never goes. But smaller, and quieter, and no longer hungry.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The infirmary's empty. The shades are small now. They'll never be gone. Grief isn't a wound. It's a scar. Scars are fine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I told my sister I miss the cages. She didn't laugh. She held my hand. The shade on my shoulder is the size of a sparrow now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I don't mind a sparrow.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Twelve at the Gate
quests.summary: Twelve new disciples climbed the nine thousand steps this spring. None of them know who Elder Mo was.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Twelve new ones! At the gate! Mud and hope, like always. One of them fainted on my boots. It felt like old times.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Twelve candidates stand at the gate, muddy and shaking. One clutches a letter. One clutches a chicken. Nobody knows why.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The outer court needs an elder. I have no elder to give it. I have Wei Tong. I'm going to ask him. Come with me. He'll say no.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Wei Tong Says No
quests.summary: Wei Tong says no. Then no again. Then, at the hall steps, next to the cup of tea, he says something else.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: No. I'm not an elder. I'm a senior outer disciple with a sword called Dumpling. Elder Mo was... he was Elder Mo.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He wrote your name in his notes. Under 'if I'm gone'. He wrote: Wei Tong. He'll say no. Ask twice.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...He wrote that? He wrote 'ask twice'?

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Fine. Fine. I'll teach them. Not as an elder. As a senior brother who's very, very stubborn. He'd want stubborn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The First Lesson
quests.summary: Wei Tong's first lesson with the new disciples. He asks you to demonstrate, the way you did for him years ago.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Right! New disciples! This is {player}. Soul Transformation. Very scary. Watch the stance. Not the face. The face is distracting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Demonstrate on the puppets for the new disciples

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! Your sword follows your body! That's what he said to me. Now I'm saying it to you!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They stood up straight. All twelve. One of them saluted the puppet. I cried a bit. Don't tell them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Chickens and Contribution Points
quests.summary: The new disciple with the chicken has lost the chicken. It is somewhere on the mountain, being a chicken.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The girl with the chicken lost the chicken. It's her only family. Well, it's a chicken. But it's hers. Find it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Search the plum garden for the lost chicken

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You found it! In the plum garden! Eating plums! Qiu Hua is crying. The chicken is not. Chickens are very calm.

quests.title: Elder Mo's Notes
quests.summary: Elder Mo left notes on every outer disciple he ever taught. Wei Tong asks you to read them with him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: His notes. On every disciple. Forty years of them. I found them under his bed. With his old tea set. The good one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Read Elder Mo's notes with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wei Tong: eats too much, laughs too loud, heart the size of the mountain. Will make a better teacher than me. Do not tell him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He said I'd be better than him. He never told me. He told the paper. Why do old men tell paper things?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because paper doesn't argue back.

quests.title: The New Ones Test the Teacher
quests.summary: The new disciples challenge Wei Tong to a spar, all twelve at once. He asks you to stand beside him, just in case.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: All twelve at once! They think I'm soft because I cried at the salute! Stand next to me. I'm not soft. I'm... medium.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Stand beside Wei Tong against the new disciples

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: More sparring disciples? Heaven must think we're bored.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Twelve on the floor, laughing. Nobody hurt. That's how you do it. You make them fall, then you make them laugh.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Budget for Buns
quests.summary: Wei Tong asks Steward Qian for a budget for buns. For the new disciples. For morale. Steward Qian has opinions.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Buns! A budget for buns! Elder Mo never asked for buns!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He bet me buns every week for six years. I lost every bet. On purpose. That's three hundred buns. Consider it back pay.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: ...That's actually a very good argument. Fine. Buns. A small budget. Very small. Medium.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: He's going to be a wonderful teacher. He's already the only one who's ever beaten Qian in an argument.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian refused the bun budget. The treasury would never notice a few coppers.

choices.text: Pay from your own purse

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: File a proper request

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it from the treasury

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: Wolves at the Wall
quests.summary: Spring wolves come down from the snowline to the outer wall, hungry and young. Wei Tong takes the new disciples to watch.

objectives.text: Make your way to the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Young wolves nose along the outer wall, grey and thin. Twelve new disciples watch from the gate, frightened and thrilled.

objectives.text: Drive the spirit wolves from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Watch how you drive them off. Not kill. Drive. They're only hungry. Hungry isn't a crime. Elder Mo taught me that.

objectives.text: Leave meat scraps for the wolves at the treeline
Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They'll go back to the snowline now, fed. The new ones think we're heroes. We're just people who feed wolves.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit wolves were driven mad by a demonic talisman nailed to a tree.

choices.text: Burn the talisman and calm the beasts

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Take it to the elders as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep it. It could be useful.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Standing Where He Stood
quests.summary: Wei Tong asks you to meditate at the hall steps, where Elder Mo stood every morning. He says someone should.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Someone should stand where he stood. Not me. I'd cry. You. Sit there. With the tea. Be grumpy at the sunrise.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Meditate at the hall steps at sunrise

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sun comes up over the sea of clouds. Your soul settles, deeper than it has since the formation. Middle stage of Soul Transformation.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Back straight, you think, and straighten it, and smile.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You straightened your back at the end. I saw. He'd have said adequate.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Adequate
quests.summary: At the end of the first month, the twelve new disciples give Wei Tong a gift: a plaque for the weapon rack.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The new ones made a plaque for Wei Tong. They asked me what to carve. I said one word. They carved it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: It says 'Adequate'. Just that. On the weapon rack. In terrible calligraphy. I'm never taking it down. Never.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Somebody bring me a bun. I'm having a moment.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Judge Wanted
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou needs a judge from the sect. The Sect Master sends you, and suggests you ask the last judge for advice.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Qingshi needs a judge. You're the closest thing to a judge I have who isn't in chains. Ask the one who is, before you go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You want advice. From me. The man who wrote half the precepts and broke all of them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Very well. Listen to everyone twice. Decide once. And never, ever judge someone for what you'd have done in their place. That was my mistake.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: (quietly) Kinder than I was, at your age.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The yamen courtyard is full. Petitioners, witnesses, three goats and one very loud rooster. Magistrate Zhou looks relieved to see you.

quests.title: The Case of the Ferry
quests.summary: The first case: Old Pan and Merchant Jin both claim the old ferry landing. Both have documents. Both are shouting.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years I've used that landing! Forty! My father used it! His father probably fell off it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Hear what Merchant Jin has to say

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild bought it! Twelve years ago! I have the deed! I'm not asking him to leave! I'm asking him to pay rent! Small rent! Tiny!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The guild owns the landing. Old Pan rows people for free when the town needs him. The guild will charge him the same: nothing.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: ...Nothing? That's... hm. That's exactly what I'd have done if I were a better man. Fine. Nothing. I'm getting good at nothing.

quests.title: The Case of the Stolen Chickens
quests.summary: Somebody is stealing chickens from the terraced fields. The farmers blame Iron-Fang's reformed men. Iron-Fang is furious.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They say my men took the chickens. My men haven't stolen anything in two years. They've been farming. Badly. But honestly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chicken coops on the terraces stand empty. Feathers lead not to the bandits' huts but uphill, toward the graves.

objectives.text: Follow the feathers from the coops

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The feathers lead to a fox den under a grave tablet. A very fat fox. And a very small pile of bones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: A fox. Two years honest, and they blame us for a fox. Well. The fox is very clever. I respect the fox.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Case That Isn't Simple
quests.summary: Widow Liu brings a case she doesn't want to bring. Her son wants to climb the nine thousand steps. She wants a judge to forbid it.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He's sixteen now. He wants to climb the steps. To become a cultivator. Like you. I want a judge to say no.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I lost him once. I won't lose him to the Abyss. I won't.

objectives.text: Talk with Liu Er at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, I won't go to the Abyss. I want to learn to protect the town. Like Constable Du. Like the immortal.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.text: Find Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No judge should decide this. He'll climb in spring, with your blessing, or not at all. That's between you.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: ...Coward. That's a coward's judgement. It's also correct. Spring. Not before. And he writes every week.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er, listening at the well, asks you to put in a word with the sect for spring.

choices.text: Promise to vouch for him

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell him the gate is the same for everyone

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Ask what it's worth to him

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Justice With Swords
quests.summary: Rogue cultivators have heard the Law Hall is empty and decided the law no longer applies to them. They are wrong.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Rogues on the river road, robbing travellers. They say there's no Law Hall anymore, so no law. I've written them a very firm letter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Clear the docks of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Finish the rogue cultivators at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Letter delivered. By you. With your fist. That's the kind of letter they understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Case of the Old Temple
quests.summary: Someone has been leaving offerings at Keeper Hong's old temple. Offerings to the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Someone is leaving offerings at the temple at night. Red candles. Crescents. Hong's old altar. The town is frightened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Red candles burn on the old altar, arranged in a crescent. Beside them, a child's drawing of a man with a kind face.

objectives.text: Examine the offerings on Hong's old altar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the back of the drawing: Grandfather Hong. He was kind to me. Nobody else was. A child's hand.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A child. Grieving a monster who was kind to her. That's... I don't know what that is. Not a crime.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Child at the Temple
quests.summary: You find the child who left the offerings. She is nine, an orphan, and she knew Keeper Hong only as someone who fed her.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the back alley, a girl of nine sits hugging her knees, a red candle stub in her hand. She looks at your sword, then your face.

objectives.text: Join Madam Fang at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Little Mei. Orphan. Hong fed her every day for three years. He was a monster, and he fed her. People are complicated.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: I'll take her. The inn needs someone to dry the cups. Iron-Fang's getting old. Don't tell him I said that.

objectives.choice_prompt: Little Mei still wears the pendant Keeper Hong gave her. It is a Blood Moon token.

choices.text: Let her keep it, and say nothing

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Take it to the Law Hall

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take it from her and sell it

reply.speaker: innkeeper_fang
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Night Court
quests.summary: Blood Moon cultivators come for the child. Hong's old followers think she belongs to them.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Masked men at the inn! Asking for the orphan! Madam Fang hit one with a ladle and he's very upset!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward flares on the inn door. Inside, Madam Fang stands in front of the child with a ladle and an expression like thunder.

objectives.text: Fight off the Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Nobody takes a child from my inn. Not the Blood Moon, not the yamen, not heaven itself. She dries cups now. She's mine.

quests.title: The Law Tablet
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou wants your judgements carved on the yamen's law tablet. He says it's how Qingshi remembers.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Your judgements. On the law tablet. The ferry, the fox, the boy, the child. Qingshi remembers its judges.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather carving stones from the market
Watch the judgements carved on the tablet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the four judgements the carver adds a line nobody asked for: judged by one who listened twice.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Listened twice. I told him to carve it. It's the finest thing I've ever said about anyone. I'm going to weep now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Report to the Chains
quests.summary: Back at the sect you tell Gu Hanshan how it went. He listens twice, as he said to.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: A fox, a ferry, a boy and a child. You judged none of them for what you'd have done. Good.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The Law Hall is empty. It should stay empty until someone kinder than me sits in it. That may be a long time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe it's you, after all this.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No. I'll never sit there again. But thank you for saying it. It's a strange thing to be forgiven by the person you wronged most.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The herb terraces step down the slope in green stripes, each labelled in Elder Hua's stern hand.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Gate closes at dusk. Always has. Always will.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Green in the Pond
quests.summary: Xiao Man comes running: the lotus in the pond has opened, and it is green, and the carp are bowing to it.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: The lotus! The one you planted! It opened this morning and it's green! Green and gold! The carp are bowing! Carp can't bow!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A lotus the colour of new jade floats in the pond, gold at its heart. Every carp in the water faces it, perfectly still.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's been sitting here since dawn. She says the hermit promised to come. She's sent him six cranes. They were very bad cranes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Nine Thousand Steps
quests.summary: At noon, Lu Ping runs up from the gate: an old man in a straw hat is climbing the steps, very slowly, and complaining the whole way.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (steps back half a pace) {senior}... people say things about you. I don't believe them. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: An old man on the steps! Straw hat! He's complaining about every single step! He says they were lower three hundred years ago!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Make your way to the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Up the last steps comes the hermit, straw hat, walking stick, bad knees, and an expression of profound betrayal toward staircases.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Nine thousand steps. Your founder was a sadist. I told her so three hundred years ago. She laughed. I'm still right.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Where's the lotus? I came to see the lotus. Not the steps. Definitely not the steps.

quests.title: The Hermit Meets the Sect Master
quests.summary: The Sect Master comes to the gate herself. The last disciple of the Verdant Lotus bows to the master of the Azure Cloud.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Lan Jue of the Verdant Lotus. Welcome to the Azure Cloud. Three hundred years late. Better late.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sect Master. I ran when your founder and mine needed me most. I've come to say I'm sorry. And to look at a flower.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your sect gave everything to the seal. Ours forgot your name. We're both sorry. Come and look at the flower.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; here isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

quests.title: Two Sects at One Pond
quests.summary: The hermit and the Sect Master sit at the pond together. They ask you to sit between them.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit between us. You're the only thing both our sects have in common now. Humour two old people.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Sit between the two sects at the pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blue on one side, green on the other. The lotus turns toward you. For a moment the pond reflects two founders, side by side, and then only the three of you.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He'll stay a few days. He says the pagoda needs someone who knows how to read Verdant Lotus script. Bai is ecstatic.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Lotus ruins' pond is your family's. The Azure Cloud wants it registered as sect land.

choices.text: Share it with both sects

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Register it properly

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Claim it for yourself alone

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Bai Meets Lan
quests.summary: Elder Bai has waited his whole life to meet a Verdant Lotus scholar. The hermit has waited three hundred years to meet a good librarian.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: You read the old script! You read it fluently! Do you know what the third character on the drowned stele means? I've guessed for forty years!

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It means 'turtle'. It was a soup recipe. We hid everything important in soup recipes.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: ...I knew it. I knew it! My grandmother! She learned it from you! From your sect! Oh, sit down, sit down, have some tea!

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Finally. Someone who pours for me. Three hundred years I've been pouring my own.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Peach Trees for the Old Man
quests.summary: Elder Hua has an idea: plant Elder Mo's peach trees beside the lotus, so there's something of him by the water too.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Peach saplings from the old orchard. Mo's orchard. Plant them by the pond. He left me peaches for forty years. I'm leaving him trees.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Dig peach saplings from the old orchard
Plant Elder Mo's peach trees by the pond

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three peach saplings beside the green lotus. Elder Hua pats the earth around each one, and doesn't say anything for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: In five years they'll fruit. I'll leave a peach on my own doorstep every autumn, and pretend. That's our tradition.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more spirit herbs than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Wolves Follow the Hermit
quests.summary: The hermit's old friends from the forest have followed him up the mountain: grey wolves who don't understand stairs either.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey wolves pace at the outer wall, whining. They followed the hermit's scent up nine thousand steps and are very confused.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Some of the wolves are not his. Some have purple in their eyes, and came up with the hermit's scent to hide their own.

objectives.text: Calm the hermit's wolves with meat

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My wolves. And void-touched ones pretending to be my wolves. The fold at the Abyss is leaking all over the world. I felt it in the forest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Letter for Lan
quests.summary: You still have the letter from the reliquary, addressed to Lan when he stops running. You think he has.

objectives.text: Give the hermit his master's letter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lan Jue breaks the green wax with trembling fingers. He reads it twice. Then he laughs, and cries, and laughs.

objectives.text: Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She wrote: Lan, you idiot, stop running and go and teach someone. That's all. Three hundred years. That's all it said.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I'll teach. The sutra. Here, in the pagoda, if your Sect Master allows. Somebody has to, and it seems I'm the only one left.

quests.title: Wei Tong Is Jealous
quests.summary: Word spreads that the hermit will teach the Heart Sutra in the pagoda. Wei Tong wants to know if there's lunch.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He's going to teach? In the pagoda? Every morning? Is there lunch? The Verdant Lotus must have had lunch.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: We had tea. And a turtle soup. Very famous. Very secret. The recipe was also a sealing diagram.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...I'm going to learn the Heart Sutra. For the soup. Mostly for the soup. A bit for the sutra.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone's happy. I'm suspicious. It's been a week without an attack. Something's wrong.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Something's Wrong
quests.summary: Han Xue is right. A crane arrives from Qingshi, spotted with ash: the outer villages are burning, one each night.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A crane from Constable Du. Villages burning in the lowlands. One a night. Each one leaves a pile of ash in the shape of a ladder.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Ash. Luo Hui. The First Rung is back, and he wants you to know it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Go. I'll be in the pagoda, being taught to use your terrible modern brushes by your excitable librarian. Come back.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hexagonal pavilion is empty except for a teapot, still warm, and a single fallen plum petal.

objectives.text: Meet the hermit at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Ladders in the Ash
quests.summary: Constable Du takes you to the latest burned village. In the ash, someone has drawn a ladder with seven rungs.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the fields a village smoulders. In the ash of the largest house, a ladder has been drawn with a finger. Seven rungs. The first rung is circled.

objectives.text: Talk with Constable Du at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Seven villages. Nobody killed. Everyone woken, marched out, then the houses burned. Like he wants us to count.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: And every time, a letter nailed to the well. Addressed to you.

quests.title: The First Letter
quests.summary: The letters are in a beautiful hand. They are polite. They are very, very specific about you.

objectives.text: Read the letter nailed to the well

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dear heir. You shook me in the warehouse. I have healed. My star is bright again. Come and shake me properly. Luo Hui, the First Rung.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: There's a second page. A map of Qingshi's outer villages. Seven of them crossed out. The eighth circled. Tonight.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He's telling you where he'll be. That's either arrogance or a trap. It's both. It's always both.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Eighth Village
quests.summary: The eighth village is on the river. You get there before the ash does.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The eighth village is across my river. I'll ferry you over. No fare. I'll wait. I'll pray. I'll hit anyone who comes near with an oar.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Ring the dock bell to wake the village

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell clangs across the water. Lamps flare in the village. Families pour out of their houses, just as figures in grey ash pour in.

objectives.text: Stop the ash-cultists at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Look for Zhao Kang at the main street

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Nobody burned tonight. That's one village he didn't get. He'll be angry. Good. Angry people write worse letters.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Letters Back
quests.summary: Zhao Kang suggests writing back. Rudely. Han Xue suggests writing back politely. You write back honestly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Write back. Tell him he's a pile of ash with ideas above his station. Rungs are for climbing on. Tell him that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Write back politely. Politeness makes arrogant people careless. He'll underestimate you.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll write back honestly. Dear Luo Hui. I'm coming. I won't burn anything. Stop burning things. That's all.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's worse. That's much worse. He'll hate that. Send it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The ash letters threaten the eighth village unless the heir comes alone.

choices.text: Go alone, as asked

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Tell the Sect Master everything

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Send a decoy in your robes

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Ash on the Wind
quests.summary: Luo Hui's answer comes as ash on the wind, blowing north toward the bamboo forest.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the watchtower you see it: a thin grey line of ash in the sky, blowing north, toward the forest, like a finger pointing.

objectives.text: Defeat the ash-cultists at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists wait in the hill graves to slow you down. They've been told to die slowly. They're good at following orders.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I followed the ash from the rim. He's been moving between the Abyss and the forest. He's building something in the ruins.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus ruins. He's using your family's stones. For his rung.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

quests.title: The Burning Bamboo
quests.summary: The bamboo forest's edge is burning. Luo Hui wants you to come through fire.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bamboo at the forest's edge is burning in a perfect line, like a fence. Through the smoke, a ladder of ash hangs in the air.

objectives.text: Drive the ash-cultists from the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists stand in the burning grove, feeding the fire, chanting a single word over and over: climb.

objectives.text: Make your way to the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins gate is black with soot. On the archway, over the carved lotus, someone has painted a red rung.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I followed you. My men are putting out the fire. We're very good at fire. We used to start them. Now we stop them. It's better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Rung in the Ruins
quests.summary: Inside the ruins, Luo Hui has built an altar of Verdant Lotus stones, tied to his star. He's using your family to hold up his ladder.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the courtyard, lotus stones have been piled into an altar. A thread of red light rises from it, up through the canopy, toward a star.

objectives.text: Pull the stolen lotus stones from the altar
Cut the red thread to the star

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The thread snaps. Far above, a red star flickers. Somewhere in the forest, someone screams in rage, and the ash stops falling.

objectives.text: Clear the ruins gate of ash-cultists

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui's cultists pour out of the bamboo, too late to save the altar, just in time to be angry about it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shrine is quiet. The lotus stones are back where they belong. Luo Hui is gone. His ash trail leads south. Toward the Abyss.

quests.title: He'll Be at the Abyss
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the ash trail. Luo Hui has gone home to the Abyss rim, to heal. It's where he'll be strongest.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's gone to the rim. Near the fold. That's where the rungs draw power now. He'll be strongest there.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Which is where you should fight him. Because there, if you win, his star doesn't come back.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we rest. We heal. We go to the rim when we're ready, not when he wants us. Everyone agree? Good. Nobody argue.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Ash and Soul
quests.summary: Before the hunt you sit in the ruined shrine and let the week settle into your transformed soul.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul and body blur at the edges, like ink in water. The ruins hum with your family's old patience. Late stage of Soul Transformation.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You glow when you meditate. Did you know that? My men think you're a god. I told them you're a very stubborn orphan. They prefer god.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Liu Er's Steps
quests.summary: Back in Qingshi, Liu Er is packing. It's spring. He's climbing the nine thousand steps tomorrow, with his mother's blessing.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Tomorrow! The nine thousand steps! Mother blessed me. She cried. Then she packed me eleven meals. For one day.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Will you be at the gate? You don't have to. But if you were. That would be... that would be very good.

objectives.text: Meet Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He writes every week. That's the deal. And if he fails the test he comes home and carries water. That's also the deal.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Widow Liu confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Mirror Calls
quests.summary: You wake with the Heart Mirror humming in your soul. Han Xue says no. Then says she's coming.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The mirror's calling you? Absolutely not. Last time it let out a monster wearing your face.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...You're going anyway. I can see it. Fine. I'm coming. I'll stand at the edge and glare at it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The canyon is quieter since the fold. The wind comes up from below carrying the smell of nothing at all.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You're going to the mirror. Don't look surprised; I can see it on you. I'll guide you. The paths have changed since the fold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Wraiths on the Old Paths
quests.summary: The fold's leak has filled the old Abyss paths with void wraiths, and they are drawn to souls like yours.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Wraiths. They smell transformed souls. You're a feast to them. Stay close, and hit first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

objectives.text: Hold the blood pools against more void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the bottom of the Abyss the darkness is thicker than you remember, as if the fold had poured some of itself down here.

quests.title: Gu's Warning
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan insisted on coming, chained, to the depths. He says there is something about the mirror you need to hear.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I couldn't face the mirror. You could. Now it wants to finish what it started. It will show you something new.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Not your fear of dying. You've faced that. Your fear of living. Of going on when everyone else stops.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: How do you know?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Because I watched my daughter die and went on living. That was my mirror. Yours will be the same, only higher.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Shi at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The abyss depths is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.choice_prompt: Gu Hanshan offers what he knows of the Mirror in exchange for a softer cell.

choices.text: Grant it. Information saves lives.

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Promise nothing, and listen

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Threaten him instead

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Mirror's Surface
quests.summary: The Heart Mirror is still, black and patient. When you look into it, it doesn't show you. It shows everyone else.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mirror shows Han Xue, old, grey-haired. Zhao Kang, bent over a cane. Wei Tong's grave. The sect, and you above it, young and alone.

objectives.text: Look deeper into the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You climb the Ascension Stair, and every step, someone you love grows older and falls away, until there's no one left to wave.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stop looking. {player}, stop. You've gone white. What did you see?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You. Old. Everyone, gone. And me, still climbing.

quests.title: The Fear of Leaving
quests.summary: The mirror lets out a new shade. This one wears your face too, but older, sadder, and it doesn't want to hurt you. It wants you to stop.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A figure steps out of the water, wearing your face, but older, with eyes that have watched everyone die. It raises its sword, and weeps.

objectives.name: The Fear of Leaving
objectives.text: Face The Fear of Leaving at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Stay. Don't climb. Stay with them. Grow old with them. Heaven is lonely, {player}. I've seen it. I'm what you become.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Maybe. But they'd tell me to climb. Every one of them would tell me to climb.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mirror calms. Your reflection is only you again, tired, not alone. Behind you, in the water, Han Xue is scowling. It's very comforting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'd tell you to climb. And then come back down and visit. Weekly. Like Zhao Kang writes to his grandfather.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Everyone Would Say Climb
quests.summary: On the way back up, Zhao Kang, who came to find you, says the thing the mirror couldn't argue with.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I heard what you said to it. That we'd all tell you to climb. Of course we would. And then complain about it forever.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Heaven's lonely? Then take us with you. In here. The complaints especially. Heaven could use some complaints.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When you reach the top, remember us down here. That's all anyone who stays behind wants. To be remembered.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I remembered a name down there. Not mine. My mother's. It's a start.

quests.title: Blood Guards at the Rim
