quests.summary: Luo Hui's Blood Guards are waiting at the rim. He knows you went to the mirror. He knows you're tired.

objectives.text: Make your way to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Guards line the rim, and behind them ash drifts upward, toward one flickering red star.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guards at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

objectives.text: Gather demon cores from the fallen guards
Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's watching. He wanted you tired. You're not tired. You're something else. I don't know the word.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Rest Before the Rung
quests.summary: Han Xue orders you to rest one night before facing Luo Hui. You don't argue. You're learning.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One night. You rest. That's not a suggestion from your senior sister. That's an order from the person who'll carry you home if you don't.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Rest your soul in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the stillness at the bottom of the world, your soul rests. The fear of leaving is still there, but small, and folded, like a letter kept for later.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Shi at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I came to bring you medicine. My sister made more. It says 'eat this, idiot' on the label. That's how she says I love you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Flickering Star
quests.summary: In soul sight, the thread from the rim to Luo Hui's star is thick and bright. His rung is at the obelisk ring.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, a red thread rises from the obelisk ring to the sky, thick as a rope, humming. The First Rung is there.

objectives.text: Trace the red thread with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the thread's root, among the obelisk stumps, a pale man sits in a ring of ash, waiting. He waves.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He waved. The First Rung waved at you. I'm going to enjoy this more than a senior sister should.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Night Before the Rung
quests.summary: At the rim, before the fight, Ye Wuming tells you the name he remembered. His mother's name.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her name was Ye Qing. Evening Clear. I remembered it in the mirror. I think she named me something like it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When this is done, I'll find the rest. Tomorrow, break the first rung. For the children in the cages. For her.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Ash Circle
quests.summary: Luo Hui's last followers form a circle of ash around the obelisk ring. Breaking it means breaking them.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A circle of ash, and people standing in it chanting. I'm not going to ask. I'm just going to hit them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

objectives.text: Stop the ash-cultists at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ash-cultists ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ash circle breaks. At the obelisk ring, the pale man stands up and dusts himself off, politely.

quests.title: The Last Letter
quests.summary: Before the fight, Luo Hui sends one last letter by a trembling cultist. It's very short.

objectives.text: Go to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cultist hands you a letter and runs. It says: Dear heir. Thank you for writing back. Nobody ever writes back. Luo Hui.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He's lonely.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He burned seven villages. Lonely isn't an excuse. But... yes. He's lonely. That's what makes it sad.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Seven Anchors
quests.summary: The First Rung's star is tied to seven anchor-stones around the obelisk ring. Cut them, and his star can't heal him.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seven anchor-stones glow red among the obelisk stumps. Each one sings a single note up to a flickering star.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last anchor cracks. Overhead, the red star stops flickering and holds, steady and small. It can't send him anything now.

objectives.text: Defeat the Blood Guards at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui's guards charge from the bone field, too late. The pale man doesn't join them. He's waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Everything is quiet. The ash has stopped falling. Across the pools, the First Rung stands alone in his circle.

quests.title: The First Rung Falls
quests.summary: The First Rung of the Patriarch's Ladder stands in his circle of ash and bows. One rung is nothing. Seven is a road to heaven.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui bows. Ash drifts from his sleeves. His star is overhead, cut off. He knows. He smiles anyway.

objectives.name: Luo Hui, the First Rung
objectives.text: Bring down Luo Hui, the First Rung

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: You wrote back. Nobody ever writes back. I was a scribe once, before the moon took me. I wrote a thousand letters. No answers.

dialogue.speaker: rung_luo
dialogue.text: Come, heir. Test me properly. One rung is nothing. But I'd like to be something, just once.

objectives.text: Stand over the fallen First Rung

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Luo Hui lies in his ash, smiling. Thank you for the letter, he says, and becomes ash, and the wind takes him, and his star goes out.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: One star out. On Qing Luan's chart, one red star is dark now. Six left.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He thanked you. The Blood Moon never taught anyone to thank. He learned it somewhere. That's almost worse.

quests.title: One Star Out
quests.summary: The Sect Master comes through the array to see for herself. Above the fold, one of seven red points of light is gone.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One star. Out. I saw it from the mountain; Qing Luan's crane arrived five minutes later, shouting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Six left. Each one harder. But the Ladder can be broken. You've proved it. The long war has its first victory.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I brought dumplings to the Abyss. For the victory. They're a bit ashy. Everything's a bit ashy here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Scribe's Letters
quests.summary: In Luo Hui's camp you find crates of letters. Thousands of them. All written by him. None of them sent.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Crates. Letters. Thousands. All in his hand. All addressed to people. None sent.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: To his mother. To a friend called Bo. To a girl he met once at a market. Forty years of letters to people he never saw again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Like Gu's letters to his daughter.

quests.title: What the Letters Say
quests.summary: Among the unsent letters, one is addressed to the Patriarch. It's the only one that's been opened.

objectives.text: Read the letter addressed to the Patriarch

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Master. The heir grows. When the seventh rung is set and the heir's lightning comes, the ladder will hold your weight. Your faithful first.

objectives.text: Make your way to the war camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath, in a different, older hand, a single word in red: Good.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When the heir's lightning comes. Your tribulation. They're waiting for it. All seven rungs, to hold him while he climbs your lightning.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Six to go. Break them before your sky breaks. That's the whole war, in one sentence.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Question
quests.summary: Iron-Fang asks the question everyone has been avoiding: if the fold opens only for the tribulation, how long will his family wait?

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: If he only comes out for your lightning, how long's that? Years? My sister's behind that fold. Years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming says the void holds them still. Like flies in amber. They won't age. They won't know how long.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...Then I'll wait for them. Iron-Fang pays his debts, and he waits. Get strong, sect brat. Get strong faster.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hmph. Keep up, village brat. Friend. Village friend.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

quests.title: Void at the Rim
quests.summary: With the first rung gone, the fold shudders, and more void wraiths spill out at the rim, angry and lost.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fold's upset. More wraiths. They don't know what they are. They just know something broke.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the field of bones
Find Zhao Kang after the fight

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've counted. That's one Rung, forty guards, sixty wraiths and one very ashy dumpling. Best week of my life.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Burning the Letters
quests.summary: At dusk, Han Xue asks what to do with Luo Hui's thousand unsent letters. You know what he'd want.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A thousand letters. We can't deliver them. Most of the people are dead. What do we do?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: We send them. The only way we can.

objectives.text: Burn the unsent letters at the rim

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letters burn, and the ash rises, and for the first time it doesn't form a ladder. It just goes up, into the dark, like it's finally being delivered.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's the kindest thing anyone's ever done for a monster. I'm not crying. It's the ash.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Before they burn, you see Luo Hui's letters name the villages that paid him. Some paid in children.

choices.text: Let them burn, as the villages ask

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Keep a copy for the Law Hall

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Copy the names, and make those villages pay you

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Locked Box
quests.summary: The Sect Master gives you a box of plain wood, locked, with your name on it in Elder Mo's square handwriting.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He left this for you. With instructions: 'give it when the first rung falls, not before'. He knew about the rungs. Of course he did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside: a sword manual in Elder Mo's hand, a folded letter, and a single dried peach blossom, pressed flat.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: His handwriting. That's his handwriting. I'd know those square characters anywhere. He wrote like he talked. Like a wall.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Letter
quests.summary: You read Elder Mo's letter on the hall steps, where he stood every morning.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letter is short. Elder Mo's letters are always short. You read it twice.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Junior. If you're reading this, I found the flaw too late. Don't blame yourself. I'd have gone anyway. Back straight. Adequate. More than. Mo.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Back straight. Even in his last letter. Of course. He'd have written it on his own gravestone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Sword Manual
quests.summary: Elder Mo's sword manual is thirty pages of diagrams and one page of advice. The advice is: stop overthinking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The manual! Thirty pages! Diagrams! And the last page just says: stop overthinking, you overthinker. That's you. That's definitely you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Practise Elder Mo's forms on the puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's his stance! The low one! He only did it when he was really angry! You do it better! Don't tell him! He can't hear! Tell him anyway!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: His forms, in your hands. It's like watching him. Younger, and less grumpy. And better looking. Don't tell him that either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Peach Blossom
quests.summary: The dried peach blossom in the box has a note on its back. It's not for you.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A blossom from his orchard. The note on the back. Let me see. ...It says 'for Hua'. In his hand. Forty years.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Forty years of anonymous peaches, and he signs a blossom when he's gone. That stubborn, stubborn old man.

objectives.text: Find Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: I'm going to press it in my herbal. Between moonbell and mountain sage. He'd hate that. It's perfect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Cleaning His Room
quests.summary: Somebody has to clean Elder Mo's room. Wei Tong can't. Elder Hua won't. So you do, with Xiao Man, who drops everything.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I'll help! I'll only drop the unimportant things! Probably! Is a teapot important? It's his good teapot. I'll hold it very carefully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I didn't drop the teapot. I dropped the lid. It's fine. It's fine! It bounced! Wei Tong's keeping the teapot. For the tea on the steps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: In Elder Mo's room: his savings, and a note. 'For the orphans.'

choices.text: Give it to the orphans yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Give it to the treasury to distribute

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep it. He'd want you strong.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Hermit Reads the Manual
quests.summary: The hermit reads Elder Mo's sword manual in the pagoda and declares it the most irritating document he's ever loved.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: This is the most irritating sword manual I've ever read. Every diagram has a note. 'Back straight.' 'No.' 'Again.' 'Adequate.'

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I wish I'd met him. I'd have liked to argue with him. People who write 'no' in the margins are wonderful to argue with.

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I'm making a copy for the pagoda. Every note. Every 'no'. The Verdant Lotus hid everything in soup. The Azure Cloud hides it in grumbling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Guarding His Grave
quests.summary: At night, void wraiths gather at the cliff edge where Elder Mo's ashes were scattered. The fold's leak is drawn to grief.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Wraiths at the cliff! Where we scattered his ashes! They're just... standing there! Like they're mourning! Or feeding!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Ward the cliff edge where his ashes lie

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises blue over the cliff, and the wraiths flinch back. For a moment in the blue light you'd swear someone was standing very straight.

objectives.text: Clear the cliff edge of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Catch your breath with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nobody feeds on his grave. Nobody. I'll stand guard here every night if I have to. With Dumpling. And tea.

quests.title: Liu Er at the Gate
quests.summary: Liu Er reaches the top of the nine thousand steps, muddy and shaking and triumphant. Lu Ping lets him faint on his boots.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: He made it! Liu Er! He fainted on my boots! It's tradition! I'm so proud! I've known him since he was in a cage!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I made it. Nine thousand. I counted. I'm going to write to Mother right now. Can I write to Mother right now?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Welcome to the Azure Cloud, Liu Er. Tomorrow you learn how little you know.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: ...That's what Elder Mo said to you, isn't it? Wei Tong told me. I'm going to try very hard to be adequate.

quests.title: Standing Straight
quests.summary: On the last night of the first year without him, you sit at the cliff edge with Elder Mo's manual and straighten your back.

objectives.text: Meditate where Elder Mo's ashes lie

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Back straight. Breath long. Your soul and body settle into one shape, like a sword into its sheath. Great Perfection of Soul Transformation.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wind off the sea of clouds sounds, just for a moment, like someone saying hmph.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Great Perfection. Next you sever what binds you, and walk in the void. Qing Luan's crane says the isles are tearing open with rifts. She needs you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mo would say go. So go. Adequately.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Tea on the Steps
quests.summary: In the morning, Wei Tong pours tea on the hall steps for Elder Mo. Today, twelve new disciples pour with him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Twelve new ones, and me, and a cup for him. Every morning. Train first. Then tea. That's the rule now. His rule. Our rule.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The void, next. Rifts in the sky. We'll need everything he taught us. Straight backs included.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Crane Full of Holes
quests.summary: Qing Luan's cloud crane arrives full of holes, and her voice keeps skipping words.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A crane from the star-gazer. It's full of holes. Her voice skips. 'Rifts. Isles. Come. Forgetting.' That's all we have.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The isles are closed for sixty years. If something's tearing them open, it's the fold. Go. Take Han Xue and Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road is torn. Where the jade bridge should be, a rift of purple nothing hangs in the air, silently eating a pine.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You came. Good. I'm... what was I saying. The rifts. They're eating the isles. And me. I'm a memory. Memories are easy to eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Nothing Where the Bridge Was
quests.summary: The jade bridge is half gone, bitten off by a rift. Beyond it, the Isle of Winds floats alone.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade bridge ends in mid-air. Where the rest should be, the rift hums, a colour that isn't a colour.

objectives.text: Touch the rift's edge with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing. Not dark. Not cold. Your soul slides off it the way water slides off oil. Something on the other side notices you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It noticed you. I saw your face. What noticed you?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know. Something that lives in nothing.

quests.title: Things That Live in Nothing
quests.summary: The things that live in nothing come out to see who touched their door.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Wraiths again. Purple ones. The Abyss's fold must connect to every rift. It's one big nothing with a lot of doors.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I remember you. Good. I forgot for a moment. Don't let me forget again. Tell me your name every hour. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A void creature, cornered, is only trying to go home through the rift.

choices.text: Let it pass

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Kill it. Orders are orders.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Trap it and sell it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Standing on Nothing
quests.summary: Qing Luan's first lesson in the void: stand on it. Not beside it. On it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Void walking. Your soul steps first, like before. But this time, step onto the nothing, and let the nothing hold you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It will, if you don't argue with it. Nothing is very polite if you don't argue.

objectives.text: Stand on the void with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You step onto the rift. It doesn't hold you. Then, when you stop expecting it to, it does, soft as snow, silent as a held breath.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You stood on nothing. Most cultivators take ten years. You took an afternoon. You're very bad at arguing with things you don't understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Storm Wolves in the Rift
quests.summary: The storm wolves of the isles have fallen into the rifts and come back wrong: half lightning, half nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves pace the spirit vein, their hind legs fading into purple nothing. They snap at the air, at crystals, at each other.

objectives.text: Break the storm wolves at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The storm wolves spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather void shards from the fallen wolves
Show Yan Tie what you found

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came up the torn road! It was very scary! We shouted the whole way! Where are the wolves? Oh. You did them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Rift's Heart
quests.summary: All the rifts on the isles lead back to one wound, in the celestial ruins, where the memory crystal used to hang.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the memory crystal hung, a rift yawns like a mouth. The crystal is gone. Its memory is leaking into nothing.

objectives.text: Hold the rift's heart closed with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hold the rift like you'd hold a wound, soul pressed to it. It pushes back. Then, slowly, grudgingly, it narrows.

objectives.text: Stop the celestial sentinels at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The palace sentinels, half-eaten by the void, stagger out of the ruins to defend a palace that is barely there.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rifts across the isles shrink to hairlines. Qing Luan is sitting on the cloud gate, saying her own name over and over.

quests.title: Qing Luan Remembers Herself
quests.summary: Qing Luan is whole again, mostly. She says one thing slipped through the rift, and she wants it back.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I'm Qing Luan. I was the palace's youngest sage. I watched him climb. I'm... mostly here. One memory slipped through.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The memory of my own face. I can't remember what I looked like. Isn't that silly? Ten thousand years, and that's what I lose.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You have a star on your forehead and you frown at everyone like they've disappointed a constellation. That's what you look like.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: ...That's the nicest thing anyone's said to me in ten thousand years. Thank you, sword girl.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Stitching the Isles
quests.summary: The hairline rifts need stitching with cloud silk and qi. Every pine on the isle needs it. You have one afternoon.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Cloud silk, and your qi, stitched through the hairlines. Like mending a robe. A very large robe made of sky.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Stitch the hairline rifts with cloud silk
Join Zhao Kang at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I've never sewn anything. I've sewn the sky. My great-grandfather is going to faint. I'm writing to him tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Void Beneath the Soul
quests.summary: Qing Luan says you're ready. Not for more tricks. For the thing beneath your soul, where cultivators go to refine it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You've stood on nothing. Now go into it. Not a rift. The nothing beneath your own soul. Every cultivator has one.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Refine your soul there, and you'll never fear a rift again. Or a fold. Or a patriarch hiding in one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What's down there?

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Nothing. Exactly nothing. It's the hardest thing in the world to be alone with. Go on. I'll say your name every hour.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

quests.title: Spirit Severing
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, with Qing Luan saying your name every hour, you sink past qi and soul into the nothing beneath, and sever.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sit at the gate. Sink. I'll say your name. When you hear it, come back up. If you don't hear it, keep going. Either is fine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Gather the stitched rift-silk for the breakthrough
Sever your spirit in the void

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Past qi. Past soul. Past the place where the Heart Mirror found you. Down to the stillness beneath, where there is nothing at all.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing, and nothing, and in the nothing, your name, said by a memory who never forgets it now. You rise, and the void rises with you.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Spirit Severing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The storm reaches down with long fingers, feeling for every thread you have not cut.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came up the torn road myself. I felt it from the mountain. Spirit Severing. Every thread cut. You can walk where he's hiding now.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Not yet. Not alone. But you can. For the first time since the fold, we have a way in.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Into the Fold
quests.summary: Ye Wuming meets you at the rim. He wants to know if his children's families are still behind the gate. So does Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You can walk in the void now. So look. Into the fold. Tell me if the gate's still there. Tell me if they're still there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Make your way to the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the blood pools the fold hangs in the air, a seam of purple dark. It hums at your refined soul like a cat that wants to be let in.

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's here too. Look for my sister. She'll be the one shouting. She was always the one shouting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Drifting Fortress
quests.summary: You step your soul a hand's breadth into the fold. The black fortress is there, drifting in nothing, very far away and very near.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul steps in. Nothing. And in the nothing, the black fortress, drifting like a ship with no sea, its gate shut tight.

objectives.text: Look through the fold with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind the walls, in the cages: people. Not moving. Not breathing. Held, mid-breath, mid-word, like flies in amber. A woman mid-shout.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Mid-shout? Was she mid-shout? ...That's her. That's my sister. She's alive. She's frozen, and she's alive.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's going to cry now. Everybody look at the wall.

quests.title: The Fold Pushes Back
quests.summary: The fold doesn't like being looked into. It pushes back with everything it has.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fold's spitting wraiths at us. It didn't like you looking. Nobody likes being looked at in the bath.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Hold the field of bones against more void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It knows you now. The fold. The Patriarch inside it knows you walked to his door. He'll send something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Gu in the Void
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, has come to the rim. He says he knows what the Patriarch will send. He sent it himself, once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He'll send the Rust Monk. Tie Shan. The Second Rung. He always sends the monk when he wants something taken apart slowly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I delivered messages to Tie Shan. Before. He was a monk in a temple that burned. He prayed to the Patriarch for rain. He got rust.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Where will he go?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Where there's iron. And prayers. Qingshi. The temple. Hong's old temple. He'll want to pray in it.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: We're done at the abyss depths. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't tell anyone I'm enjoying myself.

quests.title: Blood Guards Out of Nothing
quests.summary: Blood Guards step out of the fold, wrapped in purple nothing, the first of the Patriarch's soldiers to cross since it closed.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Guards step out of the air at the obelisk ring, purple mist streaming off their armour. They've come to see who looked.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Guards from the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These Blood Guards fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Gather void shards from their armour
Share your findings with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: They came out of nothing. They can come out of nothing anywhere. The sect. The town. Anywhere.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'm going to draw a map of where the fold touches the world. Every place. Somebody has to.

quests.title: Looking for Faces
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children want you to look into the fold for their families. One by one. You can't say no.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They want you to look for their families. One by one. I told them you might not find them. They said look anyway.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the faces in the fold: the Blood Guard who once beat you. He's lost, pleading.

choices.text: Pull him out

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Pull him out, in chains

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Leave him to the nothing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring asks for her father. You look. A tall man, frozen mid-step, holding a cup. River asks for his grandmother. Small Mountain asks for nobody.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Small Mountain, is there anyone you want me to look for?

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Small Mountain shakes his head. Just look for Ye Wuming's mother, he says. He never asks for himself.

quests.title: Ye Qing
quests.summary: You look into the fold for a woman named Ye Qing, Evening Clear. You don't find her. You find something else.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: No Ye Qing in the cages. But in the fortress's lowest room, a wall of names, scratched by the children the Blood Moon stole.

objectives.text: Read the wall of names through the fold

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thousands of names. Near the bottom, small, in a six-year-old's hand: Ye Qing's son. And a name, half-scratched out. Ye Chen—

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Ye Chen. Half a name. Mine. I scratched it there when I was six. I'd forgotten I'd done it.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Half a name. It's more than I had this morning.

quests.title: Holding the Rim
quests.summary: The fold opens wider after you look. The Blood Moon wants to know how much you saw.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The rim's crawling with them. I've counted forty. I've stopped counting. I'm just hitting now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Clear the field of bones of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Blood Guards come on in silence.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators
Look for Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Rust Monk. Gu said Qingshi. The temple. If he's praying there, the whole town's iron is going to rot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Maps of the Touching Places
quests.summary: Xiao Shi starts his map: every place the fold touches the world. He needs samples from each one.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Every place the fold touches leaves a shard. I need shards from the rim, the pools, the obelisks. Then I can map the rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Gather fold-shards for Xiao Shi's map

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Twelve shards. Twelve places. I'll ask Elder Bai for the rest of the map. He'll be so excited he'll forget to eat.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Promise at the Fold
quests.summary: Before you leave, Iron-Fang puts his hand on the fold and says something to a sister who can't hear him.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Mei. It's me. Tie Hu. I'm washing dishes now. And farming. Badly. I'll get you out. Iron-Fang pays his debts.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...She's mid-shout. I bet she's shouting at me. She always was. Come on. The monk won't wait.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You reach the canyon mouth. For a moment everything is quiet, and then you notice the tracks.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Everything Rusts
quests.summary: Qingshi is turning orange. Constable Du meets you at the gate holding a spear that crumbles as he salutes.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The town gate's hinges are orange and weeping. Every nail in every house is rusting. The air smells of old blood and wet iron.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: My spear. Twenty years I've had it. It crumbled when I saluted. The gate won't close. The bell won't ring.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: There's a monk in the old temple, praying. Every time he finishes a prayer, something else rusts.

quests.title: Town Without Iron
quests.summary: Without iron, a town falls apart in small ways first. Everybody has a small way.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: My ferry chain's gone. Rusted through. I'm pulling the ferry by hand. Forty years. My arms are older than the chain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Hear what Madam Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: My pots! My ladle! I hit a man with my ladle and it snapped! I've never been so insulted!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild's scales. Rusted. I can't weigh anything. I've had to trust people. It's been a terrible week. It's been a wonderful week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Rusted Bell
quests.summary: The town bell hangs rusted solid in the watchtower. If it can ring once, the monk will hear it and come out.

objectives.text: Make your way to the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The town bell is a lump of orange. When you touch it, flakes fall like autumn leaves. Inside it, the clapper is fused.

objectives.text: Burn the rust from the bell with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul sinks into the bell and finds the iron underneath the rust, and reminds it. The rust falls away. The bell rings once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He heard it. The prayers stopped. He'll come out to see who unrusted his bell. Good. Let him come out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Acolytes in Orange
quests.summary: The monk sends his acolytes first, orange-robed and bowing, rust flaking from their blades.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They bow before they stab. I remember these. I still bow back. Then I stab. It's a whole ritual now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: More rust acolytes? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Finish the rust acolytes at the market square
Find Constable Du after the fight

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Six of them. They bowed to me first. I didn't know what to do. I bowed back. Then I hit one with a chair.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Well Rusts
quests.summary: The monk's next prayer reaches the town well. If the water turns to rust, the town has nothing to drink.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The well's turning orange! The water tastes of iron! If it goes, the whole town goes thirsty!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Seal the well against the rust

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You press your palm to the well's stones. Your soul steps into the water and holds it, clean, while the rust beats on it like rain.

objectives.text: Break the rust acolytes at the town well

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rust acolytes spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Guards that follow

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The water's clear. You held it. I carried water for a year looking for my son. I can't tell you what clean water means to me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Ha! Don't let the magistrate hear.

quests.title: Tie Shan's Temple
quests.summary: Gu said the Rust Monk was a monk whose temple burned. Old Pan remembers the fire. He remembers the monk.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I remember. Thirty years back. A temple upriver burned in a drought. The monk prayed for rain for forty days. No rain. The village left him.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Last I heard he'd gone to the Abyss to ask the Patriarch for rain instead. I suppose the Patriarch sent rust. That's what the Patriarch does.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He prayed for forty days, and nobody answered.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Aye. That'll turn a man to rust quicker than water.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the watchtower

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the watchtower isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

quests.title: Rust in the Graves
quests.summary: The monk's rust has reached the hill graves, where the old iron grave markers are crumbling into the soil.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The iron grave markers on the hill are crumbling into orange dust. Among them, rust wraiths drift, feeding on the prayers the dead can't finish.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men are recasting the markers at the forge. The forge is rusting too. We're working fast. We're very good at fast now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Rain for a Monk
quests.summary: You have an idea. The monk prayed for rain and got none. What if, before you fight him, somebody gave him rain?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Rain. You want to make it rain? For the monster who's rusting the town? ...That's the strangest plan you've ever had.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He prayed for forty days. Nobody answered. I want to answer. Then I want to fight him.

objectives.text: Call rain over the temple with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your refined soul reaches up into the sky over Qingshi and finds the clouds, and asks. It takes an hour. Then it rains.

objectives.text: Join Magistrate Zhou at the main street

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Rain! Over the temple! Only over the temple! The monk has come out and is standing in it with his face turned up! He's weeping!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Second Rung Kneels
quests.summary: The Second Rung stands in the rain he prayed for thirty years ago. He is weeping, and rusting, and he is still the Patriarch's.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Rust Monk stands in the temple courtyard, face up, rain running down his orange robes. He turns to you, and bows.

objectives.name: Tie Shan, the Rust Monk
objectives.text: Defeat Tie Shan, the Rust Monk

dialogue.speaker: rung_shan
dialogue.text: Rain. You gave me rain. Thirty years too late. Forgive me. My vows are rusted through. I can only do what I was made to do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'll answer that too, monk.

objectives.text: Pray with the Rust Monk as he falls

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tie Shan kneels in the rain. His rust washes away, and underneath there is only an old man, very tired. Thank you, he says. His star goes out.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Two stars out. You gave him rain first. I'm going to be thinking about that for a long time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Rust Monk kneels in the rain and asks to atone rather than die.

choices.text: Accept his penance

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Deliver him to the alliance's court

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Refuse him

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Iron Again
quests.summary: With the monk gone, the rust stops. Qingshi spends a week rebuilding its iron, and complaining happily.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: New spear! Forged by Iron-Fang's men. It's ugly. It's the best spear I've ever had.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Hear what Madam Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: New ladle. Iron. Heavy. I tested it on Iron-Fang's head. Gently. He said it was very good iron. I'm keeping him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.text: Meet Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The scales are fixed. I can weigh things again. I've decided not to. I've got used to trusting people. It's cheaper.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: An Abbess at the Gate
quests.summary: A woman in white climbs the last of the nine thousand steps without breathing hard. She is the Abbess of the Moon-Well.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A nun! An abbess! She climbed the steps without sweating! Nobody climbs the steps without sweating! I'm in love!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: An abbess in white robes stands at the gate, very straight, very calm, with rain-grey eyes that have not slept in days.

objectives.text: Talk with Abbess Jing at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Jing Xuan, abbess of the Moon-Well. My nuns are vanishing into rifts. Eleven, so far. One of them told me you answer when asked.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The girl you freed from the cage at the Abyss rim. Her name is Lian. She sings every morning so she knows she's here.

quests.title: The Sect Master and the Abbess
quests.summary: The Sect Master and the abbess sit in the main hall. They have met once before, forty years ago, and neither of them liked it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Abbess Jing. Forty years ago you called the Azure Cloud 'a sword with a sect attached'.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: And you called the Moon-Well 'a well with opinions'. We were both young and correct. I need your help, Yun Qingyao.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Then you'll have it. The heir walks in the void now. Rifts are nothing to the heir. Literally.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

quests.title: Where Nuns Go
quests.summary: One of the Moon-Well's rifts has opened on the sect's own mountain, in the pavilion. A nun's prayer beads lie beside it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the pavilion, a hairline rift hangs in the air. Beneath it, a string of white prayer beads, and the smell of incense and nothing.

objectives.text: Reach through the rift with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the other side: white robes, drifting in nothing. Eleven nuns, praying in the void, not frozen. Awake. Singing, very faintly.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Singing. They're singing. Lian taught them. So they'd know they're still here. Bring them back. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Walking Into Nothing
quests.summary: To bring the nuns back, you have to walk into the rift, all the way, body and soul. Qing Luan never taught you that part.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The star-gazer taught you to stand on nothing. Walking into it is different. I ran through a rift once. Three hundred years ago.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The trick is to hold on to something on this side. A name. A voice. I held on to my master's. I didn't know I was doing it.

objectives.text: Walk into the rift holding a name

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You step in holding a name: Wei Tong's, for some reason, loud and warm. The nothing closes around you. You follow the singing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You were gone an hour. You came back with eleven nuns and your robe on backwards. What happened in there?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Nothing. Exactly nothing. And some singing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: What Followed the Nuns
quests.summary: Something followed the nuns out of the rift. Several somethings, with hands.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Things followed you out. Of course they did. Things always follow you out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Catch your breath with Abbess Jing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: My nuns are safe. The Moon-Well owes the Azure Cloud a debt. We are very bad at debts. We'll learn.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Medicine for the Nuns
quests.summary: The nuns are cold and dazed from the void. Elder Hua wants warming medicine brewed before they go home.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Void-chill. They're cold in a way fire doesn't touch. Warming herbs, and a lot of them. And tea. Lots of tea.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Gather warming herbs for the nuns

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: They're warming up. One of them asked for a second cup and then apologised for being greedy. Nuns. I've never been so charmed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi's map of the fold's touching places now covers a whole wall of the pagoda. The rifts aren't random.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Look. Every rift, on the map. The isles, the Abyss, the Moon-Well, the town, our pavilion. They're not random.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Study Xiao Shi's map of the rifts

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rifts form a spiral, tightening, and at its centre, the fold. And at seven points around it, seven old red dots: the Rungs.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Rungs anchor the rifts. The rifts feed the fold. Break the rungs, and the rifts close. Xiao Shi, you're a genius. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Abbess Stays a Week
quests.summary: The abbess stays a week, to rest her nuns. She spends most of it arguing theology with the hermit, and winning.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Your hermit says compassion is the blossom of the Heart Sutra. I say compassion is the root. We've been arguing for three days.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: It's the most fun I've had in forty years. Don't tell him.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She's wrong. It's the blossom. She's very clever about being wrong. I'm going to lose, aren't I. I'm going to lose to a nun.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Abbess asks if the Azure Cloud would shelter her nuns for good, against custom.

choices.text: Yes. Custom be damned.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Put it to the elders' council

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Only if the Moon-Well pays

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Rifts on the Mountain
quests.summary: On the abbess's last night, three rifts open at once on the sect's mountain, and things pour out of all of them.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Three rifts! Three! At once! On our mountain! I'm ringing every bell I can find!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Pour your soul into the formation to hold the rifts

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sink your refined soul into the Great Azure Formation. Its blue light spreads over the mountain like a hand closing over a wound.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The void wraiths come on in silence.

objectives.text: Hold the training ground against more celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The formation answered you. The mountain answered you. The Moon-Well will stand with the Azure Cloud. Not for the debt. For that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Void in the Marrow
quests.summary: When the abbess leaves, you sit on the formation plaza where you held the rifts and let the void settle into your marrow.

objectives.text: Refine your soul on the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void you walked through settles into you like cold water into a well. Your soul is deeper, stiller. Middle stage of Spirit Severing.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. The Iron Scale. The Zhao clan. Qingshi. The sects are coming to us now, not the other way round.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The Sect Master says it's because of you. I say it's because you keep saying yes. Stop saying yes. No. Don't.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Hermit Goes Home
quests.summary: The hermit has been teaching in the pagoda for a season. This morning he packed his bag in a hurry. The spring is draining.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The spring. I felt it in my sleep. It's draining. Into nothing. Three hundred years it's been there. I'm going home.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Come with me. Please. I don't know how to fight nothing. You do.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit spring is half gone. At its bottom, a rift swirls like a drain, and the lotus pads are sinking toward it one by one.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Half. Half the spring gone in a night. The lotus is dying. My masters planted that lotus.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Drain
quests.summary: The rift at the spring's bottom is small, and pulling hard. Something on the other side wants the water.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Water spirals down into the rift at the spring's bottom. On the other side, something vast is drinking, very slowly.

objectives.text: Look through the drain with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the other side: the fold. The black fortress, drifting. And a thin stream of spring water, pouring into the altar of blood.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He's drinking the Verdant Lotus spring. Through the fold. Feeding his altar with your family's water.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Wraiths Guard the Drain
quests.summary: The drain is guarded. The Patriarch doesn't want his water cut off.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came! Elder Hua sent soup! It's cold! There are wraiths! Why is there always something?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Clear the spirit spring of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Void wraiths spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The soup survived. I'm very proud of the soup. Eat it. It's cold but it's brave.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Stones for a Dam
quests.summary: The hermit says the Verdant Lotus once dammed the spring to build the shrine. The old dam stones are still in the ruins.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The dam stones. My masters dammed the spring to build the shrine, then unmade it. The stones are in the ruins. Bring them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Gather the old dam stones from the ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins' stone keepers don't want the dam stones moved. They were told to guard them three hundred years ago.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The keepers let you take them. They recognise you now. They used to recognise me. I ran past them. They remember that too.

quests.title: Damming Nothing
quests.summary: You can't dam a rift with stone. But you can dam it with stone and a refined soul, the hermit says. He'll help.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Stones around the rift. Your soul across the gap. My sutra holding it all together. Together. Like my masters did.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Dam the rift with stone and soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Stone, soul, sutra. Root, stem, blossom. The rift pulls. You hold. The hermit sings. The drain slows, stops, and closes like an eye.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It closed. We closed it. Together. Three hundred years ago I ran from this. Today I sang it shut.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: The dam will flood a demonic cultivator's hideout downstream. His family is inside.

choices.text: Warn them first

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Follow the plan exactly

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Let it flood without warning

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Wolves at the Low Water
quests.summary: With the spring low, the forest's wolves have come down to drink the last of it, and some of them are void-touched.

objectives.text: Make your way to the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves crowd the stream below the spring, lapping at the trickle. Some of them have purple mist trailing from their fur.

objectives.text: Break the spirit wolves at the stream

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The spirit wolves have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather void shards from the touched wolves

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Another touching place for my map. The spring. The Patriarch's reaching into everything the Verdant Lotus made.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Spring Refills
quests.summary: Slowly, over a night, the spring refills. The hermit sits at its edge the whole time, and talks to it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I told it about the sect. About the lotus in your pond. About the nun who beat me at theology. It seemed interested.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Springs are good listeners. Better than people. They don't interrupt. They just fill up.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: The lotus pads are rising. The herbs by the stream are greening. It's healing. I came to see. I'm staying to watch.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Other Half
quests.summary: Ye Wuming arrives, drawn by the dam. He has news: the Third Rung is hunting his children.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Third Rung. Jiu Rong. Madam Ninefold. She wants my children back. She was the one who raised them. Trained them. Bled them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ye Wuming stands in the clearing, very still, holding a torn black ribbon. It's River's.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ribbon is torn, not cut. There's powder on it that smells of nine different perfumes. One of them is blood lotus.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She took River. Last night. She left the ribbon so I'd know. She wants me to come to her. She wants you to come with me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Hermit Says Go
quests.summary: The hermit tells you to go with Ye Wuming. The spring is safe, and a child is not.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Go. The spring's safe. I'll sit with it. A child is worth more than a spring. Even a Verdant Lotus spring.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My masters would say so. I say so. Go.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Thank you. I've never had anyone come with me. Not once. Not in forty years of hunting them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Following Nine Perfumes
quests.summary: Madam Ninefold's trail smells of nine perfumes, and they lead toward the river, and the town.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Nine perfumes. Nine faces. She always wears a different one. She'll be in the town. Hiding in plain sight. She loves plain sight.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Qingshi. Again. The town's going to start charging us rent.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The forest path is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Your stance is lazy. Fix it before someone fixes it for you.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Children in the Clearing
quests.summary: Ye Wuming has brought the rest of his children to the clearing, where the hermit's wards are strongest.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Spring, Small Mountain and the others. Here. The hermit's wards are strongest here. She'll come for them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A dozen children in black robes sit in a ring in the clearing, very quiet, very straight. Spring is holding Small Mountain's hand.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've never been afraid before. I've been angry, and cold, and patient. Never afraid. I don't like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then we'll be afraid together, and do something about it.

quests.title: Ninefold's First Face
quests.summary: At dusk a kindly old woman walks into the clearing with a basket of buns for the children. Spring screams.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring screams. The kindly old woman's face slips like a mask, and underneath there's another face, younger, smiling, cold.

objectives.text: Raise the hermit's ward around the children

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ward flares green around the ring of children. The woman's buns hit it and burn. She laughs, and walks backward into the bamboo.

objectives.text: Stop the Ninefold's acolytes at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Guards at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her first face. She'll try all nine. She has patience. So do I. So, apparently, do you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: What the Children Remember
quests.summary: The children tell you what Madam Ninefold was like. They say it very quietly, one sentence each, taking turns.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She sang to us, Spring says. Then she bled us. She told us we were special, River used to say. Small Mountain says nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then, very quietly: she said she was our mother. She said it every day. Some of us believed her.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I believed her. Forty years ago. She told me too. She's the reason I don't have a name. She said I didn't need one. I had her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Buns
quests.summary: The buns the old woman brought are laced with something. Elder Hua would know what. The hermit thinks he does.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sweet bean paste, and under it, a sleeping draught and a thread of blood qi. Eat it, and you'd follow whoever called your name.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One bun has a note baked into it. Come home, River says. Mother misses you. It's in River's handwriting.

objectives.text: Show the hermit what you found

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She made River write it. She's using the children she has to call the children she doesn't. That's very old. That's very cruel.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The old woman who brought the laced buns is only a hired carrier. She's terrified.

choices.text: Let her go home

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give her to the constable

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Use her as bait for Ninefold

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Following River's Letter
quests.summary: The note says where River is. Madam Ninefold wants you to find her. You go anyway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the lookout, a light in the old bandit camp. A child's voice singing, very small. The song Lian taught the nuns.

objectives.text: Defeat the Ninefold's acolytes at the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
