dialogue.text: My men watched the camp all night. The child's alive. Singing. The woman went away and came back with a different face. Three times.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Moon cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: River in the Cage
quests.summary: River is in a cage in the old bandit camp, singing so she knows she's there. Madam Ninefold has left her as bait.

objectives.text: Make your way to the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: River sits in a cage in the middle of the camp, singing. She stops when she sees Ye Wuming, and starts crying instead.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Guards from the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lock breaks. River runs to Ye Wuming. He holds her the way you'd hold something that might break, or might break you.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She's safe. River's safe. She wasn't hurt. Madam Ninefold didn't touch her. She wanted her whole. As bait. For me.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Is Afraid
quests.summary: With River back, Ye Wuming sits apart from everyone, shaking. You sit with him. You don't say anything.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've hunted them for forty years. I've never shaken. Now I can't stop.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She was my mother, she said. She lied. She raised me. Both are true. How do I fight someone who's both?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Together. You don't have to decide what she was. Only what she isn't allowed to do.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: ...What she isn't allowed to do. Yes. I can hold on to that.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

quests.title: Ninefold's Soldiers
quests.summary: Madam Ninefold's acolytes come for the children at midnight, wearing faces the children know.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're wearing faces. People the children knew. Guards, cooks, a teacher. Don't look at the faces. Look at the hands.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Ninefold's acolytes spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Look for Xiao Shi at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know what it's like to see faces from the cages. I'll sit with them. All night. We'll count breaths. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Counting Breaths With Children
quests.summary: Xiao Shi teaches Ye Wuming's children to count breaths. You sit in the circle too. So, eventually, does Ye Wuming.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Four in, four out. A dozen children, Xiao Shi, Ye Wuming and you. By the fortieth breath, Small Mountain is asleep on Ye Wuming's shoulder.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's never slept on anyone. Not once. He sleeps sitting up, with his back to a wall. He's asleep on me.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'm going to find her. Madam Ninefold. In the town. And end this. Not for revenge. So they can sleep.

quests.title: Nine Faces in Qingshi
quests.summary: The hermit's cranes say a woman with too many faces has taken a room at the Drunken Crane, and paid in old coins.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: A woman with nine faces at the inn. She paid in old coins, and she's been asking about the children. She's waiting.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She wants you to come to her. Everyone always wants you to come to them. We'll come. On our terms.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path to the ruined shrine is longer than you remember. The view is worth it.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the ruined shrine

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Room at the Inn
quests.summary: Madam Fang shows you the room the nine-faced woman rented. It's empty. There's a mirror on every wall.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: She paid for a week. She's been out every day. She never came back to the room. Just left the mirrors. Nine of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine mirrors on nine walls. In each one, your reflection is slightly different. In the ninth, it's smiling.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the main street

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her mirrors. She practises faces in them. She's somewhere in the town wearing one of them. We have to look at everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Looking Twice
quests.summary: Widow Liu is good at looking twice. She's been doing it for years.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: I look at every face twice. I did it for a year, looking for my son. There's a new woman at the market who looks back too quickly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: New passenger on my ferry, three days running. Paid in old coins. Never looked at the water. The Blood Moon ones never do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.text: Hear what Constable Du has to say

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: New cook at the yamen. Very good cook. Came with no references. The magistrate hired her because her dumplings were perfect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Three Suspects
quests.summary: Three strangers: a market woman, a ferry passenger and the yamen's new cook. One is Madam Ninefold. Maybe all three.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The market woman sells embroidered ribbons, black ones, exactly like River's. She sees you and smiles too quickly.

objectives.text: Examine the black ribbons at her stall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Each ribbon smells of a different perfume. Nine perfumes. Nine ribbons. And a tenth, blood lotus, tucked under the counter.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Her. Or one of her. She leaves parts of herself in every face. The ribbons are a message. She wants me to know she's close.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the three suspects must be Madam Ninefold. Arresting all three would be safest.

choices.text: Investigate until you're sure

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

choices.text: Arrest all three

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

choices.text: Threaten them until one breaks

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Faces Come Off
quests.summary: When you approach the ribbon stall, the market woman is gone, and nine people in the square pull off their faces.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Nine people just pulled their faces off! That's not a sentence I ever wanted to say!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Break the faceless acolytes at the market square

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The faceless acolytes come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find Magistrate Zhou after the fight

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: The yamen cook! The cook was one of them! Her dumplings were so good! I'm devastated on several levels!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Ferry Passenger
quests.summary: Old Pan's passenger is on the ferry right now, halfway across the river, not looking at the water.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: He's on my ferry! Middle of the river! Not looking at the water! I'll turn it round! Get to the docks!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ferry swings back to the dock. A passenger in grey stands very still, not looking at the water. He smiles. It's a woman's smile.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Void wraiths ahead! Don't let them surround us!

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. First time I've carried a monster. First time I've thrown one in. Didn't come up. They never do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Nine Faces at the Well
quests.summary: Madam Ninefold's last trick: she wears Widow Liu's face and walks to the well at dawn, where everyone gathers.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: There's a woman at the well wearing my face! My face! And she's drawing water with my bucket! How dare she!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Seal the well before she poisons it

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your seal flares over the well just as the false widow tips a vial into the water. The vial shatters on the seal instead.

objectives.text: Defeat the faceless acolytes at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Faceless acolytes! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Hold the back alley against more Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Nobody wears my face. Nobody. I've spent too long making it look this tired.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Finds Her
quests.summary: Ye Wuming doesn't look for faces. He looks for the thing that never changes: the way she held him when he was six.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Faces change. Hands don't. She always held your wrist, not your hand. So you couldn't let go. I remember.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: There's a woman in the market square holding a child's wrist. The child is crying. The woman is smiling. It's her.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Order! Ah. It's already orderly. Carry on.

objectives.text: Talk with Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Mind the crates. The stamps are imported.

quests.title: Jiu Rong, Madam Ninefold
quests.summary: In the market square, holding a stranger's child by the wrist, the Third Rung turns, and all nine faces smile at once.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The woman lets go of the child's wrist. Her face flickers through nine others, then settles on one: young, beautiful, and cold as a well.

objectives.name: Jiu Rong, Madam Ninefold
objectives.text: Face Jiu Rong, Madam Ninefold at the market square

dialogue.speaker: rung_rong
dialogue.text: Wuming. My little nameless. You brought a friend. How lovely. Come home. Mother misses you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You're not my mother. My mother was Ye Qing. You're what took me from her.

dialogue.speaker: rung_rong
dialogue.text: Fold, and fold, and fold again. Which face shall I die in? You choose, heir. I'll wear it for you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Madam Ninefold falls, and her faces fall away one by one, until the last one underneath is only an old, tired woman. Her star goes out.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming at the main street

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Three stars out. She's gone. The children can sleep. I can... I don't know what I can do. I've never been without her to hunt.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's followers throw down their weapons and kneel.

choices.text: Let them go home

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Bring them to face the sect's judgement

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Make an example of them

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Stillness After
quests.summary: You sit in the town temple after Madam Ninefold falls, and let your soul refine in the stillness she left behind.

objectives.text: Refine your soul in the temple's stillness

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three stars out, four left. The void in you is quiet and deep as a well at night. Late stage of Spirit Severing.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the main street

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The children want to meet you. All of them. River wants to sing you the song. Spring wants to give you a bun. Don't eat the bun.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: A Bun From Spring
quests.summary: Spring gives you a bun. It's slightly squashed and entirely safe. Ye Wuming watches you eat it, and almost smiles.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: She made it herself. With Madam Fang. It's the first thing she's ever made that wasn't a weapon.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Thank you. For coming with me. For the rain you gave the monk. For looking into the fold for my name. For all of it.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: That child has flour everywhere. My kitchen looks like a snowstorm. I've never been happier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Map on the Ceiling
quests.summary: Xiao Shi's map has spread to the pagoda ceiling. Elder Bai is lying on the floor looking at it, very happy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Look at it! A map of nothing! On my ceiling! I'm lying on the floor like a student! I haven't been this happy in years!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pagoda's fourth floor is covered in ink: walls, shelves, ceiling. A spiral of rifts, and at seven points, red marks. Three crossed out.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Four red marks left. Four Rungs. The map shows where they touch the world. It doesn't show where they are. Not yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Shards for the Ceiling
quests.summary: To finish the map, Xiao Shi needs a void shard from every rift that's opened on the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: One shard from every rift. On the mountain. There are nine. I've marked them. Elder Bai says I'm not allowed on the roof.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Collect void shards from the mountain's rifts
Drive the void wraiths from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Some of the rifts are still open, and still hungry. Wraiths drift out, curious about the person stealing their shards.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Nine shards. The map's nearly done. I'm going to sleep for a day. Then map the ceiling of the ceiling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: The void shards came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: The Spiral's Centre
quests.summary: With every shard placed, the map shows something new: the rifts spiral toward the fold, and the fold spirals toward the sky.

objectives.text: Place the last shard on the map

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last shard clicks into place. The ink spiral glows faintly. At its centre, the fold. From the fold, a thin line going straight up.

objectives.text: Make your way to the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The line points at the Sky Isles. At the tribulation peak. At the place where heaven's lightning falls.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The fold leads up. He's not just hiding. He's aiming. At the peak. At the lightning. At your lightning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Everyone Looks at the Ceiling
quests.summary: The whole sect comes to look at the ceiling. Most of them don't understand it. All of them understand the line going up.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A line from the fold to the tribulation peak. He's waiting for your tribulation, like Gu said. Now we know where.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I don't understand the map. But I understand the line. It points at you. I don't like it. I'm going to stand near you more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: My brother drew that. My brother. Who counted bars for a year. He drew a map that can see the sky. I'm going to cry on the floor.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Reading Nothing
quests.summary: The hermit teaches you to read the map with your soul: not the ink, the nothing between the lines.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Don't read the ink. Read the nothing between. The void shows its shape in what isn't there. Sit. Look at the gaps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Read the map's gaps with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the gaps between the lines, four faint red threads. Two point to Qingshi and the bamboo, one far to the east, one straight down, into the Abyss.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Four threads! East! That's beyond the Iron Scale's lands. Nobody goes east. There's nothing east. Nothing. Oh. Nothing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Map Has Visitors
quests.summary: The finished map glows at night, and the glow draws things. Things that don't want to be mapped.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The pagoda's glowing! And there are shapes climbing it! Nine of them! No, ten! I'm ringing the bell! I'm ringing all the bells!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Clear the scripture pagoda of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Void wraiths spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths
Catch your breath with Elder Bai

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: They wanted to erase the map. On my ceiling. In my pagoda. I'm going to sleep here now. With a sword. I don't know how to use a sword.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: A Letter From the East
quests.summary: A letter arrives from the Iron Scale, from Ruan Jingtao, in a shaking hand: rifts in the east are eating their lands.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A letter from the Iron Scale! Ruan Jingtao! The handwriting's awful! Worse than usual! He must be scared!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rifts in the east. Villages vanishing. The Iron Scale's southern peak is gone. Gone. Into nothing.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Ruan Hai asks for the heir. Personally. He says: we stood with you at the banners. Stand with us now.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Supplies for the East
quests.summary: The Iron Scale needs medicine, food and void shards for wards. The whole sect helps pack.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Word of your conduct travels. All of it good. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Medicine for a sect I used to glare at across a duel. Pack it all. The Iron Scale needs it more than our grudges do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Pack medicine for the Iron Scale

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Supplies for the Iron Scale. At our cost. I've costed it. It's a lot. I don't care. Don't tell anyone I don't care.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Iron Scale needs supplies, but your sect's winter stores are thin.

choices.text: Send them half our stores

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Send what the elders approved

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Send nothing. Charity starts at home.

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Wei Tong's New Disciples Help
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve new disciples insist on helping load the carts. They also insist on a demonstration first.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My twelve want a demonstration before you go east. Spirit Severing. They want to see you walk on nothing. Show-off. Please show off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Give Wei Tong's disciples a demonstration

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You walked on nothing and hit a puppet from above. Qiu Hua fainted. The chicken did not. The chicken has seen everything now.

quests.title: East
quests.summary: At dawn, the cart for the Iron Scale leaves the sect gate. You walk beside it. Xiao Shi's map is rolled up in your pack.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The map, copied small. So you can find the rifts. I drew the gaps too. Read the gaps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: East, to the Iron Scale. Through the bamboo. The Iron Scale's border starts at the forest's far edge. We'll meet Ruan there.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Border Melts
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao meets you at the forest's far edge. Behind him, the hills are fading into purple nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest's far edge ends in fog, and the fog ends in nothing. Where the Iron Scale's hills should be, there's only a purple haze.

objectives.text: Meet Ruan Jingtao at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: You came. My father said you would. I said nobody comes when it's this bad. I was wrong. I've been wrong about you a lot.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The southern peak is gone. Three hundred disciples got out. Forty didn't. Something is walking out of where it was.

quests.title: Disciples Lost in Nothing
quests.summary: Some of the forty came back. They are wrong now, lost in nothing, and they don't know their own sect.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Those are ours. The ones who didn't get out. They came back like this. They don't know us. Don't kill them. Please.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're asleep. Not dead. Asleep. You did something with your soul. The purple left them. They're ours again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Ruan Hai's Grief
quests.summary: Ruan Hai, master of the Iron Scale, has aged ten years in a month. He lost a peak, and forty children, and he blames himself.

objectives.text: Go and see Sect Master Ruan

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Forty. Forty children, on my southern peak. I built that peak. I chose who trained there. I sent them there.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Is this what your Gu Hanshan felt? Every day? No wonder he broke.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Some of them are coming back, Sect Master Ruan. The void holds them. It doesn't eat them. We're bringing them home.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Some. Then some is what I'll hold on to.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: We're done at the lookout rock. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.text: Find Ruan Jingtao at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale does not apologise. It... reconsiders.

quests.title: The Giant's Footprints
quests.summary: Something enormous has walked out of the southern peak's nothing. It leaves footprints that fill with purple fog.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the lookout, you see footprints the size of ponds crossing the forest, each one filling with purple fog.

objectives.text: Break the hollow stone at the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Where the footprints cross the grove, hollow stone things crawl out of the fog, broken pieces of a mountain that's gone.

objectives.text: Gather shards from the hollow stone
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Pieces of the southern peak. Walking around. Hollow. The giant's made of the peak. It's made of their mountain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The Rung Beneath the Giant
quests.summary: In soul sight, the giant is tied to something: a thread, red, going east. A Rung is steering it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The giant stands at the edge of the clearing, a mountain on legs, hollow, purple fog pouring from every crack.

objectives.text: Trace the giant's red thread with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A red thread from the giant's back, running east, far beyond the forest. At its end, faint, someone hollow, holding the thread and smiling.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow. Kong Yi. The Fourth Rung. He steers things that are empty. He's steering a mountain. He's showing off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Filling the Hollow
quests.summary: The hermit's lesson from the spring: you can't dam nothing with stone. But you can fill hollowness with something.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The giant's hollow. Empty. That's what the Rung steers. What if it wasn't empty?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then he couldn't steer it.

objectives.text: Prepare your soul to fill the hollow giant

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You gather your soul like breath before a shout. Everything the Iron Scale remembers about their peak: training, laughter, names. You hold it.

objectives.text: Join Ruan Jingtao at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father's telling me stories about the southern peak. All of them. He says you asked. He's been crying for an hour. Good crying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Hollow Giant
quests.summary: The Iron Scale's southern peak, hollowed out and walking, steered by a Rung from far away. It is a mountain. It does not stop.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Hollow Giant steps into the clearing. The ground shakes. Purple fog pours from its chest where the peak's heart used to be.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Together! Iron Scale and Azure Cloud! For the southern peak! Fill it with everything!

objectives.text: Pour the Iron Scale's memories into the giant

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The giant stops. Its hollow chest fills with light: laughter, drills, names. It kneels, and settles, and becomes a hill again.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: A hill. In your forest. Made of my southern peak. The Iron Scale will visit it. Every year. We'll call it Remembering Hill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's hoard holds spirit stones stolen from Qingshi.

choices.text: Return every stone to Qingshi

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Give it all to the sect treasury

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep a share for yourself

reply.speaker: master_ruan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Bringing the Forty Home
quests.summary: With the giant stilled, the rifts on the Iron Scale's border shrink, and some of the forty come walking out of the fog.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're walking out. Some of them. Out of the fog. Nineteen. Nineteen of forty. Help me bring them in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Guide the lost disciples out of the fog

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Nineteen. The rest are still in there, frozen. We'll get them out. When the fold opens. Like Iron-Fang's family.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale will march with you when it opens. All of us. Not for debts. For them.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ruan Hai offers you the Iron Scale's sacred manual in thanks.

choices.text: Decline it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Accept it formally, for the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Accept it for yourself

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

quests.title: The Iron Scale Remembers
quests.summary: Ruan Hai makes a speech on Remembering Hill. It's short. The Iron Scale doesn't do long speeches.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale remembers. Our peak. Our lost. And the Azure Cloud, who came when asked. That's all. That's the speech.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Hear what Yan Tie has to say

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came east too. We shouted the whole way. It helped nobody. It felt wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The Fourth Rung's thread went east. Toward nothing. He'll steer something else soon. Something with a body. That's what he wants. Bodies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Brother Hollow's Taste
quests.summary: Ye Wuming says what Kong Yi, Brother Hollow, wants most: bodies to live in. Han Xue goes pale.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow. He lives in empty things. Mountains. Puppets. People who've given up. He wants a body. A good one.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A body heaven can't refuse. That's what the Patriarch wants. Brother Hollow would be the one to... fit it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We're going home. Now. And you're going to learn to make your body impossible to borrow. Whatever that takes.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wolf den gapes in the rock. Old bones, older claw marks, and a smell that makes the neck prickle.

objectives.text: Talk with Ruan Jingtao at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the wolf den isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Stitch
quests.summary: Qing Luan wants the last rift on the isles stitched shut before they close again. It's the one on the cloud gate.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A single rift hangs in the cloud gate's arch like a torn curtain. Through it, the tribulation peak, faint and far.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: One last stitch. The cloud gate. Then the isles close properly, and I get some peace, and you get a body.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A body. I mean the next stage. Sorry. I've been alone too long. I say things strangely.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Silk From the Pines
quests.summary: The last stitch needs the best cloud silk, from the highest pines on the Isle of Winds.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The highest pines. The best silk. The wind there is rude, even to guests. Be polite back. It confuses it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Gather silk from the highest pines
Stop the storm wolves at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves nest in the highest pines, and they don't want to share their silk.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I was polite to the wind. It pushed me off a branch. Politely. I've learned nothing today. It's been lovely.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Stitching the Gate
quests.summary: You stitch the last rift closed with silk and soul, standing on the nothing inside it.

objectives.text: Stitch the cloud gate's rift closed

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You stand inside the rift, on nothing, and stitch it shut around you, and step out as the last stitch pulls tight.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You stitched yourself in and out of a rift. Nobody's done that. I'm going to put it in my chart. It deserves a star.

quests.title: The Tribulation Peak
quests.summary: Qing Luan takes you to where you can see the tribulation peak, and the black rings where cultivators were answered.

objectives.text: Make your way to the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Across the gap, the tribulation peak: a summit altar scorched black in rings. Each ring is someone who stood there and was answered.

objectives.text: Read the star chart of the peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chart shows the peak, and above it, four red stars still bright. Three dark. And a thin line from the Abyss, rising toward the summit.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's where your lightning will come. And that's where he'll be waiting. Not yet. Years yet. But that's where.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Qing Luan offers to show you the Patriarch's path through the peak: a secret of her order.

choices.text: Refuse. Keep her oath intact.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Accept. It may save lives.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Insist. You're owed it.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: What Comes After the Void
quests.summary: Qing Luan tells you what the next stage is. Void Refinement. She says it's the part most cultivators hate.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Void Refinement. The void between soul and body, refined away. They become one thing. Can't be separated. Can't be borrowed. Can't be worn.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It hurts. Every bone remembers everything that ever hurt it. Most cultivators stop there. You won't. You're very stubborn.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Can't be worn. That's the answer. To Brother Hollow. To the Patriarch. Make the body impossible to borrow.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It hurts? Good. I'll hold your hand. Don't tell anyone.

quests.title: The Isles' Last Visitors
quests.summary: As the isles begin to close, the last void wraiths try to slip through before the stitches hold.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Last visitors. Trying to get out before the door shuts. I know the feeling. I'm not letting them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Cut down the celestial sentinels that follow

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's the last of them. The isles are closing. Properly. For a while. You'll be back. Everyone comes back to me eventually.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: A Face Remembered
quests.summary: Before you go, Qing Luan tells you she remembered her face. Han Xue's description helped.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I remembered my face. A star on my forehead, and a frown at everyone like they've disappointed a constellation. The sword girl was right.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Tell her thank you. Tell her I'm frowning at her fondly.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tell her I'm frowning back. Fondly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Four Red Stars
quests.summary: One last look at the chart before the isles close: four red stars left, and one of them has started to move.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One of the four red stars is sliding across the chart, slowly, toward the mountain where the Azure Cloud sits. Brother Hollow's star.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside it, very faint, a fifth line is drawn in red: a cleaver. The Fifth Rung, the Butcher, is following him.

objectives.text: Tell Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They're moving toward your mountain. Toward you. Go home, lotus child. And become impossible to borrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Still Water, Empty Sky
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, with the isles closing around you, you let your spirit severing reach its Great Perfection.

objectives.text: Bring your spirit severing to perfection

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Still water. Empty sky. Your soul is as deep as the void and as calm. Great Perfection of Spirit Severing. Next, the body. Next, the pain.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I came up to bring you home. The isles are closing. Brother Hollow is coming to us. We'll be ready. You'll be ready.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hua has prepared the tempering baths. She says they'll hurt. She says it cheerfully. That woman frightens me.

quests.title: Down the Cloud Road
quests.summary: The cloud road dissolves behind you for the last time in years. Below, your mountain, and somewhere on it, the Great Azure Formation, glowing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cloud road dissolves behind you. Above, the isles fade into sky. Below, the formation glows blue, steady, patient.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Home. Void Refinement next. It hurts, the star-gazer says. I'll complain for you. It's the least I can do. It's the most I can do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Puppets Walk
quests.summary: Wei Tong wakes you at midnight. The training puppets are standing up by themselves and walking toward the dormitories.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The puppets are walking! By themselves! Toward the dormitories! My twelve are in there! Come on!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The training ground is empty. A trail of wooden footprints leads toward the dormitories, and every step leaves a curl of purple mist.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Hollowed. Something's inside them. Something that likes empty things. Brother Hollow. Ye Wuming warned us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Hollow Wood
quests.summary: The hollowed puppets reach the dormitories. Wei Tong's twelve new disciples are awake, and very brave, and very small.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Twelve disciples, twelve puppets! Nobody fights alone! Lead with your feet, not your elbows!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Drive the hollowed puppets from the training ground

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The hollowed puppets have found you first.

objectives.text: Look for Liu Er at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I fought one! With a broom! Qiu Hua fought one with a chicken! The chicken won! Is it always like this here?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: What Was Inside
quests.summary: In the broken puppets you find what hollowed them: a thread of purple nothing, still twitching, leading east.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In each broken puppet, a thread of purple nothing twitches like a severed nerve, all pointing east.

objectives.text: Follow the threads with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: East, far, a hollow man sitting cross-legged in a hollow tree, his eyes closed, smiling. He opens his eyes. He waves.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He waved. Everyone in the Ladder waves at you. It's the most irritating thing about them, and there's a lot of competition.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The purple thread is still twitching. Elder Hua wants it studied; Han Xue wants it burned.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Seal it for Elder Hua

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep a piece, secretly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Elder Hua's Baths
quests.summary: Elder Hua has been preparing the tempering baths for a month. She describes them with terrifying cheerfulness.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Tempering baths. Nine herbs, three minerals, thunder water and one very rare lizard. You'll soak for nine days. It'll hurt. Every bone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: When it's done, your body and soul will be one thing. Nobody will be able to wear you. Isn't that wonderful? It's going to be awful.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Man at the lotus pond

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I've been gathering the herbs for a month. I only dropped the lizard twice. It's fine. It's a very forgiving lizard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Man asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Thunder Water
quests.summary: The baths need thunder water: rain that fell during a lightning strike, caught at the cliff edge.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Thunder water. Rain from a lightning storm, caught at the cliff. There's a storm tonight. Stand out in it. With buckets.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Catch thunder water at the cliff edge
Join Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You stood on the cliff in a thunderstorm with buckets. Thunder Peak is so jealous. We've been trying to do that for years. The buckets always melt.

quests.title: The First Day
quests.summary: The first day in the tempering bath. It is exactly as bad as Elder Hua promised.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: In you go. Don't scream on the first day. Save it for the fourth. The fourth is the worst. Then it gets worse again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Endure the first day of tempering

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bath is cold, then hot, then neither. Every bone in your body remembers every blow it ever took, all at once, very loudly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You didn't scream. Hmph. Mo would have said adequate. I'll say it for him. Adequate. Eight more days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Hollow Men at the Wall
quests.summary: On the fourth day, while you soak, Brother Hollow's hollowed things come for you. The sect has to hold without you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Hollowed guardians at the wall! Coming for you! In the bath! We're not letting a hollow man see you in the bath!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Through the pain, you raise a ward over the bath. Outside, you hear your friends fighting, and it's the best sound in the world.

objectives.text: Clear the outer pines of hollowed guardians

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These hollowed guardians fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Hold the sect gate against more hollowed puppets

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Held. All of them. Han Xue broke three by herself. She says it was two. It was three. I counted. I always count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Worst Day
quests.summary: The fourth day is the worst. Han Xue sits beside the bath and doesn't say anything. It helps.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'm not going to say anything. I'm just going to sit here. That's all. Don't talk. Breathe. In for four.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...You're doing well. That's all. I said I wouldn't talk. I'm bad at promises today.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Nine days. On the ninth, walk to the cliff edge in the storm. Hua says the lightning finishes what the bath starts.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'll be there. The whole sect will be there. We'll stand in the rain like idiots. For you.

quests.title: Brother Hollow Writes
quests.summary: On the eighth day a letter arrives, written in a hand that looks like it was borrowed. It is from Brother Hollow.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Dear heir. Your body is a house. I am looking to rent. Soon, I think. When you're tired. Everyone gets tired. Kong Yi, the Fourth Rung.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The paper crumbles as you finish it, hollow inside, like everything he touches.

objectives.text: Show Lu Ping what you found

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A hollow man wrote you a letter? About renting you? I'm going to burn the gate. No. I'm going to guard the gate. Harder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Void Refinement
quests.summary: On the ninth day, you walk from the bath to the cliff edge in a thunderstorm. The whole sect stands in the rain to watch.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Ninth day. Walk to the cliff. Let the lightning in. It will finish what the bath started. It will also hurt. Last time, I promise.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Plant thunder crystals on the cliff
Refine the void between body and soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lightning comes down and doesn't stop at your skin. It runs through bone and soul alike and finds no seam between them, because there isn't one.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You are one thing now. Body, soul, qi, all one. Nothing could wear you. Nothing could fit.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Void Refinement

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spiral turns the colour of a bruise. Lightning walks inside it, looking for the gap between body and soul.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Void Refinement. The whole sect in the rain, cheering. Wei Tong is crying. I'm crying. It's the rain. Welcome back.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Let the hollow man come now. There's no room in you for anyone but you.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Invitation
quests.summary: Yan Tie invites you to the Thunder Peak forge. He's been waiting years to ask. He asks very loudly.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's lightning forge! We temper swords there! Once a generation, we temper a person! It's your turn! Say yes! Loudly!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's disciples line the path up to their summit, shouting encouragement at nothing in particular.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The forge is at the top of the peak, where the lightning lands. Thunder wolves live there. They like the lightning too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Wolves of the Peak
quests.summary: The thunder wolves that live around the forge are not void-touched. They're just very big and very fond of lightning.

objectives.text: Make your way to the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wolves with sparks in their fur lounge around the forge path, sunbathing in a thunderstorm.

objectives.text: Fight off the peak thunder wolves

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Don't kill them! They're Thunder Peak's wolves! Just convince them to move! Thunder Peak convinces loudly!

objectives.text: Gather the sparks the wolves shed
Talk it over with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Convinced. They'll come back tomorrow. They always come back. We named the big one Rumble. He's a very good boy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Lightning Forge
quests.summary: The forge is a ring of star-iron anvils around a pillar of black glass, where lightning has struck for a thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A ring of star-iron anvils surrounds a pillar of black glass. The air smells of rain and burnt metal. Your hair stands on end.

objectives.text: Lay your hand on the lightning forge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The glass pillar hums. Your integrated body hums back. Somewhere above, the storm notices, and begins to gather.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: It noticed you. The forge never notices anyone. It noticed me once, when I was twelve. I fell off. You didn't fall off.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Tempered Like a Sword
quests.summary: Thunder Peak's secret: an integrated body can be struck by lightning on purpose, and it gets stronger each time.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stand on the forge. Let it hit you. Integrated bodies don't break. They get denser. Like steel. Very painful steel.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Temper your body on the lightning forge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lightning hits you. It doesn't hurt the way the bath hurt. It hurts the way a hammer hurts iron: usefully.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Eleven strikes! The record's nine! Thunder Peak's going to carve your name on the forge! We don't carve names! We'll start!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Forge's Old Guardians
quests.summary: The forge has guardians older than Thunder Peak. They wake when the record is broken, to see who broke it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The forge guardians are awake! Nobody told me the forge had guardians! Nobody tells me anything about Thunder Peak!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Break the forge guardians at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: More forge guardians? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of forge guardians
Find Yan Tie after the fight

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: They only wake when the record's broken! They've been asleep for three hundred years! You broke a three-hundred-year sleep!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: What Thunder Peak Shouts
quests.summary: Thunder Peak holds a feast for the record-breaker. The feast is very loud. Yan Tie tells you why Thunder Peak shouts.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Why do we shout? Because the first master of Thunder Peak was deaf. He shouted so he could feel his voice. We shout so he'd hear us.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Also it's fun. Mostly it's fun. But it started with him.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came for the feast. Thunder Peak's food is terrible. Loud, but terrible. I brought dumplings. I'm a hero here now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: Thunder Peak's forge-masters offer a banned tempering. Faster, and more dangerous.

choices.text: Refuse

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Accept, but only on yourself

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Accept, and have the juniors test it first

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: An Integrated Spar
quests.summary: Han Xue wants to test your new body. She has been waiting for a fair fight for years. This one still isn't fair.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Spar. You and me. Your new body against my old sword. It won't be fair. I don't care. I want to see.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Spar with Han Xue's Frost Sword disciples first

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You didn't even move your feet. My disciples bounced off you. This isn't the sparring match you owe me. That one I'll win.

quests.title: Star Iron for a Blade
quests.summary: Your ugly practice blade from Elder Mo cracked on the forge. Thunder Peak offers to reforge it with star iron.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Elder Mo's blade cracked. Thunder Peak can fix it. Star iron from the forge anvils. Elder Mo would want it fixed, not replaced.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Gather star iron from the old anvils

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Reforged. Still ugly. Stronger. We didn't change a thing about how it looks. We didn't dare. He'd haunt us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Hollow Wolves
quests.summary: Brother Hollow tries again: he slips into the thunder wolves while they sleep, and sends them against the forge.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Rumble! Rumble's eyes are purple! The hollow man's in the wolves! In my good boy! Get him out!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises over the forge. The lightning in it answers yours. The hollowed wolves hit the ward and yelp.

objectives.text: Stop the peak thunder wolves at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Finish the peak thunder wolves at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Rumble's eyes are yellow again. He licked my face. Brother Hollow's gone from him. Thunder Peak will never forgive that hollow man.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: East Again
quests.summary: A crane from Constable Du: people in Qingshi are going hollow. Not puppets. People. The ones who've given up.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Constable Du writes: people in Qingshi are going hollow. Sitting in doorways, eyes purple, smiling. The ones who've lost hope.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Go. You're the one body on this mountain he can't enter. Take Liu Er. It's his town.

objectives.text: Talk with Liu Er at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: My town? People are going hollow in my town? I'm packing. I'm packing now. I'm packing a broom.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Liu Er quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Purple Eyes in Doorways
quests.summary: Qingshi's main street is quiet. In a dozen doorways, people sit smiling with purple eyes, doing nothing at all.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In a dozen doorways, townsfolk sit very still, smiling, eyes purple. A child tugs at her father's sleeve. He doesn't move.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Eleven so far. The ones who'd given up. The man who lost his farm. The woman whose son died in the siege. Now they just sit.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They're not dead. They're not asleep. They're... rented out.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Liu Er Comes Home
quests.summary: Liu Er comes home in blue robes and finds his mother standing guard over the neighbours with a bucket.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: My son! In blue robes! No, don't hug me, I'm guarding the Chens. They're hollow. I throw water on them. It doesn't help. It makes me feel better.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother, I'm a cultivator now. Sort of. A small one. I brought a broom.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: A broom. My son climbs nine thousand steps and comes back with a broom. I've never been so proud.

objectives.text: Join Liu Er at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I can swim across the river and back. Twice, if nobody's counting.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Keep your sword sheathed in town, cultivator. Mostly.

quests.title: What Hollow Looks Like
quests.summary: You look at a hollow townsman with soul sight. There's almost nothing left inside. Just a thread, and someone holding it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Chen sits in his doorway, smiling. In soul sight he is nearly empty: a flicker of self, and a purple thread running east.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Deep inside, very small, Old Chen is still there. He's sitting in a corner of himself, very tired, waiting for someone to say he matters.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're still in there. Hiding in the corners. Brother Hollow moved in because they moved out. Make them want to come back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Reasons to Come Back
quests.summary: You sit with Old Chen and tell him why he matters. Not grand reasons. Small ones. His neighbours help.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Tell him about the plums. He grows the best plums on the street. Every summer, he gives the children the ripe ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Remind Old Chen why he matters

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Plums. The children. The way he whistles. Slowly, the purple fades from his eyes, and Old Chen looks at you, and asks why everyone's crying.

objectives.text: Hear what Liu Er has to say

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: It works! You have to remind them! We can do that! I can do that! I know everyone on this street!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Chen's son wants the hollowed kept locked up until they are cured.

choices.text: Refuse. They heal among neighbours.

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Agree, as the magistrate ordered

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Lock them up, and charge their families

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Plums and Reasons
quests.summary: Liu Er organises the town: everyone brings something that reminds a hollow neighbour they matter.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Everyone bring one thing! Something that reminds them! Plums for Old Chen! Ribbons for Mei's mother! Anything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Meet Madam Fang at the main street

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Eleven hollow people, and the whole town carrying plums and ribbons and old songs. I've never seen Qingshi like this.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Brother Hollow Pushes Back
quests.summary: When his tenants start leaving, Brother Hollow sends his shades to keep them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shades! Pouring out of the alley! Coming for the ones who woke up! Iron-Fang's men, form a line! With brooms!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Defeat the hollow shades at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The hollow shades spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Cut down the hollow shades that follow

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Brooms. We fought shades with brooms. Liu Er's idea. My men have never been so embarrassed or so effective.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Last Hollow
quests.summary: The last hollow person in Qingshi is the one nobody expected: Magistrate Zhou.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The magistrate. The last one. He's sitting in the yamen, smiling, purple. He gave up, and none of us noticed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Magistrate Zhou. Your speech at the tide. One word. Hold. The whole town held because you said it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: ...Hold. I said hold. I did, didn't I. The town held. I held. ...Why am I sitting in the dark? Somebody light a lamp.

quests.title: The Thread East
quests.summary: With the last tenant evicted, all of Brother Hollow's threads in Qingshi pull back east at once. You feel which way.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven purple threads snap back east at once, like fishing lines reeled in. In soul sight they all end in the same place.

objectives.text: Follow the snapped threads with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: East, then south. Not beyond the Iron Scale. The Abyss. The blood pools. He's hiding where the body-tempering water is.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The blood pools. Where you'd go to temper your body further. He knows. He's waiting where you'd go next. He's clever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Plum Wine for the Returned
quests.summary: Qingshi throws a small feast for the eleven who came back. Old Chen brings last summer's plum wine.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously) W-what can I do for you, immortal? Anything. Anything at all.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Old Chen's plum wine! He's been saving it for a wedding. He says this is better than a wedding. I'm paying for the noodles. Don't argue.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Gather plums from Old Chen's trees
Pour the plum wine at the Drunken Crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven people who came back, and the whole street around them, drinking plum wine. Old Chen whistles. The children cheer.

objectives.text: Find Old Pan at the main street

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years in this town. Never seen it hold together like this. You did that. The boy with the broom did that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Liu Er Stays a Night
quests.summary: Liu Er asks to stay one night in Qingshi before going back up the mountain. His mother has made eleven meals.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: One night. Mother made eleven meals. She's still counting in elevens. I'll be back at the sect tomorrow. Wei Tong will understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Join Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: He reminded eleven people they mattered. He reminded me too. Take care of him up there. He's very small in those big robes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Warning
quests.summary: Ye Wuming meets you at the rim, grim. The Fourth Rung has been seen at the pools, wearing someone.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rim is quiet. Ye Wuming waits at the canyon mouth, arms folded, and his children are nowhere to be seen.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I sent the children away. Brother Hollow's at the pools. He's wearing someone. A Blood Guard captain, big and strong and empty.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He can't wear you now. So he wants you to watch him wear someone else. He wants you to feel sorry for them.

quests.title: Hollow Guards
quests.summary: The Blood Guards at the pools are all hollowed, and they move together like fingers on one hand.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They all move at once. Like a puppet show. One puppeteer. I hate puppet shows. I've always hated puppet shows.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Guards from the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

objectives.text: Catch your breath with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's testing how many he can hold at once. Twelve. He's getting stronger. Every body he fills, he learns.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

quests.title: Tempering in the Pools
quests.summary: Between fights you temper your body in the purified blood pools, the way Elder Hua told you. It hurts differently.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Hua said the purified pools finish what the bath and the forge start. I'll watch the rim. Temper. Don't argue.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Temper your body in the purified pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The pool water is warm and clean now, pink as dawn. It sinks into your integrated body and finds the last seams, and seals them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You glow. Pink. It's very undignified. It's also, I'm told, how cultivators look before a stage breaks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Captain He Wears
quests.summary: At the obelisk ring, a Blood Guard captain stands alone, smiling. His eyes are purple. His voice isn't his.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A Blood Guard captain, huge, scarred, smiling with a stranger's smile. His voice, when it comes, is soft and hollow.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Inside, in a corner, the captain is still there: a boy taken from a village, forty years ago, who never stopped wanting to go home.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I knew him. Forty years ago. We were in the cages together. His name was Tan. He cried every night for his mother.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Get Brother Hollow out of him. Please. Tan deserves to go home. Even now. Especially now.

objectives.choice_prompt: Brother Hollow wears Tan's body. Tan may still be in there, somewhere.

choices.text: Try to save Tan

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: End it cleanly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: No argument here.

choices.text: Leave Tan hollow, as a lure

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Gu Knew Tan
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, has come to the rim. He knew the captain too. He brought him to the Abyss.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tan. I brought him. Forty years ago, as a boy. I thought I was saving him. I was selling him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: If there's a way to reach him, it's his mother's village. Willow Creek. The same village you came from.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. My village.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. He was your mother's cousin. I'm sorry. I've been carrying that one a long time.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The obelisk ring is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

quests.title: Willow Creek Memories
quests.summary: To reach Tan, you need something from Willow Creek. You have one thing: your mother's pendant, and the memories in it.

objectives.text: Make your way to the blood pools
