dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hold the pendant. In soul sight it glows with Willow Creek: a willow, a creek, a woman singing, a boy called Tan laughing.

objectives.text: Clear the blood pools of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow feels the memory. His hollow guards come, fast, to stop you.

objectives.text: Gather the lotus that grows where the memories fell
Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Blood lotus, pink now. Growing where your memories touched the pool. Your village grows here now. That's strange and beautiful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Twelve Fingers
quests.summary: Brother Hollow sends everything he's wearing at once. Twelve bodies, one mind, all smiling.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's here! Twelve of them! One of me! I like those odds! Actually, you're here too. I like them more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Blood Guards ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Hold the field of bones against more Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They fell like puppets with cut strings. Because that's what they were. Poor sods. We'll bury them properly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Singing to Tan
quests.summary: You go to the hollowed captain with the pendant, and do the only thing that makes sense. You sing the song from Willow Creek.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The captain stands at the obelisk ring. You sing the only song you remember from Willow Creek, the one your mother sang. Badly.

objectives.text: Sing Willow Creek's song to Tan

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The captain's purple eyes flicker. Deep inside, a boy called Tan lifts his head. Mother? he says. The purple drains away.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Tan's back. Forty years in the cages and the Guard, and he's back, crying for his mother. He's asking your name.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Brother Hollow's thread snapped. He felt it. He's angry now. Angry and empty is a very dangerous thing.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Pink Water, Iron Bones
quests.summary: Before Brother Hollow comes, you finish tempering in the pools. Tan sits on the rim, watching, wrapped in Ye Wuming's cloak.

objectives.text: Finish tempering in the purified pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your bones feel like iron. Your soul feels like water poured into them. They are one thing. Middle stage of Body Integration.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Tan wants to go home to Willow Creek. I said I'd take him. I know what it's like, the first hour after the door opens.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Hollow Man Comes Himself
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the snapped threads. Brother Hollow has stopped sending bodies. He's coming himself.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's stopped sending puppets. He's coming himself. East, to the forest. He wants to fight where there are empty things to use.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The bamboo forest. Hollow bamboo. Thousands of empty stalks. He'll have an army of them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Of course he will. Everyone always wants to fight us in the bamboo. Let's go.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Bamboo Stands Up
quests.summary: The hermit's crane says the bamboo is standing up. Not growing. Standing. And walking.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo stood up at dawn. The hollow stalks. They pulled themselves out of the ground and started walking. Come quickly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The forest path is lined with bamboo men: stalks woven into bodies, purple mist in their hollows, all turned toward you.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Ten thousand stalks. Ten thousand hollow bodies. My forest. He's wearing my forest. I am very, very angry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Bamboo Men
quests.summary: The bamboo men come at you in waves, clattering, hollow, very light and very many.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bamboo men! They're light! They go down easily! There are a LOT of them! Dumpling, I'm sorry again!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Break the bamboo men at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Bamboo men! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Face the next wave of bamboo men

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I've cut down about a hundred bamboo men. I'm going to dream of bamboo. I'm going to eat bamboo shoots for a year out of spite.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Where He Lives
quests.summary: Brother Hollow isn't in any one stalk. He's in all of them. But in soul sight, one hollow is fuller than the others.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the whole forest is threaded with purple. But in the clearing, one old stalk glows brighter, full of someone.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A man sitting cross-legged in the hollow of a single bamboo, smiling, eyes closed. He opens them. He waves. Of course he waves.

objectives.text: Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That's him. His real self. He hides in the smallest hollow and wears the largest. Break that stalk, and he has to come out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Hermit's Plan
quests.summary: The hermit has a plan. It involves the Heart Sutra, the spirit spring, and filling ten thousand hollows at once.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: He lives in hollows. So we fill them. Water from the spring, with the sutra in it. Every stalk. All at once.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: It'll take the whole spring. It'll take everything I have. It's my forest. I'll give it everything.

objectives.text: Join Xiao Shi at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'll carry water. I'm good at carrying things. I carried hope for a year in a cage. Water's lighter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The hermit's plan means drowning a bamboo grove where spirit foxes den.

choices.text: Move the foxes first, whatever it costs

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Follow the plan

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Drown them all

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Spring Water for Ten Thousand
quests.summary: Everyone carries spring water to the bamboo: you, Xiao Shi, Wei Tong, Ye Wuming, even Zhao Kang, complaining.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You've changed. I haven't decided if I like it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Water carrying. The Zhao clan heir. Carrying water. For bamboo. My great-grandfather would faint. I'm going to tell him. In detail.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Carry sutra-water from the spirit spring
Stop the bamboo men at the spirit spring

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bamboo men at the spring try to stop you. Water hisses on them like it's too honest to touch.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Enough. Stand back. I'm going to sing. Loudly. It's been three hundred years since I sang this loudly. Cover your ears. Don't.

quests.title: The Hermit Sings
quests.summary: The hermit sings the Heart Sutra, all three verses, while you pour the water. The forest fills.

objectives.text: Pour your qi into the hermit's song

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. The hermit's voice fills the forest, and the water fills the stalks, and one by one the purple goes out of them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ten thousand hollows, filled with something that isn't empty. There's nowhere left for Brother Hollow to live but himself.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Blossom. I sang the blossom. I've never reached it before. Compassion. Even for him. That's what filled the stalks.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Kong Yi, Brother Hollow
quests.summary: With nowhere else to hide, the Fourth Rung steps out of his stalk: a thin man, very tired, smiling out of habit.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thin man steps out of a bamboo stalk and stands in the clearing. Without borrowed bodies he is small, and grey, and smiling from habit.

dialogue.speaker: rung_kong
dialogue.text: You filled my forest. With compassion. How rude. I was so comfortable. I am empty. It's very restful. Let me rest in you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: There's no room, Kong Yi. I'm full.

dialogue.speaker: rung_kong
dialogue.text: Then I'll have to make room. The old-fashioned way.

objectives.text: Stand over the fallen Fourth Rung

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Kong Yi lies in the grass. For a moment, before the end, he looks full: of surprise, of something like relief. Then his star goes out.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Four stars out. Three left. The Butcher is next. He was always Brother Hollow's shadow. He'll be coming.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen enemy's belongings: a manual of a forbidden blood technique.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Seal it in the Scripture Pagoda

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Keep it. Study it. Quietly.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Clearing the Last Stalks
quests.summary: Some of the bamboo men are still walking, confused, without anyone steering them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A few bamboo men wander near the wolf den, bumping into trees, lost now that no one is inside them.

objectives.text: Defeat the bamboo men at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Gather the fallen stalks for replanting

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Replant them. They're bamboo. They'll grow. They'll forget. Bamboo is very good at forgetting. It's why it's so old.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Four Stars Out
quests.summary: The hermit lies on his back in the clearing, exhausted, looking up at the sky through ten thousand healthy stalks.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I reached the blossom. Three hundred years. My masters would laugh. It took a hollow man to teach me compassion.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Go home. I'm going to lie here for a week. Tell Bai I'll be late for his lecture. Tell him the blossom's real.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Four down. Three left. The Butcher, Lady Silk, and the one nobody's seen. We're more than halfway up his ladder.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Butcher's Calling Card
quests.summary: On the way home, you find a calling card nailed to a tree: a butcher's cleaver, and a price list. Your name is on it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nailed to a stalk: a butcher's cleaver, and a price list in neat characters. Cultivators, by the jin. At the bottom, your name. Price: everything.

objectives.text: Talk with Zhao Kang at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A price list. With you on it. Everything, it says. I'm insulted on your behalf. You're worth more than everything.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...That came out wrong. Or right. I don't know. Let's go home.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: An Offer for Merchant Jin
quests.summary: Merchant Jin writes to the sect: someone has offered him a partnership. In meat. The meat is cultivators.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: A man came to the guild. With a cleaver. He offered me a partnership. In meat. Cultivator meat. By the jin. I said no.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Then I said yes, so I could find out where his market is. Then I wrote to you. Was that brave? I feel sick.

objectives.text: Make your way to the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the guild warehouse, Merchant Jin sits on a crate, very pale, holding a contract written in a butcher's neat hand.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The market's beneath the old guild warehouse. The one on stilts. Where the pale man hid his crates. They reuse everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Butcher's Contract
quests.summary: The contract lists prices. Outer disciples: cheap. Inner disciples: more. Elders: very dear. At the bottom: one special order.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Special order: one body, integrated, Verdant Lotus blood, undamaged. For the Master. Price: whatever the Master's hand pays.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath, in red: failing that, bodies of close kin will serve for fitting. Collect the heir's friends.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Close kin. Your friends. He's going to try to take us to... practise. I'm going to be very rude to him.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin was offered the Butcher's contract. He wants it burned before anyone sees his name.

choices.text: Burn it

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Take it to the magistrate as evidence

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep it, to hold over Jin

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Down Beneath the Stilts
quests.summary: Merchant Jin leads you to the market as his 'partner's' newest buyer. Nobody in the market is surprised to see a cultivator buying.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the old warehouse on stilts, stairs lead down into a cellar cut into the riverbank. It smells of ice and old blood.

objectives.text: Drive the market guards from the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The market's guards check faces at the alley entrance. One of them recognises you. That's the end of the disguise.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the warehouse: a market. Stalls. Scales. And ice, purple and humming, with shapes frozen inside it.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Merchant Jin

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I've been a smuggler. I've been a coward. I've never seen anything like this. I'm going to need a lot of honest years to forget it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Frozen in Void-Ice
quests.summary: Not all the shapes in the void-ice are dead. Some of them are breathing, very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the void-ice, a cultivator in Iron Scale green. Her chest rises, once, very slowly. She's alive.

objectives.text: Clear the guild warehouse of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ice cracks. A young woman in Iron Scale green falls out, gasping. One of the forty from the southern peak. Alive.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Iron Scale. One of Ruan's forty. The butcher bought her from the void. We have to tell Ruan. We have to find the rest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Madam Fang's Kitchen
quests.summary: The rescued Iron Scale disciple is taken to the Drunken Crane. Madam Fang feeds her, and Iron-Fang dries the dishes and listens.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Soup. Three bowls. She ate them like a wolf. She says there are more. Frozen. In another market. Further in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The Butcher. I've heard the name. He used to buy bandits who died in raids. Iron-Fang's men, some of them. Before I knew.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want a word with him. A long word. With brooms and without.

quests.title: The Butcher's Guards
quests.summary: The Butcher's market guards come looking for the woman who escaped their ice.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Guards from the underground market! Coming up through the warehouse! Looking for the girl! I've got a new spear and a bad mood!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Guards at the market square

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Nine of them. All wearing butcher's aprons over their armour. Who does that? Who dresses like that on purpose?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Butcher's Ledger
quests.summary: In the market's back room, the Butcher's ledger: every body bought, every body sold. And where the best ones go.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The back room is spotless. A cleaver on the wall, a set of scales, and a ledger in the same neat hand as the price list.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The best bodies go to 'the larder': the caves beneath the old wolf den in the bamboo. The Butcher keeps them there, fresh, for fitting.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The wolf den. Where the blood seal wept. Where the grotto opened. Where everything happens. I'm starting to hate that den.

quests.title: Warm Blankets for the Frozen
quests.summary: If there are more frozen people in the larder, they'll need warmth. Madam Fang raids the whole town for blankets.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Blankets! Every blanket in Qingshi! I've taken the magistrate's. He doesn't know yet. He'll be very brave about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Join Liu Er at the main street

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I carried forty blankets. Mother made me take a coat too. Wei Tong says that's what heroes' mothers do. Is it?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Iron-Fang Knows the Road
quests.summary: Iron-Fang says the Butcher's carts to the larder use the old bandit roads through the bamboo. He knows every one.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The old bandit roads. I cut half of them myself. The Butcher's using them to move his meat. My roads. For that.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I'll show you. Every road. Every hide. Every trick. Iron-Fang pays his debts. This one I'll pay with interest.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild will pay for the carts to bring the frozen ones home. All of them. At no cost. I'm getting good at no cost.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin confides they're hiding a runaway from the Blood Moon's cages. The magistrate doesn't know.

choices.text: Help hide them

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Tell the magistrate, gently

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Report them for the reward

reply.speaker: merchant_jin
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Up the Bandit Roads
quests.summary: At dawn, you follow Iron-Fang out of Qingshi onto roads that don't appear on any map.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: No map has these roads. I burned the maps. I'm the map now. Follow me. Don't step where I don't step.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A bandit chief leading us through his old roads to rescue frozen cultivators from a butcher. Elder Mo would have liked this.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The town temple smells of clean incense. A sparrow nests in the eaves, bold as a magistrate.

objectives.text: Hear what Old Pan has to say

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. It's never lied to me yet.

objectives.choice_prompt: Old Pan offers you a gift for the immortal's protection. The neighbours can't afford one.

choices.text: Refuse it

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Accept it, and record it with the magistrate

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Accept, and ask the neighbours for theirs

reply.speaker: ferryman_pan
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The First Road
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's first road runs from the river to the old bridge, hidden under a canopy of bent bamboo.

objectives.text: Make your way to the old bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Under the old bridge, a path you've never noticed: bent bamboo, a tunnel of green. Cart ruts, fresh. Iron-Fang kneels and reads them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Two carts, heavy. Last night. Void-ice leaks cold; see the frost on the ruts? Frozen people, going to the larder.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I robbed forty caravans on this road. I'm going to try to make up for one of them today.

quests.title: Carters on the Road
quests.summary: The Butcher's carters are moving the next load. Iron-Fang knows exactly where to catch them.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Here. The bend. They always slow down at the bend. I know because I made them slow down, years ago, with a fallen tree.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Break the Butcher's carters at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The Butcher's carters come on in silence.

objectives.text: Cut down the rogue cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: One cart. Three frozen. Iron Scale green. We'll take them to the hermit. The spring warms people. It warmed me once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Frost on the Cart
quests.summary: The cart is full of void-ice. The people inside are breathing, barely.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three blocks of purple ice on a cart. Inside, three Iron Scale disciples, breathing once a minute.

objectives.text: Stop the rogue cultivators at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These rogue cultivators fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Break the void-ice on the cart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ice breaks. Three Iron Scale disciples tumble out, blue with cold. You wrap them in Madam Fang's blankets and hold on.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Bring them to the spring. The water's warm today. It knows. Springs always know when someone's cold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen rogue cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Tie Hu's Confession
quests.summary: At the hermit's fire, Iron-Fang tells you what he did on the second road, years ago.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The second road. I burned a village there. Willow Creek. Twenty years back. For the Blood Moon, for my sister's life.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. That's my village.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...I know. I figured it out years ago. I didn't tell you. Iron-Fang pays his debts. This one I can't pay. I'm sorry.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the stream

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You were paying for your sister. So was I, in a way, paying for my mother. We'll bring your sister home, Tie Hu.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...You're a fool. The biggest fool I've ever met. Thank you. I don't know what else to say.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang confesses that years ago he sold men to the Butcher.

choices.text: Forgive him

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: He must face the magistrate after the war

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Hold it over him, so he obeys you

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Second Road
quests.summary: The second road leads toward the wolf den. It's guarded now, by wolves the Butcher feeds.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The second road ends at the wolf den. Wolves pace the entrance, fat and slow, fed on things you don't want to think about.

objectives.text: Defeat the spirit wolves at the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: More spirit wolves? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The tallies say forty bodies in the larder. Twenty-one breathing. The rest... the rest are what the Butcher keeps for fitting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Warming the Frozen
quests.summary: The three rescued Iron Scale disciples are still cold. The spring's warmth isn't enough. Your integrated body might be.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The void-cold is in their bones. Your body is one thing now. Share its warmth. Hold their hands. Let your qi flow into them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Warm the frozen disciples with your qi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your qi runs into them like warm water into cold stone. One by one, they stop shaking. One of them says thank you in Iron Scale dialect.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'll take them home to the Iron Scale. The first hour after the door opens, you need someone to walk with you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Butcher's Hide
quests.summary: On the third road, Iron-Fang finds one of his old hides. The Butcher's been using it. There's a letter inside.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Behind the lookout rock, a hide dug into the hill, shored with bamboo. Iron-Fang dug it twenty years ago. Someone's been living in it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A cleaver-sharpening stone, a set of scales, and a letter: The heir's friends. Start with the loud one. Iron-Fang.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Start with the loud one. That's me. He's coming for me first. Good. I've been waiting twenty years to pay somebody back properly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Butcher Comes for Iron-Fang
quests.summary: That night, the Butcher's men come for Iron-Fang at the hermit's fire. They don't get him.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They came for Iron-Fang! With nets! Nets! Like he's a fish! He's not a fish! He's a very large, very angry bandit!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Raise the hermit's ward around the fire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ward flares green around the hermit's fire. Nets hit it and burn. Iron-Fang is laughing, which is somehow the most frightening part.

objectives.text: Drive the Butcher's carters from the clearing

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Nets. For me. I haven't been this insulted since the sect brat spared my life. Let's go to the larder. Now. Tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The bandits left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Bones Like Iron Roads
quests.summary: Before the larder, you sit on the old bandit road and let everything settle: the frozen, the confession, the roads.

objectives.text: Temper your body on the old bandit road

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your body remembers the lightning, the pools, the bath. It settles into itself like a road into a valley. Late stage of Body Integration.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You look like you're made of iron. And water. And stubbornness. Mostly stubbornness. Ready? The larder's under the den.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Under the Den
quests.summary: Iron-Fang says the larder is under the wolf den, in the caves where the grotto used to open. The Butcher keeps it cold.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Under the den. Where the grotto was. The Butcher found the old caves and filled them with void-ice. It's his larder.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Twenty-one breathing, the tallies say. We bring all twenty-one out. Then we find him. Then I say something to him.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tea steam curls from the hermit's hut. It always does. Nobody has ever seen the fire.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao Arrives
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao arrives at the wolf den with twenty Iron Scale disciples. His people are in that larder.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Twenty of us. Nineteen of the forty are in there, the ledger says. Breathing. I'm going in. I'm not asking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The wolf den breathes cold. Frost rims the cave mouth. Deep inside, something hums, like a thousand bees made of ice.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father wanted to come. His knees won't manage the cave. He gave me his sword. It's very heavy. I'm going to use it anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Larder Guards
quests.summary: The larder's guards are waiting. The Butcher knew you'd come. He wants you here.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Guards at the cave mouth. And ice golems. The Butcher's been preparing. He wants us inside.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Clear the wolf den of larder guards

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Hold the herb grove against more ice golems
Look for Iron-Fang at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: He wants us inside. So we go inside. That's what bandits call a trap. That's what heroes call Tuesday.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Rows of Ice
quests.summary: Inside the larder: rows of void-ice, humming, each with a shape inside. Twenty-one are breathing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Rows of purple ice, humming. Inside each, a shape. Iron Scale green. Moon-Well white. Farmers. Twenty-one chests rising, very slowly.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one the ice cracks. One by one, people fall out, gasping, into Iron Scale arms and Madam Fang's blankets.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ruan Jingtao

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Nineteen of ours. All nineteen. And two Moon-Well nuns. And farmers. Twenty-one. All breathing. All going home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Nineteen Who Aren't Breathing
quests.summary: The other nineteen blocks of ice hold people who aren't breathing. The Butcher kept them for fitting. For practice.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: These nineteen are gone. He kept them for practice. For fitting a soul into a body that isn't its own.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: We take them home too. To be buried. Not left for him. Everyone out. Xiao Shi's rule.

objectives.text: Hear what the hermit has to say

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I'll sing for them. At the spring. The blossom verse. They deserve compassion more than anyone who's still breathing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nineteen frozen cultivators. Thawing risks their lives; leaving them risks the Butcher using them.

choices.text: Thaw them slowly, whatever it costs

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Wait for Elder Hua's order

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Destroy them. It's safer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Fitting Room
quests.summary: At the back of the larder, a room with a stone table, and a diagram on the wall: a body, and a soul, and the seams between them.

objectives.text: Make your way to the wolf den

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the back of the larder, a stone table. On the wall, a diagram drawn in careful red: a body, a soul, and seven points where they meet.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seven points. Seven rungs. The Ladder isn't just for climbing. It's to hold the Patriarch's soul in a body while heaven's lightning tries to burn him out.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Seven anchors, holding him in a stolen body while the lightning burns. Four are gone. He'd only have three now. Would three be enough?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Not for a long fitting. For a short one... maybe. Let's not find out. Let's break them all.

quests.title: Carrying the Frozen Out
quests.summary: Everyone carries someone. Iron Scale disciples, bandits, a hermit, an heir. Twenty-one living, nineteen gone.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone carry someone. Living first. Then the gone. Iron-Fang carries two. Iron-Fang always carries two.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Carry the frozen out of the larder
Meet Ruan Jingtao at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: All forty. Out. Living and gone. The Iron Scale remembers who carried them. We'll carve it on Remembering Hill.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Butcher's Welcome
quests.summary: As you carry the last of them out, the Butcher's ice golems come to take back what's his.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ice golems! Coming out of the walls! He wants his larder back! He can't have it! It's a cave now! Just a cave!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Break the ice golems at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ice golems spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Just a cave. Just a stupid cave. I'm going to have nightmares about that cave. I'm going to write them down. For my great-grandfather.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Singing for Nineteen
quests.summary: At the spring, the hermit sings for the nineteen who didn't come back breathing. You sit with him.

objectives.text: Sit with the hermit as he sings for the dead

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The blossom verse. The hermit's voice is old and steady. Nineteen names, read by Ruan Jingtao, one by one, between verses.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Nineteen names. Sung. The Butcher kept their bodies. He never had their names. We keep those now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Where the Butcher Went
quests.summary: The Butcher wasn't in his larder. His ledger's last entry says where he's gone: the Abyss rim, to the Master's door.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the empty larder, pinned to the fitting table with a cleaver, a note: Gone to wait at the Master's door. Bring the loud one. Wen Tu.

objectives.text: Pull the cleaver from the table

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The cleaver comes free. It's warm. On its blade, very small, seven notches. Four of them have been scratched out.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Bring the loud one. He wants me at the rim. At his master's door. Good. I'll bring myself. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: To the Rim
quests.summary: Iron-Fang, Ruan Jingtao and you set out for the Abyss rim. The Butcher is waiting at the fold.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale comes too. He froze our people. We're going to watch him fall. It's not revenge. It's closure. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: It's a bit revenge. It's fine. A bit revenge is healthy. Ask anyone. Ask the hermit. Don't ask the hermit.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Sound of Sharpening
quests.summary: At the rim, you can hear it before you see it: the long, patient sound of a cleaver on stone.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Down in the canyon, a slow, steady sound: steel on stone, over and over, patient as a heartbeat.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's at the obelisk ring. Sharpening. He's been sharpening for three days, the children say. Waiting for you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: And for Iron-Fang. He's very specific. The Butcher is always very specific.

quests.title: The Butcher's Hands
quests.summary: The Butcher's hands, men in bloody aprons over their armour, hold the bone field.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Aprons over armour. I've seen them before. They came to my old camp, twenty years ago, to buy the dead. I let them in. I let them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Stop the butcher's hands at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The butcher's hands have found you first.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Guards at the war camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I let them in, once. Never again. Iron-Fang says never again, and means it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the bandits is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

quests.title: Gu Knew the Butcher
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, has come to the rim again. He knows Wen Tu. He sold him bodies, once.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Wen Tu. I sold him the bodies of the dead from the Qingshi siege. He paid in silver. I sent the silver to the families. I told myself that made it clean.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He weighs everything. Fear especially. Don't be afraid of him. It makes him heavier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not afraid of him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No. I can see that. You're afraid for Iron-Fang. That weighs nothing. That's very good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Trust fewer people than you'd like. Trust me slightly less.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: We're done at the blood pools. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men want to know if heroes get lunch breaks.

quests.title: Seven Notches
quests.summary: At the edge of the obelisk ring, the Butcher's cleavers hang from a rack. Each has seven notches. Five scratched out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A rack of cleavers stands at the edge of the obelisk ring. On each blade, seven notches. Four scratched out. The fifth half-scratched.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fifth notch is his. He's been scratching it out himself, slowly, as if he knows. As if he's already weighed himself.

objectives.text: Show Ruan Jingtao what you found

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: He knows he's going to lose. And he's waiting anyway. What kind of person waits to lose?

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: One who was built to. The Rungs were children once. Taken. Weighed. Like my children. Like me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Fold Drips
quests.summary: The fold is leaking again, heavier now, since four Rungs fell. Wraiths spill out around the obelisk ring.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fold ripples. Purple wraiths drip out of it like rain off a roof, and drift toward the obelisk ring and the sharpening sound.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The fold's weaker. Every Rung that falls, it leaks more. When they're all gone, it might just... open.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: That's either the best news I've heard in years, or the worst. It's both. It's always both.

quests.title: Weighing Nothing
quests.summary: Before the fight, you sit at the rim and do what Gu said: let your fear for Iron-Fang weigh nothing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe. The fear is there, but light, like a feather. Your body and soul hold it without effort. It weighs exactly nothing.

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You look calm. Too calm. Don't be calm for my sake. Be angry for my sake. No. Calm. Calm's better. I'm confused.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Wen Tu, the Butcher of Wen
quests.summary: The Fifth Rung puts down his whetstone, picks up his cleaver, and weighs you with his eyes.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A huge man in a bloody apron stands among the obelisk stumps, cleaver in hand. He looks at you the way a butcher looks at a carcass: fairly.

objectives.name: Wen Tu, the Butcher of Wen
objectives.text: Face Wen Tu, the Butcher of Wen at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: rung_wen
dialogue.text: Wen Tu. Fifth Rung. Meat is meat. I weigh cultivators by the jin. You're very heavy, heir. All that iron in your bones.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Weigh me, Butcher. Iron-Fang. Twenty years ago you bought my dead. I'm here to settle the account.

dialogue.speaker: rung_wen
dialogue.text: Ah. The loud one. Two at once. Good. Good. I've already scratched my notch. Let's see if I was right.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Wen Tu lies among the obelisk stumps. He looks up at Iron-Fang. You were heavier than I weighed, he says. His star goes out.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Account settled. I thought I'd feel something. I feel tired. And hungry. Is that what winning feels like? It's disappointing.

quests.title: Five Stars Out
quests.summary: Five stars out. Two left. The fold ripples, weaker, and for a moment, through it, you see the black gate clearly.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Five out. Two left. Lady Silk, and the one nobody's seen. The Patriarch's own shadow. The Seventh Rung.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Through the fold, just now. The gate. Clearer than ever. It's closer. It's getting closer.

objectives.text: Find Ruan Jingtao at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale will be at the rim when it opens. All of us. Remembering Hill will be empty that day. We'll all be here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Butcher's Last Ledger
quests.summary: The Butcher kept a last ledger. Every body he ever bought. Every name he ever knew. Iron-Fang wants to read it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: His last ledger. Every body. Every name. I want to read it. I want to find my men's names. The ones I let him buy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Gather the pages of the Butcher's ledger

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Eleven of my men. Twenty years ago. Names, here, in his hand. I'm going to carve them somewhere. Somewhere clean.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Butcher's ledger names every buyer. Some are respected elders of other sects.

choices.text: Publish every name

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

choices.text: Hand it to the alliance court

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blackmail the elders

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Carving Names
quests.summary: Iron-Fang carves eleven names on a flat stone at the rim, above the fold. It takes all night. Nobody helps. Nobody leaves.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Eleven names. Carved. Above the fold. When it opens, they'll be the first thing anyone sees. That's something.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. This one's paid. Now there's just my sister. Get strong. Get stronger. Break the last two.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Doctor's Orders
quests.summary: Elder Hua has prescribed rest. A whole week. She has written it on a scroll and pinned it to your door.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Rest. One week. Written, sealed, pinned to your door. Doctor's orders. The last stage of integration is being a person in your body.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Not a weapon. Not a key. A person. Eat. Sleep. Walk. Let your friends be annoying. That's the medicine.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The herb terraces are green and ordinary. Somewhere a bird is singing badly. For once, nothing is on fire.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Elder Hua says I have to make sure you rest. I'm going to follow you everywhere. With soup. And a hat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: I'm not going to tell anyone. Probably.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Being a Person
quests.summary: Being a person turns out to be harder than being a weapon. Everyone has opinions about how to do it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Being a person? Easy. Eat. Nap. Eat again. Complain about the weather. Eat. That's the whole technique.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Being a person means letting people be rude to you and being rude back. It's very relaxing. Try it. You're terrible at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Being a person means sitting still without planning anything. I can't do it either. Let's not do it together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: A Picnic at the Pond
quests.summary: Xiao Man organises a picnic at the lotus pond, under Elder Mo's peach trees. The whole sect comes. Nothing is on fire.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: {senior}! The little ones at the gate tell stories about you now. Good ones!

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: A picnic! Under the peach trees! By the green lotus! Everyone's invited! Nobody's allowed to talk about Rungs!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Gather peaches from Elder Mo's orchard
Lay out the picnic beneath the peach trees

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole sect on the grass by the pond. The green lotus. The first peaches from Elder Mo's saplings. Nobody talks about Rungs for three hours.

objectives.text: Talk with Xiao Shi at the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The first peaches. From his trees. Elder Hua cried. Wei Tong cried. I cried. The carp looked very embarrassed for all of us.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Teaching the Twelve
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve are not so new any more. They want you to teach them what an integrated body can do. Carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My twelve want a lesson. From you. Integrated body. Carefully. Qiu Hua has a new chicken. Don't hit the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Teach Wei Tong's twelve with the puppets

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The training puppets come on in silence.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er after the fight

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: You hit a puppet and it didn't break, it just... sat down. Politely. How do you make a puppet sit down politely?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Hermit's Lecture
quests.summary: The hermit gives his first full lecture on the Heart Sutra in the pagoda. The whole sect squeezes in. Bai weeps.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root: patience. Stem: forgiveness. Blossom: compassion. I reached the blossom in a bamboo forest, fighting a hollow man. Take notes.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The sutra says a body is a lotus: it grows in mud and isn't stained. You're all very muddy. That's the point.

objectives.text: Find Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Three hundred disciples in my pagoda. Listening to the Verdant Lotus sutra. My grandmother would have fainted. I'm going to faint.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Thunder Peak's Gift
quests.summary: Thunder Peak has carved your name on the lightning forge. Yan Tie wants you to see it, and bring back a stone from it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Your name! On the forge! First name we've ever carved! Bring back a stone from the forge for your room! Thunder Peak insists!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Gather a stone from the lightning forge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: It hums! The forge stone hums! It'll hum on your windowsill forever! Thunder Peak thinks that's a very good present!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The humming forge stone was chipped from Thunder Peak's sacred anvil without their elders' leave.

choices.text: Return it quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Keep it. It was a gift.

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Sell it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Visitors From Nothing
quests.summary: On the sixth day of rest, void wraiths come up the back path. Elder Hua says fighting counts as rest if you enjoy it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Wraiths on the back path. Go. Fighting counts as rest if you enjoy it. Enjoy it. That's an order from your doctor.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Ring the alarm at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings over the sea of clouds. On the hidden path, purple shapes pause, then keep climbing, slower now, less sure.

objectives.text: Drive the void wraiths from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Void wraiths ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow
Catch your breath with Zhao Kang

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was relaxing. Was it relaxing? I think it was. I'm learning to be a person. It's very violent.

quests.title: The Sect Master's Gift
quests.summary: The Sect Master gives you something on the last day of rest: a key to the main hall. Nobody but her has ever had one.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A key. To the main hall. Nobody but the sect master has ever had one. Now you do.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Not because you'll be sect master. Because you'll need somewhere quiet, one day, and I want you to have it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, I don't know what to say.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Say nothing. That's what the main hall is for. Nothing, in quiet. Go and try it.

objectives.text: Join Liu Er at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the scholar rock isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

quests.title: One Body, One Soul
quests.summary: In the quiet of the main hall, with the founder's tablet and the faded green lotus beside it, integration completes.

objectives.text: Meditate in stillness on the stone bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: No lightning. No pain. Only breath, and a body that is entirely yours, and a soul that fills it to the edges. Great Perfection of Void Refinement.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You feel everyone on the mountain, faintly, the way you feel your own fingers. That, the hermit says later, is the start of Body Integration.

objectives.text: Hear what the Sect Master has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Great Perfection. Hua says you rested well. Wei Tong says you ate nine peaches. Both, apparently, count.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: What Comes Next
quests.summary: Qing Luan's last crane before the isles sealed said something you only now understand: the next stage isn't yours alone.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Body Integration. Not only your body: everyone's. A stage you can't reach alone. You carry others, and they carry you. It's the sutra's blossom, as a realm.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Lady Silk is the next Rung. She spins webs between people. Between sects. The answer to a web is not a sword. It's a vehicle.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A vehicle. All the sects, together. The Iron Scale, the Zhao clan, the Moon-Well, Qingshi. That's what she'll try to cut. Let's not let her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Not Alone
quests.summary: The Sect Master stands on the formation plaza and says something no Azure Cloud master has said in three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When the fold opens, we cannot march alone. Three hundred years ago we had the Verdant Lotus. Now we need everyone.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'm calling a conclave. Every orthodox sect. On our mountain. The first in three centuries. Lu Ping, prepare the cranes.

objectives.text: Make your way to the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The formation glows under the Sect Master's feet. Every disciple on the plaza goes very quiet, and then starts talking at once.

objectives.text: Talk with Lu Ping at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Cranes! Hundreds of cranes! I've never folded hundreds of cranes! I've folded eleven, and three of them flew into walls!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The Hermit Explains the Body of Many
quests.summary: The hermit explains the next realm over tea in the pagoda. It's not what you expected.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Body Integration. The body of many. Every realm before this was about you. Your qi, your core, your soul, your body. This one isn't.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You carry others. Their hopes, their fears, their weight. And they carry you. You can't reach it alone. You never could.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: How do I cultivate carrying people?

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You carry them. Literally, sometimes. Start small. Start with the ones already on your back.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Have you eaten? I haven't eaten. We should both eat.

objectives.text: Join Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I could have done this alone. I'm choosing not to. Appreciate it.

quests.title: Paper for a Thousand Cranes
quests.summary: Lu Ping needs paper for a thousand cranes. Elder Bai's pagoda has paper. Elder Bai has conditions.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Paper! For cranes! From my pagoda! My good paper! ...For a conclave of sects. Fine. Take it. Take the second-best paper.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Gather crane paper from the pagoda

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Second-best paper. Still better than anything I've ever folded. I'm going to fold my best crane ever. It's going to fly perfectly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Folding a Thousand Cranes
quests.summary: Everyone on the mountain folds cranes. Some are beautiful. Wei Tong's look like dumplings. They fly anyway.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole sect sits on the plaza folding paper cranes. Children, elders, the hermit, the Sect Master. Wei Tong's cranes look like dumplings.

objectives.text: Breathe life into the thousand cranes

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You breathe qi into the pile. A thousand paper cranes rise, circle the mountain once, and scatter east, west, north and south.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My dumpling cranes flew! They flew! One of them flew into Elder Bai. He kept it. He said it was the most honest crane he's ever met.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Carrying Wei Tong
quests.summary: The hermit said start with the ones already on your back. Wei Tong volunteers. Literally. He wants to be carried.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Carrying people? Start with me! Carry me around the training ground! I carried you once, when the wolf king got me! Your turn!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Fight the puppets while carrying Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Faster! Left! There's a puppet on the left! I'm very heavy! I've been eating for this moment all week!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You carried me and fought four puppets. I'm going to tell everyone. I'm going to tell my twelve. I'm going to tell the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: What Everyone Carries
quests.summary: You ask people what they carry. Everyone has an answer, and none of them are small.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: What do I carry? Frost Sword Peak. Thirty disciples who think I'm frightening. I am. It's on purpose. It keeps them alive.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I carry the map. And the cages. And my sister, who carries everyone. I'm getting better at carrying her back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Every patient I've ever lost. And forty years of peaches. The peaches are lighter.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A disciple confesses he hates carrying anyone but himself.

choices.text: Tell him that's honest, and it's fine

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Remind him of the sect's oath

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Tell him the weak deserve no carrying

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Wraiths Follow the Cranes
quests.summary: Some of the cranes are followed. Void wraiths slip out of rifts and drift after them like moths.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Wraiths following the cranes! They want to eat the invitations! I'm not letting a wraith eat my great-grandfather's invitation!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Ward the cranes' flight path from the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises over the cliff like a shield. The cranes fly through it. The wraiths don't.

objectives.text: Clear the outer pines of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Void wraiths spill out of cover, weapons bright.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: All the cranes made it out. Every single one. Even the dumpling ones. Especially the dumpling ones. They're very determined.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Carrying the Mountain
quests.summary: The hermit asks you to sit on the formation and feel the whole mountain at once. Every person on it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit on the formation. Feel everyone on the mountain. Every breath. Not to watch them. To hold them. Gently.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Feel everyone on the mountain at once

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three thousand breaths, all at once. Wei Tong snoring. Xiao Man humming. The Sect Master worrying. You hold them, and they're light.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You're smiling. Everyone who first feels it smiles. Then they cry. Then they get up and carry things. That's Body Integration.

quests.title: The First Answers
quests.summary: The first cranes come back within a week. Every sect you've ever helped has answered.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Answers! From the Iron Scale! The Zhao clan! The Moon-Well! Qingshi's yamen! And... sects I've never heard of! Dozens!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The Silk Pavilion. The Cinder Cloud. The Hundred Wells. I didn't even know there were that many sects. There are loads!

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone's coming. Everyone we've helped, and everyone who heard we helped. You did this. You said yes too often.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Sect Master asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Body Integration
quests.summary: On the eve of the conclave, with every answer in, the hermit asks you to sit at the pond and carry them all at once.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Every answer. Every sect. Every person who said yes because you said yes first. Carry them. All of them. Tonight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather the returned cranes by the pond
Carry every sect in your cultivation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale, Zhao, Moon-Well, Qingshi, and dozens more. You carry them all, and they carry you. It's the lightest you've ever felt.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside you the green lotus opens wider than it ever has. Beneath the water, something like a vehicle made of light begins to take shape.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Body Integration

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The clouds cover the whole sky. Every bolt that falls will test whether your body is truly one thing.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Body Integration. A body of many. The first in the Azure Cloud since the founder. Tomorrow the sects arrive. Carry them well.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Green Banners Again
quests.summary: The Iron Scale arrive first. This time, the green banners bow at the gate.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (bows so deeply they nearly topple) {senior}! This junior greets... I mean, hello. Your qi makes my hair stand up.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Green banners! The Iron Scale! They're bowing! At the gate! The Iron Scale doesn't bow! I'm going to faint on my own boots!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale green fills the processional way. At the gate, Ruan Hai stops, and bows. Every Iron Scale disciple behind him bows too.

objectives.text: Join Sect Master Ruan at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale answers. Remembering Hill sends its greetings. We brought tea. The good tea. For the Cinder Peak incident.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Father insisted on the tea. He's been practising his bow for a week. Don't tell him it was slightly crooked.

quests.title: The Zhao Clan Arrives in Gold
quests.summary: The Zhao clan arrives in gold palanquins. Zhao Kang pretends not to be waiting at the gate. He's been there since dawn.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan answers. With gold, naturally. And with three hundred disciples, and my great-grandson's monthly letters, framed.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Framed? You framed my letters? The one about the dumplings? The one where I said 'love'?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Especially that one. It's in the ancestral hall. Next to your brother's stone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...I need a moment. Behind the gate. Alone. Don't follow me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The Moon-Well Arrives Singing
quests.summary: The Moon-Well Nunnery comes up the steps singing. The girl from the cage, Lian, leads the song.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well answers. We sing on the steps. Lian's idea. So we know we're here. It's become a tradition. Traditions start small.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A young nun with bright eyes bows to you. Lian. She doesn't say anything. She sings one line of the song, only for you, and walks on.

quests.title: Space for Everyone
quests.summary: Steward Qian needs somewhere to put two thousand guests. The mountain has flat stones. Not enough.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Two thousand guests! Where do I put them? The plaza? The terraces? The roof? I've put forty on the roof! It's a very nice roof!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Mark out camp spaces across the plaza

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Everyone has a flat stone. Some of them have flat stones on the roof. Nobody's complained. Well, the Zhao clan complained. Politely.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit stones you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Who Goes First
quests.summary: The Cinder Cloud and the Hundred Wells argue about who should enter the main hall first. The argument becomes a brawl.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The hero of the hour! Stop blushing. Everyone's talking about you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The Cinder Cloud and the Hundred Wells are fighting! About who goes through the door first! It's a very big door! They could both fit!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Rowdy sect disciples! Back to back, and mind your footing!

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You carried two brawling disciples off the training ground, one under each arm. They're friends now. They bonded over being carried.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The two brawling sects look to you to say who enters the main hall first.

choices.text: The smallest sect first

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: By seniority, as tradition says

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Whoever pays the most

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Silk Pavilion
quests.summary: A small sect nobody has heard of arrives last: the Silk Pavilion. Its envoy is a woman in pink silk who smiles at everyone.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A single palanquin of pink silk arrives at the gate. The woman who steps out is beautiful, gracious, and bows to everyone, including the gate.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Credentials in perfect order. A small sect, far to the south. Envoy: Lady Si Rou. The seal is flawless. It is almost too flawless.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Lady Si Rou. She smiled at me. Nobody smiles at me. I'm frightening on purpose. I'm going to watch her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Wraiths at the Camp
quests.summary: Two thousand guests means two thousand people who might grieve, fear, or hope. The wraiths come to feed.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
