dialogue.text: Wraiths in the Iron Scale camp! We've fought them before! On Remembering Hill! We know how! Kind of!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The void wraiths have found you first.

objectives.text: Hold the formation plaza against more void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Iron Scale and Azure Cloud, fighting side by side. Again. It's becoming a habit. A good habit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Night Before the Conclave
quests.summary: On the night before the conclave, the whole mountain is lit by two thousand lanterns, and nobody sleeps.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Two thousand guests. Forty sects. One mountain. Tomorrow I have to speak to all of them. I've never been so frightened.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you've faced the Blood Moon.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon doesn't ask questions after your speech. Forty sect masters do. Sit with me. Don't say anything. Carry me a bit.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I don't do speeches. Walk faster.

objectives.text: Meet Sect Master Ruan at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: Speak plainly. I am too old for riddles and too tired for lies.

quests.title: Lanterns for Forty Sects
quests.summary: Every sect hangs a lantern on the formation's nine pillars. Forty colours. It's the most beautiful thing on the mountain.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Forty lanterns! On nine pillars! Some pillars have five! The Zhao clan's is gold! Of course it's gold!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Hang the last lantern on the ninth pillar

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty lanterns on nine pillars. Blue, green, gold, white, pink. The formation glows beneath them, and the mountain looks like a festival of stars.

objectives.text: Talk with Abbess Jing at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Forty sects. Three hundred years of quarrels. One mountain of lanterns. Whatever happens tomorrow, tonight was worth it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The incense bundles came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Pink at the Edges
quests.summary: Late at night, Han Xue finds you. She's been watching Lady Si Rou. She has something to show you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Lady Si Rou. She visited eleven camps tonight. Eleven. She smiled at everyone. And after each visit, someone started arguing.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Iron Scale with Zhao. Moon-Well with Cinder Cloud. Always after she left. I'm going to keep watching. You keep carrying.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Don't bow so deeply. My neck hurts just watching.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Abbess's Test
quests.summary: Abbess Jing has a condition for the Moon-Well's support: a week of service, anonymous, in the town below.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: (does not smile) {player}. The righteous path has a narrow gate. Mind you still fit.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well will stand with you. On one condition. A week in Qingshi. Serving the poor. Nobody may know who you are.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Great Vehicle is carrying people who don't know your name. Anyone can carry people who cheer.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You walk into Qingshi in a plain grey robe, hood up. The gate guard doesn't look twice. It's the strangest feeling in the world.

objectives.text: Join Madam Fang at the main street

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: A new dishwasher? Iron-Fang needs help. He's getting old. Don't tell him I said that. What's your name? No name? Fine. Dishes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Dishes at the Drunken Crane
quests.summary: Your first task: dishes, at the Drunken Crane, beside Iron-Fang, who doesn't recognise you with your hood up.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: New dishwasher? Good. Stack them by size. Rinse twice. Don't talk. Dishwashing is a sacred silence.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You're good. Very good. Where'd you learn? ...Wait. I know that stance. Sect brat? No. Don't tell me. I won't tell anyone.

quests.title: Water for the Well
quests.summary: Widow Liu is too old to carry all the water now. A hooded stranger offers to help.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Help? From a stranger? Well. My arms aren't what they were. Twenty buckets to the old houses on the hill. Thank you, stranger.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: You carry water the way someone I know carries it. Straight-backed. ...I won't ask. Heaven keeps its accounts. So do I.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Rogues in the Poor Quarter
quests.summary: Rogue cultivators are shaking down the poor quarter. The hooded dishwasher happens to be passing.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the back alley, three rogues are taking coppers from an old man who hasn't got any. The old man is crying. The rogues are laughing.

objectives.text: Break the rogue cultivators at the back alley

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The rogue cultivators spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Someone beat three rogues in the back alley and gave all the coppers back. A stranger in grey. Nobody knows who. I'm writing it down as 'grey'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogues you beat were disciples once, expelled for being poor.

choices.text: Give them work and a second chance

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Hand them to the constable

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Recruit them as your own enforcers

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: Rice for the Hill Houses
quests.summary: The old houses on the hill have no rice this winter. The guild warehouse has plenty. Merchant Jin has a new policy.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Rice for the hill houses? The guild has a new policy. Anyone who asks gets rice. It's a terrible policy. I love it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Sacks of rice, stamped with the guild's seal and a new mark underneath: a small lotus, in green. Jin's added it. Nobody asked him to.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The lotus? It's for... someone. Who saved the town. Who I nearly sold. Carry the rice, stranger. Don't ask about the lotus.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Liu Er Doesn't Recognise You
quests.summary: Liu Er is home on leave. He's teaching the town children to stand straight. He asks the hooded stranger to demonstrate.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Stranger! Can you stand straight? Show the children? Like this. Back straight. A crooked spine makes a crooked meridian. My teacher's teacher said that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Like this?

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Exactly like that. Perfect. You stand like... never mind. You stand very well, stranger. Thank you.

objectives.text: Hear what Widow Liu has to say

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Meet Constable Du at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

quests.title: Night in the Poor Quarter
quests.summary: Wraiths come to the poor quarter at night, where people are cold and afraid and have given up. The stranger in grey is there.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Shades in the old houses! Drawn to the cold ones! The poor ones! Someone ring the bell!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Ring the dock bell to wake the quarter

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Lamps flare in the old houses. People come out, and a hooded stranger stands between them and the purple dark.

objectives.text: Stop the void wraiths at the hill graves

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The void wraiths come on in silence.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: The stranger in grey. Standing in the street all night. Nobody knows who. I know who. I'm not saying. Forty years. I can keep a secret.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Carrying Without Being Seen
quests.summary: On the sixth night, you sit in the temple, hood up, and carry the whole town the way you carried the mountain. Nobody knows.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole town, breathing. Nobody knows who's holding them. They don't need to. They're held. It's lighter than being cheered.

objectives.text: Talk with Magistrate Zhou at the main street

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: A stranger has been helping everyone this week. The yamen would like to honour them. We can't find them. It's very frustrating. It's wonderful.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Everyone Knew
quests.summary: On the seventh day, you find out that everyone knew who you were. Nobody said. The whole town kept the secret.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Everyone knew. From the first day. Iron-Fang knew by the stance. Widow Liu knew by the water. We decided not to say.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: You wanted to carry us without being seen. So we let you. That's what a town does for someone it loves. It pretends.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing at the market square

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: They all knew. And they let you carry them anyway, and carried your secret. That's the Great Vehicle. Both directions. You've passed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Up the Mountain Again
quests.summary: You walk back up the nine thousand steps without the hood. At the gate, Abbess Jing bows to you. The Moon-Well is with you.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well stands with the Azure Cloud. Not because you asked. Because a whole town kept your secret for a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the town temple

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Welcome back. Lady Silk visited thirty camps while you were gone. Thirty arguments. The conclave starts tomorrow. It's going to be a mess.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Sect Master Speaks
quests.summary: The conclave opens. The Sect Master stands before forty sect masters and speaks for three minutes. Nobody moves.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Three hundred years ago two sects sealed a monster. One gave everything. The other forgot. When the fold opens, we cannot forget again.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I'm not asking you to follow the Azure Cloud. I'm asking you to walk beside it. That's all. That's the speech.

objectives.text: Make your way to the main hall

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sect masters sit in the main hall in silence. Then Ruan Hai stands and bows. Then the Zhao ancestor. Then everyone at once.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Three minutes! Everyone stood up! I cried! Wei Tong cried! A Hundred Wells elder cried! The Zhao ancestor pretended not to!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The First Argument
quests.summary: The standing ovation lasts three minutes. The first argument lasts three hours. It's about who marches in front.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale marches at the front. We have the most to avenge. Forty of our children in the ice.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan marches at the front. We have the most gold. Gold marches very well.

objectives.text: Hear what Abbess Jing has to say

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well marches wherever we're needed. That's usually the back. Where the wounded are. Nobody argues about the back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Pink Silk in the Hall
quests.summary: Lady Si Rou sits quietly through the argument. Each time she whispers to someone, the argument gets worse.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lady Si Rou leans over and whispers to the Cinder Cloud's master. He stands up and shouts at the Hundred Wells. She smiles.

objectives.text: Watch Lady Si Rou with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, silk threads run from her fingers to eleven sect masters. Thin, pink, almost invisible. Each tugs, gently, toward anger.

objectives.text: Show Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Threads. On eleven sect masters. She's puppeteering the conclave. She's the Sixth Rung. Lady Silk. Qing Luan's chart said silk.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We can't accuse an envoy in the middle of a conclave. Nobody would believe us. They'd think we're the ones pulling strings.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Cutting Threads Quietly
quests.summary: You can't accuse her. But you can cut threads, quietly, one sect master at a time, by carrying them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master Ruan. You lost forty. We'll get them out. Together. The front doesn't matter. Getting them out matters.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Yes. Yes, you're right. I don't know why I was shouting. It felt like someone else's anger. I'll march at the side.

objectives.text: Meet Ancestor Zhao at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The side is fine for the Zhao clan too. Gold looks good from any angle. I don't know why I was so angry.

quests.title: Disciples Brawl
quests.summary: The sect masters calm down. Their disciples, who have been drinking in the camps, do not.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The disciples are brawling! Forty sects' worth! In the camps! Someone started a rumour that the Iron Scale cheated at the banners!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Defeat the quarrelling disciples at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Finish the Iron Scale disciples at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Everyone's calm. Mostly. I found out who started the rumour. A servant in pink. Silk Pavilion. Of course.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: The drunk brawlers sober up. The side that started it is your oldest ally.

choices.text: Punish the side that started it

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Break it up and punish nobody

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Side with your allies regardless

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

quests.title: Collecting the Threads
quests.summary: Now you know what to look for, you can see Lady Silk's threads everywhere in the camps. You gather them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Threads everywhere. On tents. On banners. On teacups. She's woven the whole camp. Cut them. Quietly. Before she notices.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Gather the pink threads from the camps

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Forty threads. Cut. She'll notice. She'll be angry. Angry is good. Angry makes people careless. Even spiders.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Bai's Research
quests.summary: Elder Bai has been researching the Silk Pavilion. It doesn't exist. It never has.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The Silk Pavilion. Far to the south. I've read every map. There's nothing there. A lake. A very pretty lake. No sect.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Compare the Silk Pavilion's seal with the Blood Moon records

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Silk Pavilion's seal, under magnification, has a tiny crescent woven into its border. Seven threads. Six still bright.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Blood Moon. The Sixth Rung. In our conclave. In my pagoda, borrowing books. She borrowed three and returned them on time. I'm furious.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Telling the Sect Master
quests.summary: You tell the Sect Master. She listens, and smiles, and it's the most frightening smile you've ever seen.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A Rung. In my conclave. Pulling my guests' strings. In my hall.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: We don't accuse her. We let her pull, and we cut, and we carry, and when she's tired, we ask her to leave. Politely. With swords.

objectives.text: Talk with Abbess Jing at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well saw the threads too. We said nothing. We've been cutting them since the first day. Quietly. We're very good at quiet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Conclave's Second Day
quests.summary: On the second day, the threads are gone and the sect masters agree on everything. Lady Silk's servants try something louder.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Fire in the Cinder Cloud camp! And the Hundred Wells camp! Both at once! Blamed on each other! Both sects are drawing swords!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Raise the formation over both camps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Great Azure Formation rises over the camps like a hand. Blue light, and under it, both fires go out.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Moon cultivators from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Servants in pink. Both fires. The Cinder Cloud and the Hundred Wells are embracing. Crying. It's very awkward. It's lovely.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Carrying Forty
quests.summary: At the end of the second day, you sit on the formation and carry forty sects. It's heavier than a mountain. It's lighter than you feared.

objectives.text: Carry the forty sects on the formation

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, two thousand breaths. Somewhere among them, a woman in pink, holding her breath, very angry. You carry her too.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Middle stage of Body Integration. Your vehicle has room for more than you thought.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're carrying her too, aren't you. Lady Silk. I can see it on your face. You're carrying the spider.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's either very foolish or very wise. The hermit would say both. I say be careful.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Old Question
quests.summary: On the third day of the conclave, someone asks who should hold the Lotus Key. The room goes cold.

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale gave up that question at the banners. We don't raise it. But forty sects didn't give it up. They're asking.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The main hall is silent. Forty sect masters look at you. Somewhere at the back, a woman in pink silk is very still.

objectives.text: Join Ancestor Zhao at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: It's a fair question. The key opens the seal. The seal holds the Patriarch. Should one young person carry all of that?

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I ask as an old man who likes you. Not as a Zhao. Answer honestly.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: ancestor_zhao
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: An Honest Answer
quests.summary: You answer honestly. It's not the answer anyone expected.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: No. One person shouldn't carry it. That's the mistake the founders made. The Verdant Lotus gave everything and everyone forgot.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll carry the key. You carry me. All of you. When the fold opens, I walk in front, and you walk beside me. That's the only answer.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well accepts that answer. Carry the key. We'll carry the carrier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Afterwards, a small sect's master asks you privately to argue for his seat.

choices.text: Promise to argue fairly for everyone

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Argue for him; small sects need a voice

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Ask what it's worth to him

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: The Last Thread
quests.summary: Lady Silk's last thread is on the one sect master who hasn't answered. The Cinder Cloud's master stands, eyes glazed.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Cinder Cloud's master stands. His eyes are glazed pink. He says, in a voice not quite his own: the key should go to the Silk Pavilion.

objectives.text: Trace the last thread with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One thread, thick as rope, from the Cinder Cloud master to the woman in pink. She's pulling with everything she has.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She's pulling hard. Too hard. She's exposed herself. Everyone felt that. Everyone's looking at her now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Spider Runs
quests.summary: Exposed, Lady Silk doesn't fight. She runs, and her servants cover her escape with fire and pink smoke.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: She's running! Pink smoke everywhere! Her servants are throwing fire! In the main hall! That's the founder's tablet in there!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Clear the formation plaza of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Blood Moon cultivators spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The founder's tablet is safe. The faded green lotus beside it is safe. Lady Silk is gone. Down the back path. Toward Qingshi.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Conclave Decides
quests.summary: With Lady Silk gone, the conclave decides in an hour what it couldn't decide in three days.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The key stays with its bearer. Forty sects walk beside the bearer when the fold opens. The Great Vehicle. All in favour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Hear what Sect Master Ruan has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. In favour.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan. In favour. In gold.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. In favour. Singing.

quests.title: Signatures on One Scroll
quests.summary: Forty sects sign one scroll. It takes a long time. Some sects have very long names.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Forty signatures! On one scroll! The Hundred Wells has a very long name! It took them ten minutes! The scroll's going to need an extension!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The scroll of the Great Vehicle. Forty seals. I'm putting it in the pagoda. On the top shelf. Above the turtle soup. Where it belongs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Where Silk Goes
quests.summary: Lady Silk fled toward Qingshi. The hermit says spiders always go where they've already spun.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Spiders go home to their webs. She's spun in Qingshi before. Many times, I'd guess. Look for the places where people quarrel too easily.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Read Madam Fang's crane about Qingshi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A crane from Madam Fang: the town's been quarrelling for months. Over nothing. Neighbours who've been friends for forty years. It started last spring.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Last spring. When the Silk Pavilion's envoy first 'visited' the region. She's been weaving Qingshi for a year. We didn't notice.

quests.title: Webs on the Mountain
quests.summary: Before you go after her, you have to clear the webs she left on the mountain. They're in the camps, the hall, the pagoda.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Pink threads everywhere! On my twelve! On the chicken! She threaded the chicken! That's a new low!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Cut the threads from Wei Tong's disciples

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: One by one the threads snap. Wei Tong's twelve blink, shake their heads, and stop glaring at each other.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

objectives.text: Hold the outer pines against more Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The chicken's free. The chicken's fine. Qiu Hua's crying. The chicken isn't. Chickens don't cry. The chicken has seen too much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Carrying a Web
quests.summary: The hermit says: to unravel a web, you have to hold every thread at once. Only a body of many can do that.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Hold every thread at once. Every quarrel she started. Carry them all, and they'll untangle, because you'll be too heavy to pull.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Hold every thread of the web at once

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thousand quarrels. You hold them all, and they hang slack, because nobody is pulling any more. Some of them snap. Some of them become friendships.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The mountain's free of her. Now the town. Go. Take someone who's good with gossip. Actually, the town has someone better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Down to Qingshi
quests.summary: The conclave agrees to wait while you go after Lady Silk. Ruan Jingtao and Zhao Kang insist on coming.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale comes. She threaded my father. Nobody threads my father.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan comes. She threaded my great-grandfather. He's a hundred and twelve. That's elder abuse.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The bamboo bends, and so it outlives the storm.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Town That Quarrels
quests.summary: Qingshi's main street is full of people not speaking to each other. The silence is louder than shouting.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Neighbours cross the street to avoid each other. The noodle seller and the tea seller have put up a fence between their stalls.

objectives.text: Find Constable Du at the main street

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Nobody's talking. The magistrate and I had a row about a lost chicken three months ago. We haven't spoken since. It was a chicken.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: It feels like someone else's anger. I don't know how to explain it.

quests.title: Madam Fang and Iron-Fang
quests.summary: Madam Fang and Iron-Fang have argued. Over a dish. They're both miserable. Neither will apologise.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: He broke my favourite dish. On purpose, I said. By accident, he said. We haven't spoken in a month. The inn's very quiet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I didn't break it on purpose. I'd never. I love that dish. She loves that dish. I just... couldn't say it. Something stopped me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: There's a thread on both of you. Pink. Lady Silk's. Let me cut it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...I love that dish. I love this inn. Madam Fang, I'm sorry. I'll wash every dish forever. I was going to anyway.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Threads Across the Town
quests.summary: In soul sight, the whole town is laced with pink threads, and they all lead to one place.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: From the watchtower, in soul sight: pink threads across every street, every house, every friendship. They all lead to the temple.

objectives.text: Follow the threads with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The temple. Hong's old temple, where the Rust Monk prayed. At its heart, a knot of pink, pulsing, and someone sitting in it, weaving.

objectives.text: Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The temple again. That temple has had a terrible few decades. I'm going to donate to it. Heavily. After we clear the spider out.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Mending Friendships
quests.summary: Before you face her, the hermit's advice: carry the town. Cut the threads one friendship at a time.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: The noodle seller and the tea seller. Forty years they shared a stall. Now there's a fence. Help me take it down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Take down the fences in the market

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: They're sharing tea and noodles again. The noodle seller cried into the tea. It's fine. It's salty tea now. People like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Magistrate and the Constable
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou and Constable Du haven't spoken in three months. Over a chicken.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Constable Du lost my chicken. My prize chicken. Three months ago. He said it wasn't his fault.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: It wasn't my fault. It was the fox. The one from the judgement. It came back. I should have said so. Something stopped me.

objectives.text: Hear what Magistrate Zhou has to say

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: ...The fox? The clever one? Oh. Oh, Du. I'm sorry. I'm sorry. I'll buy a new chicken. We'll guard it together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Silk set the magistrate and the constable at each other's throats. The town wants one gone.

choices.text: Reconcile them, whatever it takes

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Let the law decide

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Back whoever owes you more

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Silk Servants
quests.summary: As the threads snap, Lady Silk's servants come out of hiding, desperate to reweave what's breaking.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Servants in pink! Everywhere! They're trying to reweave the threads! Stop them before they tie anyone back up!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Break the silk servants at the main street

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These silk servants fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're gone. The town's talking again. Loudly. I've never heard so many apologies at once. It's deafening.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Jin's Guild Pigeons
quests.summary: Merchant Jin's guild pigeons have been carrying messages for Lady Silk for a year. He didn't know. He's horrified.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: (nervously) W-what can I do for you, immortal? Anything. Anything at all.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: My pigeons! My guild pigeons! Carrying her messages! For a year! Through my loft! I didn't know!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Tiny scrolls, tied to pigeon legs, all in pink silk. Orders. Quarrels to start. Friendships to cut. And one scroll: the heir's friends are next.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: I'm going to burn the loft. No. I'm going to keep the pigeons and send honest messages. Forever. Just to spite her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: The Heir's Friends Are Next
quests.summary: The last scroll said the heir's friends are next. Lady Silk's threads reach up the mountain, toward everyone you love.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Your friends! Up the mountain! She's threading them! Han Xue! Wei Tong! The Xiao children! Go! Go!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Send your soul up the mountain along the threads

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your soul runs up the pink threads like fire up a fuse. On the mountain, Han Xue, Wei Tong and the Xiao children blink, and the threads fall away.

objectives.text: Stop the silk servants at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: More silk servants? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the docks

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You cut the threads on the mountain from down here? With your soul? That's Body Integration? I'm going to need to sit down.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Town Carries Back
quests.summary: Qingshi, freed from the web, does something unexpected: the whole town gathers in the square and holds hands. For you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The immortal who helps! My grandmother lit incense for you.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The whole town. In the square. Holding hands. The magistrate's idea. He said the immortal carries us. We should carry back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Stand in the circle of the town

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thousand hands, and you in the middle. The town carries you. It's the lightest you've ever been. Your vehicle grows wider.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the main street

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've never held so many hands. I'm going to make a speech. One word. Hold. We held. I held. We all held.

quests.title: The Spider in the Temple
quests.summary: Lady Silk has nowhere left to spin. She's in the temple, at the centre of a web that's falling apart. And then she isn't.

objectives.text: Make your way to the town temple

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The temple is empty. At its heart, a knot of pink silk, unravelling, and a note in a beautiful hand.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I came down. I'm not threaded any more. She left a note. It says: come to the conclave's last night. I'll be the guest of honour.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: She's going back up the mountain. Into the middle of forty sects. For one last trick.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Feast
quests.summary: The conclave's last feast. Forty sects on the formation plaza. Every lantern lit. Every guard watching. One empty seat.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty sects, one feast, one empty seat. She said she'd come. She will. Spiders keep their appointments.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Long tables on the plaza, lanterns on every pillar. At the head table, one seat is empty, draped in pink silk.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The empty seat's got pink silk on it! Nobody put it there! It was just there! I'm not sitting near it! I'm sitting near Wei Tong!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Watching Every Face
quests.summary: At the feast, everyone watches everyone. It makes for very awkward conversation.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone's watching everyone. Nobody's eating. It's the worst feast ever. I'm eating. Somebody has to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Join Abbess Jing at the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well sings when it's nervous. We're about to sing. I apologise in advance.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: At my age, every feast might be the last. This one might actually be. I'm going to have the duck.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The Wine
quests.summary: Halfway through the feast, you notice the wine. Every cup on every table has a thread of pink in it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Every cup of wine on every table has a single pink thread floating in it, curled like a question mark.

objectives.text: Pull the threads from the wine with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two thousand threads rise out of two thousand cups at once and drift together, twisting, into a single silk rope above the empty seat.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Silk in the wine. If everyone had drunk it... forty sects, threaded at once. She'd have had the whole alliance on a string.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The feast wine is threaded with silk. Announcing it means panic; silence means someone may drink.

choices.text: Announce it at once

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Swap the wine quietly, as protocol says

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Let the enemy's guests drink it

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Servants at the Tables
quests.summary: When the threads leave the wine, Lady Silk's servants, disguised as serving staff, drop their trays.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The servers! Half of them are hers! Trays down, knives out! Protect the sect masters!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Defeat the silk servants at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The silk servants have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the silk servants that follow
Look for Ruan Jingtao at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: My father hit one with a duck. A whole roast duck. He says it's the best thing he's done in years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Guest of Honour Arrives
quests.summary: The silk rope above the empty seat twists, and becomes a woman in pink. The guest of honour has arrived.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: She's here! In the seat! She came out of the rope! I'm ringing the bell! I'm ringing it so hard!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Raise the formation around the feast

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Great Azure Formation rises, blue, around every table. Two thousand guests inside it. One woman in pink, outside, smiling.

objectives.text: Drive the Blood Guards from the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master after the fight

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everyone's inside the formation. She's outside it, alone. Go. The whole alliance is watching. Carry them into this fight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Lady Silk Speaks
quests.summary: Lady Silk speaks to you from outside the formation, very politely, as if you were old friends.

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: Si Rou. Sixth Rung. Every alliance is a web, heir. I merely spin faster. You untangled mine. How rude. How impressive.

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: Five of my brothers and sisters gone. My thread is the last strong one before the Shadow. Come and cut it, if you can.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'm not coming alone, Lady Silk.

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: No. I see that. Forty sects. What a heavy vehicle. Let's see if it breaks.

objectives.text: Hear what Lu Ping has to say

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: We're done at here. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Meet Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

quests.title: The Sixth Rung Falls
quests.summary: On the formation plaza, before forty sects, you face Lady Silk. She fights with thread and knife and smile.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lady Silk steps onto the plaza. Silk unspools from her sleeves like water. Two thousand people watch from behind the formation's light.

objectives.name: Si Rou, Lady Silk
objectives.text: Bring down Si Rou, Lady Silk

dialogue.speaker: rung_si
dialogue.text: Such lovely manners. Such soft throats. Let's see how much you can carry, heir, when I cut the straps.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Everything. They're carrying me too.

objectives.text: Stand over the fallen Sixth Rung

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Si Rou lies on the plaza. Her silk unravels around her. You carried them, she says. I only pulled. I never learned to carry. Her star goes out.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Six. Six stars out. One left. The Shadow. The one nobody's seen. Forty sects watched you do it. They're cheering. Listen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: The Feast, Properly
quests.summary: With Lady Silk gone, the feast begins again. Properly this time. Wei Tong makes sure of it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Feast! Properly! No threads! No knives! Just duck and noodles and forty sects being ridiculous! Eat! Everyone eat!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Carry dishes to all forty tables
Raise a cup to the alliance

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two thousand cups, raised together. No threads in any of them. The Moon-Well sings. The Iron Scale shouts. Thunder Peak shouts louder.

objectives.text: Find Abbess Jing at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Great Vehicle. Forty sects in one feast. Three hundred years since anyone saw this. Enjoy it. It won't come again for a while.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more medicine bundles than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Carrying Two Thousand
quests.summary: After the feast, you sit on the empty plaza and carry everyone who was at it. Two thousand people. It's light.

objectives.text: Carry the whole alliance in stillness

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Two thousand breaths, and more beyond them: towns, villages, mountains. Your vehicle is vast now, and still light. Late stage of Body Integration.

objectives.text: Join the hermit at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You carried her too. At the end. Lady Silk. I saw it. She died being carried. That's more than most Rungs get.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: A careful choice. Neither soft nor cruel.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

quests.title: One Left
quests.summary: Qing Luan's last crane before the isles sealed said the seventh star was different. Now you understand why.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One star left. The Seventh Rung. The Patriarch's Shadow. Nobody's ever seen them. Gu doesn't know. Ye Wuming doesn't know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Whoever it is, they're closest to him. When they fall, the Ladder is gone. And the fold, Qing Luan said, will have to open.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One left. Tomorrow, the alliance swears its oath. Then we get ready. For the Shadow. And for the sky.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Carving the Oath
quests.summary: The oath is to be carved on a new stele beside the Nine Precepts at the gate. Forty sects, forty lines.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A new stele. Beside the Nine Precepts. Forty lines, one for each sect. The oath of the Great Vehicle. Carve the first line.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A new stele stands beside the old one at the gate. The Nine Precepts on the left. On the right, blank stone, waiting for forty lines.

objectives.text: Carve the first line of the oath

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You carve: when the fold opens, we walk together. The Azure Cloud. Then you hand the chisel to Ruan Hai.

objectives.text: Hear what Sect Master Ruan has to say

dialogue.speaker: master_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. We walk together. And we remember. I'll carve that. My hands are shaking. Old hands. Good hands.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Forty Lines
quests.summary: Each sect carves one line. Some are solemn. Some are not. All of them are true.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan. We walk together, in gold. I've carved it very neatly. I've been practising calligraphy for a century.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Meet Abbess Jing at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. We walk together, singing. Lian carved it. Her hand was steady. Mine wouldn't have been.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.text: Talk with Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The Hundred Wells carved theirs and it took twenty minutes! The Cinder Cloud carved a joke! About the Hundred Wells! Everyone laughed! Even the Hundred Wells!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: A Ledger of Forty Letters
quests.summary: Steward Qian insists on a system: every sect writes monthly. He will keep the ledger. He's never been so happy.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (forcing a smile) Immortal. We've paid, haven't we? We've paid.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Everyone knows your kindness. Here, have a peach.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Monthly letters! Forty sects! A ledger! I'll track every letter! Every reply! Every late one! This is the best day of my career!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Collect the sects' first monthly letters

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty letters. All on time. Well, thirty-nine. The Zhao clan's was early. Of course it was. Gold is always early.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Ruan Jingtao's Farewell
quests.summary: Ruan Jingtao leaves with the Iron Scale. He wants a spar before he goes. It's how the Iron Scale says goodbye, apparently. Also the Zhao clan.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: A spar before I go. The Iron Scale says goodbye with swords. So does the Zhao clan, Zhao Kang says. Everybody says goodbye with swords except the Moon-Well.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well says goodbye with songs.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: ...Maybe we should all try songs. After the spar. Pick up a sword.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Draw. Obviously. Draws are the only honest ending between friends. See you at the fold. I'll be the one in green, shouting.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Tide Goes Out
quests.summary: As the sects leave, the wraiths that followed them come with them, drifting after the last banners down the steps.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wraiths trailing the last banners. Like gulls after boats. Clear them before they follow anyone home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Clear the sect gate of void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The void wraiths spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Hold the outer pines against more void wraiths

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The steps are clear. The last banners are gone. The mountain's quiet. I miss the noise. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Zhao Ancestor's Last Words
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu stays a day longer than the others. He's a hundred and fourteen. He wants to say something.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: I'm a hundred and fourteen. I may not be alive when the fold opens. My great-grandson will march in my place.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Look after him. He's very bad at being looked after. He complains. Let him. It's how he knows he's loved.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He said that? About me? To you? ...He's going to live forever, that old man. He's too stubborn to die. Like me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ancestor Zhao asks you to hide his failing health from his clan.

choices.text: Keep his secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Tell Zhao Kang. He has a right to know.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Use it for the alliance's advantage

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: An Empty Mountain
quests.summary: With the sects gone, the mountain feels empty. The hermit says the Great Vehicle includes carrying absence.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Empty mountain. Two thousand people gone home. Carry them anyway. They're still there, on their own mountains. Carry the distance too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Carry the departed sects from the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, forty mountains, scattered across the land. You carry them all, even from here. The distance is light.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: You're getting good at this. Too good. Heaven will notice soon. It always notices people who carry too much.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Qing Luan's Last Crane
quests.summary: A crane arrives from the closed Sky Isles, dim and flickering. Qing Luan's voice, very faint.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A crane! From the isles! They're closed! How did it get out? It's very dim! It's saying your name!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Listen to Qing Luan's faint crane

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lotus child. Six stars out. The seventh is moving. Toward the Abyss. And heaven is leaning down to look at you. Your tribulation is coming.

objectives.text: Show the Sect Master what you found

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Your tribulation. Heaven's noticed. Years yet, maybe. But it's started. The last stage before the sky: Tribulation Transcendence.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: What Comes After the Body
quests.summary: The Sect Master explains the stage beyond: not a realm you reach, but a sky you survive.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mahayana first. Then Tribulation Transcendence. You don't reach that one. Heaven sends it. Nine bolts, and the ninth is the heart. You survive it, or you don't.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Nobody from the Azure Cloud has faced it in three hundred years. Your founder did. She survived. Barely. She never talked about the ninth bolt.

objectives.text: Join Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Years yet. We'll prepare. We'll break the last Rung. We'll open the fold. Then the sky. In that order. Nobody skip ahead.

quests.title: Letters From Forty Mountains
quests.summary: A month later, forty letters arrive on time. Steward Qian reads them all aloud at dinner. Nobody minds.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty letters! On time! The Iron Scale's training! The Moon-Well's singing! The Zhao clan's rich! The Hundred Wells has a new well!

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I've never been so happy to count anything. Forty. Every month. For as long as it takes.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the formation plaza isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A School in the Ruins
quests.summary: The hermit has turned the Verdant Lotus ruins into a school. Three hundred young disciples from forty sects. One old man.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred children. Forty sects. One old man. And you. Mostly you. I'm very old. I get tired after lunch.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ruins' courtyard is full of children in forty colours, sitting in rows, arguing about which verse of the sutra is best.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: They're arguing. About the sutra. Three hundred years of silence in these ruins and now they're arguing. It's the best sound I've ever heard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Teaching Roots
quests.summary: Your first lesson: the root. Patience. Three hundred children are not patient.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I'm helping teach! I'm teaching roots! Patience! They're very impatient about patience!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I'm teaching them to count breaths. Four in, four out. The Iron Scale children count loudly. The Moon-Well children sing it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.text: Meet Xiao Man at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I'm teaching herbs. I've only dropped four. The children think dropping is part of the lesson. I'm not correcting them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Old Sentinels, New Students
quests.summary: The ruins' old stone sentinels don't understand children. The children want to fight them. Carefully.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}! The juniors want to know if you're real. I told them barely.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The sentinels woke up when the children arrived. They think it's an invasion. It kind of is. Show the students how. Carefully.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The sentinels have sat down. The children are climbing them. The sentinels seem... happy? Can stone be happy? These look happy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: The training ledger says three puppets broke today. Nobody saw who broke them.

choices.text: Own up and pay for them

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Repair them yourself, quietly

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Blame the juniors

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Sutra Slips for Everyone
quests.summary: Every child needs a copy of the sutra. The hermit has one. The drowned archive has more, if someone will dive.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The archive under the courtyard. Dry now, mostly. There are copies of the sutra down there. Hundreds. Bring them up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Carry sutra slips up from the archive

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred copies. For three hundred children. My masters wrote these for a school that died. Now there's a school again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Copying the sutra for everyone breaks the Pagoda's rule against sharing its texts.

choices.text: Share them anyway

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Ask Elder Bai for an exception

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Sell the copies

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Wolves Come to Class
quests.summary: The forest's wolves have come to see what the noise is. The children want to pet them. Some of them shouldn't be petted.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Grey wolves at the edge of the clearing, curious. The children are delighted. One wolf has purple eyes.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Spirit wolves ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Talk it over with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Void-touched wolves near children. I don't like it. I'll stay with the school. My own children can help. They know about being scared.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Children Teach
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children, once the Blood Moon's, now teach the alliance's children how to tell a trap from a friend.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Spring's teaching. River's teaching. Small Mountain's teaching the youngest ones to hide. He's very good at hiding. It's his gift.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: They were weapons once. Now they're teachers. That's the whole war, isn't it. Turning weapons into teachers.

objectives.text: Talk with Abbess Jing at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well children are learning from Blood Moon children. Three hundred years ago that would have been a war. Now it's a class.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Abbess Jing asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: You walk your own road. Mind it doesn't walk off a cliff.

quests.title: Teaching the Blossom
quests.summary: The last lesson is the blossom: compassion. The hermit asks you to teach it. He says he only just learned it himself.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The blossom. You teach it. I only learned it last year, from a hollow man. You've been living it since you were a child.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Teach the blossom to three hundred children

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You don't explain it. You carry them, all three hundred, and let them feel it. One by one, they go quiet. Then they carry each other.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Three hundred children, carrying each other. In my masters' courtyard. I'm going to cry. I'm old. I'm allowed.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Wraiths at the School
quests.summary: Wraiths come for the school at night, drawn by three hundred young souls. The children stay calm. They were taught.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Wraiths at the ruins! Three hundred children! Stay calm! ...They are calm. They're counting breaths. All of them. Together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Raise the old Verdant Lotus ward over the school

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ward rises green over the courtyard, stronger than ever, fed by three hundred children counting breaths at once.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the ruins gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The void wraiths come on in silence.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of void wraiths
Catch your breath with Wei Tong

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I came to bring food for three hundred children and walked into a battle. The children are fine. The food is fine. I'm fine. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Hermit's Successor
quests.summary: The hermit has been watching one child especially: Qiu Hua, Wei Tong's disciple, the girl with the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Qiu Hua. The girl with the chicken. She reached the blossom today. Nine years old. It took me three hundred.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the margin of her sutra copy, in a nine-year-old's hand: the chicken is also carrying me. Beside it, a drawing of a chicken.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: She'll teach it after me. The Verdant Lotus has a future. A future that brings a chicken to class. My masters would approve.

quests.title: The School Stays
quests.summary: The alliance decides the school will stay. Every year, forty sects will send children to the Verdant Lotus ruins.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The school stays. Every year. Forty sects' children, in the Verdant Lotus ruins. The Moon-Well will send teachers. And songs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Find the hermit at the hermit's hut

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The Verdant Lotus is a school now. Not a sect. A school. That's better. Sects fall. Schools grow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Forty Sects at the Rim
quests.summary: Forty sects' fighters gather at the Abyss rim. It's the largest army the world has seen in three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty sects at the rim. Not to march. Not yet. To seal the rifts. To practise walking together. Carry them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Make your way to the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The canyon rim is a sea of banners: green, gold, white, blue, and forty more. The fold hums below them like a disturbed hive.

objectives.text: Join Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Forty sects. At the rim. My children are crying. They never imagined anyone would come. Now everyone has.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Fold-Born Guards
quests.summary: The fold feels forty sects at its edge, and spits out everything it has.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: They're coming out of the fold! Guards made of nothing! Iron Scale, left flank! We practised this! On Remembering Hill!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Stop the fold-born guards at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fold-born guards spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Finish the void wraiths at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Forty sects fighting as one. I've never seen anything like it. Nobody has. For three hundred years, nobody has.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Rift Shards for Forty Wards
quests.summary: Each sect needs a shard from the fold to anchor its ward. You gather them, one for each sect.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Each sect needs a shard to anchor its ward. Forty shards. Forty wards. One ring around the fold.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Gather forty shards from the fold's edge

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: Forty shards, forty wards. The Moon-Well will sing while we set them. Everyone else will shout. It'll be very noisy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the void shards you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: abbess_jing
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Forty Wards Around the Fold
quests.summary: Forty sects set forty wards around the fold at once. You hold them all together.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty wards rise around the fold like a crown of light. Each one flickers. Each one needs someone to hold it steady.

objectives.text: Hold all forty wards at once

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hold them all. Forty sects, forty wards, one ring. The fold shudders, and shrinks, and for the first time since it formed, stops leaking.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It stopped. The fold stopped leaking. Forty sects did that. You did that. We all did that. I'm going to sit down on this bone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Gu at the Rim
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains, watches the forty wards rise. He asks to say something to the alliance.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I betrayed the Azure Cloud. I fed children to the Abyss. I altered the formation that killed Mo Changfeng.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: And I am here, in chains, watching forty sects do what I thought was impossible. I was wrong about everything. That's all. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: He asked me to let him say it. I let him. Some things should be said in front of everyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Fold's Guardian
quests.summary: The fold doesn't like the wards. Something enormous climbs out of it: a colossus of nothing, built to guard the door.

objectives.text: Hurry to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The fold bulges. Out of it climbs a colossus of purple stone and nothing, taller than the canyon wall, eyes like holes in the sky.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: It's huge! It's very, very huge! Forty sects, one giant! I like those odds! I'm lying! Hit it anyway!

objectives.text: Seal the colossus back into the fold

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The colossus falls, and the forty wards pull it back into the fold, and the fold closes behind it like a mouth closing on a secret.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty sects and a giant. Iron-Fang's men fought beside the Zhao clan. The Zhao clan paid us. In gold. We gave it back. We're honest now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: What's Left
quests.summary: With the colossus sealed, the last wraiths wander the bone field, lost. The alliance hunts them together.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old war camp is overrun with lost wraiths, drifting, purposeless now that the fold has stopped feeding them.

objectives.text: Defeat the void wraiths at the war camp
