dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Void wraiths! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Gather the demon cores they leave
Tell Wei Tong what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I brought food for forty sects! To the Abyss! It's a very bad place for a picnic! We're having one anyway!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: On the bone field: Blood Moon survivors, old men and women, begging for passage.

choices.text: Take them in

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Register them for the alliance's judgement

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Leave them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: A Picnic in the Abyss
quests.summary: Wei Tong's picnic for forty sects on the bone field is the strangest meal anyone has ever eaten. Everyone attends.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumplings for forty sects! On the bone field! It's disgusting here! Eat anyway! For morale! For Elder Mo!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Raise a cup at the rim with forty sects

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, eating dumplings on a field of bones, under a sky the colour of a bruise. Somebody laughs. Then everybody laughs.

objectives.text: Meet Abbess Jing at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: A picnic. In the Abyss. The Moon-Well will sing about this for a hundred years. It'll be a very strange song.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: A Vehicle for Ten Thousand
quests.summary: At the rim, with forty sects around you and the fold sealed below, you carry them all, and your Body Integration reaches Great Perfection.

objectives.text: Carry ten thousand in the stillness of the depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ten thousand souls. Forty sects. Villages beyond them. You carry them all, and far above, heaven's attention settles on you like weather.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Great Perfection of Body Integration. The sky is leaning down to look at you. Your tribulation is gathering.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I felt it. Heaven, looking at you. The whole alliance felt it. Your tribulation isn't years away any more. It's gathering.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Hm. Measured. I can live with measured.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Heaven Takes Notice
quests.summary: On the way home, the sky over the sect is strange: clouds turning slowly in a spiral, directly above your room.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The clouds over the sect are spiralling. Directly over your room. Wei Tong says it's weather. It's not weather.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: It's heaven. Taking notice. Qing Luan was right. The last stage before the sky is starting. Tribulation Transcendence.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Heart Mirror lies still and black. You do not look into it for long.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The clouds are loud today. Or I am tired. One of us should rest.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Stair Without Waiting
quests.summary: A stair of cloud unrolls over the sect, years early, for no one but you. The whole mountain comes out in its nightclothes again.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The stair! Again! Years early! Everyone's in their nightclothes again! Elder Bai's still got the turtles!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair of cloud descends from the spiral above your room, step by step, and stops at your feet. Only yours.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Heaven opened my isles for you. Without asking me. Rude. Also flattering. Mostly rude. Come in.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You've caught heaven's eye, lotus child. That's either the best thing that can happen to a cultivator, or the last.

quests.title: The Spiral Over the Mountain
quests.summary: From the isles, Qing Luan shows you the spiral in the clouds from above. It is centred exactly on you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below the isles, a spiral of cloud turns over the Azure Cloud Sect, slow and vast. At its centre, the roof of your room.

objectives.text: Read heaven's spiral on the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chart shows the spiral too, and within it, nine faint rings. Nine bolts. One ring is brighter than the rest: the ninth. The heart.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Nine bolts. Like your founder's. The ninth is the heart. She never told anyone what it was. I watched. I didn't understand.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: Storm Wolves Gather
quests.summary: Heaven's attention charges the isles. The storm wolves are crackling, restless, drawn to you like iron to a lodestone.

objectives.text: Make your way to the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves pace the spirit vein, fur crackling, eyes fixed on you. Every one of them is humming the same note as the clouds.

objectives.text: Drive the storm wolves from the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Gather the charged crystals they guard
Show Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The wolves are following you. The lightning is following you. Everything's following you. I'm following you. It's a parade.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Qing Luan Is Worried
quests.summary: Qing Luan is worried. She never worries. She's a memory. Memories don't worry.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I'm worried. I don't worry. I'm ten thousand years old and I've never worried. It's very uncomfortable.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Heaven's early. The Patriarch is waiting. The Seventh Rung is somewhere. And you're very young to be struck by lightning.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then we prepare. Crystals. Rods. Training. Everything. Early. Like heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Standing Where Heaven Looks
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to stand on the isle where heaven's eye is brightest and let it look. Not fight it. Be seen.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Let heaven look at you. Don't hide. Don't fight. Be seen. Heaven hates being hidden from. It punishes that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sky looks at you. Not the clouds. Behind the clouds. Something vast and not unkind, weighing you the way a teacher weighs a student.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It liked what it saw. I think. Heaven's very hard to read. It frowned. That's good. It frowns at people it's interested in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Sentinels That Know
quests.summary: The palace sentinels know what heaven's eye means. They come to test whether you deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came up the stair! We're here for the lightning! Where's the lightning? Oh. Sentinels. Also fine!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Clear the celestial ruins of celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Cut down the storm wolves that follow

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: They bowed. After we beat them. The sentinels bowed to you. Thunder Peak has never been bowed to by a building.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade
quests.summary: Qing Luan says tribulations leave jade behind: the ground remembers lightning. There are old seams on the peak's slopes.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Tribulation jade. Where lightning struck cultivators before you, the ground turned to jade. It remembers. It can teach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Gather tribulation jade from the old strikes

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Hold one. Feel it? That's someone's third bolt, ten thousand years ago. They survived. The jade is proud of them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The richest seam of tribulation jade runs under a village shrine on the slope.

choices.text: Leave the shrine alone

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Buy the land properly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Dig it up anyway

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Peak From Afar
quests.summary: From the isle of winds, you look at the tribulation peak. It's quiet. Black rings. And someone standing on it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Across the gap, the tribulation peak. Black rings on the summit. And on the highest ring, very small, a figure in dark red, looking back.

objectives.text: Look at the figure through the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chart shows the seventh red star directly over the peak. The figure beneath it waves, once, and steps into a rift, and is gone.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Seventh Rung. On my peak. Looking at you. The Patriarch's Shadow. Nobody's seen them. Until now. Now they want to be seen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Heaven's Timetable
quests.summary: Qing Luan says she can't tell when the tribulation will come. Only that it's closer than anyone thought.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A year. Two. Less. Heaven doesn't keep calendars. It keeps promises. It's promised you lightning. It'll deliver.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Prepare. And before you prepare, break through. You're ready. You've been ready since the Great Vehicle.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stone cloud gate frames nothing but sky, as if heaven were a room next door.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: If you get hurt, I'll be very annoyed. Don't annoy me.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Mahayana
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, under heaven's eye, you take the last step before the sky: preparing to transcend.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Mahayana. The Great Vehicle, as a realm. Everyone you carry, carrying you. Sit at the gate. Let heaven's eye fill you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Set tribulation jade around the gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Heaven's eye settles on you, and you don't flinch. Qi, soul, body, vehicle: everything you are rises to meet it, and holds.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Far above, very faint, the first rumble of a storm that has been gathering for ten thousand years, and is gathering for you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The storm is vast and oddly quiet. It falls on everyone you carry, and through them, on you.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Mahayana. The first in three hundred years. The storm's gathering. So are we. Come home. We've work to do.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Bai's Delta
quests.summary: Elder Bai has read every book on tribulations. His plan: split the lightning like a river delta, with crystals.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Split the lightning! Like a river delta! Crystals on the summit, drawing off the bolts! Your founder did it! I think! The page is smudged!

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals. The strongest. From the isles. Go. I'll draw the delta. On my ceiling. Next to Xiao Shi's map.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spirit vein glitters with crystals, blue and humming. You'll need ninety-nine. There are, at a guess, ninety-eight.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine? Your librarian is an optimist. The vein will give what it can. Ask nicely. It remembers the rust.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Asking the Vein Nicely
quests.summary: The spirit vein remembers the Rust Monk, and you, who healed it. It gives its crystals freely.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It remembers you healed it. It's giving you its best. Take them gently. They're very old and very proud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Harvest crystals from the grateful vein

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Forty. The vein gave forty of its best. It's never given anyone more than three. It likes you. Everything likes you. It's exhausting.

quests.title: Shadows at the Vein
quests.summary: Shadow-born things step out of rifts at the vein, grabbing crystals. The Seventh Rung wants them too.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Shadows! Out of the rifts! Grabbing crystals! Whoever the Seventh Rung is, they want your delta broken before you build it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They took three. Only three. We'll need more. The Seventh Rung is playing a very long game. So are we.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Storm Wolf Crystals
quests.summary: The storm wolves carry crystals in their fur. They'll let them go, if you're faster than lightning.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Storm wolves race across the Isle of Winds, crystals glittering in their fur like frost. They're very fast. So are you now.

objectives.text: Break the storm wolves at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The storm wolves have found you first.

objectives.text: Gather the crystals the wolves shed
Share your findings with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: You outran a storm wolf! Thunder Peak has been trying for three hundred years! We're carving it on the forge! Next to your name!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Crystal Heart
quests.summary: At the vein's deepest point, beneath the ruins, lies a crystal heart that can charge all the others at once.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the ruins, a cavern of blue light. At its centre, a crystal the size of a house, beating slowly, like a heart.

objectives.text: Gather the shards around the crystal heart
Charge the crystals at the heart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You set the crystals around the heart. It beats faster. Each crystal brightens with its pulse until they all beat together.

objectives.text: Stop the celestial sentinels at the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The heart's ancient guardians stir on the old serpent's isle, and come to see who woke it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The charged crystals hum in your pack like a hive of lightning. Ninety of them. Nearly enough.

quests.title: The Jiao Remembers
quests.summary: A shadow passes over the isles: a great serpent, storm-grey, circling. The Jiao you freed has come back.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The Jiao! It's come back! It remembers you! Look, it's carrying something in its claws!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Make your way to the serpent's isle

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Jiao circles once and drops nine crystals at your feet, each as large as a fist and humming with stored storm. Then it bows its great head.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you, great one. We're even now.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Jiao rumbles, which might be a laugh, and sinks into the clouds.

quests.title: Ninety-Nine
quests.summary: Ninety crystals from the vein and the wolves, nine from the Jiao. Ninety-nine. Exactly what Elder Bai asked for.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals, each humming a different note. Together they sound like the sky clearing its throat.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath the humming, faint, one crystal is off-key. A shadow is curled inside it, very small, listening.

objectives.text: Tell Han Xue what you found

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A shadow in a crystal. Listening. The Seventh Rung put a spy in our delta. Crush it. No. Wait. Let it listen. Let's tell it lies.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Lies for a Shadow
quests.summary: Han Xue has a plan: let the Seventh Rung's spy hear a false plan. Wei Tong is terrible at lying. That's why it'll work.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Talk near the crystal. Loudly. Say the delta goes on the eastern slope. It'll go on the western one. The shadow will report east.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The delta goes on the EASTERN slope! The EASTERN one! Definitely not the western one! I've never heard of the western one!

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...That's perfect. That's the worst lie I've ever heard. They'll believe it completely.

objectives.choice_prompt: To fool Xue Chen's shadows, you must lie to your own disciples too.

choices.text: Lie, and apologise afterwards

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Tell them the truth and trust them

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Use them as unknowing bait

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Carrying Crystals Down
quests.summary: Carrying ninety-nine charged crystals down the cloud stair, with shadows snapping at your heels.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals down a staircase made of cloud with shadows chasing us. I've had worse days. I can't remember when.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These shadow-born fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Hold the cloud gate against more storm wolves

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Down you go. Keep them dry. Keep them humming. And tell your librarian the delta was a good idea. It was your founder's, too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Crystals in the Pagoda
quests.summary: Elder Bai stores the ninety-nine crystals in the pagoda, under the ceiling map. The pagoda hums all night.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Ninety-nine crystals! In my pagoda! Humming! I can't sleep! I don't want to sleep! I'm going to read by them!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The eastern slope! I told the shadow the eastern slope! Did it work? Han Xue says it worked. I'm a spy now. A terrible spy. The best terrible spy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Shadows Drinking at the Rim
quests.summary: Ye Wuming sends Spring with a message: shadows are drinking blood from the fold's edge, and something is watching them.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The sect hasn't tamed you. Good.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Shadows at the rim. Drinking from the fold's edge. The Seventh Rung's. And something's watching them drink. Someone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the rim, shadow-born things crouch at the fold's edge, lapping at the dark. Something else watches from the obelisk ring. Very still.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Forty sects' wards held the fold for a year. The shadows are wearing them thin. Drinking them. Someone taught them how.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: The Shadow-Born
quests.summary: The shadow-born things are made of the Patriarch's own darkness. They're faster than wraiths, and they don't fear light.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: These don't flinch at wards! These don't flinch at anything! These are new! I hate new!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: More shadow-born? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: They're made of him. The Patriarch. His own shadow, cut into pieces. The Seventh Rung isn't just his servant. They're his shadow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Guards: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Watcher at the Ring
quests.summary: At the obelisk ring, a young man in dark red sits on a stump, watching. He doesn't wave. He bows.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A young man in dark red sits on an obelisk stump. Red eyes. A face that looks almost familiar. He stands, and bows, very correctly.

objectives.text: Look at the young man with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight he is two things at once: a young man, frightened, and a shadow cast by something enormous behind the fold.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: Xue Chen. Seventh Rung. The Patriarch's Shadow. I was born in his shadow. I've never been anywhere else. I wanted to see you.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: You're the one who writes back. And gives rain. And carries spiders. He's very curious about you. So am I.

quests.title: Willow Creek
quests.summary: Xue Chen says a name that stops your heart: Willow Creek. He was born there, too. Before he was taken.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. I was born there. Taken at three. My mother was a cousin of yours, I think. Everyone there was someone's cousin.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: The Patriarch raised me in his shadow. I've never seen the sun properly. It's very bright. I don't like it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You could leave his shadow.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...No. I'm the last rung. Without me, he falls. He's the only father I've ever had. I'll see you at the peak, cousin.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The blood pools is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Speak. The Law Hall listens, even when it does not answer.

quests.title: The Shadow Leaves
quests.summary: Xue Chen steps into a rift, and his shadow-born cover his escape.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: He's gone! Into a rift! His shadows are everywhere! Iron-Fang's men, hold the rim!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Clear the obelisk ring of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Moon cultivators at the war camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: A boy. The last rung is a boy. Taken at three. Like my men's children. Like Ye's children. I don't want to hit a boy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Gu Knew Him
quests.summary: Gu Hanshan, in chains at the rim, says he knew Xue Chen as a child. He tried to save him. He failed.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Xue Chen. I saw him once, when he was five. In the Patriarch's shadow. I tried to take him out with Lan's soul. I failed at both.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He's not evil. He's never been anywhere else. The Patriarch is his whole world. Breaking him will break a child.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I was that child. Once. Nobody broke me. Somebody stole me back. Maybe that's the answer. Not breaking. Stealing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Shadow's Trail
quests.summary: Xue Chen's shadow-born leave a trail of drained blood lotus toward the heart mirror. He's been visiting it.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Heart Mirror lies still and black. Around it, drained blood lotus, grey and brittle. Someone sits here often, looking in.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-born spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather the drained lotus around the mirror
Show Xiao Shi what you found

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: He comes here to look at himself. In the mirror. I know that. I used to look at myself in puddles in the cage, to remember my face.

quests.title: What the Shadow Sees
quests.summary: You look into the Heart Mirror where Xue Chen sits. It shows you what he sees there.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The mirror shows a boy of three, in Willow Creek, holding his mother's hand, laughing. The mirror shows it over and over.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: That's what he comes to see. Not a monster. Not a rung. A boy in a village by a creek, with his mother, before the shadow.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: He comes to see himself before. Every day. That's the saddest thing I've ever heard. Don't cry. I'm not crying either.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Steal Him Back
quests.summary: Ye Wuming says it again, on the way back: not breaking. Stealing back. Like someone stole him.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: When the time comes, try to steal him back. Before you break him. Like someone stole me. If it can't be done, then break him.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: But try. Please. For the boy in the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll try, Ye Wuming. For the boy in the mirror.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Gu at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Stealing the shadow back needs a relic from a Willow Creek grave.

choices.text: Ask the villagers' permission

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: The law. I used to believe it mattered most.

choices.text: Borrow it at night and return it after

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. The Law Hall would have your hide.

choices.text: Take it and keep it

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: I know that look. I wore it for twenty years.

quests.title: Thinking of Willow Creek
quests.summary: At the rim, you sit and remember Willow Creek. The creek. The willows. A cousin you never knew you had.

objectives.text: Remember Willow Creek in the depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A creek, a willow, a woman singing. Your mother. And somewhere, a cousin's child, laughing, three years old, before the shadow came.

objectives.text: Find Iron-Fang at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. The village I burned. Twenty years ago. His mother might have... I don't know. I'll carry that too. Iron-Fang carries two.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Stray Lightning
quests.summary: Elder Bai explains the danger: the tribulation strikes you, but the storm is enormous, and stray bolts can burn the sect.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The tribulation strikes you. But the storm around it is vast. Stray bolts. Your founder's tribulation burned half a forest. We have a sect.

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: Lightning rods. Nine. Around the mountain. Star iron and crystal. Thunder Peak knows how. Ask them. Don't let them shout at you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The spiral of cloud over the sect is lower today. The air tastes of metal. Somewhere far above, heaven is clearing its throat.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Lightning rods! Thunder Peak has been waiting for this day for three hundred years! We have designs! Very loud designs!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Qian's Budget
quests.summary: Steward Qian has costed nine lightning rods. He is crying. He is also, strangely, smiling.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Nine rods. Star iron. Crystal caps. Thunder Peak's labour, which is loud. It's the most expensive thing the sect has ever built.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: And I don't care. For the first time in my life, I don't care what it costs. It protects everyone. Don't tell anyone. I have a reputation.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Steward Qian said 'I don't care what it costs'! Out loud! I heard it! I'm writing it on the gate!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Even Qian's tears won't cover nine lightning rods. The rest must come from somewhere.

choices.text: Cut your own allowance first

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Levy the town, as the charter allows

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Squeeze Merchant Jin until he pays

reply.speaker: gate_lu
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Star Iron for Nine Rods
quests.summary: Nine rods need star iron. The Thunder Peak forge has old anvils. They'll have to be melted. Yan Tie is heartbroken and proud.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The old anvils. Melted. For rods. Three hundred years of anvils. Thunder Peak weeps. Thunder Peak also says yes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Nine anvils. Nine rods. Thunder Peak's history, protecting everyone. That's what history's for. We'll carve new anvils. Louder ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Wolves Want the Iron
quests.summary: The peak thunder wolves love star iron. They follow the anvils down the mountain, hopefully.

objectives.text: Make your way to the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Thunder wolves follow the anvil carts down the path, tongues out, crackling, like dogs following a butcher's cart.

objectives.text: Break the peak thunder wolves at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Gather the sparks the wolves shed
Share your findings with Yan Tie

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Rumble followed us all the way down! He wants to help! He's licking the rods! It's actually charging them! Good boy!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Raising the First Rod
quests.summary: The first rod goes up at the cliff edge, where the lightning always strikes first. You set its crystal cap.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A rod of star iron, twice the height of the main hall, rises at the cliff edge. It hums as the spiral above turns.

objectives.text: Set the crystal cap on the first rod

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystal cap clicks into place. Above, a single thread of lightning reaches down from the spiral, touches the rod, and runs harmlessly into the earth.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Bai what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It works! The first rod works! The delta will work! The founder's plan works! My grandmother's turtle soup recipe works!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Shadows Against the Rods
quests.summary: The Seventh Rung's shadow-born try to tear down the rods before they're finished. The eastern slope has twice as many. Wei Tong's lie worked.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're attacking the eastern slope! Twice as many there! My lie worked! I'm a genius! A terrible genius!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The shadow-born come on in silence.

objectives.text: Cut down the shadow-born that follow
Look for Han Xue at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Eastern slope, overrun, empty. Western slope, rods standing. The shadow believed Wei Tong. I'm never going to let him forget it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Nine Rods Around the Mountain
quests.summary: Eight more rods, around the mountain. Every disciple helps carry. Even the twelve. Even the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: (bows three times, then a fourth to be safe) {senior}! Sorry. You're very high up now. It's hard not to bow.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Every disciple carries! The twelve! Me! The chicken! Qiu Hua insisted! The chicken is carrying a very small piece of crystal!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Carry the rods to their places
Hear what Xiao Man has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Nine rods. Around the mountain. I dropped one. Only one. It bounced. Rods bounce. Who knew?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: The spirit stones came from a hermit's plot, and the hermit isn't home.

choices.text: Leave payment and a note

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: Right. Yes. Good. I think.

choices.text: Take only what the task needs

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Take everything

reply.speaker: xiao_man
reply.text: (quietly) Is that... is that what seniors are supposed to do?

quests.title: Singing With the Rods
quests.summary: The nine rods hum in the storm. Yan Tie says Thunder Peak's tradition is to shout back. You try humming instead.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak shouts back at the storm! It's tradition! Try it! No? Humming? Fine! Hum! Hum loudly!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Hum with the nine rods in the storm

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You hum. The rods hum. The storm above hums back. For a moment, heaven and the mountain and you are one very long note.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Middle stage of Mahayana. The storm is closer. You are readier.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Nine rods. The sect is safe from stray lightning. Now it's only you the sky wants. That's a sentence I never wanted to say.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Map, Updated
quests.summary: Xiao Shi adds the nine rods to his ceiling map. Beside them, the fold. And a red line where the moon rises.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Nine rods on the map. And the fold. And look: the moon's path. It passes directly over the fold and the peak. Every month, a little redder.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The moon's turning red. Slowly. The old books say the last blood moon comes when the Ladder is almost gone. We're almost there.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: The last blood moon and your tribulation. The books never said they'd be the same night. But they might be. I don't like that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Farewells Early
quests.summary: The Sect Master says something that makes everyone go quiet: it's time to start saying goodbyes. Not because you'll die. Because you'll climb.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Start saying goodbye. Not because you'll fall. Because you won't. When you transcend, the stair opens. Most who climb don't come back.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Say what you need to say to the people you love. Early. So there's no rush at the end. Start with Qingshi. They'd want to be first.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Heaven's Warning Shot
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane arrives crackling. Heaven is sending a lesser tribulation. Three bolts. Tonight. On the isles.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: A crane from the star-gazer. Crackling. A lesser tribulation. Three bolts. Tonight. Go. We'll watch from the mountain. Everyone's watching.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isles are dark and humming. Overhead, a small spiral of black cloud turns directly above the Isle of Winds.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Three bolts. A warning. Heaven checking you're serious. Most die. You won't. Probably. I'm cheerful. I'm very cheerful. Sit.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Crystals on the Isle
quests.summary: You plant thunder crystals around the Isle of Winds, a small delta for a small storm.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Crystals around the isle. A small delta. Practice for the big one. Plant them where the wind is strongest.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Plant thunder crystals around the isle

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak came to watch! We brought a banner! It says 'strike harder'! Is that helpful? Thunder Peak isn't sure!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The First Bolt
quests.summary: The first bolt comes down white. Your body takes it the way the forge taught you: usefully.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: White. Everything white. Your integrated body takes the bolt and doesn't break. It hums. The crystals around you split the rest into the sea of clouds.

objectives.text: Hear what Qing Luan has to say

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: One. Good. You didn't die. I'm less cheerful now. The second is worse. The third is the heart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Storm Wolves in the Lightning
quests.summary: The lesser tribulation charges the storm wolves. They come howling out of the pines, crackling, mad with lightning.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Storm wolves! Drunk on lightning! Between bolts! Heaven's warning shot has brought friends! Rude friends!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Defeat the storm wolves at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Cleared. The second bolt's coming. I can feel my hair standing up. I have very good hair. This is a tragedy.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The Second Bolt
quests.summary: The second bolt is purple. It goes through your body and into your soul, looking for seams. There aren't any.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Purple. The bolt goes through body and into soul, searching for a seam where it could split you. It finds none. It goes away, disappointed.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Two. The third is the heart. Your heart demon will flicker in it. It'll look like you. It'll know you. Don't be kind to it.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: No. Be kind to it. That's how you won last time. I'm confused. I'm frightened. Be yourself.

quests.title: The Flickering Shadow
quests.summary: The third bolt comes down black, and out of it steps a shadow wearing your face, flickering like a candle in wind.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The third bolt hits the ruins and doesn't vanish. It stands up, black, wearing your face, flickering in and out like a bad lamp.

objectives.name: The Flickering Shadow
objectives.text: Face The Flickering Shadow at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Hello again. Heaven sent me. A little piece of you, to test the rest. Every time you win, I come back stronger. See you at the ninth.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Every time you come back, so do I.

objectives.text: Let the third bolt pass through you

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow fades into the bolt, and the bolt fades into you, and you're still standing. The lesser tribulation is over.

objectives.text: Talk with Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Three. You survived a lesser tribulation. The first in three hundred years. Your founder was the last. She'd be proud. I'm proud. I'm crying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: The fallen enemy's followers throw down their weapons and kneel.

choices.text: Let them go home

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Bring them to face the sect's judgement

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Correct. The precepts exist for moments like this.

choices.text: Make an example of them

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Everyone Watched
quests.summary: The whole sect watched from the mountain. The whole alliance, their cranes say. They all saw the three bolts fall.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: We watched from the cliff. Three bolts. Three. The whole sect cheered. Wei Tong fainted. Then he got up and cheered.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Find Wei Tong at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I didn't faint. I sat down very suddenly. And lay down. Briefly. For morale.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.text: Join Yan Tie at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Thunder Peak's banner said strike harder. Heaven listened. We're very sorry. We're making a new banner. It says 'please don't'.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The disciples watched you nearly die in the lightning. They're frightened.

choices.text: Tell them the truth: it will be worse

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Tell them it didn't hurt

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Tell them fear is for the weak

reply.speaker: yan_tie
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Tribulation Jade, Fresh
quests.summary: Where the three bolts struck the isle, the ground has turned to fresh jade. Your jade.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Your jade. Where you stood. Fresh. Take some. Someday, someone will find the rest and feel your three bolts and be proud of you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Give some to the people you love. Tribulation jade is warm forever. They'll have something of you when you climb.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: The Ninth Ring
quests.summary: Qing Luan reads the chart after the lesser tribulation. The ninth ring is brighter. Closer. And red.

objectives.text: Read the star chart after the storm

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine rings on the chart. The ninth is red now, not white. The seventh star sits right on it. The Patriarch's Shadow, on your heart bolt.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beneath it, in Qing Luan's hand, fresh ink: the last blood moon and the ninth bolt. Same night. Same hour. Oh no.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Same night. The last blood moon and your heart tribulation. He's planned it. For three hundred years. He'll ride your heart bolt.

quests.title: Warm Jade
quests.summary: You carry pieces of warm tribulation jade down the stair. Everyone you love will get one.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Go. Give out your jade. Say your goodbyes early. And come back up when the sky calls. I'll be at the gate. Frowning.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Warm jade for everyone. You're giving away pieces of your own tribulation. That's the most you thing you've ever done.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Down the Steps With Jade
quests.summary: You walk down the nine thousand steps with a bag of warm jade. Qingshi sees you coming from the watchtower.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qingshi's gate is open. The whole town is waiting in the street. Somebody saw you from the watchtower and rang the bell, very gently.

objectives.text: Hear what Constable Du has to say

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: The watchtower saw you coming. We rang the bell soft. Not an alarm. A welcome. We've never had a bell for that. We do now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Madam Fang's Bowl
quests.summary: Madam Fang has kept a bowl of noodles hot for you since the Crimson Road. Every day. She's not going to stop.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Your bowl. Kept hot. Every day since the Crimson Road. I'm not going to stop when you climb. I'll keep it hot forever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Madam Fang. For you. Tribulation jade. It stays warm forever too.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: ...Warm forever. Like the bowl. Oh, you terrible child. Now I'm crying into the noodles. Eat them anyway. They're salty now.

objectives.text: Meet Old Pan at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Talk with Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

quests.title: Iron-Fang's Dishes
quests.summary: Iron-Fang is washing dishes. He doesn't look up. He's been expecting this. He doesn't want it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Goodbyes. Early. The Sect Master's idea. I don't like it. Iron-Fang doesn't say goodbye. Iron-Fang says see you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: See you later, Tie Hu. At the black gate.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...At the black gate. Yes. That's a see-you-later I can say. Give me the jade. I'll keep it with my sister's ribbon.

objectives.text: Find Liu Er at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Join Constable Du at the town gate

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: We're done at here. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.choice_prompt: Constable Du asks you to settle a farmers' quarrel. One of them is your friend.

choices.text: Judge it fairly

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Favour the poorer one

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Favour whoever pays

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: Water for the Last Time
quests.summary: Widow Liu asks you to carry water with her, one last time, to the old houses on the hill. Liu Er comes too.

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Carry water with me. To the hill houses. One more time. My son too. The three of us. Like a family.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Carry water up the hill with the Lius

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: Mother cried the whole way. I cried the whole way. You didn't cry. You carried twice as much. That's how you cry, isn't it?

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. I keep mine. You're paid in full. Forever. Take care up there.

quests.title: Shadows in the Town
quests.summary: The Seventh Rung's shadows have followed you down. They want to see who you love. They're taking notes.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Shadows! In the street! Following you! Watching who you talk to! The town's not having that!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Hold the market square against more rogue cultivators

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Gone. The whole town chased them. With brooms. Liu Er taught everyone. Qingshi's the best-armed town in the world. With brooms.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: The rogue cultivators left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Magistrate's Speech
quests.summary: Magistrate Zhou has written a speech. It's nine pages. He reads one word of it.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've written a speech. Nine pages. I'm going to read one word. It's the best word I know.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Hold.

objectives.text: Hear what Magistrate Zhou has to say

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: ...That's it. That's the speech. Hold. Whatever happens up there. Hold. Qingshi will. For you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Jade in the Qing River
quests.summary: Old Pan takes you out on the river, one last time. He doesn't charge a fare. He never did, after the siege.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Old Pan's ferry slides out onto the Qing River. The town lights shine on the water. He rows slowly, very slowly.

objectives.text: Drop a piece of jade into the river

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The jade sinks, glowing, into the river. Old Pan nods. Now the river remembers you too, he says. Forty years, it's never lied.

objectives.text: Show Old Pan what you found

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Forty years on this water. I've carried everyone. You were the only one who ever carried me back. Mind the third plank. Always.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Merchant Jin's Ledger
quests.summary: Merchant Jin has closed his books for the day, to give you something: the guild's ledger, with a new last page.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: The guild's ledger. The last page. Every debt the town owes you. I've written them all. It's a very long page.

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: And at the bottom, in my own hand: paid in full, by a town that learned to be honest. I'm framing it. In the warehouse.

objectives.text: Meet Iron-Fang at the main street

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Talk with Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; here isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.choice_prompt: Merchant Jin wants to forgive the town's debts in your name. It's a fortune.

choices.text: Forgive them in his name, not yours

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Let the debts stand. Contracts are contracts.

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take the credit, and a share

reply.speaker: widow_liu
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Temple, One Last Time
quests.summary: You sit in the town temple, clean now, where you cleansed Hong's defilement years ago, and carry the whole town.

objectives.text: Carry Qingshi in the temple's quiet

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The whole town, breathing. Madam Fang humming. Iron-Fang scrubbing. Widow Liu counting in elevens. You hold them, and then you let them hold you.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the main street

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I came down to walk you home. I watched you carry the whole town. From the temple steps. Every face in the street was crying.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: See You Later
quests.summary: You leave Qingshi at dusk. The whole town lines the road. Nobody says goodbye. Everybody says see you later.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: See you later. That's what Iron-Fang says. So that's what the town says. See you later. At the gate. On the stair. Later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Join Liu Er at the terraced fields

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: See you later, Senior Brother. Senior Sister. Whichever. See you later. I'll be the loudest one at the gate. After Thunder Peak.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Senior Sister Asks
quests.summary: Han Xue asks for something. She never asks for anything. She asks very stiffly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I need to break through. Nascent Soul. I've been close for a year. I didn't want to while you needed guarding.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You guarded me once, in your head. When you broke through, I stood guard in the plum garden. Now it's your turn. Please.

objectives.text: Make your way to the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The plum garden is quiet. The same stone where you established your foundation, years ago. Han Xue sits on it. Very straight.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Breakthroughs attract trouble. Heart demons, jealous juniors, very curious elders. And shadow-born. Keep them away. That's all.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Curious Elders
quests.summary: The first trouble is Elder Hua, Elder Bai, Wei Tong, Zhao Kang and Lu Ping, all of whom want to watch.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Is she breaking through? Can we watch? Everyone wants to watch! Elder Bai brought a notebook! Wei Tong brought snacks!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Ward the plum garden against visitors

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises gently around the plum garden. Outside it, a crowd of well-meaning people press their noses to the light.

objectives.text: Clear the outer pines of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Not all the visitors are well-meaning. In the pines, shadow-born are gathering, drawn by a soul about to form.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators
Find Wei Tong after the fight

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Shadow-born, trying to get at her while she's breaking through. I've been waiting all year to hit one of those for her.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Moon cultivators is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Han Xue's Heart
quests.summary: Halfway through, Han Xue speaks without opening her eyes. Her heart demon is flickering. She's telling you about it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: My demon's here. It says I only follow you because I'm afraid to lead. It says I'll be your senior sister forever and nothing else.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're the one who walked me into the Abyss, Senior Sister. You lead. I follow you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: ...It went quiet. It didn't like that. Keep talking. About anything. Tell me about the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Hear what Zhao Kang has to say

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

quests.title: Han Xue's Shadow
quests.summary: Han Xue's heart demon steps out of the plum trees: a copy of her, sword drawn, cold eyes. You won't let it reach her.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A figure in Frost Sword blue steps out of the plum trees. Han Xue's face. Han Xue's sword. Eyes like a frozen lake.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Shadow-born ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Finish the shadow-born at the plum garden
Catch your breath with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-Han falls apart like frost in sunlight. Behind you, the real Han Xue breathes out, long and slow, and smiles with her eyes closed.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sliver of Han Xue's shadow is left, cold and humming. It would feed a cultivator's soul.

choices.text: Let it melt away

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Give it to the hermit to seal

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Absorb it

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Guarding the Stone
quests.summary: Han Xue's soul is forming. You sit beside her on the stone and hold the ward, and wait, and don't talk about the chicken.

objectives.text: Hold the ward beside Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Plum petals fall. Han Xue's breath slows. In soul sight, a tiny figure is forming in her chest: a small, straight sword, with her face.

objectives.text: Meet Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul. It's a sword. Of course it is. With my face. Frowning. Of course it is.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Thank you. For guarding. For the plum garden. For everything. That's all. Don't make it weird.

quests.title: Everyone Comes In
quests.summary: The ward comes down, and everyone who has been waiting comes in at once, with snacks.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Nascent Soul! Han Xue! I brought snacks! Everyone brought snacks! We've been waiting for hours! The snacks are cold! Eat them!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Talk with Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Let me see your wrist. Hm. Steady. Very steady. Stubborn pulse. Like someone else I know.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Congratulations. Now you're only three realms behind the heir instead of seven. I'm eight behind. I'm going to be very dramatic about it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Plum Blossoms for a New Soul
quests.summary: Wei Tong insists on a tradition he invented just now: plum blossoms for a new soul.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: New tradition! Plum blossoms for a new soul! I invented it just now! Everyone gather blossoms! Throw them at her!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather plum blossoms for Han Xue
Join Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone's throwing plum blossoms at me. I'm going to have petals in my hair for a week. I'm going to allow it. Once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The Sparring Match
quests.summary: Han Xue reminds you, as she always does, that you owe her a sparring match. Now she has a soul to match yours.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You owe me a proper sparring match. Remember? From the rim, years ago. Now I've got a soul. Now it'll be closer.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When, Senior Sister?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: After. When this is done. After the gate, and the sky. You don't get to ascend without paying your debts. That's my rule.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Strength without a clear heart is a landslide. I learned that the hard way.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Here is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister still feeds me like I'm a starving cat. I'm not complaining.

quests.title: A Gift of Jade
quests.summary: You give Han Xue a piece of your tribulation jade. She holds it for a long time.

objectives.text: Give Han Xue your tribulation jade

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: She holds the jade in both hands. It's warm. She doesn't say anything. She puts it inside her robe, over her heart, next to her new soul.

objectives.text: Talk it over with Han Xue

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Warm forever, the star-gazer said. Good. I get cold on the Frost Sword Peak. I'll wear it. Always. Don't tell anyone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Two Souls on the Mountain
quests.summary: That night, from the cliff edge, you can see two souls glowing on the mountain: yours, and a small, straight sword.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Two nascent souls younger than thirty on my mountain. Three hundred years since that happened. The last two founded the sect.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang is next, he says. He's been saying it for a year. He's very close. He needs a push. Maybe a wager.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seven tiers of scripture rise above you. From the fourth floor comes the sound of someone sneezing on dust.

objectives.text: Meet Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Palanquin
quests.summary: The gold palanquin climbs the nine thousand steps one last time. The Zhao ancestor has something to say.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: The gold palanquin! Again! The bearers are older now! One of them is crying again! It's the same one!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The palanquin sets down at the gate. The ancestor steps out, slower than last time, leaning on a cane of gold.

objectives.text: Talk with Ancestor Zhao at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: A hundred and fifteen. I've climbed these steps for the last time. I've come to name my heir. Where is he? Hiding?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Zhao Kang Hides Again
quests.summary: Zhao Kang is hiding. Behind the turtle soup books again. Elder Bai has given up and brought him tea.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I don't want to be clan head. I want to be here. At the gate. When it opens. With you. And then I want to fight you, when you come back down.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He'll say I have to. The clan needs me. I know the clan needs me. I just... need something first.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: What do you need, Zhao Kang?

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: A wager. With you. Like when we were idiots. One last idiotic wager. Then I'll be clan head. Then I'll be an adult. Ugh.

objectives.text: Find Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Nobody tells the gate disciple anything. So I listen. Constantly.

objectives.text: Join Steward Qian at the incense cauldron

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is not a well. It is a very small cup.

quests.title: The Wager
quests.summary: The wager: if Zhao Kang can reach the golden core's peak before your tribulation, you owe him a bout when you come back down.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The wager. If I reach the peak of Core Formation before your sky falls, you owe me a proper bout when you come back down. Properly.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If I don't, I... I'll be clan head without complaining. For a month. That's the stakes.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You're on. Though I'd have given you the bout anyway.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I know. That's why it has to be a wager. So it's earned. Zhao clan standards. Low ones, but standards.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang's clan offers you a fortune to make sure he loses the wager.

choices.text: Refuse

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Sensible. Boring. Sensible.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell Zhao Kang

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Accept

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Training for the Wager
quests.summary: Zhao Kang trains for a month. Day and night. You help. So does everyone. He complains the whole time. It works.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: If the Law Hall asks, I haven't seen you all week.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Train! Now! Puppets! Harder puppets! Wei Tong, tune them to furious! I want furious!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Help Zhao Kang train on furious puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Furious puppets! For Zhao Kang! I've never tuned them this high! One of them is growling! Puppets can't growl!

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: One month. Every day. I've never trained this hard. I've never complained this hard. It's the best month of my life.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Your sparring partner leaves an opening that would injure them badly.

choices.text: Pull the blow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Strike exactly as the rules allow

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it. Pain teaches.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: The Clan Champions
quests.summary: The Zhao clan's champions want to test their future head. They're very polite about it, and very hard to beat.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: My champions. They want to test the boy. The old way. You'll stand beside him. The Zhao clan's test always has a friend in it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Stand beside Zhao Kang against the champions

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Zhao clan champions! Back to back, and mind your footing!

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: He beat them. With you beside him, but he beat them. His brother did the same. The Zhao clan is in good hands. Stubborn ones.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Zhao Kang's Peak
quests.summary: On the last night of the month, Zhao Kang sits at his brother's stone, and reaches for the peak.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Sit with me. At Ming's stone. I'm going to try. If I don't make it, don't tell anyone I cried.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Sit with Zhao Kang as he reaches for his peak

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Incense for Zhao Ming, twisting over the sea of clouds. Zhao Kang's golden core burns brighter and brighter, like a lantern with a crack in it, letting the light out.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Peak of Core Formation. And beside him, your own cultivation rises with his: late stage of Mahayana.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Peak. I made it. I won. You owe me a bout. When you come back down. I'm going to win that too.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: The Ancestor's Blessing
quests.summary: Zhao Tianlu names his great-grandson head of the clan, in front of the whole sect. Zhao Kang doesn't hide.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Zhao Kang. Head of the Zhao clan. Who will lead it from the Azure Cloud, because that's where his heart is. The clan agrees. I agree.
