dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: ...Thank you, Great-Grandfather. I'll write monthly. With love. In gold ink. Because we're the Zhao clan.

objectives.text: Meet Ancestor Zhao at the training ground

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: Gold ink. Of course. You've learned something after all. Now I'm going home to die in comfort. In about twenty years. Out of spite.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Jade for the Zhao Clan
quests.summary: You give Zhao Kang a piece of your tribulation jade. He gives you something back: the small copy of his brother's stone.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Your jade. Warm. I'll keep it with the monthly letters. And here. Ming's stone. The small one. Take it up the stair with you.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: So a Zhao climbs to heaven too. First out of the grotto. First up the stair. Ming would've liked that.

objectives.text: Gather the Zhao clan's farewell gifts
Talk with Steward Qian at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Gifts from the Zhao clan. Gold. For the treasury. For the march. I'm not going to faint. I've grown. I've grown so much.

quests.title: Shadows at the Palanquin
quests.summary: The Seventh Rung's shadows come for the palanquin on its way down, to hurt someone you love. They find Zhao Kang waiting.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows! At Great-Grandfather's palanquin! On MY steps! I'm clan head now! Nobody touches the palanquin!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Break the void wraiths at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Cut down the void wraiths that follow

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Clan head for one day and I've already defended the palanquin. Great-Grandfather says I'm too dramatic. He's smiling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: When You Come Back Down
quests.summary: Zhao Kang walks you to the cliff edge. He says the thing he's going to say again, years from now, at the ruins.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: When you come back down, we fight. Properly. Promise. Not see-you-later. A promise. Zhao clan standards.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When I come back down, Zhao Kang.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Good. Hmph. Go and be struck by lightning. I'll be here. Complaining. Forever.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You slow at the formation plaza, letting your senses spread like ripples on a pond.

objectives.text: Find Ancestor Zhao at the formation plaza

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: We're done at the formation plaza. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: ancestor_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan counts in centuries, and in gold.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Chart Read Whole
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane says only: come. I've read the whole chart. It's worse. Bring the sword girl. And the nameless one.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The star-gazer's crane. 'Come. Read the whole chart. Worse.' Take Han Xue. And Ye Wuming. She asked for him. By description.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isles are dim. Above, the moon hangs full and dark red, like an eye that's been crying.

objectives.text: Join Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You came. Good. Sit. Don't sit. Stand. This is standing news. I'm not cheerful. I'll never be cheerful again. Look at the chart.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Whole Chart
quests.summary: On the star pavilion's jade floor, the whole chart, read at last. The ladder, the moon, the ninth bolt, and the stair.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seven red stars in a ladder. Six dark. The seventh bright, over the peak. The moon's path crossing it. The ninth ring, red. And the stair.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last blood moon rises. The fold opens. The Patriarch falls, or seems to. His soul climbs the seventh rung to the peak, and rides the ninth bolt into you.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: That's his plan. Three hundred years. Your body, cleaned by heaven's own lightning, with him inside it. Walking up the stair.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Unless the seventh rung falls first. Then he has nothing to climb. Then he has to jump. Jumping is much harder.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Reads It Too
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the chart. He's quiet for a long time. Then he says what he's decided.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The seventh rung. Xue Chen. The boy in the mirror. If he falls before the moon, the Patriarch has to jump. He might miss.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll try to steal him back. Before. If I can't, you'll have to break him. I'm sorry. I wish there were a third way.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: There's always a third way. We just haven't found it yet. We'll look. Until the moon rises. Then we'll do what we have to.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Han Xue mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: Shadow-Born on the Isles
quests.summary: The shadow-born have followed the red star to the isles. They're guarding the peak, waiting for their master's son.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows! On the isles! Guarding the peak! I followed you up the stair! Obviously! I'm clan head! I do what I want!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're guarding the peak for Xue Chen. For the night of the moon. We should break their guard now. So it's broken then.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Peak's Guardians
quests.summary: The shadow-born have taken the tribulation peak's slopes. You can't let them hold it until the moon.

objectives.text: Make your way to the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born crouch on the peak's lower slopes, among the ruins, in a ring. They're drawing something on the stones. A ladder.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Weapons up! This is going to get loud.

objectives.text: Gather the stones they drew on
Tell Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: A ladder, drawn on the slopes. Seven rungs. Six scratched out. The seventh fresh. They're making sure he knows the way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Watching the Red Moon
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to watch the red moon rise with her. She says it helps to look at what's coming.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Watch it rise. The red moon. Every month, redder. The last one will be the colour of the Patriarch's robes. Look at it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The moon rises red over the sea of clouds. Beneath it, the fold is a dark smudge on the earth. Above it, heaven's spiral turns. All three, lining up.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Months. Not years. Months. The moon, the fold, the stair and your lightning. All one night. I've never seen stars this certain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Stargazers could warn the towns early, but the alliance fears a panic.

choices.text: Warn the towns

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Follow the alliance's decision

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Sell the warning to the rich

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Qing Luan's Promise
quests.summary: Qing Luan makes a promise: on the night, she'll be at the cloud gate. Whatever happens.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: On the night, I'll be at the cloud gate. When the Patriarch's soul crosses my bridge, I'll see it. I'll tell you. Loudly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ten thousand years I watched the stair and did nothing. Not this time. This time I'll shout.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: You'll shout. I'll hold the bridge. Zhao Kang will complain. Ye Wuming will hold the abyss. Everyone has a job. Good.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Crystals for the Peak
quests.summary: Before you leave, you plant the first of Elder Bai's ninety-nine crystals on the peak's lower slopes. The delta begins.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You again. Which rule have you broken this week? No. Don't tell me. Later.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Plant the first crystals now. On the lower slopes. Let them settle in. Crystals like to get to know a place before they work.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Forty on the slopes. The rest on the night. The delta's begun. Your founder's plan, in your hands. She'd be glad.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Xue Chen at the Peak
quests.summary: As you leave, you see him again: Xue Chen, on the summit, alone, looking at the red moon. He doesn't wave. He doesn't bow.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the summit, a young man in dark red, alone, looking up at the moon. He doesn't wave. He looks tired. He looks three years old.

objectives.text: Watch Xue Chen through the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Through the chart, his star flickers. Not bright and certain like the others were. Flickering. Like someone who isn't sure.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's not sure. His star's flickering. Nobody in the Ladder ever flickered. There's a door there. A small one. We'll try it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Down to the Last Preparations
quests.summary: You go down the stair. Months, not years. Everyone on the mountain looks up at the moon every night now.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Months. We prepare. Everyone. Forty sects, one mountain, one moon. And one boy on a peak who isn't sure.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rest while you can. Say your goodbyes. And one day soon, the moon will be the colour of his robes.

objectives.text: Meet Ye Wuming at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming asks whether an old debt should be paid in coin or in blood.

choices.text: Coin, and mercy

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Whatever the law says

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Blood. Debts are debts.

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: To the Foot of the Stair
quests.summary: Qing Luan meets you at the cloud gate with a lantern, though it's day. She says the stair likes lanterns.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A lantern. The stair likes them. Don't ask me why. Ten thousand years and I still don't understand it. Follow me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qing Luan walks ahead with a lantern in broad daylight, humming. The isles are quiet. The red moon is a pale ghost in the day sky.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stair. Nobody's stood at its foot since your founders. I want it to meet you. Before the night. So it knows your face.

quests.title: The Stair's Sentinels
quests.summary: The stair has its own sentinels, older than the palace's. They don't want anyone near. Qing Luan tells them to move.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Move! I was a sage when your stones were still stars! Move! ...They won't move. Hit them. Gently. They're very old.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Drive the celestial sentinels from the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The celestial sentinels spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Hold the jade bridge against more celestial sentinels

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: They'll let you pass now. They bowed. They never bow. The stair must have told them to. It's curious about you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Stair's sentinels demand an oath: never to return to the mortal world.

choices.text: Refuse the oath

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Swear it honestly

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Swear it, and mean none of it

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: The precepts weep. I'll pretend not to hear them.

quests.title: The Ascension Stair
quests.summary: At the foot of the Ascension Stair, you look up. Each step is made of light. It climbs into cloud, and out of sight.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Ascension Stair climbs into cloud, each step made of light. It hums, very quietly. As you watch, the first step brightens.

objectives.text: Lay your hand on the first step

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The step is warm. It knows you. Not yet, it seems to say. Soon. It dims again, patiently. It has waited ten thousand years. It can wait a few months.

objectives.text: Show Qing Luan what you found

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It knew you. It brightened. It told you not yet. That's a stair being polite. Stairs are almost never polite.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: What's at the Top
quests.summary: Everyone asks the same question: what's at the top? Qing Luan doesn't know. Nobody does.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: What's at the top? Heaven? A door? A very large tea room? I need to know what to complain about.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A door, I think. I watched your founders pull him down before he reached it. Nobody's ever knocked on it.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Then you'll be the first to knock. Be polite. Heaven's sensitive about manners, the star-gazer says. Don't knock too loud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll knock gently, Senior Sister.

quests.title: Silk for the Stair
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to tie cloud silk to the stair's railing. For every person you love. So the stair remembers them too.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Tie silk to the stair. One ribbon for everyone you love. The stair will remember them. When you climb, they'll climb with you. In a way.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather silk ribbons for everyone you love
Find Wei Tong at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I followed you up! Again! You're tying ribbons! For everyone! Is there one for me? There's one for me! There's one for Elder Mo!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: You gathered more cloud silk than the task needs.

choices.text: Give the extra to the town's poor

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand everything to the storehouse, as the rules say

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Keep the extra for your own cultivation

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Ribbons for Everyone
quests.summary: Ribbons for everyone: Elder Mo, the hermit, Madam Fang, the Xiao siblings, Iron-Fang, Ye Wuming, even Gu Hanshan.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Gu Hanshan? The traitor? You tied a ribbon for him?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: He's trying. That's worth a ribbon.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: ...You're going to be a very strange immortal. Heaven's going to have no idea what to do with you. I'm delighted.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Elder Mo's ribbon is blue. And straight. I tied it very straight. He'd want it straight.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Shadows on the Stair
quests.summary: Shadow-born try to climb the stair's lowest steps, testing it for their master. The stair burns them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born claw at the stair's lowest steps. Each time they touch it, they burn, and shriek, and try again.

objectives.text: Clear the immortal garden of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The shadow-born come on in silence.

objectives.text: Gather the ash of the burned shadows
Talk it over with Qing Luan

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The stair burns anything that isn't its own. Anything carrying something that isn't theirs. The palace inscription said so. A stolen body. A stolen heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Sitting at the Stair
quests.summary: You sit at the foot of the stair for an hour, and let it get to know you. It hums. You hum back.

objectives.text: Sit at the foot of the Ascension Stair

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The stair hums a note too low to hear. You hum it back. For an hour, you and the stair are alone on the isles, getting acquainted.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: It likes you. The stair likes you. I've never seen it like anyone. It liked your founder, a little. It likes you more.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Sect Master Comes Up
quests.summary: The Sect Master comes up the cloud road to see the stair herself. She's never seen it. She's never had time.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The Ascension Stair. I've been sect master for eleven years and never seen it. I never had time. I'm taking time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When you climb it, I'll be at the cloud gate. I'll bow. I'll try not to cry. I'll fail.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Sect Master, you said I don't have to go.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You don't. But you will. Because someone should see what's up there. That's what I'd say. That's what you'll say.

objectives.text: Hear what Wei Tong has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the celestial ruins isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: If we survive this, I'm cooking. If we don't, somebody else is cooking.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: I have been a memory for a very long time. It's restful, mostly.

quests.title: The Moon Is Almost Red
quests.summary: On the way down, the moon rises, and it's almost the colour of the Patriarch's robes. Almost.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Almost red. One more month. Maybe two. Go home. Get ready. I'll be here. Frowning. Fondly.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the immortal garden

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: One more month. Then everything, all at once. I'll hold the bridge. You hold everything else. Like always.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Redder Every Night
quests.summary: The moon rises over the sea of clouds, and it is the colour of rust. Tomorrow it will be the colour of blood.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The moon rises over the sea of clouds, the colour of rust. The whole sect is on the walls, watching it, not speaking.

objectives.text: Find the Sect Master at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Rust tonight. Blood soon. Qing Luan's crane says weeks. The fold is breathing. The wards are straining. It's time.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Everything we've prepared for since the Heart Mirror. It's time. Go and see Steward Qian. His ledger has become a war.

quests.title: A Ledger of Armies
quests.summary: Steward Qian's ledger of monthly letters has become a ledger of armies. Forty sects. How many each. When they'll arrive.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty sects. Eleven thousand fighters. Supplies for a month. I've counted it all. I've never counted anything so important.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

objectives.text: Read Steward Qian's ledger of armies

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron Scale, three thousand. Zhao clan, two thousand, in gold. Moon-Well, five hundred healers. Qingshi: forty guards, one magistrate, one very old ballista.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The ballista. Qingshi's sending the ballista. It's older than me. It's never hit anything. They insist. It's for morale.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Xiao Shi's Last Map
quests.summary: Xiao Shi has drawn one last map: the Abyss, as it will be when the fold opens. Every path. Every door.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The last map. The Abyss when the fold opens. Every path. Every door. Every cage. I remember them all. I drew them all.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The cages are here, past the gate. Iron-Fang's sister is in that one. I remember her. She shouted at the guards every day.

objectives.text: Join Elder Bai at the scripture pagoda

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: It's beautiful. Accurate. Terrible. I've made eleven copies. One for every commander. And one for my ceiling.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Medicine for Eleven Thousand
quests.summary: Elder Hua and Xiao Man have been making medicine for months. It's still not enough. It's never enough.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Eleven thousand fighters. I've made four thousand bundles. Xiao Man's made four thousand more. The Moon-Well brings the rest.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I've only dropped two hundred! Out of four thousand! That's a record! A good record! Help me pack the last ones!

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Eight thousand bundles. Every one with a note inside. Xiao Man's idea. Most say 'come home'. Some say 'eat this, idiot'.

objectives.choice_prompt: There's medicine for ten thousand, not eleven. Who goes without?

choices.text: The sect's own disciples

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Whoever enlisted last

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: The bandits

reply.speaker: elder_hua
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Shadows Under the Red Moon
quests.summary: Under the rusting moon, the shadow-born grow bold. They climb the back path in the open now, not bothering to hide.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Shadows on the back path! Not even sneaking! Just walking up! Under the red moon! I'm ringing everything!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: They're not even hiding any more. The red moon makes them brave. Or stupid. Same thing, in shadows.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Twelve Want to March
quests.summary: Wei Tong's twelve, not new any more, want to march with the army. Wei Tong says no. They ask you.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: My twelve want to march. To the Abyss. They're not ready. They're so ready. I don't know. You decide. You're scarier.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Test Wei Tong's twelve on the puppets

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They've seen us. Good. I hate sneaking.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're ready. Of course they're ready. I trained them. With Elder Mo's words. They'll march behind me. Right behind me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: A junior begs you to teach them a forbidden technique from the fourth floor.

choices.text: Refuse, and tell the elders

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Rules, rules. Fine. You're right. Again.

choices.text: Teach them something safer instead

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Teach it. Rules are for the timid.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Forty Hands, One Promise
quests.summary: Forty sects' last monthly letters arrive at once. Every one says the same thing, in forty different hands.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Forty letters. All at once. All the same. We're coming. In forty hands. The Zhao clan's is in gold ink. Of course it is.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty sects. Coming. Three hundred years ago, two sects stood at the Abyss. This time, forty-one.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.text: Hear what Han Xue has to say

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Forty-one. Plus a town. Plus a bandit's army. Plus a traitor in chains. Plus a chicken. We're a very strange army.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Under the Rusting Moon
quests.summary: You sit at the cliff edge under the rusting moon and carry everyone who'll march. Eleven thousand. Light.

objectives.text: Carry eleven thousand under the red moon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven thousand fighters, and the towns behind them, and the families behind the towns. The moon is red. You carry them, and it's light.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You looked peaceful, up there. Under that moon. I've never seen anyone look peaceful under a blood moon.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

objectives.choice_prompt: Nearby, a junior's qi is running wild. Helping will cost you your meditation.

choices.text: Stop and steady their qi

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: Send for the elders; it's their duty

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Drink their stray qi to deepen your own

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: The Fold Breathes
quests.summary: A crane from Ye Wuming at the rim: the fold is breathing. In and out. Every breath, the black gate comes a little closer.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: A crane from Ye Wuming! He says the fold's breathing! In and out! And every time it breathes, the gate gets closer!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gate drifts closer with every breath. The children can see it now, from the rim, like a ship through fog. Come soon. Ye.

objectives.text: Share your findings with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Weeks. Maybe less. Iron-Fang has asked for time to gather his men. Go and help him. He says they need washing.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Heaven Answers the Red Moon
quests.summary: Under the red moon, the storm that has watched you for a year finally turns its eye. Tribulation Transcendence will not wait for the war.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The clouds over the cliff. They're turning. Like an eye. It's yours, isn't it? Go. We'll hold the walls. We're good at walls.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.text: Break through beneath the red moon

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty sects, a town, a bandit army, a mountain of friends. You carry them all, and the sky, at last, answers.

objectives.text: Survive the tribulation of Tribulation Transcendence

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The red moon hangs behind the storm like an eye behind a veil. Heaven has been waiting for this for years.

objectives.text: Talk with the Sect Master at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tribulation Transcendence. Under a blood moon. Mo would have said adequate and gone to cry somewhere private. So will I.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's crane came. He needs soap. For forty bandits. I'm bringing soap. And dumplings. Everybody needs dumplings.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Old Camp, Full Again
quests.summary: The old bandit camp is full again, for the first time since you burned it. This time, the bandits are waiting for you.

objectives.text: Head to the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The old bandit camp is full: forty men, rough and grey-bearded and very dirty, sitting around fires, polishing farm tools into weapons.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty. My old men. Farmers now, mostly. All of them have someone behind that gate. All of them want to march.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They're also filthy. A bandit camp's no place to wash. Your hermit has a spring. I'm told springs are for washing.

quests.title: Soap for Forty
quests.summary: Wei Tong has brought soap. A lot of soap. The hermit's spring has never seen so many bandits at once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Soap! For forty! And towels! And dumplings for after! I've planned this very carefully! Everyone into the spring!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Hand out soap at the spirit spring
Join the hermit at the clearing

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Forty bandits. In my spring. With soap. The lotus is very confused. So am I. But they're very clean now. Cleaner than me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: An old herb-woman asks to share the spirit herbs you were sent to gather.

choices.text: Leave her half

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Mercy costs something. You paid it without complaint. Well done.

choices.text: Tell her the sect has claimed it

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: Take it all and send her away hungry

reply.speaker: hermit_lan
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Washed
quests.summary: Forty bandits, washed. They look at each other, clean for the first time in years, and don't recognise anyone.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They don't recognise each other. Twenty years of dirt, gone. Old Bao's got a face under there. Who knew. He's very handsome.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Make your way to the herb grove

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: An old bandit touches his own clean face and laughs. Then cries. Then laughs again. The others do the same. It's contagious.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Washed. Now fed. Then trained. Then we march. Iron-Fang's army. Clean for the first time in twenty years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Fed
quests.summary: Wei Tong feeds forty bandits. It takes all day. It's the happiest you've ever seen him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Straight-backed as a precept stele, as always.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Forty bandits! Forty appetites! This is the best day of my life! Dumplings! Noodles! More dumplings! Nobody leaves hungry!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Carry Wei Tong's dumplings to the fires
Serve the first bowl to Iron-Fang

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang takes the first bowl. He eats slowly. Around the fires, forty washed and fed men eat, and talk about their families, and laugh.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Forty of them. Clean. Full. Laughing. I've never seen them like this. Neither have they. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Trained
quests.summary: Washed and fed, Iron-Fang's men need training. With real weapons. They've only ever fought with farm tools and desperation.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They fight like farmers. Desperate farmers. Brave, stupid, messy. Teach them to fight like people who want to come home.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: I came to help teach! With a broom! The broom is a very good teacher! Everyone in Qingshi agrees!

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Better. They're still messy. But they fight like they want to come home. That's the most important stance there is.

quests.title: Shadows in the Camp
quests.summary: The shadow-born come for Iron-Fang's camp at night. They want the bandits scared. The bandits are fed now. It's harder.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Shadows! At the camp! Forty clean men, form a line! With farm tools! With brooms! Liu Er, show them!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the old bandit camp

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Careful, {player}. These shadow-born fight like they have nothing to lose.

objectives.text: Finish the shadow-born at the forest path

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Held. My men held. First fight in years where nobody ran. They said they didn't want to get dirty again. Best reason I've heard.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Names Behind the Gate
quests.summary: Around the fire, each of Iron-Fang's men says one name: the person waiting for them behind the black gate.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Around the fire, forty men, one name each. A wife. A son. A mother. A brother. Iron-Fang goes last.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Tie Mei. My sister. She's mid-shout, the heir says. Frozen, mid-shout. She was always shouting. I'd give anything to hear it.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: My children listened to every name. They're going to find every cage. They promised. They keep promises. I taught them that.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.choice_prompt: Some of Iron-Fang's men still owe old blood debts to Qingshi families.

choices.text: Settle their debts from your own purse

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Have the magistrate record them for after the war

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Tell the families to take it out of their hides

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Old Map
quests.summary: Iron-Fang has an old map, from when the Blood Moon used him: the fortress, the gate, and the guard changes.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Ha. You break rules like someone raised on the road.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The Blood Moon used me for twenty years. I learned things. When the guards change. Where the gate's weakest. Here.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A map drawn in charcoal on leather: the black gate, the court, the cages. A note in Iron-Fang's hand: the gate opens only from inside. Or with a token.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: A token. Like the blood-red one I lost. The one your Elder Gu took. Wonder what happened to it. Probably melted. The Law Hall melts everything.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Forty Men by the Fire
quests.summary: The night before Iron-Fang's army leaves the forest, you sit by their fire and carry them. Forty. Plus the forty behind the gate.

objectives.text: Carry Iron-Fang's army by the fire

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Forty washed, fed men, snoring by the fire. Forty frozen people behind a gate, mid-word, mid-shout. You carry both. They weigh the same.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: You're carrying my men. I can tell. They're sleeping better than they have in years. Thank you, sect brat. Sect hero. Whatever.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A rival's meditation is faltering beside you. One nudge of qi would break it.

choices.text: Steady them instead

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Leave them to their own path

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Hm. Practical.

choices.text: Nudge it. One rival fewer.

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: March to the Rim
quests.summary: Iron-Fang's army marches out of the bamboo toward the Abyss rim, clean, fed, and singing a very bad bandit song.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: We'll camp at the rim. Near the fold. Near our families. We'll wait for your sect. Don't be late. The moon won't wait.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the lookout rock

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: They're singing! A bandit song! It's about stealing a goose! It's terrible! I'm learning it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Three Requests
quests.summary: The Sect Master summons you. Gu Hanshan has asked for three last requests, and asked that you escort him.

objectives.text: See what the Sect Master wants

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: (coldly) {player}. I have heard what you've been doing. Speak, and be brief.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: There you are. Half the young ones want to be you. Try to deserve it.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Gu has asked for three last requests. He asked that you escort him. He won't say why they're last. I think we both know.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Grant them. All three. Whatever they are. He's earned three.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Three. The cliff where Mo's ashes lie. The Law Hall, once more. And my daughter's letters. I'd like to burn them.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Then I'll be ready. For whatever the moon brings. Thank you for escorting me. I know you'd rather not.

quests.title: The First Request
quests.summary: The first request: the cliff edge, where Elder Mo's ashes were scattered. Gu Hanshan kneels.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Gu Hanshan kneels at the cliff edge, chains clinking. The sea of clouds is red under the rusting moon.

objectives.text: Kneel beside Gu at the cliff

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Mo, he says. I altered your formation. You died fixing my mistake. I don't ask you to forgive me. I just wanted you to know I know.

objectives.text: Tell Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: He'd have said something grumpy. Hmph. Adequate apology. More than adequate. I can hear him. I can hear him saying it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Wei Tong at the Cliff
quests.summary: Wei Tong has followed. He's been angry at Gu for years. He's not sure what he is now.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I followed you. I don't know why. I've been angry at him for years. For Elder Mo. I wanted to hit him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He knelt. He apologised to Elder Mo. Elder Mo would have... Elder Mo would have said adequate. I'm not going to hit him.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Thank you, Wei Tong. He was proud of you. He told me once, before. He said you'd be a better teacher than him.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: ...He told YOU? He told the paper and he told YOU? That old man. That stubborn, stubborn old man.

objectives.text: Join Elder Hua at the herb terraces

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Mind the moonbell. It bites, and it holds grudges.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: The tea has been steeping for a decade. It is nearly ready.

quests.title: The Second Request
quests.summary: The second request: the Law Hall, empty for years. Gu Hanshan sits in his old chair, once.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The Law Hall is empty and dusty. Gu Hanshan sits in his old chair, very straight, and looks at the empty chairs where his disciples sat.

objectives.text: Watch Gu sit in the Law Hall one last time

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: He takes a brush and writes one line on a fresh slip, and leaves it on the desk: fill this hall with someone kinder than me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than my grief. I wrote that once. Now I'll write this. Kinder. Someone kinder. That's all the law needs.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Shadows at the Law Hall
quests.summary: The shadow-born come for Gu in the Law Hall. The Patriarch knows he's planning something.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Shadows! Coming for Gu! The Patriarch must know he's up to something! Protect the traitor! I never thought I'd say that!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The shadow-born have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan protected Gu Hanshan. My brother would laugh. Or cry. Both. The Zhao clan does both at once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Among the fallen Blood Moon cultivators: a boy of fifteen, unhurt, too frightened to run.

choices.text: Send him home to his mother

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Bring him to the sect to be judged

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Make him carry your gear, unpaid

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

quests.title: Zhao Kang and Gu
quests.summary: Zhao Kang asks Gu Hanshan one last question. It's not the one anyone expected.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: I asked you once why you sent my brother. You told me. I've got a different question now. Did he suffer?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...No. It was quick. He was brave. He was protecting a caravan. He died between them and the bandits. Standing.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Standing. Good. That's... good. Thank you. That's all I needed. Go and finish your requests.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: Here is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: A good healer asks what hurts. A great one asks why.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumpling, my sword, is ready. I'm ready. My stomach is always ready.

objectives.choice_prompt: Wei Tong asks what you really think of the sect's precepts.

choices.text: They keep us from becoming the Blood Moon

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Kindness first. Precepts after.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: That's why people follow you, you know.

choices.text: They're tools. Use them when they help you.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: Letters to a Dead Girl
quests.summary: The third request: twenty years of unsent letters to Gu Lan. He wants to burn them, the way you burned Luo Hui's.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The letters. To Lan. Twenty years. You burned the First Rung's letters. You sent them, you said. Send mine.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

objectives.text: Gather Gu's letters to his daughter
Burn the letters at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The letters burn. The ash rises over the sea of clouds and goes up, and up. Gu watches it until it's gone. He doesn't cry. He smiles.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Delivered. Twenty years late. She had better manners than me. She'll read them anyway.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: You gave me water once, on the bone field, when the rules said no. I never thanked you. Thank you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.choice_prompt: Before the last letter burned, you read one line: the name of Gu Lan's poisoner, alive in another sect.

choices.text: Let it lie. Gu has forgiven.

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. She would have liked you.

choices.text: Send it to that sect's Law Hall

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Correct. I taught that once. I should have listened.

choices.text: Hunt him down yourself

reply.speaker: elder_gu
reply.text: Hm. The Law Hall would have your hide.

quests.title: The Sect Master and the Traitor
quests.summary: At the end, the Sect Master comes to the moon gate. She and Gu Hanshan talk for the first time in years.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Forty years, Hanshan. I trusted you with our law and our children.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: And I broke both. Qingyao. I have a way through the black gate. When the moon rises, I'll use it. Don't stop me.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: ...I won't. Come back, if you can. That's not a request. It's what I say to everyone. I'm saying it to you too.

objectives.text: Talk with the hermit at the scholar rock

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Sit. Breathe. The forest will wait. It is very good at waiting.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: The precepts are older than your grief, and mine.

quests.title: Sitting With the Traitor
quests.summary: On the last night of his requests, Gu Hanshan asks you to sit with him at the moon gate. He doesn't want to be alone.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Sit with me. Just sit. I've been alone for twenty years, even in company. Tonight I'd like not to be.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Sit with Gu Hanshan at the moon gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You sit with the man who betrayed everything, under a red moon, in silence. It isn't forgiveness. It's company. It might be the same thing.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Thank you. For the sitting. For everything. You'd have made a good Law Hall elder. You listen twice. Go and sleep.

quests.title: The Hermit's Blessing
quests.summary: The hermit comes to the moon gate at dawn and blesses Gu Hanshan with the Heart Sutra. Gu weeps, at last.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. Even for you, Gu Hanshan. Especially for you. Compassion doesn't choose who deserves it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: ...I'm crying. I haven't cried since Lan. Thank you, Verdant Lotus. Your sect was always kinder than ours.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: I have a hundred elders and one sect. Some days I would trade the elders for a nap.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Shadows Over Qingshi
quests.summary: A crane from Constable Du: shadows over Qingshi at dusk. Hundreds. And a young man in red, standing on the watchtower.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: A crane from Constable Du. Hundreds of shadows over Qingshi. And a young man in red on the watchtower. Xue Chen.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Qingshi's gate is shut. The sky above the town is thick with drifting shadow-born, circling like crows over a field.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Hundreds of them. Circling. Not attacking. Waiting. The boy on the tower's waiting too. He hasn't moved in an hour.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Town Knows What to Do
quests.summary: Qingshi knows what to do. It's held before. Everyone takes their place without being asked.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: Children in the cellar with the wine. Again. They've never touched the wine. Well. Once. That boy. He's a guard now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang's men came back from the rim to help. Clean ones. Fed ones. They know this town. They tried to burn it once. Now they'll hold it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.text: Meet Magistrate Zhou at the yamen

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: I've written a speech. One word. You know the word. Everyone knows the word.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Magistrate Zhou admits the town's grain tally was fudged to feed the refugees.

choices.text: Keep it quiet. It fed people.

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Insist the books be put right

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take a cut for your silence

reply.speaker: magistrate_zhou
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Boy on the Tower
quests.summary: Xue Chen stands on the watchtower, looking down at the town. He isn't giving orders. He's watching the children.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Xue Chen stands on the watchtower. Below him, children run to the inn cellar. He watches them. He looks like he's trying to remember something.

objectives.text: Look at Xue Chen with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In soul sight, the thread from him to the fold is thick and red. And somewhere in it, very small, a boy from Willow Creek, pulling the other way.

objectives.text: Show Ye Wuming what you found

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He's pulling against his own thread. Very weakly. But pulling. There's a door there. A small one. Let's knock.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: The Shadows Fall
quests.summary: At full dark, the Patriarch pulls the thread, and every shadow-born over Qingshi falls on the town at once.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: They're coming down! All of them! Everyone to your places! Magistrate, the word! Say the word!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. The magistrate shouts one word from the yamen steps. Hold. Every door in Qingshi slams, and every hand picks up something.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the main street

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-born spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

dialogue.speaker: magistrate_zhou
dialogue.text: Hold! I said hold! They held! We held! I'm going to say it again! Hold!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: The River Assault
quests.summary: The shadows come up the river too, where Old Pan's ferry is still crossing with the last farmers.

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Shadows on the water! My ferry's out there! Full of farmers! Forty years! I'm not losing a passenger now!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the docks

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The shadow-born come on in silence.

objectives.text: Hold the terraced fields against more Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: Every farmer across. Every one. I hit a shadow with an oar. It felt the same as the wolf. Wonderful. Every time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: Xue Chen Watches
quests.summary: Through the fighting, Xue Chen doesn't move from the tower. When the shadows falter, he speaks to you, from far away.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: They're holding. A town of mortals, holding against the shadow of the Patriarch. With brooms. Why?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Because they carry each other. Come down, cousin. Carry something with us.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...I can't. He's pulling. He's my father. He's the only thing I've ever had. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry.

objectives.text: Talk with Old Pan at the docks

dialogue.speaker: ferryman_pan
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Find Merchant Jin at the guild warehouse

dialogue.speaker: merchant_jin
dialogue.text: We're done at here. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

quests.title: Blood for the Moon
quests.summary: The shadows aren't trying to win. They're trying to spill blood, anywhere, for the moon. Some of it has already soaked the graves.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the hill graves, shadow-born are drawing a circle in blood, the old way, Hong's way. They've nearly finished.

objectives.text: Clear the hill graves of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: More shadow-born? Heaven must think we're bored.

objectives.text: Gather the blood-soaked earth before the moon drinks it
Talk it over with Liu Er

dialogue.speaker: liu_er
dialogue.text: The circle's broken! I broke it with the broom! The broom is a hero! Everybody's going to hear about the broom!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xue Chen's captives are tied at the river. Freeing them now weakens the gate.

choices.text: Free them now

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: {senior}, that was... I want to be like that one day.

choices.text: Hold the gate, as ordered

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: The ninth precept! You did the ninth precept!

choices.text: Use the captives as a shield

reply.speaker: liu_er
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Last Wave at the Gate
quests.summary: The last wave of shadows hits the town gate. Constable Du holds it with his ugly new spear.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Last wave! At the gate! My spear's ugly! It's the best spear in the world! Everyone with a spear, with me! For Qingshi!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Your ward rises over the gate. Constable Du's ugly spear catches the light. Behind him, forty clean bandits and a town full of brooms.

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Left side's mine. Right side's yours. Middle is whoever's faster.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of shadow-born

dialogue.speaker: constable_du
dialogue.text: Held. Qingshi held. Again. I'm going to write it down. In the good ink. Then I'm going to sleep for a week.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The Blood Guards left a purse of spirit stones behind, and a wounded straggler.

choices.text: Return the stones to the people they robbed

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Heaven bless you, immortal. We won't forget.

choices.text: Turn stones and straggler over to the sect

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: Proper. Very proper. Good.

choices.text: Pocket the stones and leave the straggler

reply.speaker: constable_du
reply.text: (backing away) As you say, immortal.

quests.title: The Empty Tower
quests.summary: When the last shadow falls, the watchtower is empty. Xue Chen is gone. He left something on the rail.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The watchtower is empty. On the rail, a small carved horse, very old, the kind a child might carry from a village by a creek.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Carved on its belly, in a child's scratches: Chen. Willow Creek. He left it for you. Or for himself. Or both.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Ye Wuming

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He left the only thing he brought from home. That's not a threat. That's a boy asking someone to hold his toy while he does something terrible.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Qingshi Holds, Again
quests.summary: Dawn over Qingshi. The town is scarred, tired and whole. Madam Fang opens the cellar. The children still haven't touched the wine.

dialogue.speaker: innkeeper_fang
dialogue.text: The children didn't touch the wine. Not one sip. I'm so proud. I'm going to give them some. Just a thimble. For bravery.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Join Widow Liu at the town well

dialogue.speaker: widow_liu
dialogue.text: Heaven keeps its accounts. So do I. Qingshi owes you everything. We're square. You owe us nothing. Come back anyway.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Setting the Rung Early
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane arrives on fire: Xue Chen is on the peak, setting his rung, a week early. Come now.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Her crane was on fire. Xue Chen, on the peak, setting his rung early. Go. Han Xue and Zhao Kang are already at the stair.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Make your way to the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The isles are dark. The moon is nearly red. On the tribulation peak, a thread of red light rises into the sky like smoke from a fire.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: He's on my peak. Setting his rung. Tying the ladder to the sky. If he finishes, the Patriarch has seven steps to climb your lightning.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Break it. Before the moon. Before he finishes. Go. I'll shout. I'm shouting now. GO.

objectives.choice_prompt: A dead courier's satchel holds silver for Blood Moon informers, and their names.

choices.text: Burn the names; they were desperate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: That was kindly done. Remember how it felt.

choices.text: Give the names to the magistrate

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Keep the silver

reply.speaker: star_sage
reply.text: (a long silence) I did not teach you that.

quests.title: Shadows on the Bridge
quests.summary: The shadow-born hold the jade bridge, the way to the peak. Han Xue says she'll hold it for you. Not yet. Soon.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Shadows on the bridge. I'll hold it. Not tonight, the real night. Tonight we just go through. Together.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the jade bridge

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Here they come. Strike first, apologise never.

objectives.text: Finish the shadow-born at the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Through. The bridge is ours. On the night, I'll stand right here. Nothing crosses. I've decided. It's my bridge now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Delta Holds
quests.summary: The forty crystals you planted on the peak's lower slopes are holding off Xue Chen's thread. The shadows are trying to smash them.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the lower slopes, your forty crystals glow, bending the red thread away from the summit. Shadows claw at them.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born spill out of cover, weapons bright.

objectives.text: Plant fresh crystals to strengthen the delta
Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The delta's holding. Your founder's plan. Bai's ceiling. Thunder Peak's anvils. All holding. Now go up there and talk to your cousin.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: The Rung on the Peak
quests.summary: On the summit, Xue Chen kneels in the black rings, weaving a thread of red into the sky. He's crying.

objectives.text: Hurry to the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: On the summit, in the black rings of old tribulations, Xue Chen kneels, weaving a red thread into the sky. His face is wet.

objectives.text: Watch the rung through the star chart

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The seventh star flickers. Bright, dim, bright. He's setting it. And un-setting it. Over and over. He can't decide.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He can't decide. He's setting it and pulling it out. He's been doing it for hours, the star-gazer says. He's breaking himself.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

objectives.choice_prompt: Something valuable lies here, unclaimed: a purse of spirit stones.

choices.text: Report it to the sect

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Leave it for whoever lost it

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Pocket it quietly

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Good. Rules are for people who've never been hungry.

quests.title: Talking to the Shadow
quests.summary: You call across the gap to Xue Chen. He hears you. He doesn't stop weaving, but he answers.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Cousin! Xue Chen! You left me your horse. I've got it. I'll keep it safe. Come down and take it back.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: Keep it. I can't come down. If I stop, he'll pull me. If I finish, he'll climb you. Every choice is someone falling.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: I'm going to the mirror. The Heart Mirror. Where I can see myself before. Come find me there. When the moon's almost red.

objectives.text: Hear what Ye Wuming has to say

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Keep walking, lotus-bearer.

objectives.text: Meet the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; the cloud gate isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: When I was a disciple, I thought sect masters knew everything. I was wrong, and now it's my problem.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xue Chen asks whether you would spare him, if he gave up his rung.

choices.text: Yes. I would.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Good. Heaven notices kindness, even when people don't.

choices.text: The alliance court would decide

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Order is a kindness too, when it is fair.

choices.text: No. Never.

reply.speaker: master_yun
reply.text: Power without a heart. We fought a war against exactly that.

quests.title: Storm Wolves on the Peak
quests.summary: When Xue Chen steps into a rift, his thread snaps, and the whole peak crackles. The storm wolves go wild.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: He's gone! The thread snapped! The peak's crackling! The storm wolves are going mad! Of course they are!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Defeat the storm wolves at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A shout goes up. The storm wolves have found you first.

objectives.text: Cut down the celestial sentinels that follow
Look for Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: The seventh star is still lit. But it's not tied to the peak any more. He left it loose. On purpose, I think. He's giving you a chance.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Standing on the Black Rings
quests.summary: Qing Luan asks you to stand on the summit's black rings, where your tribulation will fall, and let the peak learn you.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (sighs) I can see the precepts sliding off you like rain.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Punctual, correct, precepts in order. You make an old teacher's work easy.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Stand on the rings. Where you'll stand on the night. Let the peak learn your weight. It should know who it's holding up.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.text: Let the tribulation peak learn you

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The black rings hum under your feet: ten thousand years of cultivators who stood here and were answered. They're curious about you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Fifth layer of Tribulation Transcendence. Halfway to the sky.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Peak. You're ready. The sky's ready. The moon's nearly ready. Only the Shadow isn't. Go to the mirror. Go and find your cousin.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Warm Jade for Qing Luan
quests.summary: Before you go, you give Qing Luan a piece of tribulation jade. She has never been given anything.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: (warmly) {player}. The mountain speaks well of you. Come, sit.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: For me? Jade? Warm forever? I'm a memory. Memories don't get gifts. Nobody's given me anything in ten thousand years.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Gather silk to wrap Qing Luan's jade

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Wrapped in silk from my own pines. It's warm. I can feel it. Memories can't feel warmth. I can. You broke a rule of the universe.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: See You on the Night
quests.summary: At the cloud gate, Qing Luan says goodbye, of a sort. She says she'll see you on the night. She'll be the one shouting.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: On the night, I'll be here. At the gate. When his soul crosses my bridge, I'll see it. I'll shout. Loudly. Finally.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Ten thousand years I watched and said nothing. This time I'll shout so loudly the Patriarch will hear it in the lightning.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And I'll be on the bridge. Nothing crosses. See you on the night, star-gazer. Frown at me fondly.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Always, sword girl. Always.

quests.title: Down to the Mirror
quests.summary: Ye Wuming reads the snapped thread. Xue Chen has gone to the Heart Mirror, at the bottom of the world, to wait for you.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The mirror. He's at the mirror. Looking at himself before. Waiting for you. Or for courage. Maybe both.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: The fold's opening. The gate's nearly back. When you go to the mirror, the whole Abyss will be waking. Be quick. Be kind. If you can.

objectives.text: Find Qing Luan at the star pavilion

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: A Holiday
quests.summary: The Sect Master stands on the plaza and declares one last holiday. No training. No war. Only an evening.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: One evening. No training. No preparations. No war. Tomorrow the moon turns red. Tonight, we're a sect. Just a sect. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Lanterns everywhere. On the pillars, the eaves, the trees. The formation glows blue beneath them. Somebody is already singing, badly.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: One evening. I've been cooking for three days. Dumplings. Every kind. Every kind that exists. Some that don't. Come and eat.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Dumplings for Everyone
quests.summary: Wei Tong's dumplings, for the whole mountain. Every kind. The twelve serve. The chicken supervises.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Still breaking rules? Good. Someone has to keep the elders awake.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You're so proper lately. It's unnerving. Do something wrong. Once.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Dumplings! Pork! Cabbage! Lotus root! Peach! Peach dumplings are new! Elder Mo's peaches! In dumplings! He'd hate it!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Carry Wei Tong's dumplings around the plaza
Leave a peach dumpling on the hall steps

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A peach dumpling on the hall steps, beside the morning's cold tea, where Elder Mo stood. Everybody who passes bows to it.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: He'd hate the peach dumpling. He'd eat three. I'm leaving him three.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

quests.title: Everyone Talks
quests.summary: The whole mountain wants to talk to you tonight. Everyone has something to say. Nobody says goodbye.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: I made you a pill. It's probably a pill. It's for luck. Or indigestion. Take it anyway. I only dropped it once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's crying. I'm crying. We're both very happy. It's a strange night. Thank you. I'll keep saying it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: I've finished copying Elder Mo's manual. Every 'no'. I've added one at the end. In my hand. It says: adequate.

objectives.choice_prompt: Elder Bai asks you to vouch for a friend's examination, though you've never seen their work.

choices.text: Vouch anyway

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: Hm. Unorthodox. It worked. Don't make a habit of it.

choices.text: Refuse. Vouching must be honest.

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: By the rules, and rightly so.

choices.text: Vouch, for a favour later

reply.speaker: elder_bai
reply.text: I will remember this, {player}. So will heaven.

quests.title: Lanterns on the Cliff
quests.summary: Lu Ping has organised a lantern release from the cliff edge, like the examination, years ago. Everyone writes a wish.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: (quietly) Hello, {senior}. I'll be good. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: {senior}! I tried to do a kind thing like you did. It went wrong. But I tried!

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Lanterns! From the cliff! Like the examination! Everyone writes a wish! I've written mine already! It says 'win the betting book'!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Gather lanterns for the whole sect
Release your lantern over the sea of clouds

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A thousand lanterns over the sea of clouds. Yours says the same as it did years ago: to be strong enough to protect people.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beside it, Zhao Kang's lantern. It says: to beat you. And underneath, smaller: when you come back down.

objectives.text: Meet Zhao Kang at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't read other people's lanterns. It's still the worst manners in the sect. What did yours say? No. I know what it said.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: The Hermit's Song
quests.summary: The hermit sings the Heart Sutra on the plaza, all three verses, and three hundred disciples who learned it in the ruins sing with him.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. Everyone who learned it in my masters' courtyard. Sing it with me. Loudly. The whole mountain.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Three hundred voices, then a thousand, then the whole mountain. The green lotus in the pond opens as wide as it can. The carp bow.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: My masters sang this while the water rose. I ran. Tonight the whole Azure Cloud sings it. They hear. I know they hear.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Uninvited to the Last Evening
quests.summary: The shadows come on the last evening, as they always do. The sect doesn't stop singing while it fights them.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Shadows on the back path! Thunder Peak's got it! We're shouting the sutra at them! It's working! It's very loud!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Ring the cliff bell over the singing

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The bell rings. Nobody stops singing. Thunder Peak shouts the sutra. The twelve sing it. The shadows, confused, retreat from a mountain that won't be afraid.

objectives.text: Drive the shadow-born from the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Stay close! I am not writing to your family.

objectives.text: Stop the Blood Moon cultivators regrouping

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: They ran from singing! Thunder Peak has never won a fight by singing! We're adding it to the forge! Next to your name!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Han Xue on the Bridge
quests.summary: Han Xue finds you on the stone bridge. She wants to say something. She says it very stiffly.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the moon. Then the gate. Then the sky. I'll hold the bridge on the isles. Nothing crosses. I promised.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And the sparring match. You still owe me. I'm going to keep saying it until you pay, so you have to come back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: After, Senior Sister.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: After. Good. That's all. Don't make it weird. ...Thank you. For the plum garden. Both times. That's all.
