objectives.text: Talk with Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: I trained three puppets this morning. They cried. Well, one creaked.

objectives.text: Find Zhao Kang at the plum garden

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: The Zhao clan does not panic. It becomes strategically alarmed.

objectives.choice_prompt: Zhao Kang quietly admits to breaking a sect rule to help someone.

choices.text: Promise to keep the secret

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

choices.text: Urge them to confess to the elders

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Remember it. Leverage is useful.

reply.speaker: rival_zhao
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Main Hall, Quiet
quests.summary: Late at night you use the key the Sect Master gave you: the main hall, quiet, with the founder's tablet and the faded green lotus.

objectives.text: Sit in stillness beneath the lanterns

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Silence, lanterns and the pond. You carry the whole mountain one last time as a disciple. Tomorrow you carry it as something else.

objectives.text: Join the Sect Master at the main hall

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You found the quiet. Good. I came to find it too. Let's share it. Say nothing. That's what it's for.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

quests.title: Steward Qian's Account
quests.summary: At midnight, Steward Qian finds you with the empty account he opened in your name years ago. He wants to close it.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Your account. Opened before the descent. I said I don't open accounts for people who don't come back. It's still empty.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: I'm not closing it. I'm keeping it open. Forever. You'll fill it. When you come back down. I don't make bad investments.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: Here is clear. For now. Nothing stays clear for long these days.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

objectives.text: Hear what Xiao Shi has to say

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Everyone still has all their fingers? Good. Count them again, to be sure.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

objectives.choice_prompt: Steward Qian's last account shows a surplus nobody knows about.

choices.text: Give it to the war widows

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Return it to the treasury

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Keep it for after the war

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: Dawn, and the Moon
quests.summary: At dawn the whole sect is still awake. The moon sets. When it rises tonight, it will be red. Tomorrow, the Abyss.

objectives.text: Go and see the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Tonight it rises red. We go to the rim at dusk. Every sect meets us there. First, Ye Wuming asked for you. At the mirror. Go.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Right away.

objectives.text: Meet Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go. Find your cousin. Be kind. Come back for breakfast. I'm making more dumplings. I'm always making more dumplings.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Fortress Returns
quests.summary: At the rim, the fold is opening like a hand unclenching. Out of it, slowly, the black fortress drifts back into the world.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Below the rim, the fold unclenches. The black fortress drifts out of nothing and settles onto the Abyss floor with a sound like a mountain sighing.

objectives.text: Talk with Ye Wuming at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's back. The gate. The court. The cages. Exactly where it was. As if it never left. As if nobody waited years for it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: The cages. My sister. She's there. Frozen, mid-shout. I can see the cage from here. Iron-Fang is very calm. Iron-Fang is not calm.

quests.title: The Fortress Wakes
quests.summary: With the fortress back, its guards wake. They've been frozen too. They don't know how long.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Blood Guards! Out of the fortress! They don't know how long they've been gone! They look confused! Confused is good!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: You can count on me.

objectives.text: Clear the field of bones of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Blood Guards ahead! Don't let them surround us!

objectives.text: Hold the war camp against more Blood Moon cultivators

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale's vanguard is here. Three thousand more at the teleport array. Remembering Hill came to the Abyss. We remember.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Gate, Shut
quests.summary: The black gate stands shut, carved with a moon swallowing a sword. It only opens from inside, or with a token.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Beyond the obelisk ring, the black gate stands shut. Taller than the main hall. Silent. Carved with a moon swallowing a sword.

objectives.text: Look at the gate with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gate is sealed from inside. Nothing will open it from here. Not qi, not soul, not forty sects. Only someone the gate thinks is its own.

objectives.text: Show Elder Gu what you found

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: It opens from inside. I know. I have a way. Tomorrow, under the moon, I'll use it. Don't ask what. You'll see.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Ye Wuming's Children Take Their Places
quests.summary: Ye Wuming's children, grown now, take their places at the obelisk ring. They've been waiting for this their whole lives.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Spring. River. Small Mountain. All of them. Grown. They'll hold the obelisk ring tomorrow. They know every path. They were born to them.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll see what I can find.

objectives.text: Make your way to the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Spring bows to you. River hums the Moon-Well song. Small Mountain, very tall now, says nothing, and salutes.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: My name. It's very close. Tomorrow, maybe. When he falls. I think I'll remember it when he falls. I'll tell you.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: Ye Wuming's children want to fight at the front. The youngest is barely grown.

choices.text: Send the youngest to the rear

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Let each of them choose

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Ha. Knew there was a bandit in you somewhere.

choices.text: Put them all at the front

reply.speaker: wanderer_ye
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: Shadows at the Mirror Path
quests.summary: The path down to the Heart Mirror is thick with shadow-born, guarding the way to their master's son.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The path past the blood pools to the depths is crowded with shadow-born, standing very still, like mourners at a gate.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The shadow-born spread out to surround you. They are not quite fast enough.

objectives.text: Gather void shards from the guarding shadows
Talk it over with Xiao Shi

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I know the path. I drew it. I'll lead you as far as the depths. Then you go alone. That's what he asked for. Alone.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Iron-Fang at the Rim
quests.summary: Iron-Fang stands at the rim looking at his sister's cage. His forty men stand behind him, washed and fed, silent.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Tomorrow. The gate opens tomorrow. Then the cages. Then my sister shouts at me for twenty years of being late.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Go and find your cousin, sect brat. Be kind to him. He's someone's sister's son too. Everyone is.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Well. That happened. I'll tell the story better tomorrow.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Thank you. I'll keep saying it until you're sick of it.

objectives.text: Join Ruan Jingtao at the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Quiet now. I don't trust quiet. Let's keep moving.

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: Your mountain is taller. Ours is wider. We're both very proud of that.

quests.title: The Depths
quests.summary: At the bottom of the Abyss, the last shadows gather in the depths, around the path to the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I came down. Obviously. I'll hold the depths while you go to the mirror. Go. Alone. That's what he wanted.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't let you down.

objectives.text: Break the shadow-born at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Steel whispers. The shadow-born come on in silence.

objectives.text: Face the next wave of Blood Guards

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: The depths are clear. The mirror's waiting. He's waiting. Go and be kind. Or go and win. Whichever you have to.

objectives.choice_prompt: One of the Blood Guards is still alive, clutching a wound and begging for his life.

choices.text: Bind his wound and let him go

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Hand him over to face the law

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: End it. He would have killed you.

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Remind me never to owe you money.

choices.text: Make him swear to serve you, then let him run

reply.speaker: senior_han
reply.text: Rules are for people without your luck.

quests.title: Before the Mirror
quests.summary: At the edge of the depths, before you go to the mirror, you sit and remember Willow Creek. You want to bring it with you.

objectives.text: Remember Willow Creek before the mirror

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A creek, a willow, a woman singing. A cousin you never met, three years old, laughing. A carved horse in your hand.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: You're taking the village with you. Good. Show it to him. Show him what the mirror shows him. Maybe it'll be enough.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Medicine at the Rim
quests.summary: While you prepare, the Moon-Well's healers arrive at the rim with Xiao Man's medicine bundles. Eight thousand notes saying 'come home'.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: My sister's bundles. Eight thousand. Every one says come home. Or eat this, idiot. Take one. For the mirror.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Already going.

objectives.text: Take a medicine bundle for the mirror

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: The note in yours says: come home, cousin-finder. She knew. My sister always knows. She drops things. She knows things.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

quests.title: Alone to the Mirror
quests.summary: Ye Wuming walks you to the last turn of the path. Then he stops. The rest you walk alone.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: This is as far as I go. He asked for you alone. Be kind to him. He's what I would have been, if nobody had stolen me back.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: And if you can't steal him back... end it quickly. For him. Not for the ladder. For him.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The broken obelisks lean together like old men sharing a secret.

objectives.text: Hear what Iron-Fang has to say

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Hold still, you've got a scratch. There. Now you look heroic instead of careless.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Say no more.

objectives.choice_prompt: Iron-Fang still carries a blade taken in the old days. Its owner's family lives nearby.

choices.text: Urge them to give it back

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Let the magistrate decide

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Offer to sell it for them, for a cut

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Boy at the Mirror
quests.summary: Xue Chen sits cross-legged at the edge of the Heart Mirror, looking into it. In it, a boy of three is laughing by a creek.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Xue Chen sits at the mirror's edge. In the black water, a boy of three holds his mother's hand by a creek, laughing, over and over.

objectives.text: Meet Xue Chen at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: You came alone. Thank you. Sit. Look. That's me. Before. I come here every day. It's the only place I'm not his.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: Two Cousins
quests.summary: You sit beside him and look into the mirror together. It shows you both: two children from the same village.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Willow Creek. I was born there too. My mother sang by the creek. Your mother might have heard her.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...The mirror's showing both of us now. Two children. Same creek. One taken at three. One not. Why you and not me?

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I don't know. Luck. A mother who ran. Nothing I earned. Come with me, Chen. Leave his shadow. There's still time.

objectives.text: Talk with Iron-Fang at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: I've seen worse days. Not many, but some.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Eventually.

objectives.text: Find Xiao Shi at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: We're done at the obelisk ring. Whatever comes next, I'd rather meet it with a full stomach.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: I draw maps now. It helps, knowing where the walls are.

objectives.choice_prompt: Xiao Shi mentions a junior stealing food from the kitchens for a sick friend.

choices.text: Cover the food yourself

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: I'm going to tell everyone at the gate about this.

choices.text: Report it; the kitchens have rules

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: That's exactly what the precepts say! I memorised them!

choices.text: Tell the junior you'll stay quiet, for a price

reply.speaker: xiao_shi
reply.text: (looking at the ground) Oh. Okay.

quests.title: The Thread
quests.summary: In soul sight, the thread from Xue Chen to the fold is so thick it's a chain. And it's pulling.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A red chain runs from Xue Chen's back into the dark, toward the fortress. It tightens as you speak. Something at the other end has noticed.

objectives.text: Touch the red chain with your soul

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: At the other end of the chain, on a throne of fused bone, something that was once a man opens one eye. Mine, it says. My shadow. Mine.

objectives.text: Share your findings with Xue Chen

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: He felt you touch it. He's pulling. He's going to make me fight you. I'm sorry. I'm so sorry. I tried. Keep the horse.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: A sealed jade slip lies here, stamped with another sect's seal.

choices.text: Return it to its sect unread

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: Obedient little heir.

choices.text: Read it first. Knowledge is knowledge.

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: No rules. Careful. That's how it starts.

choices.text: Sell it to the highest bidder

reply.speaker: rung_chen
reply.text: There it is. The thing your elders pretend you don't have.

quests.title: Shadows of the Shadow
quests.summary: The Patriarch pulls, and Xue Chen's own shadow-born pour out of the mirror's dark edges.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Shadow-born pour out of the mirror's edges, faceless, silent. Xue Chen screams at them to stop. They don't. They never listened to him.

objectives.text: Stop the shadow-born at the Heart Mirror

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Shadow-born! Back to back, and mind your footing!

objectives.text: Finish the Blood Guards at the abyss depths
Find Han Xue after the fight

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I said I'd hold the depths. I'm holding them. Ye Wuming's here. Iron-Fang's here. You're not alone. You never were. Finish it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Ye Wuming Tries
quests.summary: Ye Wuming comes to the mirror after all. He can't stay away. He tries to steal Xue Chen back.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Chen. I was you. Forty years ago. A shadow's child. Someone stole me back. Let me steal you. Let go of the chain.

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: I can't. It's not a chain. It's him. He's inside it. If I let go, I let go of... everything I've ever been.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Then let go of that. Be something new. I did. It hurts. It's worth it. Please.

objectives.text: Join Xue Chen at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: ...I'm trying. I'm trying. He won't let me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

quests.title: The Seventh Rung Breaks
quests.summary: The Patriarch pulls the chain with all his strength, and Xue Chen rises, eyes red, sword drawn, weeping. The last Rung fights.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Xue Chen rises. His eyes are red now, all the way through. His sword is drawn. His face is wet. His voice is someone else's.

objectives.name: Xue Chen, the Patriarch's Shadow
objectives.text: Bring down Xue Chen, the Patriarch's Shadow

dialogue.speaker: rung_chen
dialogue.text: I was born in his shadow. I will die in yours. Forgive me, cousin. The moon is almost full.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I forgive you, Chen. Now let's break his chain together.

objectives.text: Break the red chain as Xue Chen falls

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The chain snaps. The red drains from Xue Chen's eyes. He falls into your arms, light as a child. Willow Creek, he says. I remembered.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: His star goes out. The Patriarch's Ladder has no rungs left. Far away, on a throne of bone, something howls.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: He died free. In your arms, not his. That's stealing him back. The only way that was left. I'm going to cry now. Let me.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Seven Stars Out
quests.summary: Qing Luan's crane finds you at the bottom of the world. It's shouting, and crying, and shouting again.

objectives.text: Make your way to the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A crane of cloud, burning at the edges, shouts in Qing Luan's voice: seven stars out. Seven. The ladder's gone. He'll have to jump.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Gu has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: No ladder. His power has no root now. Only what he carries in himself. Tomorrow, under the moon, he'll be weaker than he's been in three hundred years.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: And more desperate. Desperate is dangerous. I know. I was desperate once.

quests.title: Lotus for a Cousin
quests.summary: Where Xue Chen fell, blood lotus grows, pink and pale. You gather it to bury with him.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_shi
dialogue.text: Pink lotus. Where he fell. Like where Tan was freed, at the pools. Your village grows wherever you go now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Consider it done.

objectives.text: Gather the pink lotus where he fell
Meet Iron-Fang at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: We'll bury him at the rim. Next to my men's names. He was Willow Creek. My men burned Willow Creek. I'll carry that. Iron-Fang carries two.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes. I think so too.

objectives.choice_prompt: The alliance wants Xue Chen's body hung at the black gate, as a warning.

choices.text: Bury him at the rim, with the lotus

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Soft. Soft wins more fights than people think.

choices.text: Give him to the alliance

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Proper as a magistrate. Hm.

choices.text: Hang him yourself

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Careful. I know where that road ends.

quests.title: Burying a Cousin
quests.summary: At the rim, under a moon that is almost red, you bury Xue Chen with his carved horse and a handful of pink lotus.

objectives.text: Bury Xue Chen at the rim

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: A small grave at the rim, next to Iron-Fang's eleven carved names. A carved horse. Pink lotus. Chen, of Willow Creek. Free.

objectives.text: Talk with Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Tomorrow the moon. Tonight, rest. Everyone's coming. The whole sect. Forty sects. We march at dusk. Go home. Sleep. Eat something.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll remember.

quests.title: Home for the Night
quests.summary: You go home for one night. The moon is almost full, almost red. Tomorrow at dusk, the Azure Cloud marches.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I'll stay at the rim. With the children. And him. Tomorrow at dusk. We'll be at the obelisks. My name's very close now.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Understood.

objectives.text: Find Elder Gu at the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I'll come back up with you. In chains. The Sect Master will want me at the gate tomorrow. I have a way. You'll see.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: Forty Sects on the Steps
quests.summary: From dawn, the nine thousand steps are full: Iron Scale green, Zhao gold, Moon-Well white, and forty more colours, climbing.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Forty sects! On the steps! All at once! It's the longest line in history! I'm counting! I've lost count! I'm starting again!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Easy enough. Famous last words, I know.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The processional way is a river of banners. Eleven thousand fighters, climbing. At the gate, they bow to the two steles: the precepts, and the oath.

objectives.text: Join Ruan Jingtao at the sect gate

dialogue.speaker: young_ruan
dialogue.text: The Iron Scale. Three thousand. My father's leading. He brought his crooked bow. He's very proud of it.

dialogue.speaker: abbess_jing
dialogue.text: The Moon-Well. Five hundred healers. We're singing on the steps. Lian's leading. We're here.

objectives.choice_prompt: A spirit crane is caught in a poacher's snare nearby.

choices.text: Free it and bind its wing

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: You're too nice. It's annoying. I like it.

choices.text: Report the poachers to the sect

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it for its feathers

reply.speaker: young_ruan
reply.text: (quietly) That was cold, {player}. Even for a war.

quests.title: The Battle Plan
quests.summary: The Sect Master spreads Xiao Shi's map of the Abyss on the plaza and makes her plan in front of forty sect masters.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The war camp, the obelisk ring, the black gate. Every sect has a place. I'll give the plan at the rim, where they can all hear it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Leave it to me.

objectives.text: Study Xiao Shi's map with the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The map shows every path, every door, every cage. At the black gate, the Sect Master has drawn a single character: Gu.

objectives.text: Go back to the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You go through the gate, to the throne. I'll be behind you. I'll give the full plan at the rim. Now go and say see you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I know.

quests.title: Not Goodbye
quests.summary: Everyone says see you later. Nobody says goodbye. It's the rule now.

dialogue.speaker: xiao_man
dialogue.text: See you later. I've made you a bundle. It says come home, idiot. In big letters. I didn't drop it. Not once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be careful. Mostly.

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: See you later. Hold out your wrist. Hm. Stubborn pulse. Good. Come back and let me take it again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Mm.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Bai has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_bai
dialogue.text: See you later. I've written the whole saga down. Every chapter. I'm saving the last page. You'll write it.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: All right.

quests.title: The Hermit Stays
quests.summary: The hermit won't march. He's too old, he says. He'll stay and teach the children who are too young to go.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: I won't march. I'm too old, and someone has to sing to the ones who stay. I'll be in the pagoda. With Qiu Hua. And the chicken.

dialogue.speaker: hermit_lan
dialogue.text: Root, stem, blossom. You've grown all three. Go and finish what my masters started. And come back. The tea will be steeping.

objectives.text: Meet Lu Ping at the gate post

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Breathe. In for four, out for four. Good. Now we go on.

dialogue.speaker: gate_lu
dialogue.text: Heard the latest? No? Neither have I. Give me an hour.

objectives.text: Talk with Yan Tie at the cliff edge

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: That's the last of it here. Catch your breath; here isn't done with us yet.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: I owe you a rematch and a life. The rematch is easier to pay.

quests.title: The Treasury Opens
quests.summary: Steward Qian opens the treasury for the march. All of it. He doesn't count what leaves. He counts who does.

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: (starts to kneel, then catches themself) Heavens. You feel like weather now, did you know?

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: The treasury is open. All of it. I'm not counting stones tonight. I'm counting people. I'm going to count every one of you back in.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll report back when it's done.

objectives.text: Carry the treasury's supplies to the array

dialogue.speaker: steward_qian
dialogue.text: Everything's at the array. Every stone. Every pill. I've never been so poor. I've never been so proud.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Thank you.

objectives.choice_prompt: There's not enough of the treasury's best for everyone who marches.

choices.text: Arm the weakest first

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: Most cultivators wouldn't have. Thank you.

choices.text: Arm by rank

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: The magistrate would approve. So do I.

choices.text: Take the best for yourself

reply.speaker: steward_qian
reply.text: (nervously) Y-yes. Of course. Whatever the immortal wishes.

quests.title: The Last Shadows
quests.summary: The Patriarch sends everything he has left at the gathering army. It's not much, now. It's still something.

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Shadows! The last ones! Thunder Peak's got the gate! We're shouting the sutra! Everyone's shouting the sutra!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Then I'd better start walking.

objectives.text: Defeat the shadow-born at the outer pines

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: Steady. Breathe. Then hit them very hard.

objectives.text: Cut down the Blood Moon cultivators that follow

dialogue.speaker: yan_tie
dialogue.text: The last shadows! Gone! Forty sects shouting the sutra at once! You could hear it from the isles! The star-gazer probably did!

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I hear you.

quests.title: Iron-Fang and Gu
quests.summary: Iron-Fang and Gu Hanshan meet at the teleport array. The bandit and the traitor. Both waiting to pay a debt.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Traitor. You took my token, years ago. The blood-red one. From my strongbox. What did you do with it?

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: I kept it, Iron-Fang. You'll see. Tomorrow. Your sister will see too. I promise.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: ...A traitor's promise. I've heard worse. I've made worse. Fine. See you at the gate, traitor.

objectives.text: Find Han Xue at the quiet pavilion

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Not bad. Not bad at all. Remind me to be scared of you later.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: On my way.

objectives.text: Join Wei Tong at the weapon rack

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: You fight like the mountain taught you personally.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll be quick.

quests.title: The Last Stillness
quests.summary: An hour before dusk, you sit on the teleport array and carry everyone: forty sects, eleven thousand, a town, a mountain.

objectives.text: Carry the whole army in stillness

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Eleven thousand breaths. Forty sects. A town with brooms. A mountain with lanterns. A chicken. You carry them all, and they carry you.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The sun touches the sea of clouds. Far to the west, the moon begins to rise. It is exactly the colour of the Patriarch's robes.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: The moon. It's red. Properly red. I'm not afraid. I'm terrified. It's fine. Terrified is fine. Elder Mo was always terrified. He said so once.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I won't forget it.

objectives.choice_prompt: A wandering cultivator offers you a pill that 'skips the hard parts'.

choices.text: Refuse. Your foundation must be honest.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: By the book. The Law Hall would weep with joy.

choices.text: Take it to the Medicine Hall to be tested

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Fair enough. Can't argue with that.

choices.text: Swallow it. Power is power.

reply.speaker: senior_wei
reply.text: Ha! The elders are going to hate that. I love it.

quests.title: The Array Wakes
quests.summary: At dusk the teleport array wakes, every rune blazing, the route to the Abyss rim open. The Azure Cloud goes to war.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The teleport array blazes. Eleven thousand fighters wait in rows. The Sect Master stands at the front, crown on, sword drawn.

objectives.text: Light the teleport array for the march

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The runes catch. The air smells of rain. One by one, the sects step onto the array, and vanish, toward the Abyss and the red moon.

objectives.text: Tell Zhao Kang what you found

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Remember the wager. I'm not saying goodbye. I'm saying I'll see you up there, complaining. It's better.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Yes.

quests.title: Under the Last Blood Moon
quests.summary: The last of the army crosses. Han Xue waits for you at the array's edge. The moon is full and red over the sea of clouds.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Everyone's crossed. The Sect Master's waiting at the rim. Iron-Fang's army. Forty sects. Ye Wuming's children. All of them.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Let's go and finish it. Together. Like the letter in the reliquary said. Not alone.

objectives.text: Hear what Elder Hua has to say

dialogue.speaker: elder_hua
dialogue.text: That was close. Closer than I'd like. Let's not do it like that again.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I'll handle it.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

quests.title: The Last Blood Moon
quests.summary: The Azure Cloud Sect marches on the Blood Moon Abyss.

objectives.text: Watch the Azure Cloud Sect gather at the Abyss
Receive the battle plan from the Sect Master

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Wei Tong and Zhao Kang break the war camp. Ye Wuming's people take the obelisk ring. Gu will open the black gate.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You go through the gate, to the throne. I'll be behind you, holding the sect together.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Whatever happens, {player}, you are not carrying this alone. Remember the letter in the reliquary.

objectives.text: Speak with Iron-Fang at the canyon rim

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: My men are ready. Forty bandits, washed and fed, which is a first. They're a bit confused about it.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Their families are behind that gate. We'll follow you through anything, sect brat. Sorry. Sect hero.

objectives.text: Stand with Han Xue at the canyon mouth

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: Stay alive. That's not a request, it's what the Sect Master said, and I'm saying it louder.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: And after, when this is done, you owe me a proper sparring match. No holding back.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: After, Senior Sister. I promise.

quests.title: Breaking the Line
quests.summary: The Blood Moon army holds the field of bones and the war camp. Break through.

objectives.text: Break the Blood Guard line on the field of bones

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: For Elder Mo! Hey, Elder, are you watching? Watch this one!

objectives.text: Burn the Blood Moon war camp

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Left side's mine, {player}! You can have the right side. It's smaller.

objectives.text: Regroup with Wei Tong at the blood pools

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: We did it! The camp's burning, and I've only lost one bun. It was a very brave bun.

dialogue.speaker: senior_wei
dialogue.text: Go on. The gate's ahead. Elder Mo would've said something grumpy and encouraging. Pretend I did.

quests.title: The Black Gate
quests.summary: The fortress gate can only be opened from inside. Gu Hanshan has a way in.

objectives.text: Meet Gu Hanshan at the obelisk ring

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Remember the blood-red token you took from Iron-Fang's chest? The one I confiscated? I kept it.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: It's a command token. With it, the gate guards will let me in. They don't know yet what I have become.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: They'll kill you when they find out.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Yes. I've made my peace with that. It is the first peace I have felt in twenty years.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The gate is black iron, carved with a moon swallowing a sword. It is taller than the main hall. It is utterly silent.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Then, from inside, the sound of fighting. One man against many.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: You strike the seal with the Lotus Key. From the other side, someone pulls the great bar. The black gate groans open.

quests.title: Court of Crimson
quests.summary: Fight through the fortress courtyard, and find the man who opened the gate.

objectives.text: Kneel beside Gu Hanshan at the gate

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Ah. You came. I held them... as long as I could. I was always better at law than fighting.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Tell the sect... tell them the Law Hall is empty now. Fill it with someone kinder than me.

dialogue.speaker: elder_gu
dialogue.text: Lan... is waiting. I think she'll let me apologise. Thank you, {player}.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The last locks fall. Mothers, children, old men stumble into the red light, blinking, alive.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: They're here. All of them. My sister. My men's wives, their children. Alive.

dialogue.speaker: bandit_tie
dialogue.text: Iron-Fang pays his debts. Today, in full. My blade is yours until the Patriarch's head is on the floor.

objectives.choice_prompt: In the last cage, a Blood Guard begs to be freed with the rest.

choices.text: Free him

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: You'd have been a terrible bandit. It's a compliment.

choices.text: Leave him for the alliance's judges

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Rules. You sects and your rules. ...It was the right call.

choices.text: Leave him to rot

reply.speaker: bandit_tie
reply.text: Now you're speaking my old language. I don't miss it.

quests.title: The Shattered Altar
quests.summary: The Altar of Blood still feeds the Patriarch. Destroy it, and let the void teach you what remains.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The altar cracks from top to bottom. Three hundred years of stolen blood pours out and soaks away into the stone.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: It's done. His power has no root now. Only what he carries in himself.

objectives.text: Still your soul in the silence of the void

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: In the silence after the altar breaks, you sink inward. Past body, past qi, past soul, to the empty place beneath.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nothing is there. And nothing is exactly enough. You rise with the stillness of the void in your bones.

quests.title: The Blood Moon Patriarch
quests.summary: Xue Wuji waits on his throne, and he has been waiting for three hundred years.

objectives.text: Cut down the Patriarch's throne guards

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: Come then, little lotus. Show me the body I will wear to heaven.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: My body stays mine, Xue Wuji. So does my heart.

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: We shall see how long you hold them both.

objectives.text: Find Ye Wuming in the abyss depths

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: His body is dust. But his remnant soul tore free and fled upward. To the Sky Isles.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: Your breakthrough has drawn heaven's eye. Your tribulation is gathering. He means to steal it, and ascend in your place.

dialogue.speaker: wanderer_ye
dialogue.text: I have my name back, {player}. The children have theirs. Go. Finish it. We'll hold the abyss.

quests.title: Pursuit to the Heavens
quests.summary: The Patriarch's remnant has fled to the Sky Isles. Follow it before the tribulation begins.

objectives.text: Meet Qing Luan at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: You're back early. Also, the sky is on fire. I assume those two facts are related.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: A remnant soul crossed my bridge an hour ago. It is climbing toward the tribulation peak, possessing everything it touches.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Heaven's lightning is gathering for you, lotus child. Get to the peak before he does.

objectives.text: Fight through the possessed Blood Guards on the jade bridge
Speak with Han Xue on the Isle of Winds

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I followed you through the array. Obviously. Did you think I'd let you face the sky alone?

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: I'll hold the bridge. Nothing else crosses. Go.

dialogue.speaker: senior_han
dialogue.text: {player}... you still owe me that sparring match. Don't you dare ascend without paying your debts.

quests.title: Remnants of the Blood Moon
quests.summary: The remnant has corrupted the immortal garden. Clear the way and prepare lightning rods of thunder crystal.

objectives.text: Purge the possessed cultivators in the garden
Gather thunder crystals to ground the tribulation
Charge the crystals at the spirit vein

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The crystals drink from the vein until they hum. Planted on the summit, they will split heaven's lightning like a river delta.

objectives.text: Speak with Zhao Kang at the celestial ruins

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Don't look at me like that. Of course I came. Someone has to witness your triumph and complain about it.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Swear something to me. When you come back down, we fight. Properly. And I win.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: When I come back down, Zhao Kang. And you'll lose.

dialogue.speaker: rival_zhao
dialogue.text: Ha! That's the spirit. Go. The sky is waiting, and it has terrible manners.

quests.title: Heavenly Tribulation
quests.summary: The heavenly tribulation descends on the summit, and the Patriarch's remnant rides the lightning.

objectives.text: Survive the heart tribulation and destroy the remnant

dialogue.speaker: patriarch_xue
dialogue.text: The ninth bolt is the heart tribulation. I will be your heart, little lotus.

dialogue.speaker: heart_demon
dialogue.text: Hello again, {player}. He found me in the mirror. He says we can share.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: I beat you once. I'll do it as often as it takes.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Nine times nine. The storm over the peak is so large it has its own weather. The first volley is already falling.

objectives.text: Endure the nine bolts of heavenly lightning

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The lightning comes. First, second, third. Your body breaks and remakes itself. Fourth, fifth, sixth. Your qi burns white.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Seventh, eighth. The remnant screams as the lightning finds it, and there is nothing left of Xue Wuji but ash on the wind.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: The ninth bolt strikes, and it does not hurt at all. It feels like the sky, saying your name.

quests.title: Immortal Ascension
quests.summary: The Ascension Stair has opened. Say your farewells, and climb.

objectives.text: Say farewell to the Sect Master at the cloud gate

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: The stair has opened for you. Three hundred years, and our sect has its first immortal.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: You don't have to go. The heavens will wait. They have nothing but time.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: If I stay, the stair closes, and nobody climbs it again for a thousand years. Someone should see what's up there.

dialogue.speaker: master_yun
dialogue.text: Then go, {player}. And look down on us sometimes. We'll be the ones waving.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: Sixty years I waited here for someone worth the climb. It was worth it. Don't tell anyone I said so.

dialogue.speaker: star_sage
dialogue.text: At the top, you'll find a door. Knock politely. Heaven is very sensitive about manners.

dialogue.speaker: narrator
dialogue.text: Each step is made of light. Below, your friends grow small. Han Xue raises her sword in salute. Zhao Kang pretends not to cry.

dialogue.speaker: player
dialogue.text: Elder Mo. Mother. Everyone. Thank you.

bonus.note: Grateful people press medicine into your hands.
Frightened people pay you to go away. You take it.
The Law Hall records your conduct with approval.
Rules bent, lessons learned the hard way.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Three hundred years ago, the Azure Cloud and the Verdant Lotus sealed a monster beneath the earth, and the world forgot.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Only the Azure Cloud Sect remembers. It keeps its watch on this mountain, above the sea of clouds.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Every spring, its gate opens to those with the talent and stubbornness to climb nine thousand steps.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: This spring, an orphan with nothing but a jade pendant reached the top.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: The Azure Cloud Sect. I made it, Mother.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The teleport array flares, and the mountain is gone. In its place, bamboo, green and endless, whispering in the wind.

shots.speaker: senior_wei
shots.text: First mission outside the walls! Don't wander off, don't eat red mushrooms, and don't pet anything with more than four eyes.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Whispering Bamboo Forest. Spirit herbs grow here, and spirit wolves hunt here. Usually they leave cultivators alone.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Usually.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Qingshi Town. Rice fields, a river, a market, and a temple where the kindly keeper buries the dead.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Every new moon, somebody vanishes. Every morning after, the town pretends not to notice.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Almost everybody.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Visitors from the mountain! How wonderful. May the ancestors bless your journey, young immortals.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: Eyes open, {junior}. Towns that smile this hard are usually hiding something.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Clever children. Too clever. Keeper Hong was such a comfortable face. I wore it for eleven years.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The old man's skin splits like a husk. Beneath it: black and crimson robes, and eyes the colour of blood.

shots.speaker: keeper_hong
shots.text: Deacon Hong Lie of the Blood Moon. The Patriarch stirs, lotus-bearer, and he dreams of you.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: Acolytes in the alley! {player}, he's running for the graves!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: North of the wolf dens, where even the bamboo grows quiet, the forest hides something older than any sect alive.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Verdant Lotus Sect. Once it stood beside the Azure Cloud as an equal. Now its name is a footnote.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Its ruins keep their secrets well. But stones cannot be cut out of a book.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: So. The lotus comes home at last. I had hoped to be dead before it did.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Three hundred years ago the Blood Moon Patriarch drowned three kingdoms in blood, reaching for the heavens.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Our sect master and your founder bound him beneath the Abyss. The seal needed two keys, and a price.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: The Verdant Lotus paid it. Every elder gave their life to the seal. The Patriarch's servants hunted the rest of us.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: One disciple fled with the Lotus Key and a baby girl. Her line hid among mortals for three centuries.

shots.speaker: hermit_lan
shots.text: Your mother's pendant, child, is that key. And you are the last of the Verdant Lotus.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once every three years, the Azure Cloud Sect raises its banners for the Inner Sect Tournament.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Disciples of the Azure Cloud! Fight hard, fight fair, and whoever breaks the formation tiles pays for them.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: The victor will stand beside me and learn the secrets of the Azure Eye. Show heaven what this sect is made of.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: In the crowd, not everyone is watching the fighters.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Nine to one odds. Lu Ping had better not be wrong about me.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The pagoda doors hang open. Scrolls lie scattered like fallen leaves. And at the heart of the mess stands the Law Hall Elder.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: You were supposed to be watching the final, disciple. Everyone was supposed to be watching the final.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Elder Gu. The token, the missions, the pages, the pills. It was you. All of it.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: I did what a father does. Heaven took my daughter. The Blood Moon offered her back. You would have done the same.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Gu Hanshan! Put down the diagram and kneel, or I will strike you down where you stand.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: Forty years of loyalty, Sect Master, and you never once asked why I stopped smiling. Kill them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Blood Moon Abyss. A wound in the earth, three hundred years deep, where the moon is always red.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once a kingdom stood here. Its people were the Patriarch's first harvest.

shots.speaker: senior_han
shots.text: It stinks of old blood. Stay behind me. No. Stay beside me. Where I can see you.

shots.speaker: wanderer_ye
shots.text: Step where I step. Breathe when I breathe. Welcome to the place I was born.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Blood from the broken obelisks still trickles along the channels, up the dais, into the great altar.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: The diagram is delivered, Patriarch. The Azure Eye's design is in your hands. Now keep your promise. Give me my Lan.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: Patience, loyal Gu. When I walk again, you will have everything you deserve. Everything.

shots.speaker: crimson_xuemei
shots.text: Master, the lotus-bearer is here. The little lamb has come to the altar all by itself.

shots.speaker: elder_gu
shots.text: Disciple. You should not have come. Xue Mei, keep it alive. The Patriarch needs the body intact.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Blood Moon comes to Qingshi on the third night: demon cultivators, blood-fed wolves, and Iron-Fang's bandits beside them.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Their banners rise on the graveyard hill, above empty graves the town has only just refilled.

shots.speaker: rival_zhao
shots.text: I count four hundred. Maybe five. I'd count better if they stood still.

shots.speaker: magistrate_zhou
shots.text: People of Qingshi! Last time, we hid. We locked our doors and let a monster feed on our children. Not this time!

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Then we hold. Every street, every house, every wall. Not one more grave.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Once every sixty years the clouds part, and the Celestial Sky Isles drift down within reach of mortal arrays.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Here, where immortals once lived, star iron falls like rain and thunder grows in the rocks like crystal flowers.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Everything is floating. The whole world is floating.

shots.speaker: rival_zhao
shots.text: Please stop saying floating. Say resting on very tall air.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And at the highest point, the summit where heavenly tribulation strikes, waits the stair that climbs to heaven.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation stands complete: star iron pillars, thunder crystals, a web of ten thousand runes.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Outer ring. Seventh branch. This rune turns outward. It should turn inward. Why would it turn outward?

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: The Law Hall archive. Thirty years of Gu's hands on every page. Oh, you fool. You poor, grieving fool.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Above the sea of clouds, the moon rises, and for the first time in three hundred years, it rises red.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The water does not ripple. Your reflection rises from it, dripping darkness, wearing your face like a mask.

shots.speaker: heart_demon
shots.text: Hello, {player}. Don't you recognise me? I'm every time you were afraid, and pretended you weren't.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: I know what you are. A heart demon. You feed on doubt.

shots.speaker: heart_demon
shots.text: Then I'll never go hungry. Let me in. I'll carry the key for you. Isn't it heavy? Isn't it so very heavy?

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation roars like a furnace, blood-red, pulling the mountain's qi downward into the dark.

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: Stay back, all of you! Seven runes. I can turn seven runes. I just need something big enough to push them.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Elder Mo, no! Let me help, I have the Lotus Key!

shots.speaker: elder_mo
shots.text: The key is for tomorrow, {junior}. Tonight is for old men. Back straight, now. Crooked spine, crooked meridian.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Elder Mo Changfeng burns his core, his soul and seventy years of cultivation in a single breath. The red light turns blue.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Mo Changfeng. Elder of the Outer Court. You stubborn, stubborn old man.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Under the last blood moon, the Azure Cloud Sect goes to war: elders, disciples, a bandit's army and a traitor in chains.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: Three hundred years ago our founders stood here and did not finish the job. We will finish it.

shots.speaker: master_yun
shots.text: For Mo Changfeng. For the Verdant Lotus. For everyone this Abyss has swallowed. Azure Cloud, advance!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Beyond the black gate, on a throne of fused bone, something that was once a man opens its eyes.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Xue Wuji, Patriarch of the Blood Moon. Three kingdoms drowned for his ambition. Three centuries of hunger in the dark.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: The last of the Verdant Lotus. Do you know how long I have waited for you? Your great-grandmother's great-grandmother escaped me.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: You broke Gu with grief. You tried to break me with fear. It didn't work.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: Then I will break you the old way. With my hands. Come, little lotus. Show me my new body.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Above the summit, the clouds spiral into a black eye nine miles wide. Heaven has seen you. Heaven is coming.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: Nine bolts. Elder Bai said nobody knows what the ninth one is. Wonderful.

shots.speaker: patriarch_xue
shots.text: I know, little lotus. The ninth is the heart. And I will be waiting inside it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Ascension Stair opens, step by step, a road of light from the summit into the clouds.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Below, the Sect Master bows. Han Xue raises her sword. Zhao Kang shouts something rude, and wipes his eyes.

shots.speaker: player
shots.text: I'll come back. Maybe not soon. But I'll come back.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And {player}, last of the Verdant Lotus, disciple of the Azure Cloud, climbs into the heavens.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: The Great Azure Formation holds. The Blood Moon Abyss is sealed, and this time, the seal will last ten thousand years.

shots.speaker: senior_wei
shots.text: Lead with your feet, not your elbows! And whoever breaks the puppet buys lunch. For Elder Mo!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: An old hermit teaches the Verdant Lotus Heart Sutra in the pagoda. Every morning, more students come.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: Xiao Man grows herbs. She only drops some of them. Her brother writes every week.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.text: And on clear nights, above the sea of clouds, one star blinks twice, as if someone up there were waving.
